  intro γ hγ
  simp [Forest.empty] at hγ

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.Forest.singleton_isPairwiseDisjoint
statement:
theorem singleton_isPairwiseDisjoint
    (γ : FeynmanSubgraph G) (hγ : γ.IsDivergent) :
    (singleton γ hγ).IsPairwiseDisjoint
proof:
:= by
  intro γ₁ hγ₁ γ₂ hγ₂ hne
  rw [mem_singleton_elements] at hγ₁ hγ₂
  exact (hne (hγ₁.trans hγ₂.symm)).elim

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.Forest.IsPairwiseDisjoint.eq_of_mem_vertices
statement:
theorem IsPairwiseDisjoint.eq_of_mem_vertices
    {F : Forest G} (hF : F.IsPairwiseDisjoint)
    {γ₁ γ₂ : FeynmanSubgraph G}
    (hγ₁ : γ₁ ∈ F.elements) (hγ₂ : γ₂ ∈ F.elements)
    {v : VertexId} (hv₁ : v ∈ γ₁.vertices) (hv₂ : v ∈ γ₂.vertices) :
    γ₁ = γ₂
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  have hdisjoint : γ₁.Disjoint γ₂ := hF hγ₁ hγ₂ hne
  exact (Finset.disjoint_left.mp hdisjoint hv₁) hv₂

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.Forest.IsConnectedDivergentElements.isElements
statement:
theorem IsConnectedDivergentElements.isElements
    {s : Finset (FeynmanSubgraph G)}
    (h : IsConnectedDivergentElements (G := G) s) :
    IsElements (G := G) s
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, h.2⟩
  intro γ hγ
  exact (h.1 γ hγ).isDivergent

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.Forest.ofElements_elements
statement:
@[simp] theorem ofElements_elements
    (s : Finset (FeynmanSubgraph G)) (h : IsElements (G := G) s) :
    (ofElements (G := G) s h).elements = s
proof: := rfl

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.Forest.ofConnectedDivergentElements_elements
statement:
@[simp] theorem ofConnectedDivergentElements_elements
    (s : Finset (FeynmanSubgraph G))
    (h : IsConnectedDivergentElements (G := G) s) :
    (ofConnectedDivergentElements (G := G) s h).elements = s
proof: := rfl

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.Forest.ofConnectedDivergentElements_isConnectedDivergent
statement:
theorem ofConnectedDivergentElements_isConnectedDivergent
    (s : Finset (FeynmanSubgraph G))
    (h : IsConnectedDivergentElements (G := G) s) :
    (ofConnectedDivergentElements (G := G) s h).IsConnectedDivergent
proof:
:= by
  intro γ hγ
  exact h.1 γ hγ

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.Forest.connectedDivergent_elements
statement:
@[simp] theorem connectedDivergent_elements (F : Forest G) :
    F.connectedDivergent.elements =
      F.elements.filter (fun γ => γ.IsConnectedDivergent)
proof: := rfl

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.Forest.connectedDivergent_isConnectedDivergent
statement:
theorem connectedDivergent_isConnectedDivergent (F : Forest G) :
    F.connectedDivergent.IsConnectedDivergent
proof:
:= by
  intro γ hγ
  exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hγ).2

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.Forest.singleton_isConnectedDivergent
statement:
theorem singleton_isConnectedDivergent
    (γ : FeynmanSubgraph G) (hγ : γ.IsConnectedDivergent) :
    (singleton γ hγ.isDivergent).IsConnectedDivergent
proof:
:= by
  intro γ' hγ'
  rw [mem_singleton_elements] at hγ'
  exact hγ' ▸ hγ

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.Forest.connectedDivergent_le
statement:
theorem connectedDivergent_le (F : Forest G) :
    F.connectedDivergent ≤ F
proof:
:= by
  rw [le_def']
  exact Finset.filter_subset _ _

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.Forest.mem_connectedDivergentIndex_isConnectedDivergent
statement:
theorem mem_connectedDivergentIndex_isConnectedDivergent
    (G : FeynmanGraph) [DivergenceMeasure G] [Fintype (FeynmanSubgraph G)]
    {F : Forest G} (hF : F ∈ connectedDivergentIndex G) :
    F.IsConnectedDivergent
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold connectedDivergentIndex at hF
  rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hF with ⟨s, _hs, hFs⟩
  rw [← hFs]
  exact ofConnectedDivergentElements_isConnectedDivergent s.1
    ((Finset.mem_filter.mp s.2).2)

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.Forest.mem_connectedDivergentIndex_of_isConnectedDivergent
statement:
theorem mem_connectedDivergentIndex_of_isConnectedDivergent
    (G : FeynmanGraph) [DivergenceMeasure G] [Fintype (FeynmanSubgraph G)]
    (F : Forest G) (hF : F.IsConnectedDivergent) :
    F ∈ connectedDivergentIndex G
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold connectedDivergentIndex
  refine Finset.mem_image.mpr ?_
  refine ⟨⟨F.elements, ?_⟩, by simp, ?_⟩
  · rw [Finset.mem_filter]
    refine ⟨by simp, ?_⟩
    refine ⟨hF, ?_⟩
    intro γ₁ hγ₁ γ₂ hγ₂ hne
    exact F.nestedOrDisjoint hγ₁ hγ₂ hne
  · exact Forest.ext rfl

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.elements_def
statement:
@[simp] theorem elements_def (A : AdmissibleSubgraph G) :
    A.elements = A.forest.elements
proof: := rfl

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_vertices
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_vertices {A : AdmissibleSubgraph G} {v : VertexId} :
    v ∈ A.vertices ↔ ∃ γ ∈ A.elements, v ∈ γ.vertices
proof:
:= by
  simp [vertices]

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.vertices_subset
statement:
theorem vertices_subset (A : AdmissibleSubgraph G) :
    A.vertices ⊆ G.vertices
proof:
:= by
  intro v hv
  rcases mem_vertices.mp hv with ⟨γ, _hγA, hvγ⟩
  exact γ.vertices_subset hvγ

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_internalEdges
statement:
theorem mem_internalEdges {A : AdmissibleSubgraph G} {e : FeynmanEdge} :
    e ∈ A.internalEdges ↔ ∃ γ ∈ A.elements, e ∈ γ.internalEdges
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold internalEdges
  induction A.elements using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
      simp
  | insert γ s hγs ih =>
      simp [Finset.sum_insert, hγs, ih, Multiset.mem_add]

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_ambientInternalEdges_of_mem_complementEdges
statement:
theorem mem_ambientInternalEdges_of_mem_complementEdges
    (A : AdmissibleSubgraph G) {e : FeynmanEdge}
    (he : e ∈ A.complementEdges) :
    e ∈ G.internalEdges
proof:
:=
  Multiset.mem_of_le (Multiset.sub_le_self _ _) he

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.count_lt_of_mem_complementEdges
statement:
theorem count_lt_of_mem_complementEdges
    (A : AdmissibleSubgraph G) {e : FeynmanEdge}
    (he : e ∈ A.complementEdges) :
    Multiset.count e A.internalEdges < Multiset.count e G.internalEdges
proof:
:= by
  unfold complementEdges at he
  rw [Multiset.mem_sub] at he
  exact he

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.complementEdges_erase
statement:
theorem complementEdges_erase
    (A : AdmissibleSubgraph G) (e : FeynmanEdge) :
    A.complementEdges.erase e =
      G.internalEdges.erase e - A.internalEdges
proof:
:= by
  unfold complementEdges
  refine Multiset.ext.mpr (fun x => ?_)
  by_cases hxe : x = e
  · subst hxe
    rw [Multiset.count_erase_self, Multiset.count_sub,
      Multiset.count_sub, Multiset.count_erase_self]
    omega
  · rw [Multiset.count_erase_of_ne hxe, Multiset.count_sub,
      Multiset.count_sub, Multiset.count_erase_of_ne hxe]

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.componentAt_mem
statement:
theorem componentAt_mem (A : AdmissibleSubgraph G)
    {v : VertexId} (hv : v ∈ A.vertices) :
    A.componentAt hv ∈ A.elements
proof:
:=
  (Classical.choose_spec (mem_vertices.mp hv)).1

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.componentAt_vertex_mem
statement:
theorem componentAt_vertex_mem (A : AdmissibleSubgraph G)
    {v : VertexId} (hv : v ∈ A.vertices) :
    v ∈ (A.componentAt hv).vertices
proof:
:=
  (Classical.choose_spec (mem_vertices.mp hv)).2

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.componentAt?_of_not_mem
statement:
@[simp] theorem componentAt?_of_not_mem (A : AdmissibleSubgraph G)
    {v : VertexId} (hv : v ∉ A.vertices) :
    A.componentAt? v = none
proof:
:= by
  unfold componentAt?
  rw [dif_neg hv]

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.componentAt?_of_mem
statement:
theorem componentAt?_of_mem (A : AdmissibleSubgraph G)
    {v : VertexId} (hv : v ∈ A.vertices) :
    A.componentAt? v = some (A.componentAt hv)
proof:
:= by
  unfold componentAt?
  rw [dif_pos hv]

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.componentAt?_eq_some_mem
statement:
theorem componentAt?_eq_some_mem
    {A : AdmissibleSubgraph G} {v : VertexId} {γ : FeynmanSubgraph G}
    (h : A.componentAt? v = some γ) :
    γ ∈ A.elements
proof:
:= by
  unfold componentAt? at h
  split_ifs at h with hv
  · injection h with hγ
    rw [← hγ]
    exact A.componentAt_mem hv

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.componentAt?_eq_some_vertex_mem
statement:
theorem componentAt?_eq_some_vertex_mem
    {A : AdmissibleSubgraph G} {v : VertexId} {γ : FeynmanSubgraph G}
    (h : A.componentAt? v = some γ) :
    v ∈ γ.vertices
proof:
:= by
  unfold componentAt? at h
  split_ifs at h with hv
  · injection h with hγ
    rw [← hγ]
    exact A.componentAt_vertex_mem hv

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.ext
statement: theorem ext {A B : AdmissibleSubgraph G} (h : A.forest = B.forest) : A = B
proof:
:= by
  cases A
  cases B
  simp_all

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.empty_forest
statement:
@[simp] theorem empty_forest :
    (empty G).forest = Forest.empty G
proof: := rfl

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.empty_elements
statement:
@[simp] theorem empty_elements :
    (empty G).elements = ∅
proof: := rfl

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.empty_vertices
statement:
@[simp] theorem empty_vertices :
    (empty G).vertices = ∅
proof:
:= by
  rw [vertices, empty_elements]
  simp

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.empty_internalEdges
statement:
@[simp] theorem empty_internalEdges :
    (empty G).internalEdges = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [internalEdges, empty_elements]
  simp

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.empty_complementEdges
statement:
@[simp] theorem empty_complementEdges :
    (empty G).complementEdges = G.internalEdges
proof:
:= by
  rw [complementEdges, empty_internalEdges]
  simp

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.singleton_forest
statement:
@[simp] theorem singleton_forest (γ : FeynmanSubgraph G)
    (hγ : γ.IsConnectedDivergent) :
    (singleton γ hγ).forest = Forest.singleton γ hγ.isDivergent
proof: := rfl

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.singleton_elements
proof: := rfl

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.singleton_vertices
statement:
@[simp] theorem singleton_vertices (γ : FeynmanSubgraph G)
    (hγ : γ.IsConnectedDivergent) :
    (singleton γ hγ).vertices = γ.vertices
proof:
:= by
  rw [vertices, singleton_elements]
  simp

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.singleton_internalEdges
statement:
@[simp] theorem singleton_internalEdges (γ : FeynmanSubgraph G)
    (hγ : γ.IsConnectedDivergent) :
    (singleton γ hγ).internalEdges = γ.internalEdges
proof:
:= by
  rw [internalEdges, singleton_elements]
  simp

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.singleton_complementEdges
statement:
@[simp] theorem singleton_complementEdges (γ : FeynmanSubgraph G)
    (hγ : γ.IsConnectedDivergent) :
    (singleton γ hγ).complementEdges = γ.complementEdges
proof:
:= by
  rw [complementEdges, singleton_internalEdges]
  rfl

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_singleton_elements
proof:
:= by
  simp [singleton, elements]

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.singleton_injective
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : γ₁ ∈ (singleton γ₂ hγ₂).elements := by
    rw [← h]
    simp
  exact mem_singleton_elements.mp hmem

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem
statement:
theorem isConnectedDivergent_of_mem (A : AdmissibleSubgraph G)
    {γ : FeynmanSubgraph G} (hγ : γ ∈ A.elements) :
    γ.IsConnectedDivergent
proof:
:=
  A.isConnectedDivergent γ hγ

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.isDivergent_of_mem
statement:
theorem isDivergent_of_mem (A : AdmissibleSubgraph G)
    {γ : FeynmanSubgraph G} (hγ : γ ∈ A.elements) :
    γ.IsDivergent
proof:
:=
  (A.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem hγ).isDivergent

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.singleton_hasNonemptyComponents
proof:
:= by
  intro γ' hγ'
  rw [mem_singleton_elements] at hγ'
  subst γ'
  exact hγne

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.singleton_hasPositiveInternalEdgesComponents
proof:
:= by
  intro γ' hγ'
  rw [mem_singleton_elements] at hγ'
  subst γ'
  exact hγEdges

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.componentAt_eq_of_mem_vertices
statement:
theorem componentAt_eq_of_mem_vertices
    {A : AdmissibleSubgraph G} (hA : A.IsPairwiseDisjoint)
    {γ : FeynmanSubgraph G} (hγ : γ ∈ A.elements)
    {v : VertexId} (hv : v ∈ A.vertices) (hvγ : v ∈ γ.vertices) :
    A.componentAt hv = γ
proof:
:= by
  exact hA.eq_of_mem_vertices
    (A.componentAt_mem hv) hγ
    (A.componentAt_vertex_mem hv) hvγ

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.componentAt?_eq_some_of_mem_vertices
statement:
theorem componentAt?_eq_some_of_mem_vertices
    {A : AdmissibleSubgraph G} (hA : A.IsPairwiseDisjoint)
    {γ : FeynmanSubgraph G} (hγ : γ ∈ A.elements)
    {v : VertexId} (hvγ : v ∈ γ.vertices) :
    A.componentAt? v = some γ
proof:
:= by
  have hv : v ∈ A.vertices := by
    rw [mem_vertices]
    exact ⟨γ, hγ, hvγ⟩
  rw [A.componentAt?_of_mem hv]
  rw [A.componentAt_eq_of_mem_vertices hA hγ hv hvγ]

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.retargetVertex_of_not_mem
statement:
@[simp] theorem retargetVertex_of_not_mem
    (A : AdmissibleSubgraph G) (starOf : FeynmanSubgraph G → VertexId)
    {v : VertexId} (hv : v ∉ A.vertices) :
    A.retargetVertex starOf v = v
proof:
:= by
  rw [retargetVertex, componentAt?_of_not_mem A hv]

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.retargetVertex_of_mem_component
statement:
theorem retargetVertex_of_mem_component
    {A : AdmissibleSubgraph G} (hA : A.IsPairwiseDisjoint)
    (starOf : FeynmanSubgraph G → VertexId)
    {γ : FeynmanSubgraph G} (hγ : γ ∈ A.elements)
    {v : VertexId} (hvγ : v ∈ γ.vertices) :
    A.retargetVertex starOf v = starOf γ
proof:
:= by
  rw [retargetVertex, componentAt?_eq_some_of_mem_vertices hA hγ hvγ]

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.retargetEdge_source
statement:
@[simp] theorem retargetEdge_source
    (A : AdmissibleSubgraph G) (starOf : FeynmanSubgraph G → VertexId)
    (e : FeynmanEdge) :
    (A.retargetEdge starOf e).source = A.retargetVertex starOf e.source
proof: := rfl

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.retargetEdge_target
statement:
@[simp] theorem retargetEdge_target
    (A : AdmissibleSubgraph G) (starOf : FeynmanSubgraph G → VertexId)
    (e : FeynmanEdge) :
    (A.retargetEdge starOf e).target = A.retargetVertex starOf e.target
proof: := rfl

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.retargetEdge_sector
statement:
@[simp] theorem retargetEdge_sector
    (A : AdmissibleSubgraph G) (starOf : FeynmanSubgraph G → VertexId)
    (e : FeynmanEdge) :
    (A.retargetEdge starOf e).sector = e.sector
proof: := rfl

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.retargetExternalLeg_attachedTo
statement:
@[simp] theorem retargetExternalLeg_attachedTo
    (A : AdmissibleSubgraph G) (starOf : FeynmanSubgraph G → VertexId)
    (ℓ : ExternalLeg) :
    (A.retargetExternalLeg starOf ℓ).attachedTo =
      A.retargetVertex starOf ℓ.attachedTo
proof: := rfl

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.retargetExternalLeg_sector
statement:
@[simp] theorem retargetExternalLeg_sector
    (A : AdmissibleSubgraph G) (starOf : FeynmanSubgraph G → VertexId)
    (ℓ : ExternalLeg) :
    (A.retargetExternalLeg starOf ℓ).sector = ℓ.sector
proof: := rfl

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_starVertices
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_starVertices
    {A : AdmissibleSubgraph G} {starOf : FeynmanSubgraph G → VertexId}
    {v : VertexId} :
    v ∈ A.starVertices starOf ↔ ∃ γ ∈ A.elements, starOf γ = v
proof:
:= by
  simp [starVertices]

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.IsFreshStarAssignment.fresh
statement:
theorem IsFreshStarAssignment.fresh
    {A : AdmissibleSubgraph G} {starOf : FeynmanSubgraph G → VertexId}
    (h : A.IsFreshStarAssignment starOf)
    {γ : FeynmanSubgraph G} (hγ : γ ∈ A.elements) :
    starOf γ ∉ G.vertices
proof:
:=
  h.1 γ hγ

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.IsFreshStarAssignment.eq_of_star_eq
statement:
theorem IsFreshStarAssignment.eq_of_star_eq
    {A : AdmissibleSubgraph G} {starOf : FeynmanSubgraph G → VertexId}
    (h : A.IsFreshStarAssignment starOf)
    {γ₁ γ₂ : FeynmanSubgraph G}
    (hγ₁ : γ₁ ∈ A.elements) (hγ₂ : γ₂ ∈ A.elements)
    (hstar : starOf γ₁ = starOf γ₂) :
    γ₁ = γ₂
proof:
:=
  h.2 γ₁ hγ₁ γ₂ hγ₂ hstar

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.IsFreshStarAssignment.star_not_mem_vertices
statement:
theorem IsFreshStarAssignment.star_not_mem_vertices
    {A : AdmissibleSubgraph G} {starOf : FeynmanSubgraph G → VertexId}
    (h : A.IsFreshStarAssignment starOf)
    {v : VertexId} (hv : v ∈ A.starVertices starOf) :
    v ∉ G.vertices
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_starVertices] at hv
  rcases hv with ⟨γ, hγ, rfl⟩
  exact h.fresh hγ

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.IsFreshStarAssignment.disjoint_vertices_starVertices
statement:
theorem IsFreshStarAssignment.disjoint_vertices_starVertices
    {A : AdmissibleSubgraph G} {starOf : FeynmanSubgraph G → VertexId}
    (h : A.IsFreshStarAssignment starOf) :
    Disjoint G.vertices (A.starVertices starOf)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
  intro v hvG hvStar
  exact h.star_not_mem_vertices hvStar hvG

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.IsFreshStarAssignment.disjoint_sdiff_starVertices
statement:
theorem IsFreshStarAssignment.disjoint_sdiff_starVertices
    {A : AdmissibleSubgraph G} {starOf : FeynmanSubgraph G → VertexId}
    (h : A.IsFreshStarAssignment starOf) :
    Disjoint (G.vertices \ A.vertices) (A.starVertices starOf)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
  intro v hvLeft hvStar
  exact h.star_not_mem_vertices hvStar (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hvLeft).1

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.IsFreshStarAssignment.card_starVertices
statement:
theorem IsFreshStarAssignment.card_starVertices
    {A : AdmissibleSubgraph G} {starOf : FeynmanSubgraph G → VertexId}
    (h : A.IsFreshStarAssignment starOf) :
    (A.starVertices starOf).card = A.elements.card
proof:
:= by
  rw [starVertices]
  exact Finset.card_image_of_injOn (by
    intro γ hγ γ' hγ' hstar
    exact h.eq_of_star_eq hγ hγ' hstar)

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.componentFreshStar_not_mem_vertices
statement:
theorem componentFreshStar_not_mem_vertices
    (A : AdmissibleSubgraph G) (γ : FeynmanSubgraph G) :
    A.componentFreshStar γ ∉ G.vertices
proof:
:= by
  intro hmem
  have hlt : A.componentFreshStar γ < FeynmanGraph.freshVertex G.vertices := by
    unfold componentFreshStar
    exact Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Finset.le_sup (f := id) hmem)
  have hle : FeynmanGraph.freshVertex G.vertices ≤ A.componentFreshStar γ := by
    unfold componentFreshStar
    exact Nat.le_add_right _ _
  exact (Nat.not_lt_of_ge hle) hlt

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.componentFreshStar_eq_of_eq
statement:
theorem componentFreshStar_eq_of_eq
    {A : AdmissibleSubgraph G} {γ₁ γ₂ : FeynmanSubgraph G}
    (hγ₁ : γ₁ ∈ A.elements)
    (hstar : A.componentFreshStar γ₁ = A.componentFreshStar γ₂) :
    γ₁ = γ₂
proof:
:= by
  unfold componentFreshStar at hstar
  have hidx :
      A.elements.toList.idxOf γ₁ = A.elements.toList.idxOf γ₂ :=
    Nat.add_left_cancel hstar
  exact (List.idxOf_inj
    (l := A.elements.toList) (x := γ₁) (y := γ₂)
    (Finset.mem_toList.mpr hγ₁)).mp hidx

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.componentFreshStar_isFreshStarAssignment
statement:
theorem componentFreshStar_isFreshStarAssignment
    (A : AdmissibleSubgraph G) :
    A.IsFreshStarAssignment A.componentFreshStar
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro γ _hγ
    exact A.componentFreshStar_not_mem_vertices γ
  · intro γ₁ hγ₁ γ₂ _hγ₂ hstar
    exact componentFreshStar_eq_of_eq hγ₁ hstar

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.contractWithStars_vertices
statement:
@[simp] theorem contractWithStars_vertices
    (A : AdmissibleSubgraph G) (starOf : FeynmanSubgraph G → VertexId) :
    (A.contractWithStars starOf).vertices =
      (G.vertices \ A.vertices) ∪ A.starVertices starOf
proof: := rfl

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.contractWithStars_internalEdges
statement:
@[simp] theorem contractWithStars_internalEdges
    (A : AdmissibleSubgraph G) (starOf : FeynmanSubgraph G → VertexId) :
    (A.contractWithStars starOf).internalEdges =
      A.complementEdges.map (A.retargetEdge starOf)
proof: := rfl

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_contractWithStars_internalEdges
statement:
theorem mem_contractWithStars_internalEdges
    {A : AdmissibleSubgraph G} {starOf : FeynmanSubgraph G → VertexId}
    {e' : FeynmanEdge} :
    e' ∈ (A.contractWithStars starOf).internalEdges ↔
      ∃ e : FeynmanEdge,
        e ∈ A.complementEdges ∧ A.retargetEdge starOf e = e'
proof:
:= by
  rw [contractWithStars_internalEdges]
  exact Multiset.mem_map

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.contractWithStars_eraseInternalEdge_internalEdges
statement:
theorem contractWithStars_eraseInternalEdge_internalEdges
    (A : AdmissibleSubgraph G) (starOf : FeynmanSubgraph G → VertexId)
    {e : FeynmanEdge} (he : e ∈ A.complementEdges) :
    ((A.contractWithStars starOf).eraseInternalEdge
      (A.retargetEdge starOf e)).internalEdges =
        (G.internalEdges.erase e - A.internalEdges).map
          (A.retargetEdge starOf)
proof:
:= by
  rw [FeynmanGraph.eraseInternalEdge_internalEdges,
    contractWithStars_internalEdges]
  rw [← A.complementEdges_erase e]
  symm
  exact Multiset.map_erase_of_mem (A.retargetEdge starOf)
    A.complementEdges he

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.contractWithStars_externalLegs
statement:
@[simp] theorem contractWithStars_externalLegs
    (A : AdmissibleSubgraph G) (starOf : FeynmanSubgraph G → VertexId) :
    (A.contractWithStars starOf).externalLegs =
      G.externalLegs.map (A.retargetExternalLeg starOf)
proof: := rfl

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.retargetVertex_mem_contractWithStars_vertices
statement:
theorem retargetVertex_mem_contractWithStars_vertices
    (A : AdmissibleSubgraph G) (starOf : FeynmanSubgraph G → VertexId)
    {v : VertexId} (hvG : v ∈ G.vertices) :
    A.retargetVertex starOf v ∈ (A.contractWithStars starOf).vertices
proof:
:= by
  rw [contractWithStars_vertices]
  by_cases hvA : v ∈ A.vertices
  · rw [retargetVertex, componentAt?_of_mem A hvA]
    rw [Finset.mem_union]
    right
    rw [mem_starVertices]
    exact ⟨A.componentAt hvA, A.componentAt_mem hvA, rfl⟩
  · rw [retargetVertex_of_not_mem A starOf hvA]
    rw [Finset.mem_union]
    left
    exact Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨hvG, hvA⟩

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.contractWithStars_wellFormed
statement:
theorem contractWithStars_wellFormed
    (A : AdmissibleSubgraph G) (starOf : FeynmanSubgraph G → VertexId)
    (hGwf : G.WellFormed) :
    (A.contractWithStars starOf).WellFormed
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro e he
    rw [contractWithStars_internalEdges] at he
    rcases Multiset.mem_map.mp he with ⟨e₀, he₀, rfl⟩
    have he₀G : e₀ ∈ G.internalEdges :=
      Multiset.mem_of_le (Multiset.sub_le_self _ _) he₀
    have hsupp := hGwf.1 e₀ he₀G
    constructor
    · exact A.retargetVertex_mem_contractWithStars_vertices starOf hsupp.1
    · exact A.retargetVertex_mem_contractWithStars_vertices starOf hsupp.2
  · intro ℓ hℓ
    rw [contractWithStars_externalLegs] at hℓ
    rcases Multiset.mem_map.mp hℓ with ⟨ℓ₀, hℓ₀, rfl⟩
    have hsupp := hGwf.2 ℓ₀ hℓ₀
    exact A.retargetVertex_mem_contractWithStars_vertices starOf hsupp

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.contractWithStars_eraseInternalEdge_step_supportReachable
statement:
theorem contractWithStars_eraseInternalEdge_step_supportReachable
    {A : AdmissibleSubgraph G} (hDisj : A.IsPairwiseDisjoint)
    (starOf : FeynmanSubgraph G → VertexId)
    {e₀ : FeynmanEdge} (he₀ : e₀ ∈ A.complementEdges)
    {u v : VertexId} (h : (G.eraseInternalEdge e₀).SupportAdj u v) :
    ((A.contractWithStars starOf).eraseInternalEdge
      (A.retargetEdge starOf e₀)).SupportReachable
        (A.retargetVertex starOf u) (A.retargetVertex starOf v)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_hne, e, heG, hend⟩ := h
  rw [FeynmanGraph.eraseInternalEdge_internalEdges] at heG
  by_cases heA : e ∈ A.internalEdges
  · rcases mem_internalEdges.mp heA with ⟨γ, hγ, heγ⟩
    have hsupp : e.SupportedOn γ.vertices := γ.edges_supported e heγ
    simp [FeynmanEdge.SupportedOn] at hsupp
    obtain ⟨hsγ, htγ⟩ := hsupp
    have huγ : u ∈ γ.vertices := by
      rcases hend with ⟨hs, _⟩ | ⟨_, ht⟩
      · exact hs ▸ hsγ
      · exact ht ▸ htγ
    have hvγ : v ∈ γ.vertices := by
      rcases hend with ⟨_, ht⟩ | ⟨hs, _⟩
      · exact ht ▸ htγ
      · exact hs ▸ hsγ
    rw [retargetVertex_of_mem_component hDisj starOf hγ huγ,
      retargetVertex_of_mem_component hDisj starOf hγ hvγ]
    exact FeynmanGraph.SupportReachable.refl _ _
  · have heComplErase : e ∈ G.internalEdges.erase e₀ - A.internalEdges := by
      rw [Multiset.mem_sub]
      have hAcount : A.internalEdges.count e = 0 :=
        Multiset.count_eq_zero.mpr heA
      have hGcount : 0 < (G.internalEdges.erase e₀).count e :=
        Multiset.count_pos.mpr heG
      omega
    have hretarget : A.retargetEdge starOf e ∈
        ((A.contractWithStars starOf).eraseInternalEdge
          (A.retargetEdge starOf e₀)).internalEdges := by
      rw [contractWithStars_eraseInternalEdge_internalEdges A starOf he₀]
      exact Multiset.mem_map.mpr ⟨e, heComplErase, rfl⟩
    by_cases hprojEq :
        A.retargetVertex starOf u = A.retargetVertex starOf v
    · rw [hprojEq]
      exact FeynmanGraph.SupportReachable.refl _ _
    · refine SimpleGraph.Adj.reachable
        (G := ((A.contractWithStars starOf).eraseInternalEdge
          (A.retargetEdge starOf e₀)).toSimpleGraph) ?_
      rw [FeynmanGraph.toSimpleGraph_adj]
      refine ⟨hprojEq, A.retargetEdge starOf e, hretarget, ?_⟩
      rcases hend with ⟨hseq, hteq⟩ | ⟨hseq, hteq⟩
      · left
        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [retargetEdge_source, hseq]
        · rw [retargetEdge_target, hteq]
      · right
        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [retargetEdge_source, hseq]
        · rw [retargetEdge_target, hteq]

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.contractWithStars_eraseInternalEdge_path_supportReachable
statement:
theorem contractWithStars_eraseInternalEdge_path_supportReachable
    {A : AdmissibleSubgraph G} (hDisj : A.IsPairwiseDisjoint)
    (starOf : FeynmanSubgraph G → VertexId)
    {e₀ : FeynmanEdge} (he₀ : e₀ ∈ A.complementEdges)
    {u v : VertexId} (h : (G.eraseInternalEdge e₀).SupportReachable u v) :
    ((A.contractWithStars starOf).eraseInternalEdge
      (A.retargetEdge starOf e₀)).SupportReachable
        (A.retargetVertex starOf u) (A.retargetVertex starOf v)
proof:
:= by
  unfold FeynmanGraph.SupportReachable at h
  rw [SimpleGraph.reachable_iff_reflTransGen] at h
  induction h with
  | refl =>
      exact FeynmanGraph.SupportReachable.refl _ _
  | @tail x y _ hxy ih =>
      have hstep : (G.eraseInternalEdge e₀).SupportAdj x y := by
        rw [← FeynmanGraph.toSimpleGraph_adj]
        exact hxy
      have hstep_reach :=
        contractWithStars_eraseInternalEdge_step_supportReachable
          hDisj starOf he₀ hstep
      exact ih.trans hstep_reach

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.contractWithStars_eraseInternalEdge_isSupportConnected
statement:
theorem contractWithStars_eraseInternalEdge_isSupportConnected
    {A : AdmissibleSubgraph G}
    {e₀ : FeynmanEdge} (he₀ : e₀ ∈ A.complementEdges)
    (hGErase : (G.eraseInternalEdge e₀).IsSupportConnected)
    (hDisj : A.IsPairwiseDisjoint) (hCompNE : A.HasNonemptyComponents)
    (starOf : FeynmanSubgraph G → VertexId) :
    ((A.contractWithStars starOf).eraseInternalEdge
      (A.retargetEdge starOf e₀)).IsSupportConnected
proof:
:= by
  have preimage : ∀ x, x ∈
      ((A.contractWithStars starOf).eraseInternalEdge
        (A.retargetEdge starOf e₀)).vertices →
      ∃ x₀ ∈ G.vertices, A.retargetVertex starOf x₀ = x := by
    intro x hx
    rw [FeynmanGraph.eraseInternalEdge_vertices,
      contractWithStars_vertices] at hx
    rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hx with hsdiff | hstar
    · rcases Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hsdiff with ⟨hxG, hxA⟩
      exact ⟨x, hxG, retargetVertex_of_not_mem A starOf hxA⟩
    · rw [mem_starVertices] at hstar
      rcases hstar with ⟨γ, hγ, rfl⟩
      have hγne : γ.IsNonempty := hCompNE γ hγ
      have hγverts : γ.vertices.Nonempty := by
        unfold FeynmanSubgraph.IsNonempty FeynmanSubgraph.vertexCount at hγne
        exact Finset.card_pos.mp hγne
      obtain ⟨w, hwγ⟩ := hγverts
      exact ⟨w, γ.vertices_subset hwγ,
        retargetVertex_of_mem_component hDisj starOf hγ hwγ⟩
  intro u' v' hu' hv'
  obtain ⟨u, huG, rfl⟩ := preimage u' hu'
  obtain ⟨v, hvG, rfl⟩ := preimage v' hv'
  have huErase : u ∈ (G.eraseInternalEdge e₀).vertices := by
    simpa using huG
  have hvErase : v ∈ (G.eraseInternalEdge e₀).vertices := by
    simpa using hvG
  exact contractWithStars_eraseInternalEdge_path_supportReachable
    hDisj starOf he₀ (hGErase huErase hvErase)

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.contractWithStars_step_supportReachable
statement:
theorem contractWithStars_step_supportReachable
    {A : AdmissibleSubgraph G} (hDisj : A.IsPairwiseDisjoint)
    (starOf : FeynmanSubgraph G → VertexId)
    {u v : VertexId} (h : G.SupportAdj u v) :
    (A.contractWithStars starOf).SupportReachable
      (A.retargetVertex starOf u) (A.retargetVertex starOf v)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_hne, e, heG, hend⟩ := h
  by_cases heA : e ∈ A.internalEdges
  · rcases mem_internalEdges.mp heA with ⟨γ, hγ, heγ⟩
    have hsupp : e.SupportedOn γ.vertices := γ.edges_supported e heγ
    simp [FeynmanEdge.SupportedOn] at hsupp
    obtain ⟨hsγ, htγ⟩ := hsupp
    have huγ : u ∈ γ.vertices := by
      rcases hend with ⟨hs, _⟩ | ⟨_, ht⟩
      · exact hs ▸ hsγ
      · exact ht ▸ htγ
    have hvγ : v ∈ γ.vertices := by
      rcases hend with ⟨_, ht⟩ | ⟨hs, _⟩
      · exact ht ▸ htγ
      · exact hs ▸ hsγ
    rw [retargetVertex_of_mem_component hDisj starOf hγ huγ,
      retargetVertex_of_mem_component hDisj starOf hγ hvγ]
    exact FeynmanGraph.SupportReachable.refl _ _
  · have hecompl : e ∈ A.complementEdges := by
      unfold complementEdges
      rw [Multiset.mem_sub]
      have hAcount : A.internalEdges.count e = 0 :=
        Multiset.count_eq_zero.mpr heA
      have hGcount : 0 < G.internalEdges.count e :=
        Multiset.count_pos.mpr heG
      omega
    have hretarget : A.retargetEdge starOf e ∈
        (A.contractWithStars starOf).internalEdges := by
      rw [contractWithStars_internalEdges]
      exact Multiset.mem_map.mpr ⟨e, hecompl, rfl⟩
    by_cases hprojEq :
        A.retargetVertex starOf u = A.retargetVertex starOf v
    · rw [hprojEq]
      exact FeynmanGraph.SupportReachable.refl _ _
    · refine SimpleGraph.Adj.reachable (G := (A.contractWithStars starOf).toSimpleGraph) ?_
      rw [FeynmanGraph.toSimpleGraph_adj]
      refine ⟨hprojEq, A.retargetEdge starOf e, hretarget, ?_⟩
      rcases hend with ⟨hseq, hteq⟩ | ⟨hseq, hteq⟩
      · left
        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [retargetEdge_source, hseq]
        · rw [retargetEdge_target, hteq]
      · right
        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [retargetEdge_source, hseq]
        · rw [retargetEdge_target, hteq]

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.contractWithStars_path_supportReachable
statement:
theorem contractWithStars_path_supportReachable
    {A : AdmissibleSubgraph G} (hDisj : A.IsPairwiseDisjoint)
    (starOf : FeynmanSubgraph G → VertexId)
    {u v : VertexId} (h : G.SupportReachable u v) :
    (A.contractWithStars starOf).SupportReachable
      (A.retargetVertex starOf u) (A.retargetVertex starOf v)
proof:
:= by
  unfold FeynmanGraph.SupportReachable at h
  rw [SimpleGraph.reachable_iff_reflTransGen] at h
  induction h with
  | refl =>
      exact FeynmanGraph.SupportReachable.refl _ _
  | @tail x y _ hxy ih =>
      have hstep : G.SupportAdj x y := by
        rw [← FeynmanGraph.toSimpleGraph_adj]
        exact hxy
      have hstep_reach :=
        contractWithStars_step_supportReachable hDisj starOf hstep
      exact ih.trans hstep_reach

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.contractWithStars_isSupportConnected
statement:
theorem contractWithStars_isSupportConnected
    {A : AdmissibleSubgraph G}
    (hG : G.IsSupportConnected) (hDisj : A.IsPairwiseDisjoint)
    (hCompNE : A.HasNonemptyComponents)
    (starOf : FeynmanSubgraph G → VertexId) :
    (A.contractWithStars starOf).IsSupportConnected
proof:
:= by
  have preimage : ∀ x, x ∈ (A.contractWithStars starOf).vertices →
      ∃ x₀ ∈ G.vertices, A.retargetVertex starOf x₀ = x := by
    intro x hx
    rw [contractWithStars_vertices] at hx
    rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hx with hsdiff | hstar
    · rcases Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hsdiff with ⟨hxG, hxA⟩
      exact ⟨x, hxG, retargetVertex_of_not_mem A starOf hxA⟩
    · rw [mem_starVertices] at hstar
      rcases hstar with ⟨γ, hγ, rfl⟩
      have hγne : γ.IsNonempty := hCompNE γ hγ
      have hγverts : γ.vertices.Nonempty := by
        unfold FeynmanSubgraph.IsNonempty FeynmanSubgraph.vertexCount at hγne
        exact Finset.card_pos.mp hγne
      obtain ⟨w, hwγ⟩ := hγverts
      exact ⟨w, γ.vertices_subset hwγ,
        retargetVertex_of_mem_component hDisj starOf hγ hwγ⟩
  intro u' v' hu' hv'
  obtain ⟨u, huG, rfl⟩ := preimage u' hu'
  obtain ⟨v, hvG, rfl⟩ := preimage v' hv'
  exact contractWithStars_path_supportReachable hDisj starOf (hG huG hvG)

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.contractWithStars_vertexCount
statement:
theorem contractWithStars_vertexCount
    {A : AdmissibleSubgraph G} {starOf : FeynmanSubgraph G → VertexId}
    (h : A.IsFreshStarAssignment starOf) :
    (A.contractWithStars starOf).vertexCount =
      (G.vertexCount - A.vertices.card) + A.elements.card
proof:
:= by
  unfold FeynmanGraph.vertexCount
  rw [contractWithStars_vertices]
  rw [Finset.card_union_of_disjoint h.disjoint_sdiff_starVertices]
  rw [Finset.card_sdiff_of_subset A.vertices_subset]
  rw [h.card_starVertices]

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.empty_isPairwiseDisjoint
statement:
theorem empty_isPairwiseDisjoint :
    (empty G).IsPairwiseDisjoint
proof:
:= by
  exact Forest.empty_isPairwiseDisjoint

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.singleton_isPairwiseDisjoint
statement:
theorem singleton_isPairwiseDisjoint
    (γ : FeynmanSubgraph G) (hγ : γ.IsConnectedDivergent) :
    (singleton γ hγ).IsPairwiseDisjoint
proof:

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.empty_not_isNonempty
statement:
@[simp] theorem empty_not_isNonempty :
    ¬ (empty G).IsNonempty
proof:
:= by

  simp

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.singleton_isNonempty
statement:
theorem singleton_isNonempty
    (γ : FeynmanSubgraph G) (hγ : γ.IsConnectedDivergent) :
    (singleton γ hγ).IsNonempty
proof:
:= by
  simp [IsNonempty]

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.singleton_isFreshStarAssignment
statement:
theorem singleton_isFreshStarAssignment
    (γ : FeynmanSubgraph G) (hγ : γ.IsConnectedDivergent) :
    (singleton γ hγ).IsFreshStarAssignment
      (fun _ : FeynmanSubgraph G => γ.contractedVertex)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro γ' hγ'
    rw [mem_singleton_elements] at hγ'
    rw [hγ']
    exact γ.contractedVertex_not_mem_G
  · intro γ₁ hγ₁ γ₂ hγ₂ _hstar
    rw [mem_singleton_elements] at hγ₁ hγ₂
    rw [hγ₁, hγ₂]

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.singleton_starVertices
statement:
@[simp] theorem singleton_starVertices
    (γ : FeynmanSubgraph G) (hγ : γ.IsConnectedDivergent)
    (starOf : FeynmanSubgraph G → VertexId) :
    (singleton γ hγ).starVertices starOf = {starOf γ}
proof:
:= by
  rw [starVertices, singleton_elements]
  simp

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.singleton_retargetVertex
statement:
theorem singleton_retargetVertex
    (γ : FeynmanSubgraph G) (hγ : γ.IsConnectedDivergent)
    (starOf : FeynmanSubgraph G → VertexId) (v : VertexId) :
    (singleton γ hγ).retargetVertex starOf v =
      if v ∈ γ.vertices then starOf γ else v
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hv : v ∈ γ.vertices
  · rw [if_pos hv]
    exact retargetVertex_of_mem_component
      (A := singleton γ hγ) (singleton_isPairwiseDisjoint γ hγ)
      starOf (γ := γ) (by simp) hv
  · rw [if_neg hv]
    exact retargetVertex_of_not_mem (singleton γ hγ) starOf
      (by simpa using hv)

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.singleton_retargetEdge
statement:
theorem singleton_retargetEdge
    (γ : FeynmanSubgraph G) (hγ : γ.IsConnectedDivergent)
    (starOf : FeynmanSubgraph G → VertexId) (e : FeynmanEdge) :
    (singleton γ hγ).retargetEdge starOf e =
      e.retarget γ.vertices (starOf γ)
proof:
:= by
  cases e
  simp [retargetEdge, FeynmanEdge.retarget, singleton_retargetVertex]

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.singleton_retargetExternalLeg
statement:
theorem singleton_retargetExternalLeg
    (γ : FeynmanSubgraph G) (hγ : γ.IsConnectedDivergent)
    (starOf : FeynmanSubgraph G → VertexId) (ℓ : ExternalLeg) :
    (singleton γ hγ).retargetExternalLeg starOf ℓ =
      ℓ.retarget γ.vertices (starOf γ)
proof:
:= by
  cases ℓ
  simp [retargetExternalLeg, ExternalLeg.retarget, singleton_retargetVertex]

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.singleton_contractWithStars_vertices
statement:
@[simp] theorem singleton_contractWithStars_vertices
    (γ : FeynmanSubgraph G) (hγ : γ.IsConnectedDivergent)
    (starOf : FeynmanSubgraph G → VertexId) :
    ((singleton γ hγ).contractWithStars starOf).vertices =
      (γ.contractWith (starOf γ)).vertices
proof:
:= by
  rw [contractWithStars_vertices, FeynmanSubgraph.contractWith_vertices,
    singleton_vertices, singleton_starVertices]

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.singleton_contractWithStars_internalEdges
statement:
@[simp] theorem singleton_contractWithStars_internalEdges
    (γ : FeynmanSubgraph G) (hγ : γ.IsConnectedDivergent)
    (starOf : FeynmanSubgraph G → VertexId) :
    ((singleton γ hγ).contractWithStars starOf).internalEdges =
      (γ.contractWith (starOf γ)).internalEdges
proof:
:= by
  rw [contractWithStars_internalEdges, FeynmanSubgraph.contractWith_internalEdges,
    singleton_complementEdges]
  refine Multiset.map_congr rfl ?_
  intro e _he
  exact singleton_retargetEdge γ hγ starOf e

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.singleton_contractWithStars_externalLegs
statement:
@[simp] theorem singleton_contractWithStars_externalLegs
    (γ : FeynmanSubgraph G) (hγ : γ.IsConnectedDivergent)
    (starOf : FeynmanSubgraph G → VertexId) :
    ((singleton γ hγ).contractWithStars starOf).externalLegs =
      (γ.contractWith (starOf γ)).externalLegs
proof:
:= by
  rw [contractWithStars_externalLegs, FeynmanSubgraph.contractWith_externalLegs]
  refine Multiset.map_congr rfl ?_
  intro ℓ _hℓ
  exact singleton_retargetExternalLeg γ hγ starOf ℓ

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.singleton_contractWithStars
statement:
theorem singleton_contractWithStars
    (γ : FeynmanSubgraph G) (hγ : γ.IsConnectedDivergent)
    (starOf : FeynmanSubgraph G → VertexId) :
    (singleton γ hγ).contractWithStars starOf =
      γ.contractWith (starOf γ)
proof:
:= by
  apply FeynmanGraph.mk.injEq _ _ _ _ _ _ |>.mpr
  exact ⟨singleton_contractWithStars_vertices γ hγ starOf,
    singleton_contractWithStars_internalEdges γ hγ starOf,
    singleton_contractWithStars_externalLegs γ hγ starOf⟩

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.singleton_contractWithStars_contract
statement:
theorem singleton_contractWithStars_contract
    (γ : FeynmanSubgraph G) (hγ : γ.IsConnectedDivergent) :
    (singleton γ hγ).contractWithStars (fun _ => γ.contractedVertex) =
      γ.contract
proof:
:= by
  rw [singleton_contractWithStars]
  rfl

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.ofForest_forest
statement:
@[simp] theorem ofForest_forest (F : Forest G)

proof: := rfl

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.AdmissibleSubgraph.ofForest_elements
statement:
@[simp] theorem ofForest_elements (F : Forest G)

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.multiset_map_sub_of_le
statement:
private theorem multiset_map_sub_of_le {α β : Type*} [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]
    (f : α → β) {A B : Multiset α} (hBA : B ≤ A) :
    (A - B).map f = A.map f - B.map f
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (A - B).map f = ((A - B).map f + B.map f) - B.map f := by
      rw [Multiset.add_sub_cancel_right]
    _ = ((A - B + B).map f) - B.map f := by rw [Multiset.map_add]
    _ = A.map f - B.map f := by rw [Multiset.sub_add_cancel hBA]

    (γ : {x : ResolvedFeynmanSubgraph G // x ∈ (R.Data.Tags.Closure.unionOuterValue z).1.elements}) :

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.ResolvedForwardOuterValueGeometrySupply.leftOf_recovered_eq
statement:
theorem leftOf_recovered_eq (R : ResolvedForwardOuterValueGeometrySupply F V)
    {G : ResolvedFeynmanGraph} (z : ForestBlockCodType D G) :
    ((resolvedConcreteForestPromoteSupply D G).leftOf (R.Data.Tags.recoveredPreimageValue z)).elements
      = (R.Data.Tags.Closure.Assembly.Left.leftResidual z).elements
proof:
:= by
  have hLe : ((resolvedConcreteForestPromoteSupply D G).leftOf
        (R.Data.Tags.recoveredPreimageValue z)).elements
      = (R.Data.Tags.Closure.unionOuterValue z).1.elements.filter
          (ResolvedCoassocSplitChoice.leftSelectedConcrete (R.Data.Tags.recoveredPreimageValue z)) := rfl
  rw [hLe]
  ext γ
  rw [Finset.mem_filter]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hmemU, hγmem, htag⟩
    rcases (R.Data.Tags.Closure.mem_unionOuterValue_iff z γ).mp hmemU with hl | hr | hf
    · exact hl
    · exact absurd (Sum.inl.inj ((R.Data.Tags.right_tag z ⟨γ, hmemU⟩ hr).symm.trans
        ((R.choiceAt_recovered_eq z ⟨γ, hmemU⟩).symm.trans htag))) (by decide)
    · obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := R.Data.Tags.forest_tag z ⟨γ, hmemU⟩ hf
      exact absurd (hB.symm.trans ((R.choiceAt_recovered_eq z ⟨γ, hmemU⟩).symm.trans htag)) (by simp)
  · intro hl
    have hmemU : γ ∈ (R.Data.Tags.Closure.unionOuterValue z).1.elements :=
      (R.Data.Tags.Closure.mem_unionOuterValue_iff z γ).mpr (Or.inl hl)
    exact ⟨hmemU, hmemU,
      (R.choiceAt_recovered_eq z ⟨γ, hmemU⟩).trans (R.Data.Tags.left_tag z ⟨γ, hmemU⟩ hl)⟩

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.ResolvedForwardOuterValueGeometrySupply.promotedOf_recovered_eq
statement:
theorem promotedOf_recovered_eq (R : ResolvedForwardOuterValueGeometrySupply F V)
    {G : ResolvedFeynmanGraph} (z : ForestBlockCodType D G) :
    ((resolvedConcreteForestPromoteSupply D G).promotedOf (R.Data.Tags.recoveredPreimageValue z)).elements
      = (R.Data.Tags.Closure.Assembly.Region.forestRecovered z).elements
proof:
:= by
  have hpe : ((resolvedConcreteForestPromoteSupply D G).promotedOf
        (R.Data.Tags.recoveredPreimageValue z)).elements
      = (R.Data.Tags.Closure.unionOuterValue z).1.elements.attach.biUnion
        (ResolvedCoassocSplitChoice.promotedComponentElements
          (R.Data.Tags.recoveredPreimageValue z)) := rfl
  rw [hpe]
  ext x
  rw [Finset.mem_biUnion]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨γ, -, hx⟩
    rcases (R.Data.Tags.Closure.mem_unionOuterValue_iff z γ.1).mp γ.2 with hl | hr | hf
    · exfalso
      rw [show ResolvedCoassocSplitChoice.promotedComponentElements
            (R.Data.Tags.recoveredPreimageValue z) γ = ∅ from by
          unfold ResolvedCoassocSplitChoice.promotedComponentElements
          rw [(R.choiceAt_recovered_eq z γ).trans (R.Data.Tags.left_tag z γ hl)]] at hx
      simp at hx
    · exfalso
      rw [show ResolvedCoassocSplitChoice.promotedComponentElements
            (R.Data.Tags.recoveredPreimageValue z) γ = ∅ from by
          unfold ResolvedCoassocSplitChoice.promotedComponentElements
          rw [(R.choiceAt_recovered_eq z γ).trans (R.Data.Tags.right_tag z γ hr)]] at hx
      simp at hx
    · rw [ResolvedCoassocSplitChoice.promotedComponentElements_inr _
          ((R.choiceAt_recovered_eq z γ).trans (by
            rw [ResolvedRegionTagValueSupply.recoverChoiceValue,
              if_neg (R.Data.Tags.forest_notMem_left z γ hf),
              if_neg (R.Data.Tags.forest_notMem_right z γ hf), dif_pos hf])),
        R.promote_collapse z γ hf, Finset.mem_singleton] at hx
      subst hx
      exact hf
  · intro hx
    have hxu : x ∈ (R.Data.Tags.Closure.unionOuterValue z).1.elements :=
      (R.Data.Tags.Closure.mem_unionOuterValue_iff z x).mpr (Or.inr (Or.inr hx))
    refine ⟨⟨x, hxu⟩, Finset.mem_attach _ _, ?_⟩
    rw [ResolvedCoassocSplitChoice.promotedComponentElements_inr _
        ((R.choiceAt_recovered_eq z ⟨x, hxu⟩).trans (by
          rw [ResolvedRegionTagValueSupply.recoverChoiceValue,
            if_neg (R.Data.Tags.forest_notMem_left z ⟨x, hxu⟩ hx),
            if_neg (R.Data.Tags.forest_notMem_right z ⟨x, hxu⟩ hx), dif_pos hx])),
      R.promote_collapse z ⟨x, hxu⟩ hx]
    exact Finset.mem_singleton_self x

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.ResolvedForwardOuterValueGeometrySupply.coverage_value
statement:
theorem coverage_value (R : ResolvedForwardOuterValueGeometrySupply F V)
    {G : ResolvedFeynmanGraph} (z : ForestBlockCodType D G) (γ : ResolvedFeynmanSubgraph G) :
    (γ ∈ (R.Data.Tags.Closure.Assembly.Left.leftResidual z).elements
        ∨ γ ∈ (R.Data.Tags.Closure.Assembly.Region.forestRecovered z).elements)
      ↔ γ ∈ z.1.1.elements
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro (hl | hf)
    · exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hl).1
    · exact R.forestComponentMem z γ hf
  · intro hmem
    by_cases hrep : R.Data.Tags.Closure.Assembly.Left.representedInQuotient z γ
    · exact Or.inr (R.represented_cases z γ hmem hrep)
    · exact Or.inl (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hmem, hrep⟩)

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.ResolvedForwardOuterValueGeometrySupply.forward_outer_value
statement:
theorem forward_outer_value (R : ResolvedForwardOuterValueGeometrySupply F V)
    {G : ResolvedFeynmanGraph} (z : ForestBlockCodType D G) :
    (resolvedConcreteForestPromoteSupply D G).selectedOuterRawOf (R.Data.Tags.recoveredPreimageValue z)
      = z.1.1
proof:
:= by
  apply ResolvedAdmissibleSubgraph.ext_elements
  ext γ
  rw [ResolvedForestPromoteSupply.selectedOuterRawOf, ResolvedAdmissibleSubgraph.union_elements]
  constructor
  · intro hγ
    rcases (@Finset.mem_union _ (Classical.decEq _) _ _ _).mp hγ with hl | hp
    · rw [R.leftOf_recovered_eq z] at hl
      exact (R.coverage_value z γ).mp (Or.inl hl)
    · rw [R.promotedOf_recovered_eq z] at hp
      exact (R.coverage_value z γ).mp (Or.inr hp)
  · intro hmem
    rcases (R.coverage_value z γ).mpr hmem with hl | hf
    · refine (@Finset.mem_union _ (Classical.decEq _) _ _ _).mpr (Or.inl ?_)
      rw [R.leftOf_recovered_eq z]; exact hl
    · refine (@Finset.mem_union _ (Classical.decEq _) _ _ _).mpr (Or.inr ?_)
      rw [R.promotedOf_recovered_eq z]; exact hf

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.stableRecoveredForestTag_heq
statement:
private theorem stableRecoveredForestTag_heq (hSt : StableResolvedBoundaryIds G)
    (z : Phi4WTriplePrimeInverseCodomain G)
    (γ : {x // x ∈ (phi4WTriplePrime_recoveredOuter z).elements})
    (hq : ∃ δ : {x // x ∈ z.2.1.elements}, phi4WTriplePrime_inv_regionComponentOf z δ = γ.1)
    (hst : phi4WTriplePrime_inv_isForestImage z hq.choose)
    {δ : {x // x ∈ z.2.1.elements}} (hδ : phi4WTriplePrime_inv_isForestImage z δ)
    (hcs : hq.choose = δ) :
    HEq (stableRecoveredForestTag hSt z γ hq hst)
        (stableInvRecoveredInnerForestValue hSt
          (phi4WTriplePrime_forestDecontractionInput_of_starTouching z hδ))
proof:
:=
  HEq.trans
    (heq_of_eqRec _ (stableInvRecoveredInnerForestValue hSt
      (phi4WTriplePrime_forestDecontractionInput_of_starTouching z hst)))
    (stableInvRecoveredInnerForestValue_hcongr hSt z hcs _ _)

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.stableRecoveredChoice_forest_value
statement:
theorem stableRecoveredChoice_forest_value (hSt : StableResolvedBoundaryIds G)
    (z : Phi4WTriplePrimeInverseCodomain G) {δ : {x // x ∈ z.2.1.elements}}
    (hδ : phi4WTriplePrime_inv_isForestImage z δ)
    (hγ : phi4WTriplePrime_inv_recoveredParent
        (phi4WTriplePrime_forestDecontractionInput_of_starTouching z hδ)
      ∈ (phi4WTriplePrime_recoveredOuter z).elements) :
    stableRecoveredChoice hSt z
        ⟨phi4WTriplePrime_inv_recoveredParent
          (phi4WTriplePrime_forestDecontractionInput_of_starTouching z hδ), hγ⟩
        (Finset.mem_attach _ _)
      = Sum.inr (stableInvRecoveredInnerForestValue hSt
          (phi4WTriplePrime_forestDecontractionInput_of_starTouching z hδ))
proof:
:= by
  have hq : ∃ d : {x // x ∈ z.2.1.elements},
      phi4WTriplePrime_inv_regionComponentOf z d
        = phi4WTriplePrime_inv_recoveredParent
            (phi4WTriplePrime_forestDecontractionInput_of_starTouching z hδ) :=
    ⟨δ, phi4WTriplePrime_inv_regionComponentOf_eq_parent z hδ⟩
  have hcs : hq.choose = δ :=
    phi4WTriplePrime_inv_regionComponentOf_injective z
      (hq.choose_spec.trans (phi4WTriplePrime_inv_regionComponentOf_eq_parent z hδ).symm)
  have hst' : phi4WTriplePrime_inv_isForestImage z hq.choose := by rw [hcs]; exact hδ
  rw [show stableRecoveredChoice hSt z
        ⟨phi4WTriplePrime_inv_recoveredParent
          (phi4WTriplePrime_forestDecontractionInput_of_starTouching z hδ), hγ⟩
        (Finset.mem_attach _ _)
      = Sum.inr (stableRecoveredForestTag hSt z
          ⟨phi4WTriplePrime_inv_recoveredParent
            (phi4WTriplePrime_forestDecontractionInput_of_starTouching z hδ), hγ⟩ hq hst') from by
      unfold stableRecoveredChoice; rw [dif_pos hq]; exact dif_pos hst']
  exact congrArg Sum.inr
    (eq_of_heq (stableRecoveredForestTag_heq hSt z _ hq hst' hδ hcs))

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.stablePromotedElemsAt_recoveredForestOwner
statement:
theorem stablePromotedElemsAt_recoveredForestOwner (hSt : StableResolvedBoundaryIds G)
    (z : Phi4WTriplePrimeInverseCodomain G) {δ : {x // x ∈ z.2.1.elements}}
    (hδ : phi4WTriplePrime_inv_isForestImage z δ)
    (hγ : phi4WTriplePrime_inv_recoveredParent
        (phi4WTriplePrime_forestDecontractionInput_of_starTouching z hδ)
      ∈ (phi4WTriplePrime_recoveredOuter z).elements) :
    stablePromotedElemsAt (stableRecoveredResolvedSplitChoice hSt z)
        ⟨phi4WTriplePrime_inv_recoveredParent
          (phi4WTriplePrime_forestDecontractionInput_of_starTouching z hδ), hγ⟩
      = (phi4WTriplePrime_touchedOuterForest z δ).elements
proof:
:= by
  have hchoice : (stableRecoveredResolvedSplitChoice hSt z).choice
        ⟨phi4WTriplePrime_inv_recoveredParent
          (phi4WTriplePrime_forestDecontractionInput_of_starTouching z hδ), hγ⟩
        (Finset.mem_attach _ _)
      = Sum.inr (stableInvRecoveredInnerForestValue hSt
          (phi4WTriplePrime_forestDecontractionInput_of_starTouching z hδ)) := by
    rw [stableRecoveredResolvedSplitChoice_choice]
    exact stableRecoveredChoice_forest_value hSt z hδ hγ
  unfold stablePromotedElemsAt
  rw [hchoice]
  simp only [Sum.elim_inr]
  exact stableInvRecoveredInnerForest_rootRelative_image hSt
    (phi4WTriplePrime_forestDecontractionInput_of_starTouching z hδ)

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.stable_admissible_ext_elements
statement:
private theorem stable_admissible_ext_elements
    {A₁ A₂ : @ResolvedAdmissibleSubgraph phi4DivergenceMeasureFamily G}
    (h : @ResolvedAdmissibleSubgraph.elements phi4DivergenceMeasureFamily G A₁
       = @ResolvedAdmissibleSubgraph.elements phi4DivergenceMeasureFamily G A₂) : A₁ = A₂
proof:
:= by
  cases A₁; cases A₂; cases h; rfl

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.stableSelectedOuter_recoveredSplitChoice
statement:
theorem stableSelectedOuter_recoveredSplitChoice (hSt : StableResolvedBoundaryIds G)
    (z : Phi4WTriplePrimeInverseCodomain G) :
    stableSelectedOuter (stableRecoveredResolvedSplitChoice hSt z) = z.1.1
proof:
:= by
  apply stable_admissible_ext_elements
  rw [stableSelectedOuter_elements]
  ext c
  rw [Finset.mem_union]
  constructor
  · rintro (hL | hP)
    · 
      rw [stableLeftOf_elements, Finset.mem_filter] at hL
      obtain ⟨hcRO, hlp⟩ := hL
      rcases phi4WTriplePrime_recoveredOuter_component_origin z hcRO with ⟨hcA, _⟩ | ⟨δc, hδceq⟩
      · exact hcA
      · exfalso
        obtain ⟨hh, htrue⟩ := hlp
        have hq : ∃ d : {x // x ∈ z.2.1.elements},
            phi4WTriplePrime_inv_regionComponentOf z d = c := ⟨δc, hδceq⟩
        by_cases hst : phi4WTriplePrime_inv_isForestImage z hq.choose
        · rw [show (stableRecoveredResolvedSplitChoice hSt z).choice ⟨c, hh⟩ (Finset.mem_attach _ _)
                = Sum.inr (stableRecoveredForestTag hSt z ⟨c, hh⟩ hq hst) from by
                  rw [stableRecoveredResolvedSplitChoice_choice]
                  unfold stableRecoveredChoice
                  rw [dif_pos hq]; exact dif_pos hst] at htrue
          simp at htrue
        · rw [show (stableRecoveredResolvedSplitChoice hSt z).choice ⟨c, hh⟩ (Finset.mem_attach _ _)
                = Sum.inl false from by
                  rw [stableRecoveredResolvedSplitChoice_choice]
                  unfold stableRecoveredChoice
                  rw [dif_pos hq]; exact dif_neg hst] at htrue
          simp at htrue
    · 
      rw [stablePromotedOf_elements, Finset.mem_biUnion] at hP
      obtain ⟨a, -, hca⟩ := hP
      rcases hcc : (stableRecoveredResolvedSplitChoice hSt z).choice a (Finset.mem_attach _ a) with b | B
      · 
        exfalso
        rw [show stablePromotedElemsAt (stableRecoveredResolvedSplitChoice hSt z) a = ∅
              from by unfold stablePromotedElemsAt; rw [hcc]; simp only [Sum.elim_inl]] at hca
        simp at hca
      · 
        have hq : ∃ d : {x // x ∈ z.2.1.elements},
            phi4WTriplePrime_inv_regionComponentOf z d = a.1 := by
          by_contra hnq
          rw [show (stableRecoveredResolvedSplitChoice hSt z).choice a (Finset.mem_attach _ a)
                = Sum.inl true from by
                  rw [stableRecoveredResolvedSplitChoice_choice]
                  unfold stableRecoveredChoice; rw [dif_neg hnq]] at hcc
          simp at hcc
        have hst : phi4WTriplePrime_inv_isForestImage z hq.choose := by
          by_contra hns
          rw [show (stableRecoveredResolvedSplitChoice hSt z).choice a (Finset.mem_attach _ a)
                = Sum.inl false from by
                  rw [stableRecoveredResolvedSplitChoice_choice]
                  unfold stableRecoveredChoice; rw [dif_pos hq, dif_neg hns]] at hcc
          simp at hcc
        have hav : a.1 = phi4WTriplePrime_inv_recoveredParent
                          (phi4WTriplePrime_forestDecontractionInput_of_starTouching z hst) :=
          hq.choose_spec.symm.trans (phi4WTriplePrime_inv_regionComponentOf_eq_parent z hst)
        have ha_eq : a = ⟨phi4WTriplePrime_inv_recoveredParent
              (phi4WTriplePrime_forestDecontractionInput_of_starTouching z hst), hav ▸ a.2⟩ :=
          Subtype.ext hav
        have hset : stablePromotedElemsAt (stableRecoveredResolvedSplitChoice hSt z) a
            = (phi4WTriplePrime_touchedOuterForest z hq.choose).elements :=
          (congrArg (stablePromotedElemsAt (stableRecoveredResolvedSplitChoice hSt z)) ha_eq).trans
            (stablePromotedElemsAt_recoveredForestOwner hSt z hst (hav ▸ a.2))
        rw [hset] at hca
        exact phi4WTriplePrime_inv_touchedForest_subset_A hca
  · intro hc
    by_cases hL : phi4WTriplePrime_inv_isLeftComponent z c
    · 
      left
      rw [stableLeftOf_elements, Finset.mem_filter]
      exact ⟨phi4WTriplePrime_inv_left_mem_recoveredOuter z hc hL,
        phi4WTriplePrime_inv_left_mem_recoveredOuter z hc hL,
        stableRecoveredChoice_left hSt z hc hL (Finset.mem_attach _ _)⟩
    · 
      right
      obtain ⟨δ, hδv⟩ := (phi4WTriplePrime_inv_not_isLeftComponent_iff z c).mp hL
      have hδf : phi4WTriplePrime_inv_isForestImage z δ :=
        ⟨phi4WTriplePrimeCanonicalSupply.starOf G z.1.1 c, hδv,
          ResolvedAdmissibleSubgraph.mem_starVertices.mpr ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩⟩
      have hcT : c ∈ (phi4WTriplePrime_touchedOuterForest z δ).elements :=
        phi4WTriplePrime_inv_touched_of_starA_mem hc hδv
      rw [stablePromotedOf_elements, Finset.mem_biUnion]
      have hmem : phi4WTriplePrime_inv_recoveredParent
                    (phi4WTriplePrime_forestDecontractionInput_of_starTouching z hδf)
                  ∈ (phi4WTriplePrime_recoveredOuter z).elements :=
        (phi4WTriplePrime_inv_regionComponentOf_eq_parent z hδf)
          ▸ phi4WTriplePrime_inv_regionComponent_mem_recoveredOuter z δ
      refine ⟨⟨phi4WTriplePrime_inv_recoveredParent
                (phi4WTriplePrime_forestDecontractionInput_of_starTouching z hδf), hmem⟩,
        Finset.mem_attach _ _, ?_⟩
      rw [stablePromotedElemsAt_recoveredForestOwner hSt z hδf hmem]
      exact hcT

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.resolvedStarOnForgetOf_spec
statement:
theorem resolvedStarOnForgetOf_spec {G : ResolvedFeynmanGraph} (A : ResolvedAdmissibleSubgraph G)
    (star : ResolvedFeynmanSubgraph G → VertexId) (hne : A.HasNonemptyComponents)
    {B : ResolvedFeynmanSubgraph G} (hB : B ∈ A.elements) :
    resolvedStarOnForgetOf A star B.forget = star B
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : B.forget ∈ A.forget.elements := by
    rw [ResolvedAdmissibleSubgraph.forget_elements]; exact Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hB
  rw [resolvedStarOnForgetOf, dif_pos hmem]
  congr 1
  obtain ⟨hchoose_mem, hchoose_eq⟩ := (Finset.mem_image.mp hmem).choose_spec
  exact A.forget_injOn_elements hne hchoose_mem hB hchoose_eq

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.resolvedStarOnForgetOf_isFreshStarAssignment
statement:
theorem resolvedStarOnForgetOf_isFreshStarAssignment {G : ResolvedFeynmanGraph}
    (A : ResolvedAdmissibleSubgraph G) (star : ResolvedFeynmanSubgraph G → VertexId)
    (hne : A.HasNonemptyComponents)
    (hFresh : ∀ B ∈ A.elements, star B ∉ G.vertices)
    (hInj : ∀ B₁ ∈ A.elements, ∀ B₂ ∈ A.elements, star B₁ = star B₂ → B₁ = B₂) :
    A.forget.IsFreshStarAssignment (resolvedStarOnForgetOf A star)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun η hη => ?_, fun η₁ hη₁ η₂ hη₂ hstar => ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨B, hB, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hη
    rw [resolvedStarOnForgetOf_spec A star hne hB]
    exact hFresh B hB
  · obtain ⟨B₁, hB₁, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hη₁
    obtain ⟨B₂, hB₂, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hη₂
    rw [resolvedStarOnForgetOf_spec A star hne hB₁,
      resolvedStarOnForgetOf_spec A star hne hB₂] at hstar
    exact congrArg _ (hInj B₁ hB₁ B₂ hB₂ hstar)

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.touchedInnerStarTotal_fresh_raw
statement:
theorem touchedInnerStarTotal_fresh_raw (Fstar : ResolvedCanonicalStarFacts D)
    (z : ForestBlockCodType D G)
    (δ : ResolvedFeynmanSubgraph (z.1.1.contractWithStars (D.starOf G z.1.1)))
    (datum : ResolvedTouchedLegLiftDatum z δ)
    (hE : ∀ e ∈ G.internalEdges, e.source ∈ G.vertices ∧ e.target ∈ G.vertices)
    (hL : ∀ ℓ ∈ G.externalLegs, ℓ.attachedTo ∈ G.vertices) :
    ∀ B ∈ (innerRaw z δ datum hE hL).elements,
      touchedInnerStarTotal z δ datum hE hL B
        ∉ (localizedParentWithTouchedLegs z δ datum hE hL).toResolvedFeynmanGraph.vertices
proof:
:= by
  intro B hB
  rw [touchedInnerStarTotal_of_mem z δ datum hE hL B hB, touchedInnerStar]
  intro hmem
  have hmemG : D.starOf G z.1.1 (innerSource z δ datum hE hL ⟨B, hB⟩).1 ∈ G.vertices :=
    (localizedParentWithTouchedLegs z δ datum hE hL).vertices_subset hmem
  exact Fstar.starOf_fresh G z.1.1 (innerSource z δ datum hE hL ⟨B, hB⟩).1
    (mem_touchedOuterComponents.mp (innerSource z δ datum hE hL ⟨B, hB⟩).2).1 hmemG

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.touchedInnerStarTotal_injOn_raw
statement:
theorem touchedInnerStarTotal_injOn_raw (Fstar : ResolvedCanonicalStarFacts D)
    (z : ForestBlockCodType D G)
    (δ : ResolvedFeynmanSubgraph (z.1.1.contractWithStars (D.starOf G z.1.1)))
    (datum : ResolvedTouchedLegLiftDatum z δ)
    (hE : ∀ e ∈ G.internalEdges, e.source ∈ G.vertices ∧ e.target ∈ G.vertices)
    (hL : ∀ ℓ ∈ G.externalLegs, ℓ.attachedTo ∈ G.vertices) :
    ∀ B₁ ∈ (innerRaw z δ datum hE hL).elements,
    ∀ B₂ ∈ (innerRaw z δ datum hE hL).elements,
      touchedInnerStarTotal z δ datum hE hL B₁ = touchedInnerStarTotal z δ datum hE hL B₂ → B₁ = B₂
proof:
:= by
  intro B₁ hB₁ B₂ hB₂ heq
  rw [touchedInnerStarTotal_of_mem z δ datum hE hL B₁ hB₁, touchedInnerStar,
    touchedInnerStarTotal_of_mem z δ datum hE hL B₂ hB₂, touchedInnerStar] at heq
  set src₁ := innerSource z δ datum hE hL ⟨B₁, hB₁⟩ with hs₁
  set src₂ := innerSource z δ datum hE hL ⟨B₂, hB₂⟩ with hs₂
  have hsrc : src₁ = src₂ :=
    Subtype.ext (Fstar.starOf_injective G z.1.1 (η := src₁.1) (δ := src₂.1)
      (mem_touchedOuterComponents.mp src₁.2).1 (mem_touchedOuterComponents.mp src₂.2).1 heq)
  have h1 := innerSource_spec z δ datum hE hL ⟨B₁, hB₁⟩
  have h2 := innerSource_spec z δ datum hE hL ⟨B₂, hB₂⟩
  rw [← hs₁] at h1
  rw [← hs₂] at h2
  rw [hsrc] at h1
  exact h1.symm.trans h2

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.canonicalLegSaturated_innerRaw_hasNonemptyComponents
statement:
theorem canonicalLegSaturated_innerRaw_hasNonemptyComponents {G : ResolvedFeynmanGraph}
    (z : ForestBlockCodType canonicalLegSaturatedCarrierProperSupply.toData G)
    (δ : {x : ResolvedFeynmanSubgraph
        (z.1.1.contractWithStars (canonicalLegSaturatedCarrierProperSupply.toData.starOf G z.1.1)) //
          x ∈ forestDomain z}) :
    (innerRaw z δ.1
      (touchedLegLiftDatum_of_complete z δ.1 (canonicalLegSaturated_touchedLegComplete z δ))
      (liveAmbient_edges_supported ambientSupportOfW'' z)
      (liveAmbient_legs_supported ambientSupportOfW'' z)).HasNonemptyComponents
proof:
:= by
  intro γ hγ
  rw [innerRaw_elements] at hγ
  obtain ⟨A, -, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hγ
  show 0 < A.1.vertexCount
  exact (canonicalLegSaturatedCarrierProperProvider.carrier_isProperForest G z.1.1 z.1.2).2.1
    A.1 (mem_touchedOuterComponents.mp A.2).1

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.canonicalLegSaturatedFlatTouchedInnerStar_spec
statement:
theorem canonicalLegSaturatedFlatTouchedInnerStar_spec {G : ResolvedFeynmanGraph}
    (z : ForestBlockCodType canonicalLegSaturatedCarrierProperSupply.toData G)
    (δ : {x : ResolvedFeynmanSubgraph
        (z.1.1.contractWithStars (canonicalLegSaturatedCarrierProperSupply.toData.starOf G z.1.1)) //
          x ∈ forestDomain z})
    {B : ResolvedFeynmanSubgraph (localizedParentWithTouchedLegs z δ.1
        (touchedLegLiftDatum_of_complete z δ.1 (canonicalLegSaturated_touchedLegComplete z δ))
        (liveAmbient_edges_supported ambientSupportOfW'' z)
        (liveAmbient_legs_supported ambientSupportOfW'' z)).toResolvedFeynmanGraph}
    (hB : B ∈ (innerRaw z δ.1
        (touchedLegLiftDatum_of_complete z δ.1 (canonicalLegSaturated_touchedLegComplete z δ))
        (liveAmbient_edges_supported ambientSupportOfW'' z)
        (liveAmbient_legs_supported ambientSupportOfW'' z)).elements) :
    canonicalLegSaturatedFlatTouchedInnerStar z δ B.forget
      = touchedInnerStarTotal z δ.1
          (touchedLegLiftDatum_of_complete z δ.1 (canonicalLegSaturated_touchedLegComplete z δ))
          (liveAmbient_edges_supported ambientSupportOfW'' z)
          (liveAmbient_legs_supported ambientSupportOfW'' z) B
proof:
:=
  resolvedStarOnForgetOf_spec _ _ (canonicalLegSaturated_innerRaw_hasNonemptyComponents z δ) hB

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.canonicalLegSaturatedFlatTouchedInnerStar_isFreshStarAssignment
statement:
theorem canonicalLegSaturatedFlatTouchedInnerStar_isFreshStarAssignment {G : ResolvedFeynmanGraph}
    (z : ForestBlockCodType canonicalLegSaturatedCarrierProperSupply.toData G)
    (δ : {x : ResolvedFeynmanSubgraph
        (z.1.1.contractWithStars (canonicalLegSaturatedCarrierProperSupply.toData.starOf G z.1.1)) //
          x ∈ forestDomain z}) :
    (innerRaw z δ.1
        (touchedLegLiftDatum_of_complete z δ.1 (canonicalLegSaturated_touchedLegComplete z δ))
        (liveAmbient_edges_supported ambientSupportOfW'' z)
        (liveAmbient_legs_supported ambientSupportOfW'' z)).forget.IsFreshStarAssignment
      (canonicalLegSaturatedFlatTouchedInnerStar z δ)
proof:
:=
  resolvedStarOnForgetOf_isFreshStarAssignment _ _
    (canonicalLegSaturated_innerRaw_hasNonemptyComponents z δ)
    (touchedInnerStarTotal_fresh_raw canonicalLegSaturatedStarFacts z δ.1
      (touchedLegLiftDatum_of_complete z δ.1 (canonicalLegSaturated_touchedLegComplete z δ))
      (liveAmbient_edges_supported ambientSupportOfW'' z)
      (liveAmbient_legs_supported ambientSupportOfW'' z))
    (touchedInnerStarTotal_injOn_raw canonicalLegSaturatedStarFacts z δ.1
      (touchedLegLiftDatum_of_complete z δ.1 (canonicalLegSaturated_touchedLegComplete z δ))
      (liveAmbient_edges_supported ambientSupportOfW'' z)
      (liveAmbient_legs_supported ambientSupportOfW'' z))

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.ResolvedRecoveredPreimageValueGeometryFloorSupply.coassoc_gen_of_geometry_floor
statement:
theorem coassoc_gen_of_geometry_floor
    (A : ResolvedRecoveredPreimageValueGeometryFloorSupply F V)
    (carrier_isProperForest : ∀ (G : ResolvedFeynmanGraph) (B : ResolvedAdmissibleSubgraph G),
      B ∈ D.carrier G → B.IsProperForest)

    (rep_gen : ∀ x : ResolvedHopfGen, x = (rep x).toResolvedHopfGen (repCD x))
    (x : ResolvedHopfGen) :
    D.coassocLeft (MvPolynomial.X x) = D.coassocRight (MvPolynomial.X x)
