name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.stableResolvedBoundaryIds_stableLocalBoundaryCompletedGraph
statement:
theorem stableResolvedBoundaryIds_stableLocalBoundaryCompletedGraph
    (γ : ResolvedFeynmanSubgraph G) (hSt : StableResolvedBoundaryIds G) :
    StableResolvedBoundaryIds (stableLocalBoundaryCompletedGraph γ)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    intro e₁ h₁ e₂ h₂ hid
    rw [stableLocalBoundaryCompletedGraph_internalEdges] at h₁ h₂
    exact hSt.edgeIdsUnique e₁ (Multiset.mem_of_le γ.internalEdges_le h₁)
      e₂ (Multiset.mem_of_le γ.internalEdges_le h₂) hid
  · 
    intro ℓ₁ h₁ ℓ₂ h₂ hid
    rw [stableLocalBoundaryCompletedGraph_externalLegs] at h₁ h₂
    rcases Multiset.mem_add.mp h₁ with hA₁ | hB₁ <;> rcases Multiset.mem_add.mp h₂ with hA₂ | hB₂
    · exact hSt.legIdsUnique ℓ₁ (Multiset.mem_of_le γ.externalLegs_le hA₁)
        ℓ₂ (Multiset.mem_of_le γ.externalLegs_le hA₂) hid
    · rcases Multiset.mem_map.mp hB₂ with ⟨e₂, he₂, rfl⟩
      rw [boundaryExternalLeg_legId] at hid
      exact absurd hid (hSt.external_boundary_disjoint ℓ₁ (Multiset.mem_of_le γ.externalLegs_le hA₁)
        e₂ (resolvedBoundaryEdges_mem.mp he₂).1)
    · rcases Multiset.mem_map.mp hB₁ with ⟨e₁, he₁, rfl⟩
      rw [boundaryExternalLeg_legId] at hid
      exact absurd hid.symm (hSt.external_boundary_disjoint ℓ₂ (Multiset.mem_of_le γ.externalLegs_le hA₂)
        e₁ (resolvedBoundaryEdges_mem.mp he₁).1)
    · rcases Multiset.mem_map.mp hB₁ with ⟨e₁, he₁, rfl⟩
      rcases Multiset.mem_map.mp hB₂ with ⟨e₂, he₂, rfl⟩
      rw [boundaryExternalLeg_legId, boundaryExternalLeg_legId] at hid
      rw [boundaryLegId_injOn_of_edgeIdUnique hSt.edgeIdsUnique
        (resolvedBoundaryEdges_mem.mp he₁).1 (resolvedBoundaryEdges_mem.mp he₂).1 hid]
  · 
    intro ℓ hℓ e he hcontra
    rw [stableLocalBoundaryCompletedGraph_externalLegs] at hℓ
    rw [stableLocalBoundaryCompletedGraph_internalEdges] at he
    rcases Multiset.mem_add.mp hℓ with hA | hB
    · exact hSt.external_boundary_disjoint ℓ (Multiset.mem_of_le γ.externalLegs_le hA)
        e (Multiset.mem_of_le γ.internalEdges_le he) hcontra
    · rcases Multiset.mem_map.mp hB with ⟨e', he', rfl⟩
      rw [boundaryExternalLeg_legId] at hcontra
      have heq : e' = e := boundaryLegId_injOn_of_edgeIdUnique hSt.edgeIdsUnique
        (resolvedBoundaryEdges_mem.mp he').1 (Multiset.mem_of_le γ.internalEdges_le he) hcontra
      have hbd : γ.resolvedIsBoundaryEdge e' := (resolvedBoundaryEdges_mem.mp he').2
      obtain ⟨hs, ht⟩ := γ.edges_supported e he
      rw [heq] at hbd
      rcases hbd with ⟨_, hout⟩ | ⟨hout, _⟩
      · exact hout ht
      · exact hout hs

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.stableLocalBoundaryCompletedGraph_mapPerm
statement:
theorem stableLocalBoundaryCompletedGraph_mapPerm (σ : Equiv.Perm VertexId)
    (γ : ResolvedFeynmanSubgraph G) :
    stableLocalBoundaryCompletedGraph (γ.mapPerm σ)
      = (stableLocalBoundaryCompletedGraph γ).mapPerm σ
proof:
:= by
  have hpred : ∀ e : ResolvedFeynmanEdge,
      γ.resolvedIsBoundaryEdge e ↔ (γ.mapPerm σ).resolvedIsBoundaryEdge (ResolvedFeynmanEdge.map σ e) := by
    intro e
    unfold resolvedIsBoundaryEdge
    show _ ↔ ((ResolvedFeynmanEdge.map σ e).source ∈ (γ.mapPerm σ).vertices ∧
              (ResolvedFeynmanEdge.map σ e).target ∉ (γ.mapPerm σ).vertices) ∨
             ((ResolvedFeynmanEdge.map σ e).source ∉ (γ.mapPerm σ).vertices ∧
              (ResolvedFeynmanEdge.map σ e).target ∈ (γ.mapPerm σ).vertices)
    simp only [ResolvedFeynmanEdge.map, ResolvedFeynmanSubgraph.mapPerm_vertices,
      σ.injective.mem_finset_image]
  have hBE : (γ.mapPerm σ).resolvedBoundaryEdges
      = γ.resolvedBoundaryEdges.map (ResolvedFeynmanEdge.map σ) := by
    unfold resolvedBoundaryEdges
    symm
    exact Multiset.map_filter_of_iff (ResolvedFeynmanEdge.map σ) G.internalEdges
      γ.resolvedIsBoundaryEdge (γ.mapPerm σ).resolvedIsBoundaryEdge hpred
  have hleg : ∀ e : ResolvedFeynmanEdge,
      ResolvedExternalLeg.map σ (γ.boundaryExternalLeg e)
        = (γ.mapPerm σ).boundaryExternalLeg (ResolvedFeynmanEdge.map σ e) := by
    intro e
    unfold boundaryExternalLeg ResolvedExternalLeg.map resolvedInsideEndpoint
    simp only [ResolvedFeynmanEdge.map, ResolvedFeynmanSubgraph.mapPerm_vertices,
      σ.injective.mem_finset_image]
    by_cases hs : e.source ∈ γ.vertices <;> simp [hs, boundaryLegId]
  have hb : (γ.mapPerm σ).resolvedBoundaryEdges.map (γ.mapPerm σ).boundaryExternalLeg
      = (γ.resolvedBoundaryEdges.map γ.boundaryExternalLeg).map (ResolvedExternalLeg.map σ) := by
    rw [hBE, Multiset.map_map, Multiset.map_map]
    exact Multiset.map_congr rfl (fun e _ => (hleg e).symm)
  have hcomp : (γ.mapPerm σ).externalLegs
        + (γ.mapPerm σ).resolvedBoundaryEdges.map (γ.mapPerm σ).boundaryExternalLeg
      = (γ.externalLegs + γ.resolvedBoundaryEdges.map γ.boundaryExternalLeg).map (ResolvedExternalLeg.map σ) := by
    rw [Multiset.map_add, ResolvedFeynmanSubgraph.mapPerm_externalLegs, hb]
  show stableLocalBoundaryCompletedGraph (γ.mapPerm σ) = (stableLocalBoundaryCompletedGraph γ).mapPerm σ
  exact congr (congr (congrArg ResolvedFeynmanGraph.mk rfl) rfl) hcomp

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.stableComponentGen_mapPermFor
statement:
theorem stableComponentGen_mapPermFor
    {G₁ G₂ : ResolvedFeynmanGraph} {σ : Equiv.Perm VertexId} (hσ : G₂ = G₁.mapPerm σ)
    (γ : ResolvedFeynmanSubgraph G₁)
    (hCD : @FeynmanSubgraph.IsConnectedDivergent G₁.forget (phi4DivergenceMeasureFamily G₁.forget) γ.forget)
    (hCDσ : @FeynmanSubgraph.IsConnectedDivergent G₂.forget (phi4DivergenceMeasureFamily G₂.forget)
      (mapPermRFS hσ γ).forget)
    (hSt₁ : StableResolvedBoundaryIds G₁) (hSt₂ : StableResolvedBoundaryIds G₂) :
    (stableLocalBoundaryCompletedGraph (mapPermRFS hσ γ)).toStableResolvedPhi4HopfGen
        (stableLocalBoundaryCompletedGraph_exists_self_isConnectedDivergent (mapPermRFS hσ γ) hCDσ)
        (stableResolvedBoundaryIds_stableLocalBoundaryCompletedGraph (mapPermRFS hσ γ) hSt₂)
      = (stableLocalBoundaryCompletedGraph γ).toStableResolvedPhi4HopfGen
          (stableLocalBoundaryCompletedGraph_exists_self_isConnectedDivergent γ hCD)
          (stableResolvedBoundaryIds_stableLocalBoundaryCompletedGraph γ hSt₁)
proof:
:= by
  apply toStableResolvedPhi4HopfGen_class_eq
  subst hσ
  show (stableLocalBoundaryCompletedGraph (γ.mapPerm σ)).toResolvedClass
    = (stableLocalBoundaryCompletedGraph γ).toResolvedClass
  rw [stableLocalBoundaryCompletedGraph_mapPerm]
  exact ResolvedFeynmanGraph.toResolvedClass_mapPerm _ _

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.stableLeftAggregate_mapPermFor
statement:
theorem stableLeftAggregate_mapPermFor
    {G₁ G₂ : ResolvedFeynmanGraph} {σ : Equiv.Perm VertexId} (hσ : G₂ = G₁.mapPerm σ)
    (A : @ResolvedAdmissibleSubgraph phi4DivergenceMeasureFamily G₁)
    (hSt₁ : StableResolvedBoundaryIds G₁) (hSt₂ : StableResolvedBoundaryIds G₂) :
    stableLeftAggregate
        (mapPermResolvedAdmissibleSubgraphFor phi4DivergenceMeasureFamily
          phi4PermInvariantDivergenceMeasureFamily hσ A) hSt₂
      = stableLeftAggregate A hSt₁
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : (H : FeynmanGraph) → DivergenceMeasure H := phi4DivergenceMeasureFamily
  set B := mapPermResolvedAdmissibleSubgraphFor phi4DivergenceMeasureFamily
    phi4PermInvariantDivergenceMeasureFamily hσ A with hB
  have hmem : ∀ (γ : ResolvedFeynmanSubgraph G₁), γ ∈ A.elements → mapPermRFS hσ γ ∈ B.elements := by
    intro γ hγ
    rw [hB, mapPermResolvedAdmissibleSubgraphFor_elements]
    exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨γ, hγ, rfl⟩
  symm
  simp only [stableLeftAggregate]
  refine Finset.prod_bij
    (fun (γ : {x // x ∈ A.elements}) _ => (⟨mapPermRFS hσ γ.1, hmem γ.1 γ.2⟩ :
      {x // x ∈ B.elements}))
    (fun _ _ => Finset.mem_attach _ _)
    ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro γ₁ _ γ₂ _ heq
    have h1 : mapPermRFS hσ γ₁.1 = mapPermRFS hσ γ₂.1 := congrArg Subtype.val heq
    exact Subtype.ext (mapPermRFS_injective hσ h1)
  · intro b _
    obtain ⟨bv, hbv⟩ := b
    rw [hB, mapPermResolvedAdmissibleSubgraphFor_elements] at hbv
    rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hbv with ⟨γ, hγ, hγeq⟩
    exact ⟨⟨γ, hγ⟩, Finset.mem_attach _ _, Subtype.ext hγeq⟩
  · intro γ _
    exact congrArg (fun g => (MvPolynomial.X g : StableResolvedPhi4HopfH))
      (stableComponentGen_mapPermFor hσ γ.1 (A.isConnectedDivergent γ.1 γ.2)
        (B.isConnectedDivergent (mapPermRFS hσ γ.1) (hmem γ.1 γ.2)) hSt₁ hSt₂).symm

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.stableResolvedBoundaryIds_contractWithStars
statement:
theorem stableResolvedBoundaryIds_contractWithStars {G : ResolvedFeynmanGraph}
    (A : @ResolvedAdmissibleSubgraph phi4DivergenceMeasureFamily G)
    (starOf : ResolvedFeynmanSubgraph G → VertexId) (hSt : StableResolvedBoundaryIds G) :
    StableResolvedBoundaryIds (A.contractWithStars starOf)
proof:
:= by
  have hcompl : ∀ e ∈ A.complementEdges, e ∈ G.internalEdges :=
    fun e he => Multiset.mem_of_le (Multiset.sub_le_self _ _) he
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    intro e₁ h₁ e₂ h₂ hid
    rw [ResolvedAdmissibleSubgraph.contractWithStars_internalEdges] at h₁ h₂
    obtain ⟨d₁, hd₁, rfl⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp h₁
    obtain ⟨d₂, hd₂, rfl⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp h₂
    have : d₁ = d₂ := hSt.edgeIdsUnique d₁ (hcompl d₁ hd₁) d₂ (hcompl d₂ hd₂) (by
      simpa [ResolvedAdmissibleSubgraph.retargetEdge] using hid)
    rw [this]
  · 
    intro ℓ₁ h₁ ℓ₂ h₂ hid
    rw [ResolvedAdmissibleSubgraph.contractWithStars_externalLegs] at h₁ h₂
    obtain ⟨m₁, hm₁, rfl⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp h₁
    obtain ⟨m₂, hm₂, rfl⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp h₂
    have : m₁ = m₂ := hSt.legIdsUnique m₁ hm₁ m₂ hm₂ (by
      simpa [ResolvedAdmissibleSubgraph.retargetExternalLeg] using hid)
    rw [this]
  · 
    intro ℓ hℓ e he hcontra
    rw [ResolvedAdmissibleSubgraph.contractWithStars_externalLegs] at hℓ
    rw [ResolvedAdmissibleSubgraph.contractWithStars_internalEdges] at he
    obtain ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp hℓ
    obtain ⟨d, hd, rfl⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp he
    apply hSt.external_boundary_disjoint m hm d (hcompl d hd)
    simpa [ResolvedAdmissibleSubgraph.retargetExternalLeg, ResolvedAdmissibleSubgraph.retargetEdge,
      boundaryLegId] using hcontra

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.stableForestRightTerm_class_eq
statement:
theorem stableForestRightTerm_class_eq {G₁ G₂ : ResolvedFeynmanGraph}
    (A₁ : @ResolvedAdmissibleSubgraph phi4DivergenceMeasureFamily G₁)
    (A₂ : @ResolvedAdmissibleSubgraph phi4DivergenceMeasureFamily G₂)
    (s₁ : ResolvedFeynmanSubgraph G₁ → VertexId) (s₂ : ResolvedFeynmanSubgraph G₂ → VertexId)
    (hCD₁ : ResolvedFeynmanGraphClass.IsConnectedDivergentFor phi4DivergenceMeasureFamily
      phi4PermInvariantDivergenceMeasureFamily (A₁.contractWithStars s₁).toResolvedClass)
    (hCD₂ : ResolvedFeynmanGraphClass.IsConnectedDivergentFor phi4DivergenceMeasureFamily
      phi4PermInvariantDivergenceMeasureFamily (A₂.contractWithStars s₂).toResolvedClass)
    (hSt₁ : StableResolvedBoundaryIds (A₁.contractWithStars s₁))
    (hSt₂ : StableResolvedBoundaryIds (A₂.contractWithStars s₂))
    (hcls : (A₁.contractWithStars s₁).toResolvedClass = (A₂.contractWithStars s₂).toResolvedClass) :
    stableForestRightTerm A₁ s₁ hCD₁ hSt₁ = stableForestRightTerm A₂ s₂ hCD₂ hSt₂
proof:
:= by
  unfold stableForestRightTerm
  exact congrArg MvPolynomial.X (toStableResolvedPhi4HopfGen_class_eq _ _ _ _ hcls)

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.contractClass_eq_of_rightTermFor_eq
statement:
theorem contractClass_eq_of_rightTermFor_eq {G₁ G₂ : ResolvedFeynmanGraph}
    (A₁ : @ResolvedAdmissibleSubgraph phi4DivergenceMeasureFamily G₁)
    (A₂ : @ResolvedAdmissibleSubgraph phi4DivergenceMeasureFamily G₂)
    (s₁ : ResolvedFeynmanSubgraph G₁ → VertexId) (s₂ : ResolvedFeynmanSubgraph G₂ → VertexId)
    (hCD₁ : ResolvedFeynmanGraphClass.IsConnectedDivergentFor phi4DivergenceMeasureFamily
      phi4PermInvariantDivergenceMeasureFamily (A₁.contractWithStars s₁).toResolvedClass)
    (hCD₂ : ResolvedFeynmanGraphClass.IsConnectedDivergentFor phi4DivergenceMeasureFamily
      phi4PermInvariantDivergenceMeasureFamily (A₂.contractWithStars s₂).toResolvedClass)
    (h : resolvedForestRightTermFor phi4DivergenceMeasureFamily phi4PermInvariantDivergenceMeasureFamily
          A₁ s₁ hCD₁
        = resolvedForestRightTermFor phi4DivergenceMeasureFamily phi4PermInvariantDivergenceMeasureFamily
          A₂ s₂ hCD₂) :
    (A₁.contractWithStars s₁).toResolvedClass = (A₂.contractWithStars s₂).toResolvedClass
proof:
:= by
  unfold resolvedForestRightTermFor at h
  have hg := MvPolynomial.X_injective h
  have hval := congrArg Subtype.val hg
  rwa [ResolvedFeynmanGraph.toResolvedHopfGenFor_val, ResolvedFeynmanGraph.toResolvedHopfGenFor_val] at hval

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.stableForestSum_mapPerm
statement:
theorem stableForestSum_mapPerm (G : ResolvedFeynmanGraph) (σ : Equiv.Perm VertexId)
    (hSt : StableResolvedBoundaryIds G) (hStσ : StableResolvedBoundaryIds (G.mapPerm σ)) :
    stableForestSum (G.mapPerm σ) hStσ = stableForestSum G hSt
proof:
:= by
  letI : (H : FeynmanGraph) → DivergenceMeasure H := phi4DivergenceMeasureFamily
  symm
  have hmem : ∀ A : {A : @ResolvedAdmissibleSubgraph phi4DivergenceMeasureFamily G
        // A ∈ (phi4WTriplePrimeCanonicalSupply.index G).carrier},
      mapPermResolvedAdmissibleSubgraphFor phi4DivergenceMeasureFamily
          phi4PermInvariantDivergenceMeasureFamily (rfl : G.mapPerm σ = G.mapPerm σ) A.1
        ∈ (phi4WTriplePrimeCanonicalSupply.index (G.mapPerm σ)).carrier := by
    intro A
    rw [phi4WTriplePrimeCanonicalSupply.carrier_mapPerm G σ]
    exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨A.1, A.2, rfl⟩
  refine Finset.sum_bij
    (fun A _ => (⟨mapPermResolvedAdmissibleSubgraphFor phi4DivergenceMeasureFamily
        phi4PermInvariantDivergenceMeasureFamily (rfl : G.mapPerm σ = G.mapPerm σ) A.1, hmem A⟩ :
      {A : @ResolvedAdmissibleSubgraph phi4DivergenceMeasureFamily (G.mapPerm σ)
        // A ∈ (phi4WTriplePrimeCanonicalSupply.index (G.mapPerm σ)).carrier}))
    (fun _ _ => Finset.mem_attach _ _) ?_ ?_ ?_
  · 
    intro a₁ _ a₂ _ heq
    have h1 : mapPermResolvedAdmissibleSubgraphFor phi4DivergenceMeasureFamily
          phi4PermInvariantDivergenceMeasureFamily (rfl : G.mapPerm σ = G.mapPerm σ) a₁.1
        = mapPermResolvedAdmissibleSubgraphFor phi4DivergenceMeasureFamily
          phi4PermInvariantDivergenceMeasureFamily (rfl : G.mapPerm σ = G.mapPerm σ) a₂.1 :=
      congrArg Subtype.val heq
    exact Subtype.ext (mapPermResolvedAdmissibleSubgraphFor_injective phi4DivergenceMeasureFamily
      phi4PermInvariantDivergenceMeasureFamily (rfl : G.mapPerm σ = G.mapPerm σ) h1)
  · 
    intro b _
    obtain ⟨bv, hbv⟩ := b
    rw [phi4WTriplePrimeCanonicalSupply.carrier_mapPerm G σ] at hbv
    obtain ⟨A, hA, hAeq⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hbv
    exact ⟨⟨A, hA⟩, Finset.mem_attach _ _, Subtype.ext hAeq⟩
  · 
    intro A _
    have hleft : stableLeftAggregate A.1 hSt
        = stableLeftAggregate (mapPermResolvedAdmissibleSubgraphFor phi4DivergenceMeasureFamily
            phi4PermInvariantDivergenceMeasureFamily (rfl : G.mapPerm σ = G.mapPerm σ) A.1) hStσ :=
      (stableLeftAggregate_mapPermFor (rfl : G.mapPerm σ = G.mapPerm σ) A.1 hSt hStσ).symm
    have hclsOld := phi4WTriplePrimeCanonicalSupply.rightTerm_mapPerm G σ A.1 A.2 (hmem A)
    have hcls := contractClass_eq_of_rightTermFor_eq A.1
      (mapPermResolvedAdmissibleSubgraphFor phi4DivergenceMeasureFamily
        phi4PermInvariantDivergenceMeasureFamily (rfl : G.mapPerm σ = G.mapPerm σ) A.1)
      (phi4WTriplePrimeCanonicalSupply.starOf G A.1)
      (phi4WTriplePrimeCanonicalSupply.starOf (G.mapPerm σ)
        (mapPermResolvedAdmissibleSubgraphFor phi4DivergenceMeasureFamily
          phi4PermInvariantDivergenceMeasureFamily (rfl : G.mapPerm σ = G.mapPerm σ) A.1))
      (phi4WTriplePrimeCanonicalSupply.hCD G A.1 A.2)
      (phi4WTriplePrimeCanonicalSupply.hCD (G.mapPerm σ) _ (hmem A)) hclsOld
    have hright : stableForestRightTerm A.1 (phi4WTriplePrimeCanonicalSupply.starOf G A.1)
          (phi4WTriplePrimeCanonicalSupply.hCD G A.1 A.2)
          (stableResolvedBoundaryIds_contractWithStars A.1
            (phi4WTriplePrimeCanonicalSupply.starOf G A.1) hSt)
        = stableForestRightTerm (mapPermResolvedAdmissibleSubgraphFor phi4DivergenceMeasureFamily
            phi4PermInvariantDivergenceMeasureFamily (rfl : G.mapPerm σ = G.mapPerm σ) A.1)
            (phi4WTriplePrimeCanonicalSupply.starOf (G.mapPerm σ) _)
            (phi4WTriplePrimeCanonicalSupply.hCD (G.mapPerm σ) _ (hmem A))
            (stableResolvedBoundaryIds_contractWithStars _
              (phi4WTriplePrimeCanonicalSupply.starOf (G.mapPerm σ) _) hStσ) :=
      stableForestRightTerm_class_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hcls
    show stableForestSummand hSt A
      = stableForestSummand hStσ ⟨mapPermResolvedAdmissibleSubgraphFor phi4DivergenceMeasureFamily
          phi4PermInvariantDivergenceMeasureFamily (rfl : G.mapPerm σ = G.mapPerm σ) A.1, hmem A⟩
    unfold stableForestSummand
    rw [hleft, hright]

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.stableForestSumTotal_mapPerm
statement:
theorem stableForestSumTotal_mapPerm (G : ResolvedFeynmanGraph) (σ : Equiv.Perm VertexId) :
    stableForestSumTotal (G.mapPerm σ) = stableForestSumTotal G
proof:
:= by
  unfold stableForestSumTotal

  · rw [dif_neg h, dif_neg (fun hc => h ((stableResolvedBoundaryIds_mapPerm_iff G σ).mp hc))]

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.coproduct_resolved_stable_phi4_of_graph
statement:
theorem coproduct_resolved_stable_phi4_of_graph (G : ResolvedFeynmanGraph)
    (hCD : ∃ hWF : G.forget.WellFormed,
      @FeynmanSubgraph.IsConnectedDivergent G.forget (phi4DivergenceMeasureFamily G.forget)
        (FeynmanSubgraph.self G.forget hWF))
    (hSt : StableResolvedBoundaryIds G) :
    coproduct_resolved_stable_phi4 (MvPolynomial.X (G.toStableResolvedPhi4HopfGen hCD hSt))
      = (MvPolynomial.X (G.toStableResolvedPhi4HopfGen hCD hSt) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1 : StableResolvedPhi4HopfH)
          + (1 : StableResolvedPhi4HopfH) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] MvPolynomial.X (G.toStableResolvedPhi4HopfGen hCD hSt))
        + stableForestSum G hSt
proof:
:= by
  rw [coproduct_resolved_stable_phi4_X]
  unfold stableCoproductGen
  congr 1
  show stableForestSumClass G.toResolvedClass = stableForestSum G hSt
  rw [stableForestSumClass_mk]
  unfold stableForestSumTotal
  rw [dif_pos hSt]

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.sourceRightPrim_eq_rightComponents_prod
statement:
theorem sourceRightPrim_eq_rightComponents_prod (q : ResolvedCoassocSplitChoice D G) :
    resolvedForestLeftTerm (q.1.1.filterElements (fun γ => rightPrimSelected q γ))
      = ∏ γ ∈ q.rightComponents, D.rightFactorOf q γ
proof:
:= by
  rw [resolvedForestLeftTerm_eq_prod, ResolvedAdmissibleSubgraph.filterElements_elements,
    ← prod_attach_filter_val q.1.1.elements (fun δ => rightPrimSelected q δ)
      resolvedComponentGenTerm,
    ResolvedCoassocSplitChoice.rightComponents]
  apply Finset.prod_congr
  · apply Finset.filter_congr
    intro γ hγ
    simp only [ResolvedCoassocSplitChoice.isRightPrimitive, rightPrimSelected,
      ResolvedCoassocSplitChoice.choiceAt, eq_iff_iff]
    exact ⟨fun ⟨_, he⟩ => he, fun he => ⟨γ.2, he⟩⟩
  · intro γ hγ
    rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hγ
    exact (rightFactorOf_eq_genTerm_of_isRightPrimitive hγ.2).symm

theorem right_survivor_transport (R : ResolvedRightSurvivorSupply D G)
    (q : ResolvedCoassocSplitChoice D G)

        R.survivorComponent q γ₁ = R.survivorComponent q γ₂ → γ₁ = γ₂)
    (survivorGen : ∀ γ : {x : _ // x ∈ q.rightComponents},
        resolvedComponentGenTerm (R.survivorComponent q γ) = resolvedComponentGenTerm γ.1.1) :
    resolvedForestLeftTerm (q.1.1.filterElements (fun γ => rightPrimSelected q γ))
      = resolvedForestLeftTerm (R.rightSurvivorForest q)

:=
  (sourceRightPrim_eq_rightComponents_prod q).trans (rightSurvivor_region_eq R q hInj survivorGen)

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.ResolvedCoproductProperForestData.coproduct_resolvedForestLeftTerm_prodSum
statement:
theorem ResolvedCoproductProperForestData.coproduct_resolvedForestLeftTerm_prodSum
    {G : ResolvedFeynmanGraph} (A : ResolvedAdmissibleSubgraph G)
    {κ : {x : ResolvedFeynmanSubgraph G // x ∈ A.elements} → Type}
    (t : (γ : {x : ResolvedFeynmanSubgraph G // x ∈ A.elements}) → Finset (κ γ))
    (f : (γ : {x : ResolvedFeynmanSubgraph G // x ∈ A.elements}) → κ γ →
      ResolvedHopfH ⊗[ℚ] ResolvedHopfH)
    (hdecomp : ∀ γ ∈ A.elements.attach,
      D.toGenSupply.gen (resolvedComponentGen γ.1 (A.isConnectedDivergent γ.1 γ.2))
        = ∑ b ∈ t γ, f γ b) :
    D.coproduct (resolvedForestLeftTerm A)
      = ∑ p ∈ (A.elements.attach).pi t,
          ∏ γ ∈ (A.elements.attach).attach, f γ.1 (p γ.1 γ.2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [D.coproduct_resolvedForestLeftTerm, Finset.prod_congr rfl hdecomp, Finset.prod_sum]

theorem rightRecovered_forward_alpha_membership
    (A : ResolvedRecoveredRegionAlphaValueBridgeAssemblySupply F V)
    {G : ResolvedFeynmanGraph} (q : FilteredForestBlockDom D G) (γ : ResolvedFeynmanSubgraph G) :
    γ ∈ (A.Region.rightRecovered (fwdMapFilteredAlphaValue F V q)).elements
      ↔ rightPrimSelected q.1 γ

statement:
theorem forestRecovered_forward_alpha_membership

    {G : ResolvedFeynmanGraph} (q : FilteredForestBlockDom D G) (γ : ResolvedFeynmanSubgraph G) :
    γ ∈ (A.Region.forestRecovered (fwdMapFilteredAlphaValue F V q)).elements
      ↔ forestChoiceSelected q.1 γ
proof:
:= by
  rw [ResolvedRegionConstructionFromSectorValueSupply.forestRecovered_elements_eq]
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨δ, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp h
    exact A.forest_sound_value q δ
  · intro hγ
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ⟩ := A.forest_complete_value q γ hγ
    exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨δ, Finset.mem_attach _ _, hδ⟩

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.ResolvedRecoveredPreimageAlphaValueRoundTripLeafSupply.choice_component_eq_alpha_value
statement:
theorem choice_component_eq_alpha_value (R : ResolvedRecoveredPreimageAlphaValueRoundTripLeafSupply F V)
    {G : ResolvedFeynmanGraph} (q : FilteredForestBlockDom D G)
    (γ : {x : ResolvedFeynmanSubgraph G // x ∈ q.1.1.1.elements})
    (hu : γ.1 ∈ (R.Data.Tags.Closure.unionOuterAlphaValue (fwdMapFilteredAlphaValue F V q)).1.elements) :
    R.Data.Tags.recoverChoiceAlphaValue (fwdMapFilteredAlphaValue F V q) ⟨γ.1, hu⟩ (Finset.mem_attach _ _)
      = q.1.2 γ (Finset.mem_attach _ _)
proof:
:= by
  rcases hc : q.1.2 γ (Finset.mem_attach _ _) with (b | B)
  · cases b
    · have hr : rightPrimSelected q.1 γ.1 := ⟨γ.2, hc⟩
      have hmem : γ.1 ∈ (R.Data.Tags.Closure.Assembly.Region.rightRecovered
          (fwdMapFilteredAlphaValue F V q)).elements :=
        (R.Data.Tags.Closure.Assembly.rightRecovered_forward_alpha_membership q γ.1).mpr hr
      exact R.Data.Tags.right_tag_alpha (fwdMapFilteredAlphaValue F V q) ⟨γ.1, hu⟩ hmem
    · have hl : ResolvedCoassocSplitChoice.leftSelectedConcrete q.1 γ.1 := ⟨γ.2, hc⟩
      have hmem : γ.1 ∈ (R.Data.Tags.Closure.Assembly.Left.leftResidual
          (fwdMapFilteredAlphaValue F V q)).elements :=
        (R.Data.Tags.Closure.Assembly.leftResidual_forward_alpha_membership q γ.1).mpr hl
      exact R.Data.Tags.left_tag_alpha (fwdMapFilteredAlphaValue F V q) ⟨γ.1, hu⟩ hmem
  · have hf : forestChoiceSelected q.1 γ.1 := ⟨γ.2, B, hc⟩
    have hmem : γ.1 ∈ (R.Data.Tags.Closure.Assembly.Region.forestRecovered
        (fwdMapFilteredAlphaValue F V q)).elements :=
      (R.Data.Tags.Closure.Assembly.forestRecovered_forward_alpha_membership q γ.1).mpr hf
    exact R.forest_value_eq q γ hu B hmem hc

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.ResolvedRecoveredPreimageAlphaValueRoundTripLeafSupply.backward_choice_alpha_value
statement:
theorem backward_choice_alpha_value (R : ResolvedRecoveredPreimageAlphaValueRoundTripLeafSupply F V)

proof:

  have he : (R.Data.Tags.Closure.unionOuterAlphaValue (fwdMapFilteredAlphaValue F V q)).1.elements
      = q.1.1.1.elements := by
    rw [R.Data.Tags.Closure.backward_outer_alpha_value q]
  exact heq_of_index_eq (T := fun x => Bool ⊕ (D.supply (x.toResolvedFeynmanGraph)).ForestIdx)
    (f := R.Data.Tags.recoverChoiceAlphaValue (fwdMapFilteredAlphaValue F V q)) (g := q.1.2) he
    (fun x ha hb => R.choice_component_eq_alpha_value q ⟨x, hb⟩ ha)

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.coproductGen_strict_forestWithCanonicalStars_body
statement:
private theorem coproductGen_strict_forestWithCanonicalStars_body
    (G : ConnectedFeynmanGraph)
    (hGCD : G.toFeynmanGraph.IsConnectedDivergent)
    (hCD : ∀ A : AdmissibleSubgraph G.toFeynmanGraph,
      ∀ hA : A ∈ G.toFeynmanGraph.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs,
        (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestContractGraphWithStars
          G.toFeynmanGraph A
          (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
            G.toFeynmanGraph A hA)).IsConnectedDivergent) :
    coproductGen_strict_forestWithCanonicalStars G hGCD hCD =
      (have genG : HopfH := gen ⟨G.toFeynmanGraph.toClass,
        (FeynmanGraphClass.isConnectedDivergent_toClass G.toFeynmanGraph).mpr hGCD⟩
      (genG ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1 : HopfH))
      + ((1 : HopfH) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] genG)
      + ∑ A ∈ G.toFeynmanGraph.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs.filter
          (fun A => 0 < A.complementEdges.card),
          FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestStrictSummandWithCanonicalStars
            G.toFeynmanGraph hCD A)
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.coproduct_strict_X_eq
statement:
theorem coproduct_strict_X_eq (g : HopfGen) :
    coproduct_strict (MvPolynomial.X g) =
      ((MvPolynomial.X g : HopfH) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1 : HopfH))
      + ((1 : HopfH) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (MvPolynomial.X g : HopfH))
      + ∑ γ ∈ (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.properConnectedDivergentSubgraphs,
          if hγ : γ.IsConnectedDivergent ∧ 0 < γ.internalEdges.card then
            let hγNe : γ.IsNonempty
proof:
:=
              FeynmanSubgraph.isNonempty_of_internalEdges_pos hγ.2
            (gen (γ.toHopfGen hγ.1)) ⊗ₜ[ℚ]
              (gen (γ.contractToHopfGen (repG_wellFormed g) (repG_isOnePI g) hγ.1 hγNe))
          else 0 := by
  rw [coproduct_strict_X]
  unfold coproductGenClass_strict coproductGen_strict
  simp only []
  rw [genG_eq_X g _]
  rfl

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.coproduct_strict_forest_X_eq
statement:
theorem coproduct_strict_forest_X_eq
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract] (g : HopfGen) :
    coproduct_strict_forest (MvPolynomial.X g) =
      ((MvPolynomial.X g : HopfH) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1 : HopfH))
      + ((1 : HopfH) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (MvPolynomial.X g : HopfH))
      + ∑ A ∈ (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs.filter
          (fun A => 0 < A.complementEdges.card),
          FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestStrictSummandWithCanonicalStars
            (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
            (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalContractGraph_hCD_of_ambient_preservation
              (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
              (repG_wellFormed g)
              (repG_isOnePI g)
              (repG_isConnectedDivergent g))
            A
proof:
:= by
  rw [coproduct_strict_forest_X]
  rw [coproductGenClass_strict_forest_eq]
  rw [coproductGen_strict_forestWithCanonicalStarsFromAmbientPreservation_eq]
  rw [coproductGen_strict_forestWithCanonicalStars_body]
  simp [repG, gen, genG_eq_X g _]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro A hA
  rfl

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.coassoc_strict_forest_algHom_of_generators
statement:
theorem coassoc_strict_forest_algHom_of_generators
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    (hX : ∀ g : HopfGen,
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.assoc ℚ ℚ ℚ HopfH HopfH HopfH).toAlgHom
        ((Algebra.TensorProduct.map coproduct_strict_forest (AlgHom.id ℚ HopfH))
          (coproduct_strict_forest (MvPolynomial.X g))) =
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id ℚ HopfH) coproduct_strict_forest)
        (coproduct_strict_forest (MvPolynomial.X g))) :
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.assoc ℚ ℚ ℚ HopfH HopfH HopfH).toAlgHom.comp
        ((Algebra.TensorProduct.map coproduct_strict_forest (AlgHom.id ℚ HopfH)).comp
          coproduct_strict_forest)
      =
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id ℚ HopfH) coproduct_strict_forest).comp
      coproduct_strict_forest
proof:
:= by
  apply MvPolynomial.algHom_ext
  intro g
  simpa [AlgHom.comp_apply] using hX g

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.coassoc_strict_forest_linear_of_algHom
statement:
theorem coassoc_strict_forest_linear_of_algHom
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    (hAlg :
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.assoc ℚ ℚ ℚ HopfH HopfH HopfH).toAlgHom.comp
          ((Algebra.TensorProduct.map coproduct_strict_forest (AlgHom.id ℚ HopfH)).comp
            coproduct_strict_forest)
        =
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id ℚ HopfH) coproduct_strict_forest).comp
        coproduct_strict_forest) :
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.assoc ℚ ℚ ℚ HopfH HopfH HopfH).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
        coproduct_strict_forest.toLinearMap.rTensor HopfH ∘ₗ
        coproduct_strict_forest.toLinearMap

      coproduct_strict_forest.toLinearMap

  simpa [AlgHom.comp_toLinearMap,
    map_coproduct_strict_forest_id_toLinearMap_eq_rTensor,
    map_id_coproduct_strict_forest_toLinearMap_eq_lTensor] using h

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestRightHopfH_eq_of_contract_toClass_eq
statement:
private theorem forestRightHopfH_eq_of_contract_toClass_eq
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    {g₁ g₂ : HopfGen}
    {A₁ : AdmissibleSubgraph (repG g₁).toFeynmanGraph}
    {A₂ : AdmissibleSubgraph (repG g₂).toFeynmanGraph}
    {hA₁ : A₁ ∈ (repG g₁).toFeynmanGraph.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs}
    {hA₂ : A₂ ∈ (repG g₂).toFeynmanGraph.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs}

        (repG g₁).toFeynmanGraph A₁

          (repG g₁).toFeynmanGraph A₁ hA₁)).toClass =

        (repG g₂).toFeynmanGraph A₂
        (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
          (repG g₂).toFeynmanGraph A₂ hA₂)).toClass) :
    forestRightHopfH g₁ A₁ hA₁ = forestRightHopfH g₂ A₂ hA₂

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestCoproductChoice_left_not_mem_forestIndex
statement:
private theorem forestCoproductChoice_left_not_mem_forestIndex
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract] (g : HopfGen) :
    forestCoproductChoice.left ∉ forestCoproductForestChoiceIndex g
proof:
:= by
  intro hmem
  unfold forestCoproductForestChoiceIndex at hmem
  rw [Finset.mem_image] at hmem
  rcases hmem with ⟨A, _hA, hEq⟩
  cases hEq

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestCoproductChoice_right_not_mem_forestIndex
statement:
private theorem forestCoproductChoice_right_not_mem_forestIndex
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract] (g : HopfGen) :
    forestCoproductChoice.right ∉ forestCoproductForestChoiceIndex g
proof:

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestCoproductChoice_forest_injective
proof:
:= by

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestCoproductForestChoiceIndex_sum
statement:
private theorem forestCoproductForestChoiceIndex_sum
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    {M : Type} [AddCommMonoid M] (g : HopfGen)
    (f : forestCoproductChoice g → M) :
    (∑ c ∈ forestCoproductForestChoiceIndex g, f c) =
      ∑ A ∈ forestCoproductProperForestIndex g,
        f (forestCoproductChoice.forest A)
proof:
:= by
  unfold forestCoproductForestChoiceIndex
  exact Finset.sum_image (forestCoproductChoice_forest_injective g).injOn

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestCoproductChoice_inner_sum_eq_boundaries_add_forest
statement:
private theorem forestCoproductChoice_inner_sum_eq_boundaries_add_forest
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    {M : Type} [AddCommMonoid M] (g : HopfGen)
    (f : forestCoproductChoice g → M) :
    (∑ c ∈ forestCoproductChoiceIndex g, f c) =
      f forestCoproductChoice.left + f forestCoproductChoice.right +
        ∑ c ∈ forestCoproductForestChoiceIndex g, f c
proof:
:= by
  have hLeftNot :
      forestCoproductChoice.left ∉
        insert forestCoproductChoice.right
          (forestCoproductForestChoiceIndex g) := by
    intro hmem
    rw [Finset.mem_insert] at hmem
    rcases hmem with hEq | hForest
    · cases hEq
    · exact forestCoproductChoice_left_not_mem_forestIndex g hForest
  have hRightNot :
      forestCoproductChoice.right ∉ forestCoproductForestChoiceIndex g :=
    forestCoproductChoice_right_not_mem_forestIndex g
  change
    (∑ c ∈ insert forestCoproductChoice.left
        (insert forestCoproductChoice.right
          (forestCoproductForestChoiceIndex g)), f c) =
      f forestCoproductChoice.left + f forestCoproductChoice.right +
        ∑ c ∈ forestCoproductForestChoiceIndex g, f c
  rw [Finset.sum_insert hLeftNot]
  rw [Finset.sum_insert hRightNot]
  abel

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestCoproductChoiceTerm_eq_leftRightIndicators_of_not_forest
statement:
private theorem forestCoproductChoiceTerm_eq_leftRightIndicators_of_not_forest
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract] (g : HopfGen)
    (c : forestCoproductChoice g)
    (hNoForest :
      ∀ A : AdmissibleSubgraph (repG g).toFeynmanGraph,
        c ≠ forestCoproductChoice.forest A) :
    forestCoproductChoiceTerm g c =
      (if c = forestCoproductChoice.left then
        (MvPolynomial.X g : HopfH) else 1) ⊗ₜ[ℚ]
      (if c = forestCoproductChoice.right then
        (MvPolynomial.X g : HopfH) else 1)
proof:
:= by
  cases c with
  | left =>
      simp [forestCoproductChoiceTerm]
  | right =>
      simp [forestCoproductChoiceTerm]
  | forest A =>
      exact False.elim ((hNoForest A) rfl)

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.coproductGenClass_strict_forest_eq_choiceSum
statement:
private theorem coproductGenClass_strict_forest_eq_choiceSum
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract] (g : HopfGen) :
    coproductGenClass_strict_forest g =
      ∑ c ∈ forestCoproductChoiceIndex g, forestCoproductChoiceTerm g c
proof:
:= by
  rw [forestCoproductChoice_inner_sum_eq_boundaries_add_forest]
  rw [forestCoproductForestChoiceIndex_sum]
  rw [coproductGenClass_strict_forest_eq]
  rw [coproductGen_strict_forestWithCanonicalStarsFromAmbientPreservation_eq]
  rw [coproductGen_strict_forestWithCanonicalStars_body]
  simp [forestCoproductChoiceTerm, forestCoproductProperForestIndex, repG, gen]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro A hA
  rfl

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentCoproductFactor_prod_eq_choicePi
statement:
private theorem forestComponentCoproductFactor_prod_eq_choicePi
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    {G : FeynmanGraph} (A : AdmissibleSubgraph G) :
    (∏ γ ∈ A.elements, forestComponentCoproductFactor A γ) =
      ∑ p ∈ A.elements.attach.pi (forestComponentChoiceIndex A),
        ∏ γ ∈ A.elements.attach.attach,
          forestCoproductChoiceTerm
            (γ.1.1.toHopfGen (A.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem γ.1.2))
            (p γ.1 γ.2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Finset.prod_attach A.elements
    (fun γ : FeynmanSubgraph G => forestComponentCoproductFactor A γ)]
  have hProd :
      (∏ γ ∈ A.elements.attach, forestComponentCoproductFactor A γ.1) =
        ∏ γ ∈ A.elements.attach,
          ∑ c ∈ forestComponentChoiceIndex A γ,
            forestCoproductChoiceTerm
              (γ.1.toHopfGen (A.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem γ.2)) c := by
    apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
    intro γ _hγ
    rw [forestComponentCoproductFactor_eq_choiceSum_of_mem A γ.2]
    rfl
  rw [hProd]
  rw [Finset.prod_sum]

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentChoiceProductTerm_allLeft
statement:
private theorem forestComponentChoiceProductTerm_allLeft
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    {G : FeynmanGraph} (A : AdmissibleSubgraph G) :
    forestComponentChoiceProductTerm A (forestComponentAllLeftChoice A) =
      A.toHopfH ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1 : HopfH)
proof:
:= by
  unfold forestComponentChoiceProductTerm forestComponentAllLeftChoice
    forestCoproductChoiceTerm
  rw [Finset.prod_attach A.elements.attach
    (fun γ : {γ : FeynmanSubgraph G // γ ∈ A.elements} =>
      (MvPolynomial.X (γ.1.toHopfGen (A.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem γ.2)) :
          HopfH) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1 : HopfH))]
  unfold AdmissibleSubgraph.toHopfH AdmissibleSubgraph.componentToHopfH gen
  let incl : HopfH →ₐ[ℚ] HopfH ⊗[ℚ] HopfH :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft
  change (∏ x ∈ A.elements.attach,
      incl (MvPolynomial.X (x.1.toHopfGen
        (A.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem x.2)) : HopfH)) =
    incl (∏ x ∈ A.elements,
      if hγ : x ∈ A.elements then
        (MvPolynomial.X (x.toHopfGen (A.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem hγ)) :
          HopfH)
      else 1)
  calc
    (∏ x ∈ A.elements.attach,
        incl (MvPolynomial.X (x.1.toHopfGen
          (A.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem x.2)) : HopfH))
        = incl (∏ x ∈ A.elements.attach,
            (MvPolynomial.X (x.1.toHopfGen
              (A.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem x.2)) : HopfH)) := by
          rw [map_prod]
    _ = incl (∏ x ∈ A.elements,
          if hγ : x ∈ A.elements then
            (MvPolynomial.X (x.toHopfGen (A.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem hγ)) :
              HopfH)
          else 1) := by
          congr 1
          rw [← Finset.prod_attach A.elements
            (fun x : FeynmanSubgraph G =>
              if hγ : x ∈ A.elements then
                (MvPolynomial.X (x.toHopfGen
                  (A.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem hγ)) : HopfH)
              else 1)]
          apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
          intro x hx
          simp

        (MvPolynomial.X (x.toHopfGen (A.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem hγ)) :
          HopfH)
      else 1)
  calc
    (∏ x ∈ A.elements.attach,
        incl (MvPolynomial.X (x.1.toHopfGen
          (A.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem x.2)) : HopfH))
        = incl (∏ x ∈ A.elements.attach,
            (MvPolynomial.X (x.1.toHopfGen
              (A.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem x.2)) : HopfH)) := by
          rw [map_prod]
    _ = incl (∏ x ∈ A.elements,
          if hγ : x ∈ A.elements then
            (MvPolynomial.X (x.toHopfGen (A.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem hγ)) :
              HopfH)

              if hγ : x ∈ A.elements then

                  (A.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem hγ)) : HopfH)

          apply Finset.prod_congr rfl

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.mem_forestComponentCoreChoiceIndex
statement:
private theorem mem_forestComponentCoreChoiceIndex
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    {G : FeynmanGraph} (A : AdmissibleSubgraph G)
    (p : ∀ γ : {γ : FeynmanSubgraph G // γ ∈ A.elements},
      γ ∈ A.elements.attach →
        forestCoproductChoice
          (γ.1.toHopfGen (A.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem γ.2))) :
    p ∈ forestComponentCoreChoiceIndex A ↔
      p ∈ A.elements.attach.pi (forestComponentChoiceIndex A) ∧
        p ≠ forestComponentAllLeftChoice A ∧
        p ≠ forestComponentAllRightChoice A
proof:
:= by
  unfold forestComponentCoreChoiceIndex
  rw [Finset.mem_filter]

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentChoice_forest_mem_coproductProperForestIndex_of_core_mem
statement:
private theorem forestComponentChoice_forest_mem_coproductProperForestIndex_of_core_mem
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    {G : FeynmanGraph} {A : AdmissibleSubgraph G}
    {p : ∀ γ : {γ : FeynmanSubgraph G // γ ∈ A.elements},
      γ ∈ A.elements.attach →
        forestCoproductChoice
          (γ.1.toHopfGen (A.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem γ.2))}
    (hp : p ∈ forestComponentCoreChoiceIndex A)
    (γ : {γ : FeynmanSubgraph G // γ ∈ A.elements})
    {B : AdmissibleSubgraph
      (repG (γ.1.toHopfGen (A.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem γ.2))).toFeynmanGraph}
    (hB :
      p γ (Finset.mem_attach A.elements γ) =
        forestCoproductChoice.forest B) :
    B ∈ forestCoproductProperForestIndex
      (γ.1.toHopfGen (A.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem γ.2))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hpPi :
      p ∈ A.elements.attach.pi (forestComponentChoiceIndex A) :=
    ((mem_forestComponentCoreChoiceIndex A p).mp hp).1
  rw [Finset.mem_pi] at hpPi
  have hChoice :
      p γ (Finset.mem_attach A.elements γ) ∈
        forestComponentChoiceIndex A γ :=
    hpPi γ (Finset.mem_attach A.elements γ)
  unfold forestComponentChoiceIndex forestCoproductChoiceIndex at hChoice
  rw [hB] at hChoice
  rw [Finset.mem_insert] at hChoice
  rcases hChoice with hLeft | hChoice
  · cases hLeft
  rw [Finset.mem_insert] at hChoice
  rcases hChoice with hRight | hForest
  · cases hRight
  rw [Finset.mem_image] at hForest
  rcases hForest with ⟨B', hB', hEq⟩
  have hB'eq : B' = B :=
    forestCoproductChoice_forest_injective
      (γ.1.toHopfGen (A.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem γ.2)) hEq
  subst B'
  exact hB'

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentChoice_forest_mem_properDisjoint_of_core_mem
statement:
private theorem forestComponentChoice_forest_mem_properDisjoint_of_core_mem
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    {G : FeynmanGraph} {A : AdmissibleSubgraph G}
    {p : ∀ γ : {γ : FeynmanSubgraph G // γ ∈ A.elements},
      γ ∈ A.elements.attach →
        forestCoproductChoice
          (γ.1.toHopfGen (A.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem γ.2))}
    (hp : p ∈ forestComponentCoreChoiceIndex A)
    (γ : {γ : FeynmanSubgraph G // γ ∈ A.elements})
    {B : AdmissibleSubgraph
      (repG (γ.1.toHopfGen (A.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem γ.2))).toFeynmanGraph}
    (hB :
      p γ (Finset.mem_attach A.elements γ) =
        forestCoproductChoice.forest B) :
    B ∈ ((repG (γ.1.toHopfGen
      (A.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem γ.2))).toFeynmanGraph).properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs
proof:
:= by
  have hStrict :=
    forestComponentChoice_forest_mem_coproductProperForestIndex_of_core_mem
      hp γ hB
  exact ((mem_forestCoproductProperForestIndex
    (γ.1.toHopfGen (A.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem γ.2)) B).mp hStrict).1

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentChoice_forest_complementEdges_positive_of_core_mem
statement:
private theorem forestComponentChoice_forest_complementEdges_positive_of_core_mem
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    {G : FeynmanGraph} {A : AdmissibleSubgraph G}
    {p : ∀ γ : {γ : FeynmanSubgraph G // γ ∈ A.elements},
      γ ∈ A.elements.attach →

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestCoproductChoice_eq_left_or_right_or_forest
statement:
private theorem forestCoproductChoice_eq_left_or_right_or_forest
    (g : HopfGen) (c : forestCoproductChoice g) :
    c = forestCoproductChoice.left ∨
      c = forestCoproductChoice.right ∨
      ∃ A : AdmissibleSubgraph (repG g).toFeynmanGraph,
        c = forestCoproductChoice.forest A
proof:
:= by
  cases c with
  | left =>
      exact Or.inl rfl
  | right =>
      exact Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)
  | forest A =>
      exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨A, rfl⟩)

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentChoice_ne_allLeft_iff_exists_not_left
statement:
private theorem forestComponentChoice_ne_allLeft_iff_exists_not_left
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    {G : FeynmanGraph} (A : AdmissibleSubgraph G)
    (p : ∀ γ : {γ : FeynmanSubgraph G // γ ∈ A.elements},
      γ ∈ A.elements.attach →
        forestCoproductChoice
          (γ.1.toHopfGen (A.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem γ.2))) :
    p ≠ forestComponentAllLeftChoice A ↔
      ∃ γ : {γ : FeynmanSubgraph G // γ ∈ A.elements},
        p γ (Finset.mem_attach A.elements γ) ≠ forestCoproductChoice.left
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hp
    by_contra hnone
    apply hp
    funext γ hγ
    unfold forestComponentAllLeftChoice
    have hcanon : p γ (Finset.mem_attach A.elements γ) =
        forestCoproductChoice.left := by
      by_contra hneq
      exact hnone ⟨γ, hneq⟩
    have hproof : hγ = Finset.mem_attach A.elements γ := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    rw [hproof]
    exact hcanon
  · rintro ⟨γ, hγ⟩ hpEq
    have hval := congrFun (congrFun hpEq γ) (Finset.mem_attach A.elements γ)
    unfold forestComponentAllLeftChoice at hval
    exact hγ hval

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentChoice_ne_allRight_iff_exists_not_right
statement:
private theorem forestComponentChoice_ne_allRight_iff_exists_not_right
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]

  · intro hp

    rw [hproof]
    exact hcanon
  · rintro ⟨γ, hγ⟩ hpEq
    have hval := congrFun (congrFun hpEq γ) (Finset.mem_attach A.elements γ)
    unfold forestComponentAllRightChoice at hval

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentCoreChoice_has_nonLeft_and_nonRight
statement:
private theorem forestComponentCoreChoice_has_nonLeft_and_nonRight
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    {G : FeynmanGraph} {A : AdmissibleSubgraph G}
    {p : ∀ γ : {γ : FeynmanSubgraph G // γ ∈ A.elements},
      γ ∈ A.elements.attach →
        forestCoproductChoice
          (γ.1.toHopfGen (A.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem γ.2))}
    (hp : p ∈ forestComponentCoreChoiceIndex A) :
    (∃ γ : {γ : FeynmanSubgraph G // γ ∈ A.elements},
        p γ (Finset.mem_attach A.elements γ) ≠ forestCoproductChoice.left) ∧
      ∃ γ : {γ : FeynmanSubgraph G // γ ∈ A.elements},
        p γ (Finset.mem_attach A.elements γ) ≠ forestCoproductChoice.right
proof:
:= by
  have hpCore := (mem_forestComponentCoreChoiceIndex A p).mp hp
  exact ⟨(forestComponentChoice_ne_allLeft_iff_exists_not_left A p).mp hpCore.2.1,
    (forestComponentChoice_ne_allRight_iff_exists_not_right A p).mp hpCore.2.2⟩

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentCoreChoice_has_forest_or_mixed_boundary
statement:
private theorem forestComponentCoreChoice_has_forest_or_mixed_boundary
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    {G : FeynmanGraph} {A : AdmissibleSubgraph G}
    {p : ∀ γ : {γ : FeynmanSubgraph G // γ ∈ A.elements},
      γ ∈ A.elements.attach →
        forestCoproductChoice
          (γ.1.toHopfGen (A.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem γ.2))}
    (hp : p ∈ forestComponentCoreChoiceIndex A) :
    forestComponentChoiceHasForest A p ∨
      (forestComponentChoiceHasLeft A p ∧ forestComponentChoiceHasRight A p)
proof:
:= by
  rcases forestComponentCoreChoice_has_nonLeft_and_nonRight (A := A) hp with
    ⟨⟨γNotLeft, hNotLeft⟩, ⟨γNotRight, hNotRight⟩⟩
  rcases forestCoproductChoice_eq_left_or_right_or_forest
      (γNotLeft.1.toHopfGen (A.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem γNotLeft.2))
      (p γNotLeft (Finset.mem_attach A.elements γNotLeft)) with
    hLeft | hRightOrForest
  · exact False.elim (hNotLeft hLeft)
  · rcases hRightOrForest with hRight | hForest
    · have hasRight : forestComponentChoiceHasRight A p := ⟨γNotLeft, hRight⟩
      rcases forestCoproductChoice_eq_left_or_right_or_forest
          (γNotRight.1.toHopfGen (A.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem γNotRight.2))
          (p γNotRight (Finset.mem_attach A.elements γNotRight)) with
        hLeft2 | hRightOrForest2
      · have hasLeft : forestComponentChoiceHasLeft A p := ⟨γNotRight, hLeft2⟩
        exact Or.inr ⟨hasLeft, hasRight⟩
      · rcases hRightOrForest2 with hRight2 | hForest2
        · exact False.elim (hNotRight hRight2)
        · rcases hForest2 with ⟨B, hB⟩
          exact Or.inl ⟨γNotRight, B, hB⟩
    · rcases hForest with ⟨B, hB⟩
      exact Or.inl ⟨γNotLeft, B, hB⟩

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentAllLeftChoice_ne_allRightChoice
statement:
private theorem forestComponentAllLeftChoice_ne_allRightChoice
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    {G : FeynmanGraph} {A : AdmissibleSubgraph G}
    (hAne : A.IsNonempty) :
    forestComponentAllLeftChoice A ≠ forestComponentAllRightChoice A
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  rcases hAne with ⟨γ, hγ⟩
  have hmem : (⟨γ, hγ⟩ : {γ : FeynmanSubgraph G // γ ∈ A.elements}) ∈
      A.elements.attach := by
    exact Finset.mem_attach A.elements _
  have hval := congrFun (congrFun h ⟨γ, hγ⟩) hmem
  unfold forestComponentAllLeftChoice forestComponentAllRightChoice at hval
  cases hval

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentChoiceIndex_eq_insert_boundaries
statement:
private theorem forestComponentChoiceIndex_eq_insert_boundaries
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    {G : FeynmanGraph} (A : AdmissibleSubgraph G) :
    A.elements.attach.pi (forestComponentChoiceIndex A) =
      insert (forestComponentAllLeftChoice A)
        (insert (forestComponentAllRightChoice A)
          (forestComponentCoreChoiceIndex A))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext p
  unfold forestComponentCoreChoiceIndex
  simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_filter]
  constructor
  · intro hp
    by_cases hLeft : p = forestComponentAllLeftChoice A
    · exact Or.inl hLeft
    · by_cases hRight : p = forestComponentAllRightChoice A
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inl hRight)
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨hp, ⟨hLeft, hRight⟩⟩)
  · intro hp
    rcases hp with hLeft | hRest
    · rw [hLeft]
      exact forestComponentAllLeftChoice_mem A
    · rcases hRest with hRight | hCore
      · rw [hRight]
        exact forestComponentAllRightChoice_mem A
      · exact hCore.1

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentChoice_inner_sum_eq_boundaries_add_core
statement:
private theorem forestComponentChoice_inner_sum_eq_boundaries_add_core
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    {G : FeynmanGraph} (A : AdmissibleSubgraph G) (hAne : A.IsNonempty)
    (right : HopfH) :
    (∑ p ∈ A.elements.attach.pi (forestComponentChoiceIndex A),
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.assoc ℚ ℚ ℚ HopfH HopfH HopfH).toAlgHom
        ((forestComponentChoiceProductTerm A p) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] right)) =
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.assoc ℚ ℚ ℚ HopfH HopfH HopfH).toAlgHom
        ((forestComponentChoiceProductTerm A
          (forestComponentAllLeftChoice A)) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] right)
      +
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.assoc ℚ ℚ ℚ HopfH HopfH HopfH).toAlgHom
        ((forestComponentChoiceProductTerm A
          (forestComponentAllRightChoice A)) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] right)
      +
      ∑ p ∈ forestComponentCoreChoiceIndex A,
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.assoc ℚ ℚ ℚ HopfH HopfH HopfH).toAlgHom
          ((forestComponentChoiceProductTerm A p) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] right)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [forestComponentChoiceIndex_eq_insert_boundaries A]
  have hne := forestComponentAllLeftChoice_ne_allRightChoice (A := A) hAne
  have hLeftNot :
      forestComponentAllLeftChoice A ∉
        insert (forestComponentAllRightChoice A)
          (forestComponentCoreChoiceIndex A) := by
    intro hmem
    rw [Finset.mem_insert] at hmem
    rcases hmem with hEq | hCore
    · exact hne hEq
    · unfold forestComponentCoreChoiceIndex at hCore
      exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hCore).2.1 rfl
  have hRightNot :
      forestComponentAllRightChoice A ∉ forestComponentCoreChoiceIndex A := by
    intro hCore
    unfold forestComponentCoreChoiceIndex at hCore
    exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hCore).2.2 rfl
  rw [Finset.sum_insert hLeftNot]
  rw [Finset.sum_insert hRightNot]
  abel

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs_isNonempty
statement:
private theorem properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs_isNonempty
    {G : FeynmanGraph} [DivergenceMeasure G] [Fintype (FeynmanSubgraph G)]

            (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestRightWithCanonicalStars

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestTermFQuotientChoicesDistributed_eq_boundaries_add_core
statement:
private theorem forestTermFQuotientChoicesDistributed_eq_boundaries_add_core
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract] (g : HopfGen) :
    forestTermFQuotientChoicesDistributed g =
      forestTermC g + forestTermE1 g +
        forestTermFQuotientForestChoicesDistributed g
proof:
:= by
  calc
    forestTermFQuotientChoicesDistributed g
        = ∑ A ∈ forestCoproductProperForestIndex g,
            if hA : A ∈ (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs then
              A.toHopfH ⊗ₜ[ℚ]
                forestCoproductChoiceTerm
                  (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestRightWithCanonicalStars
                    (repG g).toFeynmanGraph (forestCanonicalHCD g) A hA)
                  forestCoproductChoice.left
              +
              A.toHopfH ⊗ₜ[ℚ]
                forestCoproductChoiceTerm
                  (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestRightWithCanonicalStars
                    (repG g).toFeynmanGraph (forestCanonicalHCD g) A hA)
                  forestCoproductChoice.right
              +
              ∑ c ∈ forestCoproductForestChoiceIndex
                  (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestRightWithCanonicalStars
                    (repG g).toFeynmanGraph (forestCanonicalHCD g) A hA),
                A.toHopfH ⊗ₜ[ℚ]
                  forestCoproductChoiceTerm
                    (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestRightWithCanonicalStars
                      (repG g).toFeynmanGraph (forestCanonicalHCD g) A hA) c
            else 0 := by
          unfold forestTermFQuotientChoicesDistributed
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro A _hAouter
          by_cases hA :
              A ∈ (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs
          · simpa [hA] using
              forestCoproductChoice_inner_sum_eq_boundaries_add_forest
                (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestRightWithCanonicalStars
                  (repG g).toFeynmanGraph (forestCanonicalHCD g) A hA)
                (fun c => A.toHopfH ⊗ₜ[ℚ]
                  forestCoproductChoiceTerm
                    (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestRightWithCanonicalStars
                      (repG g).toFeynmanGraph (forestCanonicalHCD g) A hA) c)
          · simp [hA]
    _ = (∑ A ∈ forestCoproductProperForestIndex g,
            if hA : A ∈ (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs then
              A.toHopfH ⊗ₜ[ℚ]
                forestCoproductChoiceTerm
                  (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestRightWithCanonicalStars
                    (repG g).toFeynmanGraph (forestCanonicalHCD g) A hA)
                  forestCoproductChoice.left
            else 0)
          +
          (∑ A ∈ forestCoproductProperForestIndex g,
            if hA : A ∈ (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs then
              A.toHopfH ⊗ₜ[ℚ]
                forestCoproductChoiceTerm
                  (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestRightWithCanonicalStars
                    (repG g).toFeynmanGraph (forestCanonicalHCD g) A hA)
                  forestCoproductChoice.right
            else 0)
          +
          forestTermFQuotientForestChoicesDistributed g := by
          unfold forestTermFQuotientForestChoicesDistributed
          rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro A _hAouter
          by_cases hA :
              A ∈ (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs
          · rw [dif_pos hA, dif_pos hA, dif_pos hA, dif_pos hA]
          · rw [dif_neg hA, dif_neg hA, dif_neg hA, dif_neg hA]
            simp
    _ = forestTermC g + forestTermE1 g +
          forestTermFQuotientForestChoicesDistributed g := by
          rw [forestTermFQuotient_leftChoice_eq_C g,
            forestTermFQuotient_rightChoice_eq_E1 g]

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestTermEComponent_allLeftChoice_eq_E1
statement:
private theorem forestTermEComponent_allLeftChoice_eq_E1
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract] (g : HopfGen) :
    (∑ A ∈ forestCoproductProperForestIndex g,
      if hA : A ∈ (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs then
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.assoc ℚ ℚ ℚ HopfH HopfH HopfH).toAlgHom
          ((forestComponentChoiceProductTerm A
            (forestComponentAllLeftChoice A)) ⊗ₜ[ℚ]
              forestRightHopfH g A hA)

proof:
:= by
  unfold forestTermE1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro A _
  by_cases hA : A ∈ (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs
  · rw [dif_pos hA, dif_pos hA]
    rw [forestComponentChoiceProductTerm_allLeft A]
    exact Algebra.TensorProduct.assoc_tmul (R := ℚ) (S := ℚ) (T := ℚ)
      (A := HopfH) (C := HopfH) (D := HopfH) _ _ _
  · rw [dif_neg hA, dif_neg hA]

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestTermEComponentCoreChoicesDistributed_eq_forest_add_mixed
statement:
private theorem forestTermEComponentCoreChoicesDistributed_eq_forest_add_mixed
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract] (g : HopfGen) :
    forestTermEComponentCoreChoicesDistributed g =
      forestTermEComponentForestChoicesDistributed g +
        forestTermEComponentMixedBoundaryChoicesDistributed g
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold forestTermEComponentCoreChoicesDistributed
    forestTermEComponentForestChoicesDistributed
    forestTermEComponentMixedBoundaryChoicesDistributed
    forestComponentForestChoiceCoreIndex
    forestComponentMixedBoundaryChoiceCoreIndex
  rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro A _hAouter
  by_cases hA : A ∈ (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs
  · rw [dif_pos hA, dif_pos hA, dif_pos hA]
    exact (Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not
      (forestComponentCoreChoiceIndex A)
      (fun p => forestComponentChoiceHasForest A p)
      (fun p =>
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.assoc ℚ ℚ ℚ HopfH HopfH HopfH).toAlgHom
          ((forestComponentChoiceProductTerm A p) ⊗ₜ[ℚ]
            forestRightHopfH g A hA))).symm
  · simp [hA]

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestTermEComponentChoicesDistributed_eq_boundaries_add_core
statement:
private theorem forestTermEComponentChoicesDistributed_eq_boundaries_add_core
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract] (g : HopfGen) :
    forestTermEComponentChoicesDistributed g =
      forestTermE1 g + forestTermE2 g +
        forestTermEComponentCoreChoicesDistributed g
proof:
:= by
  calc
    forestTermEComponentChoicesDistributed g
        = ∑ A ∈ forestCoproductProperForestIndex g,
            if hA : A ∈ (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs then
              (Algebra.TensorProduct.assoc ℚ ℚ ℚ HopfH HopfH HopfH).toAlgHom
                  ((forestComponentChoiceProductTerm A
                    (forestComponentAllLeftChoice A)) ⊗ₜ[ℚ]
                      forestRightHopfH g A hA)
              +
              (Algebra.TensorProduct.assoc ℚ ℚ ℚ HopfH HopfH HopfH).toAlgHom
                  ((forestComponentChoiceProductTerm A
                    (forestComponentAllRightChoice A)) ⊗ₜ[ℚ]
                      forestRightHopfH g A hA)
              +
              ∑ p ∈ forestComponentCoreChoiceIndex A,
                (Algebra.TensorProduct.assoc ℚ ℚ ℚ HopfH HopfH HopfH).toAlgHom
                  ((forestComponentChoiceProductTerm A p) ⊗ₜ[ℚ]
                    forestRightHopfH g A hA)
            else 0 := by
          unfold forestTermEComponentChoicesDistributed
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro A _hAouter
          by_cases hA :
              A ∈ (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs
          · simpa [hA] using
              forestComponentChoice_inner_sum_eq_boundaries_add_core A
              (properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs_isNonempty hA)
              (forestRightHopfH g A hA)
          · simp [hA]
    _ = (∑ A ∈ forestCoproductProperForestIndex g,
            if hA : A ∈ (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs then
              (Algebra.TensorProduct.assoc ℚ ℚ ℚ HopfH HopfH HopfH).toAlgHom
                ((forestComponentChoiceProductTerm A
                  (forestComponentAllLeftChoice A)) ⊗ₜ[ℚ]
                    forestRightHopfH g A hA)
            else 0)
          +
          (∑ A ∈ forestCoproductProperForestIndex g,
            if hA : A ∈ (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs then
              (Algebra.TensorProduct.assoc ℚ ℚ ℚ HopfH HopfH HopfH).toAlgHom
                ((forestComponentChoiceProductTerm A
                  (forestComponentAllRightChoice A)) ⊗ₜ[ℚ]
                    forestRightHopfH g A hA)
            else 0)
          +
          forestTermEComponentCoreChoicesDistributed g := by
          unfold forestTermEComponentCoreChoicesDistributed
          rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro A _hAouter
          by_cases hA :
              A ∈ (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs
          · rw [dif_pos hA, dif_pos hA, dif_pos hA, dif_pos hA]
          · rw [dif_neg hA, dif_neg hA, dif_neg hA, dif_neg hA]
            simp
    _ = forestTermE1 g + forestTermE2 g +
          forestTermEComponentCoreChoicesDistributed g := by
          rw [forestTermEComponent_allLeftChoice_eq_E1 g,
            forestTermEComponent_allRightChoice_eq_E2 g]

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.coassoc_forest_LHS_eq
statement:
private theorem coassoc_forest_LHS_eq
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract] (g : HopfGen) :
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.assoc ℚ ℚ ℚ HopfH HopfH HopfH).toAlgHom
        ((Algebra.TensorProduct.map coproduct_strict_forest (AlgHom.id ℚ HopfH))
          (coproduct_strict_forest (MvPolynomial.X g))) =
      forestTermA g + forestTermB g + forestTermC g + forestTermD g + forestTermE g
proof:
:= by
  rw [coproduct_strict_forest_X_eq g]
  simp only [map_add, Algebra.TensorProduct.map_tmul, AlgHom.coe_id, id_eq,
    map_one, map_sum]
  rw [coproduct_strict_forest_X_eq g]
  simp only [TensorProduct.add_tmul, TensorProduct.sum_tmul, map_add, map_sum]
  rw [show ((1 : HopfH ⊗[ℚ] HopfH) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (MvPolynomial.X g : HopfH))
        = ((1 : HopfH) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1 : HopfH)) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (MvPolynomial.X g : HopfH) from by
      rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.one_def]]
  rw [show (∑ A ∈ (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs.filter
          (fun A => 0 < A.complementEdges.card),
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.assoc ℚ ℚ ℚ HopfH HopfH HopfH).toAlgHom
          ((FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestStrictSummandWithCanonicalStars
            (repG g).toFeynmanGraph (forestCanonicalHCD g) A) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1 : HopfH))) =
        forestTermC g from ?cEq]
  case cEq =>
    unfold forestTermC forestRightHopfH forestCoproductProperForestIndex
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro A hA
    have hAProper :
        A ∈ (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs :=
      (Finset.mem_filter.mp hA).1
    rw [FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestStrictSummandWithCanonicalStars_of_mem
      (repG g).toFeynmanGraph (forestCanonicalHCD g) A hAProper]
    rw [dif_pos hAProper]
    exact Algebra.TensorProduct.assoc_tmul (R := ℚ) (S := ℚ) (T := ℚ)
      (A := HopfH) (C := HopfH) (D := HopfH) _ _ _
  rw [show (∑ A ∈ (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs.filter
          (fun A => 0 < A.complementEdges.card),
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.assoc ℚ ℚ ℚ HopfH HopfH HopfH).toAlgHom
          ((Algebra.TensorProduct.map coproduct_strict_forest (AlgHom.id ℚ HopfH))
            (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestStrictSummandWithCanonicalStars
              (repG g).toFeynmanGraph (forestCanonicalHCD g) A))) =
        forestTermE g from ?eEq]
  case eEq =>
    unfold forestTermE forestRightHopfH forestCoproductProperForestIndex
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro A hA
    have hAProper :
        A ∈ (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs :=
      (Finset.mem_filter.mp hA).1
    rw [FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestStrictSummandWithCanonicalStars_of_mem
      (repG g).toFeynmanGraph (forestCanonicalHCD g) A hAProper]
    rw [dif_pos hAProper]
    simp [Algebra.TensorProduct.map_tmul]
  unfold forestTermA forestTermB forestTermD
  rw [show (Algebra.TensorProduct.assoc ℚ ℚ ℚ HopfH HopfH HopfH).toAlgHom
        ((MvPolynomial.X g : HopfH) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1 : HopfH) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1 : HopfH)) =
      (MvPolynomial.X g : HopfH) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] ((1 : HopfH) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1 : HopfH))
      from Algebra.TensorProduct.assoc_tmul (R := ℚ) (S := ℚ) (T := ℚ)
        (A := HopfH) (C := HopfH) (D := HopfH) _ _ _]
  rw [show (Algebra.TensorProduct.assoc ℚ ℚ ℚ HopfH HopfH HopfH).toAlgHom
        ((1 : HopfH) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (MvPolynomial.X g : HopfH) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1 : HopfH)) =
      (1 : HopfH) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] ((MvPolynomial.X g : HopfH) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1 : HopfH))
      from Algebra.TensorProduct.assoc_tmul (R := ℚ) (S := ℚ) (T := ℚ)
        (A := HopfH) (C := HopfH) (D := HopfH) _ _ _]
  rw [show (Algebra.TensorProduct.assoc ℚ ℚ ℚ HopfH HopfH HopfH).toAlgHom
        ((1 : HopfH) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1 : HopfH) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (MvPolynomial.X g : HopfH)) =
      (1 : HopfH) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] ((1 : HopfH) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (MvPolynomial.X g : HopfH))
      from Algebra.TensorProduct.assoc_tmul (R := ℚ) (S := ℚ) (T := ℚ)
        (A := HopfH) (C := HopfH) (D := HopfH) _ _ _]

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.coassoc_forest_RHS_eq
statement:
private theorem coassoc_forest_RHS_eq
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract] (g : HopfGen) :
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id ℚ HopfH) coproduct_strict_forest)
        (coproduct_strict_forest (MvPolynomial.X g)) =
      forestTermA g + forestTermB g + forestTermD g + forestTermE2 g + forestTermF g
proof:
:= by
  rw [coproduct_strict_forest_X_eq g]
  simp only [map_add, Algebra.TensorProduct.map_tmul, AlgHom.coe_id, id_eq,
    map_one, map_sum]
  rw [coproduct_strict_forest_X_eq g]
  simp only [TensorProduct.tmul_add, TensorProduct.tmul_sum]
  rw [show ((MvPolynomial.X g : HopfH) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1 : HopfH ⊗[ℚ] HopfH))
        = (MvPolynomial.X g : HopfH) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] ((1 : HopfH) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1 : HopfH)) from by
      rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.one_def]]
  rw [show (∑ A ∈ (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs.filter
          (fun A => 0 < A.complementEdges.card),
        ((1 : HopfH) ⊗ₜ[ℚ]
          FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestStrictSummandWithCanonicalStars
            (repG g).toFeynmanGraph (forestCanonicalHCD g) A)) =
        forestTermE2 g from ?e2Eq]
  case e2Eq =>
    unfold forestTermE2 forestRightHopfH forestCoproductProperForestIndex
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro A hA
    have hAProper :
        A ∈ (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs :=
      (Finset.mem_filter.mp hA).1
    rw [FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestStrictSummandWithCanonicalStars_of_mem
      (repG g).toFeynmanGraph (forestCanonicalHCD g) A hAProper]
    rw [dif_pos hAProper]
  rw [show (∑ A ∈ (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs.filter
          (fun A => 0 < A.complementEdges.card),
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id ℚ HopfH) coproduct_strict_forest)
          (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestStrictSummandWithCanonicalStars
            (repG g).toFeynmanGraph (forestCanonicalHCD g) A)) =
        forestTermF g from ?fEq]
  case fEq =>
    unfold forestTermF forestRightHopfH forestCoproductProperForestIndex
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro A hA
    have hAProper :
        A ∈ (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs :=
      (Finset.mem_filter.mp hA).1
    rw [FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestStrictSummandWithCanonicalStars_of_mem
      (repG g).toFeynmanGraph (forestCanonicalHCD g) A hAProper]
    rw [dif_pos hAProper]
    simp [Algebra.TensorProduct.map_tmul]
  unfold forestTermA forestTermB forestTermD
  abel

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.coassoc_forest_X_of_main_terms
statement:
private theorem coassoc_forest_X_of_main_terms
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract] (g : HopfGen)
    (hMain : forestTermC g + forestTermE g = forestTermE2 g + forestTermF g) :
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.assoc ℚ ℚ ℚ HopfH HopfH HopfH).toAlgHom
        ((Algebra.TensorProduct.map coproduct_strict_forest (AlgHom.id ℚ HopfH))
          (coproduct_strict_forest (MvPolynomial.X g))) =
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id ℚ HopfH) coproduct_strict_forest)
        (coproduct_strict_forest (MvPolynomial.X g))
proof:
:= by
  rw [coassoc_forest_LHS_eq g, coassoc_forest_RHS_eq g]
  calc
    forestTermA g + forestTermB g + forestTermC g + forestTermD g + forestTermE g
        = (forestTermC g + forestTermE g)
            + (forestTermA g + forestTermB g + forestTermD g) := by
          abel
    _ = (forestTermE2 g + forestTermF g)
            + (forestTermA g + forestTermB g + forestTermD g) := by
          rw [hMain]
    _ = forestTermA g + forestTermB g + forestTermD g + forestTermE2 g + forestTermF g := by
          abel

statement:
private theorem coassoc_strict_forest_linear_of_main_terms
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    (hMain : ∀ g : HopfGen,
      forestTermC g + forestTermE g = forestTermE2 g + forestTermF g) :

        coproduct_strict_forest.toLinearMap.rTensor HopfH ∘ₗ
        coproduct_strict_forest.toLinearMap

      coproduct_strict_forest.toLinearMap

:=
  coassoc_strict_forest_linear_of_generators
    (fun g => coassoc_forest_X_of_main_terms g (hMain g))

        forestTermFQuotientGenerators g - forestTermC g - forestTermE1 g) :

        coproduct_strict_forest.toLinearMap.rTensor HopfH ∘ₗ

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.coassoc_strict_forest_linear_of_expanded_core_add
statement:
private theorem coassoc_strict_forest_linear_of_expanded_core_add
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    (hCore : ∀ g : HopfGen,
      forestTermEComponentGenerators g + forestTermC g =
        forestTermFQuotientGenerators g + forestTermE2 g) :
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.assoc ℚ ℚ ℚ HopfH HopfH HopfH).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
        coproduct_strict_forest.toLinearMap.rTensor HopfH ∘ₗ
        coproduct_strict_forest.toLinearMap
      =
    coproduct_strict_forest.toLinearMap.lTensor HopfH ∘ₗ
      coproduct_strict_forest.toLinearMap
proof:
:=
  coassoc_strict_forest_linear_of_expanded_core
    (fun g => by
      have h := hCore g
      calc
        forestTermEComponentGenerators g - forestTermE1 g - forestTermE2 g
            = (forestTermEComponentGenerators g + forestTermC g)
                - forestTermC g - forestTermE1 g - forestTermE2 g := by
              abel
        _ = (forestTermFQuotientGenerators g + forestTermE2 g)
                - forestTermC g - forestTermE1 g - forestTermE2 g := by
              rw [h]
        _ = forestTermFQuotientGenerators g - forestTermC g - forestTermE1 g := by
              abel)

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.tensorProduct_prod_tmul
statement:
private theorem tensorProduct_prod_tmul {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι)
    (a b : ι → HopfH) :
    (∏ x ∈ s, (a x ⊗ₜ[ℚ] b x)) =
      (∏ x ∈ s, a x) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (∏ x ∈ s, b x)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
      simp [Algebra.TensorProduct.one_def]
  | insert x s hx ih =>
      simp [Finset.prod_insert hx, ih, Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul]

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestCoproductChoiceTerm_eq_outer_inner_of_core
statement:
private theorem forestCoproductChoiceTerm_eq_outer_inner_of_core
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    {G : FeynmanGraph} (A : AdmissibleSubgraph G)
    (p : ∀ γ : {γ : FeynmanSubgraph G // γ ∈ A.elements},
      γ ∈ A.elements.attach →
        forestCoproductChoice
          (γ.1.toHopfGen (A.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem γ.2)))
    (hp : p ∈ forestComponentCoreChoiceIndex A)
    (γ : {γ : FeynmanSubgraph G // γ ∈ A.elements})
    (hγ : γ ∈ A.elements.attach) :
    forestCoproductChoiceTerm
        (γ.1.toHopfGen (A.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem γ.2))
        (p γ hγ) =
      forestComponentChoiceOuterTensorFactor A p γ hγ ⊗ₜ[ℚ]
        forestComponentChoiceInnerTensorFactorOfCore A p hp γ hγ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  cases hChoice : p γ hγ with
  | left =>
      rw [forestCoproductChoiceTerm]
      have hOuter :
          forestComponentChoiceOuterTensorFactor A p γ hγ =
            MvPolynomial.X
              (γ.1.toHopfGen (A.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem γ.2)) := by
        unfold forestComponentChoiceOuterTensorFactor
        rw [hChoice]
      have hInner :
          forestComponentChoiceInnerTensorFactorOfCore A p hp γ hγ = 1 := by
        simpa [forestComponentChoiceInnerTensorFactorOfCore, hChoice]
      rw [hOuter, hInner]
  | right =>
      rw [forestCoproductChoiceTerm]
      have hOuter :
          forestComponentChoiceOuterTensorFactor A p γ hγ = 1 := by
        unfold forestComponentChoiceOuterTensorFactor
        rw [hChoice]
      have hInner :
          forestComponentChoiceInnerTensorFactorOfCore A p hp γ hγ =
            MvPolynomial.X
              (γ.1.toHopfGen (A.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem γ.2)) := by
        simpa [forestComponentChoiceInnerTensorFactorOfCore, hChoice]
      rw [hOuter, hInner]
  | forest B =>
      have hBmem :
          B ∈ ((repG (γ.1.toHopfGen
            (A.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem γ.2))).toFeynmanGraph
          ).properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs :=
        forestComponentChoice_forest_mem_properDisjoint_of_core_mem
          hp γ (by simpa using hChoice)
      rw [forestCoproductChoiceTerm]
      rw [FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestStrictSummandWithCanonicalStars_of_mem
        (repG (γ.1.toHopfGen
          (A.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem γ.2))).toFeynmanGraph
        (forestCanonicalHCD
          (γ.1.toHopfGen (A.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem γ.2)))
        B hBmem]
      have hOuter :
          forestComponentChoiceOuterTensorFactor A p γ hγ = B.toHopfH := by
        unfold forestComponentChoiceOuterTensorFactor
        rw [hChoice]
      have hInner :
          forestComponentChoiceInnerTensorFactorOfCore A p hp γ hγ =
            forestRightHopfH
              (γ.1.toHopfGen (A.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem γ.2)) B hBmem := by
        let hBmem' :
            B ∈ ((repG (γ.1.toHopfGen
              (A.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem γ.2))).toFeynmanGraph
            ).properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs :=
          forestComponentChoice_forest_mem_properDisjoint_of_core_mem
            hp γ (by simpa using hChoice)
        have hInner' :
            forestComponentChoiceInnerTensorFactorOfCore A p hp γ hγ =
              forestRightHopfH
                (γ.1.toHopfGen (A.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem γ.2)) B hBmem' := by
          simp [forestComponentChoiceInnerTensorFactorOfCore, hChoice, hBmem']
        have hProof : hBmem' = hBmem := Subsingleton.elim _ _
        simpa [hProof] using hInner'
      rw [hOuter, hInner]
      unfold forestRightHopfH
      rfl

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentChoiceProductTerm_eq_outer_inner_products_of_core
statement:
private theorem forestComponentChoiceProductTerm_eq_outer_inner_products_of_core
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    {G : FeynmanGraph} (A : AdmissibleSubgraph G)
    (p : ∀ γ : {γ : FeynmanSubgraph G // γ ∈ A.elements},
      γ ∈ A.elements.attach →
        forestCoproductChoice
          (γ.1.toHopfGen (A.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem γ.2)))
    (hp : p ∈ forestComponentCoreChoiceIndex A) :
    forestComponentChoiceProductTerm A p =
      (∏ γ ∈ A.elements.attach,
        forestComponentChoiceOuterTensorFactor A p γ
          (Finset.mem_attach A.elements γ)) ⊗ₜ[ℚ]
      (∏ γ ∈ A.elements.attach,
        forestComponentChoiceInnerTensorFactorOfCore A p hp γ
          (Finset.mem_attach A.elements γ))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold forestComponentChoiceProductTerm
  have hFactor :
      (∏ γ ∈ A.elements.attach.attach,
          forestCoproductChoiceTerm
            (γ.1.1.toHopfGen (A.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem γ.1.2))
            (p γ.1 γ.2)) =
        ∏ γ ∈ A.elements.attach.attach,
          (forestComponentChoiceOuterTensorFactor A p γ.1 γ.2 ⊗ₜ[ℚ]
            forestComponentChoiceInnerTensorFactorOfCore A p hp γ.1 γ.2) := by
    apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
    intro γ _hγ
    exact forestCoproductChoiceTerm_eq_outer_inner_of_core A p hp γ.1 γ.2
  rw [hFactor]
  rw [tensorProduct_prod_tmul A.elements.attach.attach
    (fun γ => forestComponentChoiceOuterTensorFactor A p γ.1 γ.2)
    (fun γ => forestComponentChoiceInnerTensorFactorOfCore A p hp γ.1 γ.2)]
  rw [Finset.prod_attach A.elements.attach
    (fun γ : {γ : FeynmanSubgraph G // γ ∈ A.elements} =>
      forestComponentChoiceOuterTensorFactor A p γ
        (Finset.mem_attach A.elements γ))]
  rw [Finset.prod_attach A.elements.attach
    (fun γ : {γ : FeynmanSubgraph G // γ ∈ A.elements} =>
      forestComponentChoiceInnerTensorFactorOfCore A p hp γ
        (Finset.mem_attach A.elements γ))]

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.sum_attach_dite
statement:
private theorem sum_attach_dite {α M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M]
    (s : Finset α) [DecidablePred (fun a => a ∈ s)]
    (f : ∀ a : α, a ∈ s → M) :
    (∑ a ∈ s, if ha : a ∈ s then f a ha else 0) =
      ∑ a ∈ s.attach, f a.1 a.2
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.sum_bij (fun a ha => ⟨a, ha⟩)
  · intro a ha
    exact Finset.mem_attach s ⟨a, ha⟩
  · intro a₁ _ a₂ _ h
    exact congrArg Subtype.val h
  · intro a ha
    exact ⟨a.1, a.2, Subtype.ext rfl⟩
  · intro a ha
    exact dif_pos ha

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.sum_dite_sigma_attach
statement:
private theorem sum_dite_sigma_attach {α M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M]
    (s : Finset α) [DecidablePred (fun a => a ∈ s)]
    {β : α → Type*} (t : ∀ a : α, Finset (β a))
    (f : ∀ a : α, a ∈ s → β a → M) :
    (∑ a ∈ s, if ha : a ∈ s then ∑ b ∈ t a, f a ha b else 0) =
      ∑ q ∈ s.attach.sigma (fun a : {a // a ∈ s} => t a.1),
        f q.1.1 q.1.2 q.2
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_attach_dite s (fun a ha => ∑ b ∈ t a, f a ha b)]
  rw [Finset.sum_sigma']

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.sum_dite_filter_sigma_attach
statement:
private theorem sum_dite_filter_sigma_attach {α M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M]
    (s : Finset α) [DecidablePred (fun a => a ∈ s)]
    (p : α → Prop) [DecidablePred p]
    {β : α → Type*} (t : ∀ a : α, Finset (β a))
    (f : ∀ a : α, a ∈ s → β a → M) :
    (∑ a ∈ s.filter p, if ha : a ∈ s then ∑ b ∈ t a, f a ha b else 0) =
      ∑ q ∈ (s.attach.filter (fun a : {a // a ∈ s} => p a.1)).sigma
          (fun a : {a // a ∈ s} => t a.1),
        f q.1.1 q.1.2 q.2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  calc
    (∑ a ∈ s.filter p, if ha : a ∈ s then ∑ b ∈ t a, f a ha b else 0)
        = ∑ a ∈ s.filter p,
            if hap : a ∈ s.filter p then
              ∑ b ∈ t a, f a (Finset.mem_filter.mp hap).1 b
            else 0 := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro a ha
          rw [dif_pos (Finset.mem_filter.mp ha).1, dif_pos ha]
    _ = ∑ a ∈ (s.filter p).attach, ∑ b ∈ t a.1,
          f a.1 (Finset.mem_filter.mp a.2).1 b := by
          rw [sum_attach_dite (s.filter p)
            (fun a ha => ∑ b ∈ t a, f a (Finset.mem_filter.mp ha).1 b)]
    _ = ∑ a ∈ s.attach.filter (fun a : {a // a ∈ s} => p a.1),
          ∑ b ∈ t a.1, f a.1 a.2 b := by
          let e : {a // a ∈ s.filter p} ↪ {a // a ∈ s} :=
            (Function.Embedding.refl α).subtypeMap (by
              intro a ha
              exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp ha).1)
          rw [Finset.filter_attach]
          change
              (∑ a ∈ (s.filter p).attach, ∑ b ∈ t a.1,
                  f a.1 (Finset.mem_filter.mp a.2).1 b) =
                ∑ a ∈ (s.filter p).attach.map e, ∑ b ∈ t a.1,
                  f a.1 a.2 b
          rw [Finset.sum_map]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro a ha
          rfl
    _ = ∑ q ∈ (s.attach.filter (fun a : {a // a ∈ s} => p a.1)).sigma
          (fun a : {a // a ∈ s} => t a.1),
        f q.1.1 q.1.2 q.2 := by
          rw [Finset.sum_sigma']

statement:
private theorem sum_dite_sigma_attach_subtype {α M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M]
    (s : Finset α) [DecidablePred (fun a => a ∈ s)]
    {β : ∀ a : α, a ∈ s → Type*}
    (t : ∀ a : α, ∀ ha : a ∈ s, Finset (β a ha))
    (f : ∀ a : α, ∀ ha : a ∈ s, β a ha → M) :
    (∑ a ∈ s, if ha : a ∈ s then ∑ b ∈ t a ha, f a ha b else 0) =
      ∑ q ∈ s.attach.sigma (fun a : {a // a ∈ s} => t a.1 a.2),
        f q.1.1 q.1.2 q.2
