name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentForestChoice_vertex_mem_outer_iff_componentRemnant
statement:
private theorem
    forestComponentForestChoice_vertex_mem_outer_iff_componentRemnant
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract] (g : HopfGen)
    (q : forestComponentChoiceSigma g)
    (hq : q ∈ forestComponentForestChoiceSigmaIndex g)
    (γ : {γ : FeynmanSubgraph (repG g).toFeynmanGraph // γ ∈ q.1.1.elements})
    {B : AdmissibleSubgraph
      (repG (γ.1.toHopfGen (q.1.1.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem γ.2))).toFeynmanGraph}
    (hB :
      q.2 γ (Finset.mem_attach q.1.1.elements γ) =
        forestCoproductChoice.forest B)
    {u : VertexId} (huγ : u ∈ γ.1.vertices) :
    u ∈ (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1.vertices ↔
      u ∈ (feynmanSubgraphRepToComponentAdmissibleSubgraph γ.1
        (q.1.1.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem γ.2) B).vertices
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let Aout := (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1
  let Bc := feynmanSubgraphRepToComponentAdmissibleSubgraph γ.1
    (q.1.1.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem γ.2) B
  constructor
  · intro huOuter
    rcases AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_vertices.mp huOuter with
      ⟨δ, hδOuter, huδ⟩
    rw [forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex_val,
      forestComponentForestChoiceOuterSubgraph_elements] at hδOuter
    rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hδOuter with hδLeft | hδForest
    · have hδA : δ ∈ q.1.1.elements :=
        forestComponentChoiceLeftSubgraph_elements_subset q.1.1 q.2 hδLeft
      by_cases hδγ : δ = γ.1
      · subst δ
        rw [forestComponentChoiceLeftSubgraph_elements] at hδLeft
        have hLeft := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hδLeft).2
        unfold forestComponentChoiceIsLeft at hLeft
        rw [dif_pos γ.2] at hLeft
        rw [hB] at hLeft
        cases hLeft
      · have hDisjA : q.1.1.IsPairwiseDisjoint :=
          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
            |>.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs_isPairwiseDisjoint q.1.2
        have hdisj : δ.Disjoint γ.1 := hDisjA hδA γ.2 hδγ
        exact False.elim ((Finset.disjoint_left.mp hdisj huδ) huγ)
    · rcases forestComponentChoicePromotedForestComponents_mem_exists
        q.1.1 q.2 hδForest with
        ⟨η, Bη, hBη, hδBη⟩
      have hδSubset :
          δ.vertices ⊆ η.1.vertices :=
        feynmanSubgraphRepForestPromoteAdmissibleSubgraph_vertices_subset_outer
          η.1 (q.1.1.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem η.2) Bη hδBη
      have huη : u ∈ η.1.vertices := hδSubset huδ
      by_cases hηγ : η.1 = γ.1
      · have hηsub : η = γ := Subtype.ext hηγ
        subst η
        have hBηEq : Bη = B := by
          apply forestCoproductChoice_forest_injective
            (γ.1.toHopfGen (q.1.1.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem γ.2))
          rw [← hBη, ← hB]
        subst Bη
        unfold feynmanSubgraphRepForestPromoteAdmissibleSubgraph at hδBη
        rw [feynmanSubgraphPromoteAdmissibleSubgraph_elements] at hδBη
        rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hδBη with ⟨ηInner, _hηAttach, hηProm⟩
        have hηMem : ηInner.1 ∈ Bc.elements := by
          simpa [Bc] using ηInner.2
        have huηInner : u ∈ ηInner.1.vertices := by
          simpa [← hηProm] using huδ
        exact AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_vertices.mpr
          ⟨ηInner.1, hηMem, huηInner⟩
      · have hDisjA : q.1.1.IsPairwiseDisjoint :=
          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
            |>.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs_isPairwiseDisjoint q.1.2
        have hdisj : η.1.Disjoint γ.1 := hDisjA η.2 γ.2 hηγ
        exact False.elim ((Finset.disjoint_left.mp hdisj huη) huγ)
  · intro huBc
    rcases AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_vertices.mp huBc with
      ⟨η, hη, huη⟩
    have hηOuter :
        feynmanSubgraphPromote (γ_outer := γ.1) η ∈ Aout.elements := by
      simpa [Aout, Bc] using
        forestComponentForestChoice_componentRemnantStar_promote_mem_outer
          g q hq γ hB (η := η) hη
    exact AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_vertices.mpr
      ⟨feynmanSubgraphPromote (γ_outer := γ.1) η, hηOuter, by simpa using huη⟩

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentForestChoice_internalEdge_mem_outer_iff_componentRemnant
statement:
private theorem
    forestComponentForestChoice_internalEdge_mem_outer_iff_componentRemnant
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract] (g : HopfGen)
    (q : forestComponentChoiceSigma g)
    (hq : q ∈ forestComponentForestChoiceSigmaIndex g)
    (γ : {γ : FeynmanSubgraph (repG g).toFeynmanGraph // γ ∈ q.1.1.elements})
    {B : AdmissibleSubgraph
      (repG (γ.1.toHopfGen (q.1.1.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem γ.2))).toFeynmanGraph}

    {e : FeynmanEdge} (heγ : e ∈ γ.1.internalEdges) :
    e ∈ (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1.internalEdges ↔
      e ∈ (feynmanSubgraphRepToComponentAdmissibleSubgraph γ.1
        (q.1.1.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem γ.2) B).internalEdges
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let Aout := (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1
  let Bc := feynmanSubgraphRepToComponentAdmissibleSubgraph γ.1
    (q.1.1.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem γ.2) B
  have hsuppγ := γ.1.edges_supported e heγ
  simp [FeynmanEdge.SupportedOn] at hsuppγ
  constructor
  · intro heOuter
    rcases AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_internalEdges.mp heOuter with
      ⟨δ, hδOuter, heδ⟩
    rw [forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex_val,
      forestComponentForestChoiceOuterSubgraph_elements] at hδOuter
    have hsuppδ := δ.edges_supported e heδ
    simp [FeynmanEdge.SupportedOn] at hsuppδ
    rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hδOuter with hδLeft | hδForest
    · have hδA : δ ∈ q.1.1.elements :=
        forestComponentChoiceLeftSubgraph_elements_subset q.1.1 q.2 hδLeft
      by_cases hδγ : δ = γ.1
      · subst δ
        rw [forestComponentChoiceLeftSubgraph_elements] at hδLeft
        have hLeft := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hδLeft).2
        unfold forestComponentChoiceIsLeft at hLeft
        rw [dif_pos γ.2] at hLeft
        rw [hB] at hLeft
        cases hLeft
      · have hDisjA : q.1.1.IsPairwiseDisjoint :=
          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
            |>.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs_isPairwiseDisjoint q.1.2
        have hdisj : δ.Disjoint γ.1 := hDisjA hδA γ.2 hδγ
        exact False.elim ((Finset.disjoint_left.mp hdisj hsuppδ.1) hsuppγ.1)
    · rcases forestComponentChoicePromotedForestComponents_mem_exists
        q.1.1 q.2 hδForest with
        ⟨η, Bη, hBη, hδBη⟩
      have hδSubset :
          δ.vertices ⊆ η.1.vertices :=
        feynmanSubgraphRepForestPromoteAdmissibleSubgraph_vertices_subset_outer
          η.1 (q.1.1.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem η.2) Bη hδBη
      have hsrcη : e.source ∈ η.1.vertices := hδSubset hsuppδ.1
      by_cases hηγ : η.1 = γ.1
      · have hηsub : η = γ := Subtype.ext hηγ
        subst η
        have hBηEq : Bη = B := by
          apply forestCoproductChoice_forest_injective
            (γ.1.toHopfGen (q.1.1.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem γ.2))
          rw [← hBη, ← hB]
        subst Bη
        unfold feynmanSubgraphRepForestPromoteAdmissibleSubgraph at hδBη
        rw [feynmanSubgraphPromoteAdmissibleSubgraph_elements] at hδBη
        rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hδBη with ⟨ηInner, _hηAttach, hηProm⟩
        have hηMem : ηInner.1 ∈ Bc.elements := by
          simpa [Bc] using ηInner.2
        have heηInner : e ∈ ηInner.1.internalEdges := by
          simpa [← hηProm] using heδ
        exact AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_internalEdges.mpr
          ⟨ηInner.1, hηMem, heηInner⟩
      · have hDisjA : q.1.1.IsPairwiseDisjoint :=
          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
            |>.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs_isPairwiseDisjoint q.1.2
        have hdisj : η.1.Disjoint γ.1 := hDisjA η.2 γ.2 hηγ

    rcases AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_internalEdges.mp heBc with
      ⟨η, hη, heη⟩
    have hηOuter :
        feynmanSubgraphPromote (γ_outer := γ.1) η ∈ Aout.elements := by
      simpa [Aout, Bc] using
        forestComponentForestChoice_componentRemnantStar_promote_mem_outer
          g q hq γ hB (η := η) hη
    exact AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_internalEdges.mpr
      ⟨feynmanSubgraphPromote (γ_outer := γ.1) η, hηOuter,
        by simpa using heη⟩

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentForestChoice_promotedForestComponents_internalEdges_count_eq_componentRemnant
statement:
private theorem
    forestComponentForestChoice_promotedForestComponents_internalEdges_count_eq_componentRemnant
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract] (g : HopfGen)
    (q : forestComponentChoiceSigma g)
    (_hq : q ∈ forestComponentForestChoiceSigmaIndex g)
    (γ : {γ : FeynmanSubgraph (repG g).toFeynmanGraph // γ ∈ q.1.1.elements})
    {B : AdmissibleSubgraph
      (repG (γ.1.toHopfGen (q.1.1.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem γ.2))).toFeynmanGraph}
    (hB :
      q.2 γ (Finset.mem_attach q.1.1.elements γ) =
        forestCoproductChoice.forest B)
    {e : FeynmanEdge} (heγ : e ∈ γ.1.internalEdges) :
    (∑ δ ∈ forestComponentChoicePromotedForestComponents q.1.1 q.2,
        Multiset.count e δ.internalEdges) =
      Multiset.count e
        (feynmanSubgraphRepToComponentAdmissibleSubgraph γ.1
          (q.1.1.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem γ.2) B).internalEdges
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hDisjA : q.1.1.IsPairwiseDisjoint :=
    (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
      |>.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs_isPairwiseDisjoint q.1.2
  have hsuppγ := γ.1.edges_supported e heγ
  simp [FeynmanEdge.SupportedOn] at hsuppγ
  unfold forestComponentChoicePromotedForestComponents
  rw [Finset.sum_biUnion_of_pairwise_eq_zero (M := Nat)]
  · calc
      _ = _ := by
        rw [Finset.sum_eq_single γ]
        · intro η _hη hηγ
          cases hηChoice :
              q.2 η (Finset.mem_attach q.1.1.elements η) with
          | left =>
              simp
          | right =>
              simp
          | forest Bη =>
              simp
              intro δ hδ heδ
              have hsuppδ := δ.edges_supported e heδ
              simp [FeynmanEdge.SupportedOn] at hsuppδ
              have hδSubset :
                  δ.vertices ⊆ η.1.vertices :=
                feynmanSubgraphRepForestPromoteAdmissibleSubgraph_vertices_subset_outer
                  η.1 (q.1.1.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem η.2) Bη hδ
              have hηγNe : η.1 ≠ γ.1 := by
                intro hEq
                exact hηγ (Subtype.ext hEq)
              have hdisj : η.1.Disjoint γ.1 := hDisjA η.2 γ.2 hηγNe
              exact (Finset.disjoint_left.mp hdisj (hδSubset hsuppδ.1)) hsuppγ.1
        · intro hγnot
          exact False.elim (hγnot (Finset.mem_attach q.1.1.elements γ))
      _ =
        Multiset.count e
          (feynmanSubgraphRepToComponentAdmissibleSubgraph γ.1
            (q.1.1.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem γ.2) B).internalEdges := by
        rw [show q.2 γ _ = q.2 γ
            (Finset.mem_attach q.1.1.elements γ) by
          congr]
        rw [hB]
        change
          (∑ δ ∈
              (feynmanSubgraphRepForestPromoteAdmissibleSubgraph γ.1
                (q.1.1.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem γ.2) B).elements,
            Multiset.count e δ.internalEdges) =
            Multiset.count e
              (feynmanSubgraphRepToComponentAdmissibleSubgraph γ.1
                (q.1.1.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem γ.2) B).internalEdges
        rw [← Multiset.count_sum']
        exact congrArg (Multiset.count e)
          (feynmanSubgraphRepForestPromoteAdmissibleSubgraph_internalEdges
            γ.1 (q.1.1.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem γ.2) B)
  · intro η _hη θ _hθ hηθ δ hδ
    apply Multiset.count_eq_zero.mpr
    intro heδ
    rcases Finset.mem_inter.mp hδ with ⟨hδη, hδθ⟩
    have hsuppδ := δ.edges_supported e heδ
    simp [FeynmanEdge.SupportedOn] at hsuppδ
    cases hηChoice :
        q.2 η (Finset.mem_attach q.1.1.elements η) with
    | left =>
        simp [hηChoice] at hδη
    | right =>
        simp [hηChoice] at hδη
    | forest Bη =>
        cases hθChoice :
            q.2 θ (Finset.mem_attach q.1.1.elements θ) with
        | left =>
            simp [hθChoice] at hδθ
        | right =>
            simp [hθChoice] at hδθ
        | forest Bθ =>
            have hδSubsetη :
                δ.vertices ⊆ η.1.vertices :=
              feynmanSubgraphRepForestPromoteAdmissibleSubgraph_vertices_subset_outer
                η.1 (q.1.1.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem η.2) Bη
                (by simpa [hηChoice] using hδη)
            have hδSubsetθ :
                δ.vertices ⊆ θ.1.vertices :=
              feynmanSubgraphRepForestPromoteAdmissibleSubgraph_vertices_subset_outer
                θ.1 (q.1.1.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem θ.2) Bθ
                (by simpa [hθChoice] using hδθ)
            by_cases hηθVal : η.1 = θ.1
            · exact hηθ (Subtype.ext hηθVal)
            · have hdisj : η.1.Disjoint θ.1 := hDisjA η.2 θ.2 hηθVal
              exact (Finset.disjoint_left.mp hdisj
                (hδSubsetη hsuppδ.1)) (hδSubsetθ hsuppδ.1)

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentForestChoice_leftSubgraph_internalEdges_count_eq_zero_of_component
statement:
private theorem

    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract] (g : HopfGen)

      q.2 γ (Finset.mem_attach q.1.1.elements γ) =
        forestCoproductChoice.forest B)
    {e : FeynmanEdge} (heγ : e ∈ γ.1.internalEdges) :
    Multiset.count e (forestComponentChoiceLeftSubgraph q.1.1 q.2).internalEdges = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply Multiset.count_eq_zero.mpr
  intro heLeft
  rcases AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_internalEdges.mp heLeft with ⟨δ, hδLeft, heδ⟩
  have hδA : δ ∈ q.1.1.elements :=
    forestComponentChoiceLeftSubgraph_elements_subset q.1.1 q.2 hδLeft
  by_cases hδγ : δ = γ.1
  · subst δ
    rw [forestComponentChoiceLeftSubgraph_elements] at hδLeft
    have hLeft := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hδLeft).2
    unfold forestComponentChoiceIsLeft at hLeft
    rw [dif_pos γ.2] at hLeft
    rw [hB] at hLeft
    cases hLeft
  · have hsuppδ := δ.edges_supported e heδ
    have hsuppγ := γ.1.edges_supported e heγ
    simp [FeynmanEdge.SupportedOn] at hsuppδ hsuppγ
    have hDisjA : q.1.1.IsPairwiseDisjoint :=
      (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
        |>.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs_isPairwiseDisjoint q.1.2
    have hdisj : δ.Disjoint γ.1 := hDisjA hδA γ.2 hδγ
    exact (Finset.disjoint_left.mp hdisj hsuppδ.1) hsuppγ.1

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentForestChoice_left_promotedForestComponents_disjoint
statement:
private theorem forestComponentForestChoice_left_promotedForestComponents_disjoint
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract] (g : HopfGen)
    (q : forestComponentChoiceSigma g) :
    Disjoint (forestComponentChoiceLeftSubgraph q.1.1 q.2).elements
      (forestComponentChoicePromotedForestComponents q.1.1 q.2)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hDisjA : q.1.1.IsPairwiseDisjoint :=
    (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
      |>.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs_isPairwiseDisjoint q.1.2
  rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
  intro δ hδLeft hδPromoted
  have hδDisj : δ.Disjoint δ :=
    forestComponentChoiceLeft_promotedForestComponent_disjoint
      q.1.1 q.2 hDisjA hδLeft hδPromoted
  have hδA : δ ∈ q.1.1.elements :=
    forestComponentChoiceLeftSubgraph_elements_subset q.1.1 q.2 hδLeft
  have hδNonempty : δ.IsNonempty :=
    (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
      |>.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs_hasNonemptyComponents
        q.1.2 δ hδA
  unfold FeynmanSubgraph.IsNonempty FeynmanSubgraph.vertexCount at hδNonempty
  rcases Finset.card_pos.mp hδNonempty with ⟨v, hv⟩
  exact (Finset.disjoint_left.mp hδDisj hv) hv

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex_toHopfH_eq_left_mul_promotedComponents
statement:
private theorem forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex_toHopfH_eq_left_mul_promotedComponents
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract] (g : HopfGen)
    (q : forestComponentChoiceSigma g)
    (hq : q ∈ forestComponentForestChoiceSigmaIndex g) :
    (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1.toHopfH =
      (forestComponentChoiceLeftSubgraph q.1.1 q.2).toHopfH *
        forestComponentChoicePromotedComponentsHopfProduct q.1.1 q.2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex_val]
  unfold AdmissibleSubgraph.toHopfH
  rw [forestComponentForestChoiceOuterSubgraph_elements]
  rw [Finset.prod_union
    (forestComponentForestChoice_left_promotedForestComponents_disjoint g q)]
  unfold forestComponentChoicePromotedComponentsHopfProduct
  congr 1
  · apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
    intro δ hδ
    unfold AdmissibleSubgraph.componentToHopfH gen
    have hδOuterUnion :
        δ ∈ (forestComponentChoiceLeftSubgraph q.1.1 q.2).elements ∪
          forestComponentChoicePromotedForestComponents q.1.1 q.2 :=
      Finset.mem_union_left _ hδ
    have hδOuter :
        δ ∈ (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterSubgraph q.1.1 q.2
          ((repG g).toFeynmanGraph
            |>.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs_isPairwiseDisjoint
              q.1.2)).elements := by
      rw [forestComponentForestChoiceOuterSubgraph_elements]
      exact hδOuterUnion
    rw [dif_pos hδOuter, dif_pos hδ]
  · apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
    intro δ hδ
    unfold AdmissibleSubgraph.componentToHopfH gen
    have hδOuterUnion :
        δ ∈ (forestComponentChoiceLeftSubgraph q.1.1 q.2).elements ∪
          forestComponentChoicePromotedForestComponents q.1.1 q.2 :=
      Finset.mem_union_right _ hδ
    have hδOuter :
        δ ∈ (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterSubgraph q.1.1 q.2
          ((repG g).toFeynmanGraph
            |>.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs_isPairwiseDisjoint
              q.1.2)).elements := by
      rw [forestComponentForestChoiceOuterSubgraph_elements]
      exact hδOuterUnion
    rw [dif_pos hδOuter, dif_pos hδ]

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentForestChoice_outer_internalEdges_count_eq_componentRemnant
statement:
private theorem forestComponentForestChoice_outer_internalEdges_count_eq_componentRemnant
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract] (g : HopfGen)
    (q : forestComponentChoiceSigma g)
    (hq : q ∈ forestComponentForestChoiceSigmaIndex g)
    (γ : {γ : FeynmanSubgraph (repG g).toFeynmanGraph // γ ∈ q.1.1.elements})
    {B : AdmissibleSubgraph
      (repG (γ.1.toHopfGen (q.1.1.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem γ.2))).toFeynmanGraph}
    (hB :
      q.2 γ (Finset.mem_attach q.1.1.elements γ) =
        forestCoproductChoice.forest B)
    {e : FeynmanEdge} (heγ : e ∈ γ.1.internalEdges) :
    Multiset.count e (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1.internalEdges =
      Multiset.count e
        (feynmanSubgraphRepToComponentAdmissibleSubgraph γ.1
          (q.1.1.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem γ.2) B).internalEdges
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hLeft0 :=
    forestComponentForestChoice_leftSubgraph_internalEdges_count_eq_zero_of_component
      g q hq γ hB heγ
  have hPromoted :=
    forestComponentForestChoice_promotedForestComponents_internalEdges_count_eq_componentRemnant
      g q hq γ hB heγ
  have hLeftPromoted :
      Disjoint (forestComponentChoiceLeftSubgraph q.1.1 q.2).elements
        (forestComponentChoicePromotedForestComponents q.1.1 q.2) :=
    forestComponentForestChoice_left_promotedForestComponents_disjoint g q
  rw [forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex_val]
  unfold AdmissibleSubgraph.internalEdges
  rw [forestComponentForestChoiceOuterSubgraph_elements]
  rw [Finset.sum_union hLeftPromoted]
  rw [Multiset.count_add]
  have hLeft0' :
      Multiset.count e
          (∑ δ ∈ (forestComponentChoiceLeftSubgraph q.1.1 q.2).elements,
            δ.internalEdges) = 0 := by
    simpa [AdmissibleSubgraph.internalEdges] using hLeft0
  have hPromoted' :
      Multiset.count e
          (∑ δ ∈ forestComponentChoicePromotedForestComponents q.1.1 q.2,
            δ.internalEdges) =
        Multiset.count e
          (feynmanSubgraphRepToComponentAdmissibleSubgraph γ.1
            (q.1.1.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem γ.2) B).internalEdges := by
    rw [Multiset.count_sum']
    exact hPromoted
  have hPromoted'' :
      Multiset.count e
          (∑ δ ∈ forestComponentChoicePromotedForestComponents q.1.1 q.2,
            δ.internalEdges) =
        Multiset.count e
          (∑ δ ∈
            (feynmanSubgraphRepToComponentAdmissibleSubgraph γ.1
              (q.1.1.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem γ.2) B).elements,
            δ.internalEdges) := by
    simpa [AdmissibleSubgraph.internalEdges] using hPromoted'
  rw [hLeft0', hPromoted'']
  simp

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentForestChoice_retargetVertex_eq_componentRemnant
statement:
private theorem
    forestComponentForestChoice_retargetVertex_eq_componentRemnant
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract] (g : HopfGen)
    (q : forestComponentChoiceSigma g)
    (hq : q ∈ forestComponentForestChoiceSigmaIndex g)
    (γ : {γ : FeynmanSubgraph (repG g).toFeynmanGraph // γ ∈ q.1.1.elements})
    {B : AdmissibleSubgraph
      (repG (γ.1.toHopfGen (q.1.1.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem γ.2))).toFeynmanGraph}
    (hB :
      q.2 γ (Finset.mem_attach q.1.1.elements γ) =
        forestCoproductChoice.forest B)
    {u : VertexId} (huγ : u ∈ γ.1.vertices) :
    (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1.retargetVertex
        (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
          (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1
          (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).2) u =
      (feynmanSubgraphRepToComponentAdmissibleSubgraph γ.1
        (q.1.1.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem γ.2) B).retargetVertex
        (forestComponentForestChoiceComponentRemnantStarOf g q hq γ B) u
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let Aout := (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1
  let outerStar :=
    FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
      (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
      (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1
      (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).2
  let Bc := feynmanSubgraphRepToComponentAdmissibleSubgraph γ.1
    (q.1.1.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem γ.2) B
  let innerStar := forestComponentForestChoiceComponentRemnantStarOf g q hq γ B
  have hDisjOuter : Aout.IsPairwiseDisjoint := by
    simpa [Aout] using
      (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
        |>.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs_isPairwiseDisjoint
          (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).2
  have hBcProper :
      Bc ∈ γ.1.toFeynmanGraph.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs := by
    simpa [Bc] using
      forestComponentForestChoiceComponentRemnant_mem_properDisjoint
        g q hq γ hB
  have hDisjBc : Bc.IsPairwiseDisjoint := by
    simpa [Bc] using
      γ.1.toFeynmanGraph
        |>.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs_isPairwiseDisjoint
          hBcProper
  by_cases huBc : u ∈ Bc.vertices
  · rcases AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_vertices.mp huBc with ⟨η, hη, huη⟩
    have hηOuter : feynmanSubgraphPromote (γ_outer := γ.1) η ∈ Aout.elements := by
      simpa [Aout, Bc] using
        forestComponentForestChoice_componentRemnantStar_promote_mem_outer
          g q hq γ hB (η := η) hη
    rw [AdmissibleSubgraph.retargetVertex_of_mem_component
        hDisjOuter outerStar hηOuter (by simpa using huη)]
    rw [AdmissibleSubgraph.retargetVertex_of_mem_component
        hDisjBc innerStar hη huη]
    simp [outerStar, innerStar,
      forestComponentForestChoiceComponentRemnantStarOf]
  · have huOuter : u ∉ Aout.vertices := by
      intro huA
      exact huBc
        ((forestComponentForestChoice_vertex_mem_outer_iff_componentRemnant
          g q hq γ hB huγ).mp (by simpa [Aout] using huA))
    rw [AdmissibleSubgraph.retargetVertex_of_not_mem Aout outerStar huOuter]
    rw [AdmissibleSubgraph.retargetVertex_of_not_mem Bc innerStar huBc]

statement:

        forestCoproductChoice.forest B)
    {e : FeynmanEdge} (heγ : e ∈ γ.1.internalEdges) :
    (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1.retargetEdge
        (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
          (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1
          (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).2) e =
      (feynmanSubgraphRepToComponentAdmissibleSubgraph γ.1
        (q.1.1.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem γ.2) B).retargetEdge
        (forestComponentForestChoiceComponentRemnantStarOf g q hq γ B) e

:= by

  let Aout := (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1

    FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf

    (q.1.1.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem γ.2) B
  let innerStar := forestComponentForestChoiceComponentRemnantStarOf g q hq γ B
  have hsupp := γ.1.edges_supported e heγ
  simp [FeynmanEdge.SupportedOn] at hsupp
  have hsrc :
      Aout.retargetVertex outerStar e.source =
        Bc.retargetVertex innerStar e.source := by

        g q hq γ hB hsupp.2
  cases e
  apply FeynmanEdge.mk.injEq _ _ _ _ _ _ |>.mpr
  exact ⟨by simpa [Aout, outerStar, Bc, innerStar] using hsrc,
    by simpa [Aout, outerStar, Bc, innerStar] using htgt, rfl⟩

  let Aout := (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1

    FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
      (repG g).toFeynmanGraph

  have hDisjBc : Bc.IsPairwiseDisjoint := by
    simpa [Bc] using
      γ.1.toFeynmanGraph
        |>.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs_isPairwiseDisjoint
          hBcProper
  rw [forestComponentForestChoiceRetargetedRemnantGraph_vertices,
    forestComponentForestChoiceComponentRemnantGraph_vertices]

  · intro hv
    rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hv with ⟨u, huγ, huv⟩
    have hret :
        Aout.retargetVertex outerStar u = Bc.retargetVertex innerStar u := by
      simpa [Aout, outerStar, Bc, innerStar] using
        forestComponentForestChoice_retargetVertex_eq_componentRemnant
          g q hq γ hB huγ
    have huvB : Bc.retargetVertex innerStar u = v := hret.symm.trans huv
    by_cases huBc : u ∈ Bc.vertices
    · rcases AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_vertices.mp huBc with ⟨η, hη, huη⟩
      have hRetB :
          Bc.retargetVertex innerStar u = innerStar η :=
        AdmissibleSubgraph.retargetVertex_of_mem_component
          hDisjBc innerStar hη huη
      rw [Finset.mem_union]
      right
      rw [AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_starVertices]
      exact ⟨η, hη, hRetB.symm.trans huvB⟩
    · have hRetB : Bc.retargetVertex innerStar u = u :=
        AdmissibleSubgraph.retargetVertex_of_not_mem Bc innerStar huBc
      have huvEq : u = v := by
        rw [hRetB] at huvB
        exact huvB
      rw [Finset.mem_union]
      left
      rw [← huvEq]
      exact Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨by simpa using huγ, huBc⟩
  · intro hv
    rw [Finset.mem_union] at hv
    rcases hv with hvRest | hvStar
    · rcases Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hvRest with ⟨hvγGraph, hvBc⟩
      have hvγ : v ∈ γ.1.vertices := by
        simpa using hvγGraph
      refine Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨v, hvγ, ?_⟩
      have hret :
          Aout.retargetVertex outerStar v = Bc.retargetVertex innerStar v := by
        simpa [Aout, outerStar, Bc, innerStar] using
          forestComponentForestChoice_retargetVertex_eq_componentRemnant
            g q hq γ hB hvγ
      have hRetB : Bc.retargetVertex innerStar v = v :=
        AdmissibleSubgraph.retargetVertex_of_not_mem Bc innerStar hvBc
      exact hret.trans hRetB
    · rw [AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_starVertices] at hvStar
      rcases hvStar with ⟨η, hη, hηStar⟩
      have hηNonempty : η.IsNonempty :=
        γ.1.toFeynmanGraph
          |>.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs_hasNonemptyComponents
            hBcProper η hη
      unfold FeynmanSubgraph.IsNonempty FeynmanSubgraph.vertexCount at hηNonempty
      rcases Finset.card_pos.mp hηNonempty with ⟨u, huη⟩
      have huγ : u ∈ γ.1.vertices := by
        simpa using η.vertices_subset huη
      refine Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨u, huγ, ?_⟩
      have hret :
          Aout.retargetVertex outerStar u = Bc.retargetVertex innerStar u := by
        simpa [Aout, outerStar, Bc, innerStar] using
          forestComponentForestChoice_retargetVertex_eq_componentRemnant
            g q hq γ hB huγ
      have hRetB :
          Bc.retargetVertex innerStar u = innerStar η :=
        AdmissibleSubgraph.retargetVertex_of_mem_component
          hDisjBc innerStar hη huη
      exact hret.trans (hRetB.trans hηStar)

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentForestChoice_gamma_internalEdges_sub_outer_eq_componentRemnant_complementEdges
statement:
private theorem
    forestComponentForestChoice_gamma_internalEdges_sub_outer_eq_componentRemnant_complementEdges
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract] (g : HopfGen)
    (q : forestComponentChoiceSigma g)

      (repG (γ.1.toHopfGen (q.1.1.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem γ.2))).toFeynmanGraph}
    (hB :
      q.2 γ (Finset.mem_attach q.1.1.elements γ) =
        forestCoproductChoice.forest B) :
    γ.1.internalEdges - (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1.internalEdges =
      (feynmanSubgraphRepToComponentAdmissibleSubgraph γ.1
        (q.1.1.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem γ.2) B).complementEdges
proof:
:= by

  refine Multiset.ext.mpr ?_
  intro e
  rw [AdmissibleSubgraph.complementEdges, FeynmanSubgraph.toFeynmanGraph_internalEdges]

  by_cases heγ : e ∈ γ.1.internalEdges

      forestComponentForestChoice_outer_internalEdges_count_eq_componentRemnant
        g q hq γ hB heγ

  · have hγ0 : Multiset.count e γ.1.internalEdges = 0 :=
      Multiset.count_eq_zero.mpr heγ

    simp

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentForestChoiceForestParents_subset_of_remnant_eqRec
statement:
private theorem forestComponentForestChoiceForestParents_subset_of_remnant_eqRec
    [ForestGraphInsertionUniquenessModel]
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract] (g : HopfGen)
    {q₁ q₂ : forestComponentChoiceSigma g}
    (hq₁ : q₁ ∈ forestComponentForestChoiceSigmaIndex g)
    (hq₂ : q₂ ∈ forestComponentForestChoiceSigmaIndex g)
    (hOuter :
      forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q₁ hq₁ =
      forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q₂ hq₂)
    (hRem :
      hOuter ▸ forestComponentForestChoiceRemnantComponents g q₁ hq₁ =
        forestComponentForestChoiceRemnantComponents g q₂ hq₂)
    {γ : FeynmanSubgraph (repG g).toFeynmanGraph}
    (hγ : γ ∈ forestComponentForestChoiceForestParents g q₁) :
    γ ∈ forestComponentForestChoiceForestParents g q₂
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hγmem₁ : γ ∈ q₁.1.1.elements :=
    ((mem_forestComponentForestChoiceForestParents g q₁).mp hγ).1
  have hpr₁ :
      forestComponentForestChoiceParentRemnantBare g q₁ hq₁ γ ∈
        forestComponentForestChoiceRemnantComponents g q₁ hq₁ := by
    rw [forestComponentForestChoiceRemnantComponents_eq_image_parentRemnantBare g q₁ hq₁]
    exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨γ, hγ, rfl⟩
  have hRemEq :
      forestComponentForestChoiceParentRemnantBare g q₂ hq₂ γ =
        hOuter ▸ forestComponentForestChoiceParentRemnantBare g q₁ hq₁ γ :=
    (admissibleSubgraphQuotientRemainder_eqRec g hOuter γ).symm
  have hpr₂mem :
      forestComponentForestChoiceParentRemnantBare g q₂ hq₂ γ ∈
        forestComponentForestChoiceRemnantComponents g q₂ hq₂ := by
    have hm := mem_eqRec_forestOuterActualQuotient g hOuter hpr₁
    rw [hRem] at hm
    rw [hRemEq]
    exact hm
  rw [forestComponentForestChoiceRemnantComponents_eq_image_parentRemnantBare g q₂ hq₂]
    at hpr₂mem
  rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hpr₂mem with ⟨γ', hγ'FP, hγ'eq⟩
  have hγ'mem₂ : γ' ∈ q₂.1.1.elements :=
    ((mem_forestComponentForestChoiceForestParents g q₂).mp hγ'FP).1
  have hA₁ : q₁.1.1.IsPairwiseDisjoint :=
    (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs_isPairwiseDisjoint
      q₁.1.2
  have hA₂ : q₂.1.1.IsPairwiseDisjoint :=
    (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs_isPairwiseDisjoint
      q₂.1.2
  have hAoutPD₁ :
      forestComponentForestChoiceOuterSubgraph q₁.1.1 q₁.2 hA₁ ∈
        (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs :=
    forestComponentForestChoiceOuterSubgraph_mem_properDisjoint q₁.1.2
      (Finset.mem_sigma.mp hq₁).2
  have hAoutPD₂ :
      forestComponentForestChoiceOuterSubgraph q₂.1.1 q₂.2 hA₂ ∈
        (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs :=
    forestComponentForestChoiceOuterSubgraph_mem_properDisjoint q₂.1.2
      (Finset.mem_sigma.mp hq₂).2
  have hSV₁ := forestComponentForestChoice_remnant_sourceVertices_eq_parent_vertices
    g q₁.1.1 q₁.2 hA₁ hAoutPD₁ hγmem₁
  have hSV₂ := forestComponentForestChoice_remnant_sourceVertices_eq_parent_vertices
    g q₂.1.1 q₂.2 hA₂ hAoutPD₂ hγ'mem₂
  have hVert : γ'.vertices = γ.vertices := by
    calc γ'.vertices
        = admissibleSubgraphRemainderSourceVertices
            (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q₂ hq₂).1
            (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
              (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q₂ hq₂).1
              (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q₂ hq₂).2)
            (forestComponentForestChoiceParentRemnantBare g q₂ hq₂ γ') := hSV₂.symm
      _ = admissibleSubgraphRemainderSourceVertices
            (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q₂ hq₂).1
            (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
              (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q₂ hq₂).1
              (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q₂ hq₂).2)
            (forestComponentForestChoiceParentRemnantBare g q₂ hq₂ γ) := by rw [hγ'eq]
      _ = admissibleSubgraphRemainderSourceVertices
            (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q₂ hq₂).1
            (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
              (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q₂ hq₂).1
              (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q₂ hq₂).2)
            (hOuter ▸ forestComponentForestChoiceParentRemnantBare g q₁ hq₁ γ) :=
          congrArg
            (admissibleSubgraphRemainderSourceVertices
              (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q₂ hq₂).1
              (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
                (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q₂ hq₂).1
                (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q₂ hq₂).2))
            hRemEq
      _ = admissibleSubgraphRemainderSourceVertices
            (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q₁ hq₁).1
            (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
              (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q₁ hq₁).1
              (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q₁ hq₁).2)
            (forestComponentForestChoiceParentRemnantBare g q₁ hq₁ γ) :=
          admissibleSubgraphRemainderSourceVertices_eqRec g hOuter
            (forestComponentForestChoiceParentRemnantBare g q₁ hq₁ γ)
      _ = γ.vertices := hSV₁
  have hγ'γ : γ' = γ :=
    ForestGraphInsertionUniquenessModel.parent_eq_of_remnant_eq
      (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q₂ hq₂).1
      (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
        (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q₂ hq₂).1
        (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q₂ hq₂).2)
      hVert hγ'eq
  rw [← hγ'γ]; exact hγ'FP

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientSubgraphCanonical_toHopfH_eq_right_mul_remnant
statement:
private theorem
    forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientSubgraphCanonical_toHopfH_eq_right_mul_remnant
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract] (g : HopfGen)
    (q : forestComponentChoiceSigma g)
    (hq : q ∈ forestComponentForestChoiceSigmaIndex g) :
    (forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientSubgraphCanonical g q hq).toHopfH =
      (forestComponentForestChoiceActualRightQuotientSubgraphCanonical
        g q hq).toHopfH *
        (forestComponentForestChoiceActualRemnantQuotientSubgraphCanonical
          g q hq).toHopfH
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let R := forestComponentForestChoiceActualRightQuotientSubgraphCanonical g q hq
  let M := forestComponentForestChoiceActualRemnantQuotientSubgraphCanonical g q hq
  let Q := forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientSubgraphCanonical g q hq
  have hDisj : Disjoint R.elements M.elements := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
    intro δ hδR hδM
    have hδM' : δ ∈ forestComponentForestChoiceRemnantComponents g q hq := by
      simpa [M] using hδM
    have hSelfDisj : δ.Disjoint δ :=
      forestComponentForestChoiceRightRemnant_disjoint g q hq
        δ (by simpa [R] using hδR) δ hδM'
    have hPos :
        0 < δ.internalEdges.card :=
      forestComponentForestChoiceActualRightQuotientSubgraphCanonical_hasPositiveInternalEdgesComponents
        g q hq δ (by simpa [R] using hδR)
    rcases Multiset.exists_mem_of_ne_zero (Multiset.card_pos.mp hPos) with
      ⟨e, he⟩
    have hsupp := δ.edges_supported e he
    simp [FeynmanEdge.SupportedOn] at hsupp
    exact (Finset.disjoint_left.mp hSelfDisj hsupp.1) hsupp.1
  unfold AdmissibleSubgraph.toHopfH
  rw [forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientSubgraphCanonical_elements]
  unfold forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientComponents
  rw [Finset.prod_union (by simpa [R, M] using hDisj)]
  congr 1
  · apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
    intro δ hδ
    unfold AdmissibleSubgraph.componentToHopfH
    have hδQ :
        δ ∈ (forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientSubgraphCanonical
          g q hq).elements := by
      rw [forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientSubgraphCanonical_elements]
      unfold forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientComponents
      exact Finset.mem_union_left _ hδ
    rw [dif_pos hδQ, dif_pos hδ]
  · rw [forestComponentForestChoiceActualRemnantQuotientSubgraphCanonical_elements]
    apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
    intro δ hδ
    unfold AdmissibleSubgraph.componentToHopfH
    have hδQ :
        δ ∈ (forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientSubgraphCanonical
          g q hq).elements := by
      rw [forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientSubgraphCanonical_elements]
      unfold forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientComponents
      exact Finset.mem_union_right _ hδ
    have hδM :
        δ ∈ (forestComponentForestChoiceActualRemnantQuotientSubgraphCanonical
          g q hq).elements := by
      simpa using hδ
    rw [dif_pos hδQ, dif_pos hδM]

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientSubgraphCanonical_hasNonemptyComponents
statement:
private theorem
    forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientSubgraphCanonical_hasNonemptyComponents

      ).HasNonemptyComponents
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro δ hδ
  change δ ∈ forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientComponents g q hq at hδ
  unfold forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientComponents at hδ
  rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hδ with hRight | hRemnant
  · rcases
      forestComponentForestChoiceActualRightQuotientSubgraphCanonical_mem_exists
        g q hq hRight with
      ⟨γ, rfl⟩
    have hSourceNonempty : γ.1.IsNonempty :=
      (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs_hasNonemptyComponents
        q.1.2 γ.1
        (forestComponentChoiceRightSubgraph_elements_subset q.1.1 q.2 γ.2)
    unfold FeynmanSubgraph.IsNonempty FeynmanSubgraph.vertexCount at hSourceNonempty ⊢
    change 0 <
      (γ.1.vertices.image
        ((forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1.retargetVertex
          (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
            (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
            (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1
            (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).2))).card
    rcases Finset.card_pos.mp hSourceNonempty with ⟨v, hv⟩
    exact Finset.card_pos.mpr
      ⟨(forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1.retargetVertex
          (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
            (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
            (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1
            (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).2) v,
        Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩⟩
  · rcases forestComponentForestChoiceRemnantComponents_mem_exists
      g q hq hRemnant with
      ⟨γ, B, hB, rfl⟩
    have hSourceNonempty : γ.1.IsNonempty :=
      (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs_hasNonemptyComponents
        q.1.2 γ.1 γ.2
    unfold FeynmanSubgraph.IsNonempty FeynmanSubgraph.vertexCount at hSourceNonempty ⊢
    rw [admissibleSubgraphQuotientRemainderSubgraph_vertices]
    rcases Finset.card_pos.mp hSourceNonempty with ⟨v, hv⟩
    exact Finset.card_pos.mpr
      ⟨(forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1.retargetVertex
          (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
            (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
            (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1
            (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).2) v,
        Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩⟩

statement:
private theorem forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientSubgraphCanonical_mem_properDisjoint
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract] (g : HopfGen)
    (q : forestComponentChoiceSigma g)
    (hq : q ∈ forestComponentForestChoiceSigmaIndex g)
    (C : forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientProperCertificate g q hq) :

      (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g
        (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq)
      ).properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs

:= by
  classical
  let Q := forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g
    (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq)
  let A := forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientSubgraphCanonical g q hq
  rw [Q.mem_properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs]
  have hNonempty : A.IsNonempty :=
    forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientSubgraphCanonical_isNonempty g q hq
  have hNonemptyComponents : A.HasNonemptyComponents :=
    forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientSubgraphCanonical_hasNonemptyComponents
      g q hq
  have hPairwise : A.IsPairwiseDisjoint :=
    forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientSubgraphCanonical_isPairwiseDisjoint
      g q hq
  refine ⟨?_, hNonemptyComponents, ?_, C.positiveComponents⟩
  · rw [Q.mem_nonemptyDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs,
      Q.mem_disjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs]
    exact ⟨⟨Q.mem_admissibleDivergentSubgraphs A, hPairwise⟩,
      hNonempty⟩
  · exact admissibleSubgraph_internalEdges_card_pos_of_hasPositive_component
      C.positiveComponents hNonempty

        (repG g).toFeynmanGraph q.1.1

          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph q.1.1 q.1.2)).toClass =

        (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g

          (forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientSubgraphCanonical_mem_properDisjoint
            g q hq

              g q hq C)))).toClass) :

        (repG g).toFeynmanGraph q.1.1

          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph q.1.1 q.1.2)).toClass =

        (repG (forestOuterQuotientHopfGen g
          (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq))).toFeynmanGraph

            g q hq C))).toClass

    (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestContractGraphWithStars

            (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq))

          (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf

            (forestComponentForestChoiceRepQuotientSubgraphCanonical g q hq)
            (forestComponentForestChoiceRepQuotientSubgraphCanonical_mem_properDisjoint_of_remnantPositive
              g q hq C))).toClass := by

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentMixedBoundaryActualRightQuotientSubgraphCanonical_complementEdges_card_pos
statement:
private theorem
    forestComponentMixedBoundaryActualRightQuotientSubgraphCanonical_complementEdges_card_pos
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract] (g : HopfGen)
    (q : forestComponentChoiceSigma g)
    (hq : q ∈ forestComponentMixedBoundaryChoiceSigmaIndex g) :
    0 <
      (forestComponentMixedBoundaryActualRightQuotientSubgraphCanonical
        g q hq).complementEdges.card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let G₀ := (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
  let A := q.1.1
  let L := forestComponentChoiceLeftSubgraph q.1.1 q.2
  let R := forestComponentChoiceRightSubgraph q.1.1 q.2
  let Aout := (forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex g q hq).1
  let Q := forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g
    (forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex g q hq)
  let Aact := forestComponentMixedBoundaryActualRightQuotientSubgraphCanonical
    g q hq
  let outerStar :=
    FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
      G₀ Aout (forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex g q hq).2
  have hDisj : A.IsPairwiseDisjoint :=
    G₀.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs_isPairwiseDisjoint
      q.1.2
  have hRle : R.internalEdges ≤ L.complementEdges := by
    refine admissibleSubgraph_internalEdges_le_of_components_le R ?_ ?_
    · exact forestComponentChoiceRightSubgraph_isPairwiseDisjoint q.1.1 q.2 hDisj
    · intro γ hγ
      exact forestComponentChoiceRight_internalEdges_le_left_complement
        q.1.1 q.2 hDisj (by simpa [R] using hγ)
  have hV :
      ∀ η ∈ R.elements, ∀ v ∈ η.vertices, v ∉ Aout.vertices := by
    intro η hη v hv
    dsimp [Aout, R]
    exact forestComponentChoiceRight_vertices_not_mem_leftSubgraph
      q.1.1 q.2 hDisj hη hv
  have hRmap :
      R.internalEdges.map (Aout.retargetEdge outerStar) =
        R.internalEdges := by
    unfold AdmissibleSubgraph.internalEdges
    change (Multiset.mapAddMonoidHom (Aout.retargetEdge outerStar))
        (∑ γ ∈ R.elements, γ.internalEdges) =
      ∑ γ ∈ R.elements, γ.internalEdges
    rw [map_sum (Multiset.mapAddMonoidHom (Aout.retargetEdge outerStar))]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro γ hγ
    exact admissibleSubgraphRetargetSubgraph_internalEdges_eq_of_not_mem
      Aout outerStar γ
      (forestComponentMixedBoundaryRightRetarget_edge_le g q hq γ (by
        simpa [R] using hγ))
      (hV γ hγ)
  have hAactI : Aact.internalEdges = R.internalEdges := by
    have hinj :=
      admissibleSubgraphRetarget_injective_of_not_mem
        Aout outerStar R
        (fun η hη =>
          forestComponentMixedBoundaryRightRetarget_edge_le g q hq η (by
            simpa [R] using hη))
        hV
    unfold AdmissibleSubgraph.internalEdges
    change
      (∑ δ ∈
        (R.elements.attach.image fun γ =>
          admissibleSubgraphRetargetSubgraph
            Aout outerStar γ.1
            (forestComponentMixedBoundaryRightRetarget_edge_le g q hq γ.1
              (by simpa [R] using γ.2))),
        δ.internalEdges) =
      ∑ γ ∈ R.elements, γ.internalEdges
    rw [Finset.sum_image]
    · trans ∑ γ ∈ R.elements.attach, γ.1.internalEdges
      · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro γ _hγ
        exact admissibleSubgraphRetargetSubgraph_internalEdges_eq_of_not_mem
          Aout outerStar γ.1
          (forestComponentMixedBoundaryRightRetarget_edge_le g q hq γ.1
            (by simpa [R] using γ.2))
          (hV γ.1 γ.2)
      · rw [Finset.sum_attach]
    · intro γ₁ _ γ₂ _ hEq
      exact hinj hEq
  have hSplit :
      A.internalEdges = L.internalEdges + R.internalEdges := by
    have hp :
        q.2 ∈ forestComponentMixedBoundaryChoiceCoreIndex q.1.1 :=
      (Finset.mem_sigma.mp hq).2
    have hNoForest : ¬ forestComponentChoiceHasForest q.1.1 q.2 := by
      unfold forestComponentMixedBoundaryChoiceCoreIndex at hp
      exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).2
    have hUnion : L.elements ∪ R.elements = A.elements := by
      ext γ
      constructor
      · intro hγ
        rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hγ with hγL | hγR
        · exact forestComponentChoiceLeftSubgraph_elements_subset
            q.1.1 q.2 (by simpa [L] using hγL)
        · exact forestComponentChoiceRightSubgraph_elements_subset
            q.1.1 q.2 (by simpa [R] using hγR)
      · intro hγA
        have hγAq : γ ∈ q.1.1.elements := by
          simpa [A] using hγA
        rcases forestCoproductChoice_eq_left_or_right_or_forest
            (γ.toHopfGen (q.1.1.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem hγAq))
            (q.2 ⟨γ, hγAq⟩
              (Finset.mem_attach q.1.1.elements ⟨γ, hγAq⟩)) with
          hLeft | hRightOrForest
        · apply Finset.mem_union_left
          rw [show L.elements =
              q.1.1.elements.filter (forestComponentChoiceIsLeft q.1.1 q.2)
            by rfl]
          exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hγAq, by
            unfold forestComponentChoiceIsLeft
            rw [dif_pos hγAq]
            exact hLeft⟩
        · rcases hRightOrForest with hRight | hForest
          · apply Finset.mem_union_right
            rw [show R.elements =
                q.1.1.elements.filter (forestComponentChoiceIsRight q.1.1 q.2)
              by rfl]
            exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hγAq, by
              unfold forestComponentChoiceIsRight
              rw [dif_pos hγAq]
              exact hRight⟩
          · rcases hForest with ⟨B, hB⟩
            exact False.elim
              (hNoForest ⟨⟨γ, hγAq⟩, B, hB⟩)
    have hDisjLR : Disjoint L.elements R.elements := by
      rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
      intro γ hγL hγR
      exact forestComponentChoiceRightSubgraph_not_mem_left
        q.1.1 q.2 (by simpa [R] using hγR) (by simpa [L] using hγL)
    unfold AdmissibleSubgraph.internalEdges
    rw [← hUnion]
    rw [Finset.sum_union hDisjLR]
  have hQinternal :
      Q.internalEdges =
        (G₀.internalEdges - L.internalEdges).map (Aout.retargetEdge outerStar) := by
    simp [Q, G₀, L, Aout, outerStar, forestOuterActualQuotientGraph,
      forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex_val,
      FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestContractGraphWithStars_eq,
      AdmissibleSubgraph.contractWithStars_internalEdges,
      AdmissibleSubgraph.complementEdges]
  have hAactComplement :
      Aact.complementEdges =
        ((G₀.internalEdges - L.internalEdges) - R.internalEdges).map
          (Aout.retargetEdge outerStar) := by
    unfold AdmissibleSubgraph.complementEdges
    calc
      Q.internalEdges - Aact.internalEdges
          = (G₀.internalEdges - L.internalEdges).map
              (Aout.retargetEdge outerStar) - R.internalEdges := by
            rw [hQinternal, hAactI]
      _ = (G₀.internalEdges - L.internalEdges).map
              (Aout.retargetEdge outerStar) -
            R.internalEdges.map (Aout.retargetEdge outerStar) := by
            rw [hRmap]
      _ = ((G₀.internalEdges - L.internalEdges) - R.internalEdges).map
              (Aout.retargetEdge outerStar) := by
            exact (multiset_map_sub_of_le (Aout.retargetEdge outerStar)
              (by simpa [L] using hRle)).symm
  have hComplementSource :
      (G₀.internalEdges - L.internalEdges) - R.internalEdges =
        G₀.internalEdges - A.internalEdges := by
    rw [hSplit, Multiset.sub_add_eq_sub_sub]
  have hAcomp : 0 < A.complementEdges.card := by
    simpa [A] using (Finset.mem_filter.mp (Finset.mem_sigma.mp hq).1).2
  rw [show
      (forestComponentMixedBoundaryActualRightQuotientSubgraphCanonical
        g q hq).complementEdges = Aact.complementEdges by rfl]
  rw [hAactComplement, hComplementSource]
  simpa [AdmissibleSubgraph.complementEdges, G₀, A] using hAcomp

statement:
private theorem forestComponentMixedBoundary_rightContractClass_of_actual
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract] (g : HopfGen)
    (q : forestComponentChoiceSigma g)
    (hq : q ∈ forestComponentMixedBoundaryChoiceSigmaIndex g)
    (hActual :
      (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestContractGraphWithStars
        (repG g).toFeynmanGraph q.1.1
        (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph q.1.1 q.1.2)).toClass =
      (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestContractGraphWithStars
        (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g

          g q hq)
        (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
          (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g
            (forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex g q hq))
          (forestComponentMixedBoundaryActualRightQuotientSubgraphCanonical
            g q hq)
          (forestComponentMixedBoundaryActualRightQuotientSubgraphCanonical_mem_properDisjoint
            g q hq))).toClass) :

        (repG g).toFeynmanGraph q.1.1

        (repG (forestOuterQuotientHopfGen g

proof:

            (forestComponentMixedBoundaryActualRightQuotientSubgraphCanonical_mem_properDisjoint

    _ =

statement:
private theorem
    forestComponentMixedBoundary_productTerm_eq_repRightQuotientSubgraph
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract] (g : HopfGen)
    (q : forestComponentChoiceSigma g)
    (hq : q ∈ forestComponentMixedBoundaryChoiceSigmaIndex g) :

      (forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex g q hq).1.toHopfH ⊗ₜ[ℚ]
        (forestComponentMixedBoundaryRepRightQuotientSubgraphCanonical
          g q hq).toHopfH
proof:
:= by
  rw [forestComponentMixedBoundary_productTerm_eq_leftRightSubgraphs g q hq]
  rw [← forestComponentMixedBoundaryRepRightQuotientSubgraphCanonical_toHopfH_eq
    g q hq]

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentForestChoiceToQuotientForestSigma_mem
statement:
private theorem forestComponentForestChoiceToQuotientForestSigma_mem
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract] (g : HopfGen)
    (q : forestComponentChoiceSigma g)
    (hq : q ∈ forestComponentForestChoiceSigmaIndex g)
    (C : forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientProperCertificate g q hq) :
    forestComponentForestChoiceToQuotientForestSigma g q hq ∈
      forestQuotientForestSigmaIndex g
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold forestQuotientForestSigmaIndex
  apply Finset.mem_sigma.mpr
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · apply Finset.mem_filter.mpr
    refine ⟨Finset.mem_attach _ _, ?_⟩
    have hpForest :
        q.2 ∈ forestComponentForestChoiceCoreIndex q.1.1 :=
      (Finset.mem_sigma.mp hq).2
    have hpCore :
        q.2 ∈ forestComponentCoreChoiceIndex q.1.1 :=
      (mem_forestComponentForestChoiceCoreIndex_core_hasForest hpForest).1
    have hAcomp : 0 < q.1.1.complementEdges.card :=
      (Finset.mem_filter.mp (Finset.mem_sigma.mp hq).1).2
    have hDisj :
        q.1.1.IsPairwiseDisjoint :=
      (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
        |>.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs_isPairwiseDisjoint
          q.1.2
    exact admissibleSubgraph_complementEdges_card_pos_of_internalEdges_le
      (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterSubgraph_internalEdges_le_original
        q.1.1 q.2 hpCore hDisj)
      hAcomp
  · change forestComponentForestChoiceRepQuotientSubgraphCanonical
        g q hq ∈
        ((forestOuterQuotientGraph g
          (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq)
        ).properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs).filter
          (fun A => 0 < A.complementEdges.card)
    exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨
      forestComponentForestChoiceRepQuotientSubgraphCanonical_mem_properDisjoint
        g q hq C,
      ForestComponentForestChoiceRepQuotientComplementPositiveModel.positive
        g q hq⟩

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forest_mixed_cross_false_of_same_outer
statement:
private theorem forest_mixed_cross_false_of_same_outer
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    {g : HopfGen}
    {qF qM : forestComponentChoiceSigma g}
    (hqF : qF ∈ forestComponentForestChoiceSigmaIndex g)
    (hqM : qM ∈ forestComponentMixedBoundaryChoiceSigmaIndex g)
    (hSame : qF.1 = qM.1)
    (hEq :
      forestComponentForestChoiceToQuotientForestSigma g qF hqF =
      forestComponentMixedBoundaryToQuotientForestSigma g qM hqM) :
    False
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hpForest : qF.2 ∈ forestComponentForestChoiceCoreIndex qF.1.1 :=
    (Finset.mem_sigma.mp hqF).2
  have hpCore : qF.2 ∈ forestComponentCoreChoiceIndex qF.1.1 :=
    (mem_forestComponentForestChoiceCoreIndex_core_hasForest hpForest).1
  have hAprop : qF.1.1 ∈
      (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs := qF.1.2
  have hA : qF.1.1.IsPairwiseDisjoint :=
    ((repG g).toFeynmanGraph).properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs_isPairwiseDisjoint
      hAprop
  have hCompOuterF :
      (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterSubgraph qF.1.1 qF.2 hA).HasNonemptyComponents :=
    forestComponentForestChoiceOuterSubgraph_hasNonemptyComponents
      hpCore hAprop hA
  have hOuterIndex :
      forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g qF hqF =
        forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex g qM hqM :=
    congrArg Sigma.fst hEq
  have hOuter :
      (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g qF hqF).1 =
      (forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex g qM hqM).1 :=
    congrArg Subtype.val hOuterIndex
  exact forestComponentForestChoice_mixedBoundary_cross_same_outer_false
    hqF hqM hSame hCompOuterF hOuter

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentMixedBoundaryActualRightQuotientSubgraph_no_starVertices
statement:
private theorem forestComponentMixedBoundaryActualRightQuotientSubgraph_no_starVertices
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    (g : HopfGen)
    (q : forestComponentChoiceSigma g)
    (hq : q ∈ forestComponentMixedBoundaryChoiceSigmaIndex g) :
    ∀ δ,
      δ ∈ (forestComponentMixedBoundaryActualRightQuotientSubgraphCanonical
            g q hq).elements →
      Disjoint δ.vertices
        ((forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex g q hq).1.starVertices
          (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
            (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
            (forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex g q hq).1
            (forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex g q hq).2))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro δ hδ
  
  unfold forestComponentMixedBoundaryActualRightQuotientSubgraphCanonical
      forestComponentMixedBoundaryActualRightQuotientSubgraph
      forestOuterActualRetargetAdmissibleSubgraphOfCert
      forestOuterActualRetargetAdmissibleSubgraph
      admissibleSubgraphRetarget at hδ
  
  rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hδ with ⟨γR, hγRMem, hRetargetEq⟩
  
  have hA : q.1.1.IsPairwiseDisjoint :=
    ((repG g).toFeynmanGraph).properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs_isPairwiseDisjoint
      q.1.2
  have hVertexId :
      ∀ v ∈ γR.1.vertices,
        v ∉ (forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex g q hq).1.vertices := by
    intro v hv
    exact forestComponentChoiceRight_vertices_not_mem_leftSubgraph
      q.1.1 q.2 hA γR.2 hv
  
  have hδVertices :
      δ.vertices = γR.1.vertices := by
    rw [← hRetargetEq]
    exact admissibleSubgraphRetargetSubgraph_vertices_eq_of_not_mem
      (forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex g q hq).1 _ γR.1 _ hVertexId
  
  rw [hδVertices]
  have hFresh :
      (forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex g q hq).1.IsFreshStarAssignment
        (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
          (forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex g q hq).1
          (forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex g q hq).2) :=
    FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf_isFreshStarAssignment
      (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
      (forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex g q hq).1
      (forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex g q hq).2
  have hGdisj := hFresh.disjoint_vertices_starVertices
  
  exact (Finset.disjoint_left).mpr fun v hv hStar =>
    (Finset.disjoint_left.mp hGdisj) (γR.1.vertices_subset hv) hStar

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientSubgraph_exists_starVertex
statement:
private theorem forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientSubgraph_exists_starVertex
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    (g : HopfGen)
    (q : forestComponentChoiceSigma g)
    (hq : q ∈ forestComponentForestChoiceSigmaIndex g) :
    ∃ δ,
      δ ∈ (forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientSubgraphCanonical
            g q hq).elements ∧
      ¬ Disjoint δ.vertices
        ((forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1.starVertices
          (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
            (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
            (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1
            (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).2))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  have hpForest : q.2 ∈ forestComponentForestChoiceCoreIndex q.1.1 :=
    (Finset.mem_sigma.mp hq).2
  have hpCore : q.2 ∈ forestComponentCoreChoiceIndex q.1.1 :=
    (mem_forestComponentForestChoiceCoreIndex_core_hasForest hpForest).1
  rcases (mem_forestComponentForestChoiceCoreIndex_core_hasForest hpForest).2
    with ⟨γ, B, hPγ⟩
  
  have hPromProper :
      feynmanSubgraphRepForestPromoteAdmissibleSubgraph γ.1
        (q.1.1.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem γ.2) B ∈
        (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs :=
    forestComponentChoice_promotedForest_mem_properDisjoint_of_core_mem
      hpCore γ hPγ
  have hPromNE :
      (feynmanSubgraphRepForestPromoteAdmissibleSubgraph γ.1
        (q.1.1.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem γ.2) B).IsNonempty :=
    properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs_isNonempty hPromProper
  have hPromCompNE :
      (feynmanSubgraphRepForestPromoteAdmissibleSubgraph γ.1
        (q.1.1.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem γ.2) B).HasNonemptyComponents :=
    ((repG g).toFeynmanGraph).properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs_hasNonemptyComponents
      hPromProper
  rcases hPromNE with ⟨η, hηProm⟩
  
  let A := forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq
  let starOf := FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
      (repG g).toFeynmanGraph A.1 A.2
  let δ := admissibleSubgraphQuotientRemainderSubgraph A.1 starOf γ.1
  
  have hδRemnant : δ ∈ forestComponentForestChoiceRemnantComponents g q hq :=
    forestComponentForestChoiceRemnantComponents_mem_of_forest g q hq γ hPγ
  
  have hδActual :
      δ ∈ (forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientSubgraphCanonical
            g q hq).elements := by
    rw [forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientSubgraphCanonical_elements]
    unfold forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientComponents
    exact Finset.mem_union_right _ hδRemnant
  refine ⟨δ, hδActual, ?_⟩
  
  have hηVtxSub : η.vertices ⊆ γ.1.vertices :=
    feynmanSubgraphRepForestPromoteAdmissibleSubgraph_vertices_subset_outer
      γ.1 (q.1.1.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem γ.2) B hηProm
  have hηNE : η.IsNonempty := hPromCompNE η hηProm
  rcases Finset.card_pos.mp hηNE with ⟨v, hvη⟩
  have hvγ : v ∈ γ.1.vertices := hηVtxSub hvη
  
  have hAdisjQ : q.1.1.IsPairwiseDisjoint :=
    ((repG g).toFeynmanGraph).properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs_isPairwiseDisjoint
      q.1.2
  have hηOuter : η ∈ A.1.elements := by
    have hηPromoted :
        η ∈ forestComponentChoicePromotedForestComponents q.1.1 q.2 :=
      forestComponentChoicePromotedForestComponents_mem_of_forest
        q.1.1 q.2 γ hPγ hηProm
    show η ∈ (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterSubgraph q.1.1 q.2 hAdisjQ).elements
    rw [forestComponentForestChoiceOuterSubgraph_elements]
    exact Finset.mem_union_right _ hηPromoted
  
  have hStar : starOf η ∈ A.1.starVertices starOf :=
    AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_starVertices.mpr ⟨η, hηOuter, rfl⟩
  have hvOuter : v ∈ A.1.vertices :=
    AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_vertices.mpr ⟨η, hηOuter, hvη⟩
  have hRetV : A.1.retargetVertex starOf v = starOf η := by
    have hAdisj : A.1.IsPairwiseDisjoint :=
      ((repG g).toFeynmanGraph).properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs_isPairwiseDisjoint
        A.2
    rw [AdmissibleSubgraph.retargetVertex,
      AdmissibleSubgraph.componentAt?_eq_some_of_mem_vertices hAdisj hηOuter hvη]
  
  have hStarInDelta : starOf η ∈ δ.vertices := by
    rw [admissibleSubgraphQuotientRemainderSubgraph_vertices]
    exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨v, hvγ, hRetV⟩
  intro hdisj
  exact (Finset.disjoint_left.mp hdisj) hStarInDelta hStar

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestOuterActualQuotient_noStar_vertex_mem_ambient_complement
statement:
private theorem forestOuterActualQuotient_noStar_vertex_mem_ambient_complement
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    (g : HopfGen) (A : forestOuterProperIndex g)
    {δ : FeynmanSubgraph (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g A)}
    (hNoStar :
      Disjoint δ.vertices
        (A.1.starVertices
          (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
            (repG g).toFeynmanGraph A.1 A.2)))
    {v : VertexId} (hv : v ∈ δ.vertices) :
    v ∈ (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.vertices ∧ v ∉ A.1.vertices
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hvQ : v ∈ (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g A).vertices :=
    δ.vertices_subset hv
  unfold forestOuterActualQuotientGraph at hvQ
  simp only [FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestContractGraphWithStars_eq,
    AdmissibleSubgraph.contractWithStars_vertices] at hvQ
  rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hvQ with hRest | hStar
  · exact ⟨(Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hRest).1, (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hRest).2⟩
  · exact absurd hStar (Finset.disjoint_left.mp hNoStar hv)

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestOuterActualQuotient_noStar_internalEdge_mem_ambient
statement:
private theorem forestOuterActualQuotient_noStar_internalEdge_mem_ambient
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    (g : HopfGen) (A : forestOuterProperIndex g)
    {δ : FeynmanSubgraph (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g A)}
    (hNoStar :
      Disjoint δ.vertices
        (A.1.starVertices
          (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
            (repG g).toFeynmanGraph A.1 A.2)))
    {e : FeynmanEdge} (he : e ∈ δ.internalEdges) :
    e ∈ (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.internalEdges
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set starOf := FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
    (repG g).toFeynmanGraph A.1 A.2 with hstarOf
  have hSup : e.SupportedOn δ.vertices := δ.edges_supported e he
  have heQ : e ∈ (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g A).internalEdges :=
    Multiset.mem_of_le δ.internalEdges_le he
  unfold forestOuterActualQuotientGraph at heQ
  rw [FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestContractGraphWithStars_eq,
    AdmissibleSubgraph.contractWithStars_internalEdges] at heQ
  rcases Multiset.mem_map.mp heQ with ⟨e_orig, heOrig, hRet⟩
  have hSrcNotStar : e.source ∉ A.1.starVertices starOf :=
    Finset.disjoint_left.mp hNoStar hSup.1
  have hTgtNotStar : e.target ∉ A.1.starVertices starOf :=
    Finset.disjoint_left.mp hNoStar hSup.2
  have hRetSrc : A.1.retargetVertex starOf e_orig.source = e.source := by
    have := congrArg FeynmanEdge.source hRet; simpa using this
  have hRetTgt : A.1.retargetVertex starOf e_orig.target = e.target := by
    have := congrArg FeynmanEdge.target hRet; simpa using this
  have hSrcOrigNotA : e_orig.source ∉ A.1.vertices := by
    intro hvA
    apply hSrcNotStar
    rw [← hRetSrc, AdmissibleSubgraph.retargetVertex,
      A.1.componentAt?_of_mem hvA]
    exact AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_starVertices.mpr
      ⟨A.1.componentAt hvA, A.1.componentAt_mem hvA, rfl⟩
  have hTgtOrigNotA : e_orig.target ∉ A.1.vertices := by
    intro hvA
    apply hTgtNotStar
    rw [← hRetTgt, AdmissibleSubgraph.retargetVertex,
      A.1.componentAt?_of_mem hvA]
    exact AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_starVertices.mpr
      ⟨A.1.componentAt hvA, A.1.componentAt_mem hvA, rfl⟩
  have hRSrc := AdmissibleSubgraph.retargetVertex_of_not_mem A.1 starOf hSrcOrigNotA
  have hRTgt := AdmissibleSubgraph.retargetVertex_of_not_mem A.1 starOf hTgtOrigNotA
  have hSrc : e_orig.source = e.source := hRSrc.symm.trans hRetSrc
  have hTgt : e_orig.target = e.target := hRTgt.symm.trans hRetTgt
  have hSec : e_orig.sector = e.sector := by
    have := congrArg FeynmanEdge.sector hRet
    simpa [AdmissibleSubgraph.retargetEdge] using this
  have hEqEdge : e_orig = e := by
    cases e_orig
    cases e
    exact (FeynmanEdge.mk.injEq _ _ _ _ _ _).mpr ⟨hSrc, hTgt, hSec⟩
  rw [← hEqEdge]
  exact AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_ambientInternalEdges_of_mem_complementEdges A.1 heOrig

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestOuterActualQuotient_noStar_externalLeg_mem_ambient
statement:
private theorem forestOuterActualQuotient_noStar_externalLeg_mem_ambient
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    (g : HopfGen) (A : forestOuterProperIndex g)
    {δ : FeynmanSubgraph (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g A)}
    (hNoStar :
      Disjoint δ.vertices
        (A.1.starVertices
          (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
            (repG g).toFeynmanGraph A.1 A.2)))
    {ℓ : ExternalLeg} (hℓ : ℓ ∈ δ.externalLegs) :
    ℓ ∈ (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.externalLegs
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set starOf := FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
    (repG g).toFeynmanGraph A.1 A.2 with hstarOf
  have hSup : ℓ.SupportedOn δ.vertices := δ.legs_supported ℓ hℓ
  have hℓQ : ℓ ∈ (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g A).externalLegs :=
    Multiset.mem_of_le δ.externalLegs_le hℓ
  unfold forestOuterActualQuotientGraph at hℓQ
  rw [FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestContractGraphWithStars_eq] at hℓQ
  change ℓ ∈ (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.externalLegs.map
    (A.1.retargetExternalLeg starOf) at hℓQ
  rcases Multiset.mem_map.mp hℓQ with ⟨ℓ_orig, hℓOrig, hRet⟩
  have hAttNotStar : ℓ.attachedTo ∉ A.1.starVertices starOf :=
    Finset.disjoint_left.mp hNoStar hSup
  have hRetAtt : A.1.retargetVertex starOf ℓ_orig.attachedTo = ℓ.attachedTo := by
    have := congrArg ExternalLeg.attachedTo hRet; simpa using this
  have hAttOrigNotA : ℓ_orig.attachedTo ∉ A.1.vertices := by
    intro hvA
    apply hAttNotStar
    rw [← hRetAtt, AdmissibleSubgraph.retargetVertex,
      A.1.componentAt?_of_mem hvA]
    exact AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_starVertices.mpr
      ⟨A.1.componentAt hvA, A.1.componentAt_mem hvA, rfl⟩
  have hRAtt := AdmissibleSubgraph.retargetVertex_of_not_mem A.1 starOf hAttOrigNotA
  have hAtt : ℓ_orig.attachedTo = ℓ.attachedTo := hRAtt.symm.trans hRetAtt
  have hSec : ℓ_orig.sector = ℓ.sector := by
    have := congrArg ExternalLeg.sector hRet
    simpa [AdmissibleSubgraph.retargetExternalLeg] using this
  have hEqLeg : ℓ_orig = ℓ := by
    cases ℓ_orig
    cases ℓ
    exact (ExternalLeg.mk.injEq _ _ _ _).mpr ⟨hAtt, hSec⟩
  rw [← hEqLeg]; exact hℓOrig

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestOuterActualQuotient_noStar_retargetEdge_eq_self
statement:
private theorem forestOuterActualQuotient_noStar_retargetEdge_eq_self
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    (g : HopfGen) (A : forestOuterProperIndex g)
    {e_orig e : FeynmanEdge}
    (hRet : A.1.retargetEdge
        (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph A.1 A.2) e_orig = e)
    (hSrcS : e.source ∉ A.1.starVertices
        (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph A.1 A.2))
    (hTgtS : e.target ∉ A.1.starVertices
        (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph A.1 A.2)) :
    e_orig = e
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set starOf := FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
    (repG g).toFeynmanGraph A.1 A.2 with hstarOf
  have hRSrc : A.1.retargetVertex starOf e_orig.source = e.source := by
    have := congrArg FeynmanEdge.source hRet; simpa using this
  have hRTgt : A.1.retargetVertex starOf e_orig.target = e.target := by
    have := congrArg FeynmanEdge.target hRet; simpa using this
  have hSrcNotA : e_orig.source ∉ A.1.vertices := by
    intro hvA; apply hSrcS
    rw [← hRSrc, AdmissibleSubgraph.retargetVertex,
      A.1.componentAt?_of_mem hvA]
    exact AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_starVertices.mpr
      ⟨A.1.componentAt hvA, A.1.componentAt_mem hvA, rfl⟩
  have hTgtNotA : e_orig.target ∉ A.1.vertices := by
    intro hvA; apply hTgtS
    rw [← hRTgt, AdmissibleSubgraph.retargetVertex,
      A.1.componentAt?_of_mem hvA]
    exact AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_starVertices.mpr
      ⟨A.1.componentAt hvA, A.1.componentAt_mem hvA, rfl⟩
  have hRSId := AdmissibleSubgraph.retargetVertex_of_not_mem A.1 starOf hSrcNotA
  have hRTId := AdmissibleSubgraph.retargetVertex_of_not_mem A.1 starOf hTgtNotA
  have hSec : e_orig.sector = e.sector := by
    have := congrArg FeynmanEdge.sector hRet
    simpa [AdmissibleSubgraph.retargetEdge] using this
  cases e_orig; cases e
  exact (FeynmanEdge.mk.injEq _ _ _ _ _ _).mpr
    ⟨hRSId.symm.trans hRSrc, hRTId.symm.trans hRTgt, hSec⟩

statement:
private theorem forestOuterActualQuotientNoStarComponentLift_isConnectedDivergent
    [IsAmbientInvariantDivergence]
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    (g : HopfGen) (A : forestOuterProperIndex g)
    (δ : FeynmanSubgraph (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g A))
    (hNoStar :
      Disjoint δ.vertices
        (A.1.starVertices
          (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
            (repG g).toFeynmanGraph A.1 A.2)))
    (hδCD : δ.IsConnectedDivergent) :
    (forestOuterActualQuotientNoStarComponentLift g A δ hNoStar).IsConnectedDivergent
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨hδCD.isConnected, hδCD.isOnePI, ?_⟩
  
  show 0 ≤ (forestOuterActualQuotientNoStarComponentLift g A δ hNoStar).divergenceDegree
  have hDeg :
      (forestOuterActualQuotientNoStarComponentLift g A δ hNoStar).divergenceDegree =
        δ.divergenceDegree := by
    show DivergenceMeasure.degree _ = DivergenceMeasure.degree _
    rw [← IsAmbientInvariantDivergence.degree_self_eq
          (forestOuterActualQuotientNoStarComponentLift g A δ hNoStar),
        ← IsAmbientInvariantDivergence.degree_self_eq δ]
    rfl
  rw [hDeg]
  exact hδCD.isDivergent

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestQuotientForestSigmaMixedCover_right_right_nestedOrDisjoint
statement:
private theorem forestQuotientForestSigmaMixedCover_right_right_nestedOrDisjoint
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    (g : HopfGen)
    (r : {r : forestQuotientForestSigma g //
      r ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaIndex g})
    (hNotForest : ¬ forestQuotientForestSigma_isForestByStar g r.1) :
    ∀ γ₁,
      γ₁ ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaMixedLiftedRightComponents g r hNotForest →
    ∀ γ₂,
      γ₂ ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaMixedLiftedRightComponents g r hNotForest →
    γ₁ ≠ γ₂ →
      γ₁.NestedOrDisjoint γ₂
proof:
:= by
  intro γ₁ hγ₁ γ₂ hγ₂ hne
  unfold forestQuotientForestSigmaMixedLiftedRightComponents at hγ₁ hγ₂
  rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hγ₁ with ⟨⟨δ₁, hδ₁⟩, _, hEq₁⟩
  rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hγ₂ with ⟨⟨δ₂, hδ₂⟩, _, hEq₂⟩
  have hδne : δ₁ ≠ δ₂ := by
    intro h
    apply hne
    rw [← hEq₁, ← hEq₂]
    subst h
    rfl
  have hδNOD :=
    (forestQuotientForestSigmaActualQuotientSubgraph g r.1).forest.nestedOrDisjoint
      hδ₁ hδ₂ hδne
  rw [← hEq₁, ← hEq₂]
  rcases hδNOD with hN | hD
  · refine Or.inl ?_
    rcases hN with h | h
    · exact Or.inl ⟨h.1, h.2.1, h.2.2⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨h.1, h.2.1, h.2.2⟩
  · exact Or.inr hD

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestQuotientForestSigmaMixedCoverOuterCandidate_isPairwiseDisjoint
statement:
private theorem forestQuotientForestSigmaMixedCoverOuterCandidate_isPairwiseDisjoint
    [IsAmbientInvariantDivergence]
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    (g : HopfGen)
    (r : {r : forestQuotientForestSigma g //
      r ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaIndex g})
    (hNotForest : ¬ forestQuotientForestSigma_isForestByStar g r.1) :
    (forestQuotientForestSigmaMixedCoverOuterCandidate g r hNotForest
      ).IsPairwiseDisjoint
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hLIPD :=
    (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs_isPairwiseDisjoint
      r.1.1.2
  have hActualIPD :=
    (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g r.1.1
      ).properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs_isPairwiseDisjoint
      (forestQuotientForestSigmaActualQuotientSubgraph_mem_properDisjoint g r)
  intro γ₁ hγ₁ γ₂ hγ₂ hne
  rw [← AdmissibleSubgraph.elements_def,
    forestQuotientForestSigmaMixedCoverOuterCandidate_elements] at hγ₁ hγ₂
  rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hγ₁ with hL1 | hR1
  · rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hγ₂ with hL2 | hR2
    · exact hLIPD hL1 hL2 hne
    · 
      have hRdisj :=
        forestQuotientForestSigmaMixedLiftedRightComponents_vertices_disjoint_outer
          g r hNotForest γ₂ hR2
      refine Finset.disjoint_left.mpr fun v hv1 hv2 => ?_
      exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp hRdisj hv2
        (AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_vertices.mpr ⟨γ₁, hL1, hv1⟩)
  · rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hγ₂ with hL2 | hR2
    · 
      have hRdisj :=
        forestQuotientForestSigmaMixedLiftedRightComponents_vertices_disjoint_outer
          g r hNotForest γ₁ hR1
      refine Finset.disjoint_left.mpr fun v hv1 hv2 => ?_
      exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp hRdisj hv1
        (AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_vertices.mpr ⟨γ₂, hL2, hv2⟩)
    · 
      unfold forestQuotientForestSigmaMixedLiftedRightComponents at hR1 hR2
      rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hR1 with ⟨⟨δ₁, hδ₁⟩, _, hEq₁⟩
      rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hR2 with ⟨⟨δ₂, hδ₂⟩, _, hEq₂⟩
      have hδne : δ₁ ≠ δ₂ := by
        intro h; apply hne; rw [← hEq₁, ← hEq₂]; subst h; rfl
      have hδDisj := hActualIPD hδ₁ hδ₂ hδne
      rw [← hEq₁, ← hEq₂]
      exact hδDisj
