name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestQuotientForestSigmaMixedCoverChoiceFn_mem_mixedBoundaryCore
statement:
private theorem forestQuotientForestSigmaMixedCoverChoiceFn_mem_mixedBoundaryCore
    [IsAmbientInvariantDivergence]
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    (g : HopfGen)
    (r : {r : forestQuotientForestSigma g //
      r ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaIndex g})
    (hNotForest : ¬ forestQuotientForestSigma_isForestByStar g r.1) :
    forestQuotientForestSigmaMixedCoverChoiceFn g r hNotForest ∈
      forestComponentMixedBoundaryChoiceCoreIndex
        (forestQuotientForestSigmaMixedCoverOuterCandidate g r hNotForest)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  have hLPDiff :=
    ((repG g).toFeynmanGraph.mem_properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs r.1.1.1).mp r.1.1.2
  have hLNE : r.1.1.1.IsNonempty :=
    (((repG g).toFeynmanGraph.mem_nonemptyDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs r.1.1.1).mp
      hLPDiff.1).2
  rcases hLNE with ⟨γL, hγLelem⟩
  have hγLCand : γL ∈ (forestQuotientForestSigmaMixedCoverOuterCandidate
      g r hNotForest).elements := by
    rw [forestQuotientForestSigmaMixedCoverOuterCandidate_elements]
    exact Finset.mem_union_left _ hγLelem
  have hActualPD :=
    forestQuotientForestSigmaActualQuotientSubgraph_mem_properDisjoint g r
  have hActualPDiff :=
    ((forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g r.1.1).mem_properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs
      _).mp hActualPD
  have hActualNE :
      (forestQuotientForestSigmaActualQuotientSubgraph g r.1).IsNonempty :=
    (((forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g r.1.1
      ).mem_nonemptyDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs _).mp hActualPDiff.1).2
  rcases hActualNE with ⟨δ, hδ⟩
  have hNoStarδ :=
    forestQuotientForestSigma_all_noStar_of_not_isForestByStar
      g r hNotForest δ hδ
  set lifted := forestOuterActualQuotientNoStarComponentLift
    g r.1.1 δ hNoStarδ with hliftedDef
  have hLiftedRightMem :
      lifted ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaMixedLiftedRightComponents
        g r hNotForest := by
    unfold forestQuotientForestSigmaMixedLiftedRightComponents
    exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨⟨δ, hδ⟩, Finset.mem_attach _ _, rfl⟩
  have hLiftedCand : lifted ∈ (forestQuotientForestSigmaMixedCoverOuterCandidate
      g r hNotForest).elements := by
    rw [forestQuotientForestSigmaMixedCoverOuterCandidate_elements]
    exact Finset.mem_union_right _ hLiftedRightMem
  
  unfold forestComponentMixedBoundaryChoiceCoreIndex
  rw [Finset.mem_filter]
  refine ⟨?core, ?notForest⟩
  case core =>
    rw [mem_forestComponentCoreChoiceIndex]
    refine ⟨?pi, ?notAllLeft, ?notAllRight⟩
    case pi =>
      rw [Finset.mem_pi]
      intro γ _hattach
      unfold forestQuotientForestSigmaMixedCoverChoiceFn forestComponentChoiceIndex
        forestCoproductChoiceIndex
      split_ifs
      · exact Finset.mem_insert_self _ _
      · exact Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _)
    case notAllLeft =>
      intro hAllLeft
      have hRight :=
        forestQuotientForestSigmaMixedCoverChoiceFn_eq_right_of_mem_right
          g r hNotForest hLiftedCand hLiftedRightMem
      have hLeft :
          forestQuotientForestSigmaMixedCoverChoiceFn g r hNotForest
              ⟨lifted, hLiftedCand⟩ (Finset.mem_attach _ _) =
            forestCoproductChoice.left := by
        rw [hAllLeft]; rfl
      rw [hLeft] at hRight
      cases hRight
    case notAllRight =>
      intro hAllRight
      have hLeft :=
        forestQuotientForestSigmaMixedCoverChoiceFn_eq_left_of_mem_left
          g r hNotForest hγLCand hγLelem
      have hRight :
          forestQuotientForestSigmaMixedCoverChoiceFn g r hNotForest
              ⟨γL, hγLCand⟩ (Finset.mem_attach _ _) =
            forestCoproductChoice.right := by
        rw [hAllRight]; rfl
      rw [hRight] at hLeft
      cases hLeft
  case notForest =>
    intro hForest
    rcases hForest with ⟨⟨γ, hγ⟩, B, hB⟩
    exact forestQuotientForestSigmaMixedCoverChoiceFn_ne_forest
      g r hNotForest hγ hB

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestOuterActualQuotientNoStarComponentLift_inj_on_attach
statement:
private theorem forestOuterActualQuotientNoStarComponentLift_inj_on_attach
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    (g : HopfGen) (A : forestOuterProperIndex g)
    {D : AdmissibleSubgraph (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g A)}
    (hAll :
      ∀ δ ∈ D.elements,
        Disjoint δ.vertices
          (A.1.starVertices
            (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
              (repG g).toFeynmanGraph A.1 A.2)))
    {δ₁ δ₂ : {δ // δ ∈ D.elements}}
    (h : forestOuterActualQuotientNoStarComponentLift g A δ₁.1 (hAll δ₁.1 δ₁.2) =
         forestOuterActualQuotientNoStarComponentLift g A δ₂.1 (hAll δ₂.1 δ₂.2)) :
    δ₁ = δ₂
proof:
:= by
  rcases δ₁ with ⟨γ₁, hγ₁⟩
  rcases δ₂ with ⟨γ₂, hγ₂⟩
  apply Subtype.ext
  show γ₁ = γ₂
  have hV := congrArg FeynmanSubgraph.vertices h
  have hI := congrArg FeynmanSubgraph.internalEdges h
  have hE := congrArg FeynmanSubgraph.externalLegs h
  rw [forestOuterActualQuotientNoStarComponentLift_vertices,
      forestOuterActualQuotientNoStarComponentLift_vertices] at hV
  rw [forestOuterActualQuotientNoStarComponentLift_internalEdges,
      forestOuterActualQuotientNoStarComponentLift_internalEdges] at hI
  rw [forestOuterActualQuotientNoStarComponentLift_externalLegs,
      forestOuterActualQuotientNoStarComponentLift_externalLegs] at hE
  cases γ₁; cases γ₂
  cases hV; cases hI; cases hE
  rfl

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestQuotientForestSigmaMixedCoverOuterCandidate_complementEdges_card_pos
statement:
private theorem forestQuotientForestSigmaMixedCoverOuterCandidate_complementEdges_card_pos
    [IsAmbientInvariantDivergence]
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    (g : HopfGen)
    (r : {r : forestQuotientForestSigma g //
      r ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaIndex g})
    (hNotForest : ¬ forestQuotientForestSigma_isForestByStar g r.1) :
    0 < (forestQuotientForestSigmaMixedCoverOuterCandidate
          g r hNotForest).complementEdges.card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set candidate := forestQuotientForestSigmaMixedCoverOuterCandidate g r hNotForest
    with hCandDef
  set actual := forestQuotientForestSigmaActualQuotientSubgraph g r.1 with hActDef
  
  have hr2pos : 0 < r.1.2.complementEdges.card := by
    have h := (Finset.mem_sigma.mp r.2).2
    unfold forestCoproductProperForestIndex at h
    exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp h).2
  
  have hr2PD : r.1.2 ∈
      (forestOuterQuotientGraph g r.1.1).properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs := by
    have h := (Finset.mem_sigma.mp r.2).2
    unfold forestCoproductProperForestIndex at h
    exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp h).1
  have hr2IPD :=
    (forestOuterQuotientGraph g r.1.1).properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs_isPairwiseDisjoint
      hr2PD
  have hr2Iₗₑ := admissibleSubgraph_internalEdges_le_of_pairwise r.1.2 hr2IPD
  
  have hr2ComplCardEq : r.1.2.complementEdges.card =
      (forestOuterQuotientGraph g r.1.1).internalEdges.card - r.1.2.internalEdges.card := by
    show ((forestOuterQuotientGraph g r.1.1).internalEdges - r.1.2.internalEdges).card = _
    exact Multiset.card_sub hr2Iₗₑ
  
  have hQuotCard : (forestOuterQuotientGraph g r.1.1).internalEdges.card =
      (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g r.1.1).internalEdges.card := by
    rw [forestOuterActualToRepPerm_spec g r.1.1]
    show ((forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g r.1.1).mapPerm _).internalEdges.card = _
    rw [FeynmanGraph.mapPerm_internalEdges, Multiset.card_map]
  
  have hActGraphCard : (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g r.1.1).internalEdges.card =
      r.1.1.1.complementEdges.card := by
    unfold forestOuterActualQuotientGraph
    rw [FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestContractGraphWithStars_eq,
        AdmissibleSubgraph.contractWithStars_internalEdges, Multiset.card_map]
  
  have hr2IltLCompl : r.1.2.internalEdges.card < r.1.1.1.complementEdges.card := by
    have h1 := hr2pos
    rw [hr2ComplCardEq] at h1
    rw [hQuotCard, hActGraphCard] at h1
    omega
  
  have hActICard : actual.internalEdges.card = r.1.2.internalEdges.card := by
    show (forestQuotientForestSigmaActualQuotientSubgraph g r.1
      ).internalEdges.card = _
    unfold forestQuotientForestSigmaActualQuotientSubgraph
    have hMap := mapPermAdmissibleSubgraphPreimage_internalEdges_map
      (forestOuterActualToRepPerm_spec g r.1.1) r.1.2
    have hc := congrArg Multiset.card hMap
    rw [Multiset.card_map] at hc
    exact hc
  
  have hLiftedSum : (∑ γ ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaMixedLiftedRightComponents
        g r hNotForest, γ.internalEdges) = actual.internalEdges := by
    unfold forestQuotientForestSigmaMixedLiftedRightComponents
    rw [Finset.sum_image]
    · simp only [forestOuterActualQuotientNoStarComponentLift_internalEdges]
      exact Finset.sum_attach actual.elements (fun γ => γ.internalEdges)
    · intro δ₁ _ δ₂ _ h
      exact forestOuterActualQuotientNoStarComponentLift_inj_on_attach
        g r.1.1
        (forestQuotientForestSigma_all_noStar_of_not_isForestByStar g r hNotForest) h
  
  have hCandI : candidate.internalEdges =
      r.1.1.1.internalEdges + actual.internalEdges := by
    show (∑ γ ∈ candidate.elements, γ.internalEdges) = _
    rw [forestQuotientForestSigmaMixedCoverOuterCandidate_elements,
      Finset.sum_union
        (forestQuotientForestSigmaMixedCoverOuterCandidate_left_right_disjoint
          g r hNotForest)]
    rw [hLiftedSum]
    rfl
  
  have hLIₗₑG :=
    admissibleSubgraph_internalEdges_le_of_pairwise r.1.1.1
      ((repG g).toFeynmanGraph.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs_isPairwiseDisjoint
        r.1.1.2)
  
  have hLComplCard : r.1.1.1.complementEdges.card =
      (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.internalEdges.card - r.1.1.1.internalEdges.card := by
    show ((repG g).toFeynmanGraph.internalEdges - r.1.1.1.internalEdges).card = _
    exact Multiset.card_sub hLIₗₑG
  have hLI_le_GI : r.1.1.1.internalEdges.card ≤
      (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.internalEdges.card :=
    Multiset.card_le_card hLIₗₑG
  
  have hCandIₗₑG :=
    admissibleSubgraph_internalEdges_le_of_pairwise candidate
      (forestQuotientForestSigmaMixedCoverOuterCandidate_isPairwiseDisjoint
        g r hNotForest)
  
  have hCandComplCard : candidate.complementEdges.card =
      (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.internalEdges.card - candidate.internalEdges.card := by
    show ((repG g).toFeynmanGraph.internalEdges - candidate.internalEdges).card = _
    exact Multiset.card_sub hCandIₗₑG
  
  have hCandICard : candidate.internalEdges.card =
      r.1.1.1.internalEdges.card + r.1.2.internalEdges.card := by
    rw [hCandI, Multiset.card_add, hActICard]
  
  rw [hLComplCard] at hr2IltLCompl
  rw [hCandComplCard, hCandICard]
  omega

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestQuotientForestSigmaMixedCoverChoiceSigma_mem
statement:
private theorem forestQuotientForestSigmaMixedCoverChoiceSigma_mem
    [IsAmbientInvariantDivergence]
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    (g : HopfGen)
    (r : {r : forestQuotientForestSigma g //
      r ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaIndex g})
    (hNotForest : ¬ forestQuotientForestSigma_isForestByStar g r.1) :
    forestQuotientForestSigmaMixedCoverChoiceSigma g r hNotForest ∈
      forestComponentMixedBoundaryChoiceSigmaIndex g
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold forestComponentMixedBoundaryChoiceSigmaIndex
  refine Finset.mem_sigma.mpr ⟨?outer, ?core⟩
  case outer =>
    refine Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨?attach, ?pos⟩
    case attach =>
      exact Finset.mem_attach _ _
    case pos =>
      exact forestQuotientForestSigmaMixedCoverOuterCandidate_complementEdges_card_pos
        g r hNotForest
  case core =>
    exact forestQuotientForestSigmaMixedCoverChoiceFn_mem_mixedBoundaryCore
      g r hNotForest

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestQuotientForestSigmaMixedCover_outerIndex_eq
statement:

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestOuterActualQuotientNoStarComponentLift_retarget_eq
statement:
private theorem forestOuterActualQuotientNoStarComponentLift_retarget_eq
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    (g : HopfGen) (A : forestOuterProperIndex g)
    (δ : FeynmanSubgraph (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g A))
    (hNoStar :
      Disjoint δ.vertices
        (A.1.starVertices
          (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
            (repG g).toFeynmanGraph A.1 A.2)))
    (hEdges :
      (forestOuterActualQuotientNoStarComponentLift g A δ hNoStar).internalEdges ≤
        A.1.complementEdges) :
    admissibleSubgraphRetargetSubgraph A.1
        (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph A.1 A.2)
        (forestOuterActualQuotientNoStarComponentLift g A δ hNoStar) hEdges
      = δ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set starOf := FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
    (repG g).toFeynmanGraph A.1 A.2 with hstarOf
  
  have hV :
      (admissibleSubgraphRetargetSubgraph A.1 starOf
        (forestOuterActualQuotientNoStarComponentLift g A δ hNoStar) hEdges).vertices =
        δ.vertices := by
    show (forestOuterActualQuotientNoStarComponentLift g A δ hNoStar).vertices.image
        (A.1.retargetVertex starOf) = δ.vertices
    rw [forestOuterActualQuotientNoStarComponentLift_vertices]
    ext v
    simp only [Finset.mem_image]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rintro ⟨u, hu, hRet⟩
      have hUnotA :=
        (forestOuterActualQuotient_noStar_vertex_mem_ambient_complement
          g A hNoStar hu).2
      rw [AdmissibleSubgraph.retargetVertex_of_not_mem A.1 starOf hUnotA] at hRet
      rw [← hRet]; exact hu
    · intro hv
      refine ⟨v, hv, ?_⟩
      have hvNotA :=
        (forestOuterActualQuotient_noStar_vertex_mem_ambient_complement
          g A hNoStar hv).2
      exact AdmissibleSubgraph.retargetVertex_of_not_mem A.1 starOf hvNotA
  
  have hI :
      (admissibleSubgraphRetargetSubgraph A.1 starOf
        (forestOuterActualQuotientNoStarComponentLift g A δ hNoStar) hEdges).internalEdges =
        δ.internalEdges := by
    show (forestOuterActualQuotientNoStarComponentLift g A δ hNoStar).internalEdges.map
        (A.1.retargetEdge starOf) = δ.internalEdges
    rw [forestOuterActualQuotientNoStarComponentLift_internalEdges]
    conv_rhs => rw [← Multiset.map_id δ.internalEdges]
    apply Multiset.map_congr rfl
    intro e he
    have hSup := δ.edges_supported e he
    have hSrcNotA :=
      (forestOuterActualQuotient_noStar_vertex_mem_ambient_complement
        g A hNoStar hSup.1).2
    have hTgtNotA :=
      (forestOuterActualQuotient_noStar_vertex_mem_ambient_complement
        g A hNoStar hSup.2).2
    have hRSrc := AdmissibleSubgraph.retargetVertex_of_not_mem A.1 starOf hSrcNotA
    have hRTgt := AdmissibleSubgraph.retargetVertex_of_not_mem A.1 starOf hTgtNotA
    cases e
    show (⟨_, _, _⟩ : FeynmanEdge) = id _
    simp [AdmissibleSubgraph.retargetEdge, hRSrc, hRTgt]
  
  have hE :
      (admissibleSubgraphRetargetSubgraph A.1 starOf
        (forestOuterActualQuotientNoStarComponentLift g A δ hNoStar) hEdges).externalLegs =
        δ.externalLegs := by
    show (forestOuterActualQuotientNoStarComponentLift g A δ hNoStar).externalLegs.map
        (A.1.retargetExternalLeg starOf) = δ.externalLegs
    rw [forestOuterActualQuotientNoStarComponentLift_externalLegs]
    conv_rhs => rw [← Multiset.map_id δ.externalLegs]
    apply Multiset.map_congr rfl
    intro ℓ hℓ
    have hSup := δ.legs_supported ℓ hℓ
    have hAttNotA :=
      (forestOuterActualQuotient_noStar_vertex_mem_ambient_complement
        g A hNoStar hSup).2
    have hRAtt := AdmissibleSubgraph.retargetVertex_of_not_mem A.1 starOf hAttNotA
    cases ℓ
    show (⟨_, _⟩ : ExternalLeg) = id _
    simp [AdmissibleSubgraph.retargetExternalLeg, hRAtt]
  
  generalize hLhsDef : admissibleSubgraphRetargetSubgraph A.1 starOf
      (forestOuterActualQuotientNoStarComponentLift g A δ hNoStar) hEdges = lhs at hV hI hE
  cases lhs; cases δ
  cases hV; cases hI; cases hE
  rfl

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.mapPermAdmissibleSubgraph_mapPermAdmissibleSubgraphPreimage_eq
statement:
private theorem mapPermAdmissibleSubgraph_mapPermAdmissibleSubgraphPreimage_eq
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    {G₁ G₂ : FeynmanGraph} {π : Equiv.Perm VertexId}
    (hπ : G₂ = G₁.mapPerm π) (A : AdmissibleSubgraph G₂) :
    mapPermAdmissibleSubgraph hπ
      (mapPermAdmissibleSubgraphPreimage hπ A) = A
proof:
:= by
  apply mapPermAdmissibleSubgraphPreimage_injective hπ
  exact mapPermAdmissibleSubgraphPreimage_mapPerm_eq hπ
    (mapPermAdmissibleSubgraphPreimage hπ A)

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentMixedBoundaryActualRightQuotientSubgraph_eq_of_outer_right
statement:
private theorem forestComponentMixedBoundaryActualRightQuotientSubgraph_eq_of_outer_right
    [IsAmbientInvariantDivergence]
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    (g : HopfGen)
    (r : {r : forestQuotientForestSigma g //
      r ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaIndex g})
    (hNotForest : ¬ forestQuotientForestSigma_isForestByStar g r.1)
    (q : forestComponentChoiceSigma g)
    (hq : q ∈ forestComponentMixedBoundaryChoiceSigmaIndex g)
    (hOuter : forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex g q hq = r.1.1)
    (hRight :
      forestComponentChoiceRightSubgraph q.1.1 q.2 =
        forestQuotientForestSigmaMixedCoverRightCandidate g r hNotForest) :
    hOuter ▸
      forestComponentMixedBoundaryActualRightQuotientSubgraphCanonical g q hq
      = forestQuotientForestSigmaActualQuotientSubgraph g r.1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  obtain ⟨⟨A, D⟩, hr⟩ := r
  cases hOuter
  
  apply AdmissibleSubgraph.ext
  apply Forest.ext
  apply Finset.ext
  intro δ
  
  constructor
  · 
    intro hδLHS
    
    
    
    rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hδLHS with ⟨γ, _, hRetγ⟩
    obtain ⟨γ_val, γ_mem_orig⟩ := γ
    have γ_mem_lifted : γ_val ∈
        forestQuotientForestSigmaMixedLiftedRightComponents
          g ⟨⟨_, D⟩, hr⟩ hNotForest := by
      rw [← forestQuotientForestSigmaMixedCoverRightCandidate_elements
        g ⟨⟨_, D⟩, hr⟩ hNotForest, ← hRight]
      exact γ_mem_orig
    unfold forestQuotientForestSigmaMixedLiftedRightComponents at γ_mem_lifted
    rcases Finset.mem_image.mp γ_mem_lifted with ⟨δ₀, _, hLiftEq⟩
    have hNoStarδ₀ :=
      forestQuotientForestSigma_all_noStar_of_not_isForestByStar
        g ⟨⟨_, D⟩, hr⟩ hNotForest δ₀.1 δ₀.2
    subst hLiftEq
    have hδEqδ₀ : δ = δ₀.1 := by
      rw [← hRetγ]
      exact forestOuterActualQuotientNoStarComponentLift_retarget_eq
        g (forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex g q hq) δ₀.1 hNoStarδ₀
        (forestComponentMixedBoundaryRightRetarget_edge_le g q hq _ γ_mem_orig)
    rw [hδEqδ₀]
    exact δ₀.2
  · 
    intro hδRHS
    have hNoStarδ :=
      forestQuotientForestSigma_all_noStar_of_not_isForestByStar
        g ⟨⟨_, D⟩, hr⟩ hNotForest δ hδRHS
    set lifted := forestOuterActualQuotientNoStarComponentLift g
      (forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex g q hq) δ hNoStarδ with hLiftedDef
    have hLiftedRight :
        lifted ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaMixedLiftedRightComponents
          g ⟨⟨_, D⟩, hr⟩ hNotForest := by
      unfold forestQuotientForestSigmaMixedLiftedRightComponents
      exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨⟨δ, hδRHS⟩, Finset.mem_attach _ _, rfl⟩
    have hLiftedInRightSubgraph : lifted ∈
        (forestComponentChoiceRightSubgraph q.1.1 q.2).elements := by
      rw [hRight, forestQuotientForestSigmaMixedCoverRightCandidate_elements]
      exact hLiftedRight
    refine Finset.mem_image.mpr
      ⟨⟨lifted, hLiftedInRightSubgraph⟩, Finset.mem_attach _ _, ?_⟩
    exact forestOuterActualQuotientNoStarComponentLift_retarget_eq
      g (forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex g q hq) δ hNoStarδ _

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestOuterActualToRep_actualized_eq
statement:
private theorem forestOuterActualToRep_actualized_eq
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    (g : HopfGen) (A : forestOuterProperIndex g)
    (D : AdmissibleSubgraph (forestOuterQuotientGraph g A)) :
    forestOuterActualToRepAdmissibleSubgraph g A
        (forestQuotientForestSigmaActualQuotientSubgraph g ⟨A, D⟩)
      = D
proof:
:= by
  unfold forestOuterActualToRepAdmissibleSubgraph
    forestQuotientForestSigmaActualQuotientSubgraph
  exact mapPermAdmissibleSubgraph_mapPermAdmissibleSubgraphPreimage_eq
    (forestOuterActualToRepPerm_spec g A) D

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentMixedBoundaryRepRightQuotientSubgraph_eq_of_outer_right
statement:
private theorem forestComponentMixedBoundaryRepRightQuotientSubgraph_eq_of_outer_right
    [IsAmbientInvariantDivergence]
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    (g : HopfGen)
    (r : {r : forestQuotientForestSigma g //
      r ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaIndex g})
    (hNotForest : ¬ forestQuotientForestSigma_isForestByStar g r.1)
    (q : forestComponentChoiceSigma g)
    (hq : q ∈ forestComponentMixedBoundaryChoiceSigmaIndex g)
    (hOuter : forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex g q hq = r.1.1)
    (hRight :
      forestComponentChoiceRightSubgraph q.1.1 q.2 =
        forestQuotientForestSigmaMixedCoverRightCandidate g r hNotForest) :
    hOuter ▸
      forestComponentMixedBoundaryRepRightQuotientSubgraphCanonical g q hq
      = r.1.2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hActual := forestComponentMixedBoundaryActualRightQuotientSubgraph_eq_of_outer_right
    g r hNotForest q hq hOuter hRight
  obtain ⟨⟨A, D⟩, hr⟩ := r
  cases hOuter
  
  change forestComponentMixedBoundaryActualRightQuotientSubgraphCanonical g q hq
    = forestQuotientForestSigmaActualQuotientSubgraph g
        ⟨forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex g q hq, D⟩ at hActual
  show forestOuterActualToRepAdmissibleSubgraph g
      (forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex g q hq)
      (forestComponentMixedBoundaryActualRightQuotientSubgraphCanonical g q hq) = D
  rw [hActual]
  exact forestOuterActualToRep_actualized_eq g _ D

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestQuotientForestSigmaMixedCover_toQuotientForestSigma_eq
statement:
private theorem forestQuotientForestSigmaMixedCover_toQuotientForestSigma_eq
    [IsAmbientInvariantDivergence]
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    (g : HopfGen)
    (r : {r : forestQuotientForestSigma g //
      r ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaIndex g})
    (hNotForest : ¬ forestQuotientForestSigma_isForestByStar g r.1) :
    forestComponentMixedBoundaryToQuotientForestSigma g
        (forestQuotientForestSigmaMixedCoverChoiceSigma g r hNotForest)
        (forestQuotientForestSigmaMixedCoverChoiceSigma_mem g r hNotForest)
      = r.1
proof:
:= by
  apply Sigma.ext
  · exact forestQuotientForestSigmaMixedCover_outerIndex_eq g r hNotForest
  · exact eqRec_heq_iff_heq.mp (heq_of_eq
      (forestComponentMixedBoundaryRepRightQuotientSubgraph_eq_of_outer_right
        g r hNotForest _ _
        (forestQuotientForestSigmaMixedCover_outerIndex_eq g r hNotForest)
        (forestQuotientForestSigmaMixedCoverChoiceFn_rightSubgraph_eq g r hNotForest)))

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestQuotientForestSigma_mixedPreimage_of_not_isForestByStar
statement:
private theorem forestQuotientForestSigma_mixedPreimage_of_not_isForestByStar
    [IsAmbientInvariantDivergence]
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    (g : HopfGen)
    (r : {r : forestQuotientForestSigma g //
      r ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaIndex g})
    (hNotForest : ¬ forestQuotientForestSigma_isForestByStar g r.1) :
    ∃ q : forestComponentChoiceSigma g,
      ∃ hq : q ∈ forestComponentMixedBoundaryChoiceSigmaIndex g,
        forestComponentMixedBoundaryToQuotientForestSigma g q hq = r.1
proof:
:=
  ⟨forestQuotientForestSigmaMixedCoverChoiceSigma g r hNotForest,
    forestQuotientForestSigmaMixedCoverChoiceSigma_mem g r hNotForest,
    forestQuotientForestSigmaMixedCover_toQuotientForestSigma_eq g r hNotForest⟩

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestQuotientForestSigma_cover_mixed_half
statement:
private theorem forestQuotientForestSigma_cover_mixed_half
    [IsAmbientInvariantDivergence]

    (g : HopfGen)
    (r : {r : forestQuotientForestSigma g //
      r ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaIndex g})
    (hNotForest : ¬ forestQuotientForestSigma_isForestByStar g r.1) :
    (∃ q : forestComponentChoiceSigma g,

          forestComponentForestChoiceToQuotientForestSigma g q hq = r.1) ∨
    (∃ q : forestComponentChoiceSigma g,
        ∃ hq : q ∈ forestComponentMixedBoundaryChoiceSigmaIndex g,
          forestComponentMixedBoundaryToQuotientForestSigma g q hq = r.1)
proof:
:=

    g r hNotForest)

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceVertices_nonstar_mem
statement:
private theorem forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceVertices_nonstar_mem
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    (g : HopfGen)

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceVertices_nonstar_mem_not_mem_outer
statement:
private theorem forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceVertices_nonstar_mem_not_mem_outer
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    (g : HopfGen)
    (r : {r : forestQuotientForestSigma g //
      r ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaIndex g})
    {δ : FeynmanSubgraph (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g r.1.1)}
    {v : VertexId}
    (hvδ : v ∈ δ.vertices)
    (hvNotStar :
      v ∉ r.1.1.1.starVertices
        (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2)) :
    v ∉ r.1.1.1.vertices
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hvQ : v ∈ (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g r.1.1).vertices :=
    δ.vertices_subset hvδ
  unfold forestOuterActualQuotientGraph at hvQ
  simp only [FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestContractGraphWithStars_eq,
    AdmissibleSubgraph.contractWithStars_vertices] at hvQ
  rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hvQ with hComp | hStar
  · exact (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hComp).2
  · exact absurd hStar hvNotStar

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceVertices_disjoint_nonPromoted_vertices
statement:
private theorem forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceVertices_disjoint_nonPromoted_vertices
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    (g : HopfGen)
    (r : {r : forestQuotientForestSigma g //
      r ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaIndex g})
    {δ : FeynmanSubgraph (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g r.1.1)}
    {η : FeynmanSubgraph (repG g).toFeynmanGraph}
    (hηA : η ∈ r.1.1.1.elements)
    (hηNonPromoted :
      FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
        (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2 η ∉ δ.vertices) :
    Disjoint η.vertices
      (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceVertices g r δ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Finset.disjoint_right]
  intro v hvSrc hvη
  unfold forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceVertices at hvSrc
  rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hvSrc with hNonStar | hPromoted
  · 
    rcases Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hNonStar with ⟨hvδ, hvNotStar⟩
    have hvNotOuter :
        v ∉ r.1.1.1.vertices :=
      forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceVertices_nonstar_mem_not_mem_outer
        g r hvδ hvNotStar
    exact hvNotOuter
      (AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_vertices.mpr ⟨η, hηA, hvη⟩)
  · 
    rcases Finset.mem_biUnion.mp hPromoted with ⟨η', hη'A, hvBranch⟩
    by_cases hStar :
      FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
        (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2 η' ∈ δ.vertices
    · simp only [hStar, if_true] at hvBranch
      have hne : η' ≠ η := by
        intro h; subst h; exact hηNonPromoted hStar
      have hPairwise : r.1.1.1.IsPairwiseDisjoint :=
        (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs_isPairwiseDisjoint
          r.1.1.2
      have hDisj : η'.Disjoint η := hPairwise hη'A hηA hne
      exact (Finset.disjoint_left.mp hDisj hvBranch) hvη
    · simp only [hStar, if_false] at hvBranch
      exact (Finset.notMem_empty v hvBranch).elim

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_endpoint_mem_sourceVertices
statement:
private theorem forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_endpoint_mem_sourceVertices
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    (g : HopfGen)
    (r : {r : forestQuotientForestSigma g //
      r ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaIndex g})
    (δ : FeynmanSubgraph (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g r.1.1))
    {v : VertexId} (hvG : v ∈ (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.vertices)
    {v' : VertexId}
    (hRet :
      r.1.1.1.retargetVertex
        (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2) v = v')
    (hv'δ : v' ∈ δ.vertices) :
    v ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceVertices g r δ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hvA : v ∈ r.1.1.1.vertices
  · 
    set η := r.1.1.1.componentAt hvA with hηDef
    have hηA : η ∈ r.1.1.1.elements := r.1.1.1.componentAt_mem hvA
    have hvη : v ∈ η.vertices := r.1.1.1.componentAt_vertex_mem hvA
    have hRetη :
        r.1.1.1.retargetVertex
          (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
            (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2) v =
          FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
            (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2 η := by
      rw [AdmissibleSubgraph.retargetVertex, r.1.1.1.componentAt?_of_mem hvA]
    have hStarEq : FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
        (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2 η = v' :=
      hRetη.symm.trans hRet
    have hStarη : FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
        (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2 η ∈ δ.vertices := by
      rw [hStarEq]; exact hv'δ
    exact (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceVertices_eta_subset
      g r hηA hStarη) hvη
  · 
    have hRetId := AdmissibleSubgraph.retargetVertex_of_not_mem r.1.1.1
      (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
        (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2) hvA
    have hvEq : v = v' := hRetId.symm.trans hRet
    have hFresh := FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf_isFreshStarAssignment
      (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2
    have hvNotStar : v ∉ r.1.1.1.starVertices
        (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2) := fun hStar =>
      hFresh.star_not_mem_vertices hStar hvG
    have hvδ : v ∈ δ.vertices := hvEq.symm ▸ hv'δ
    exact forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceVertices_nonstar_mem
      g r hvδ hvNotStar

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_edgePreimage_exists
statement:
private theorem forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_edgePreimage_exists
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    (g : HopfGen)
    (r : {r : forestQuotientForestSigma g //
      r ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaIndex g})
    (δ : FeynmanSubgraph (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g r.1.1))
    {e' : FeynmanEdge} (he' : e' ∈ δ.internalEdges) :
    ∃ e : FeynmanEdge,
      e ∈ (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.internalEdges ∧
      r.1.1.1.retargetEdge
        (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2) e = e' ∧
      e.source ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceVertices g r δ ∧
      e.target ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceVertices g r δ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have he'Q : e' ∈ (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g r.1.1).internalEdges :=
    Multiset.mem_of_le δ.internalEdges_le he'
  unfold forestOuterActualQuotientGraph at he'Q
  rw [FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestContractGraphWithStars_eq,
    AdmissibleSubgraph.contractWithStars_internalEdges] at he'Q
  rcases Multiset.mem_map.mp he'Q with ⟨e, heC, hRet⟩
  have heG : e ∈ (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.internalEdges :=
    AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_ambientInternalEdges_of_mem_complementEdges _ heC
  have heSupp := δ.edges_supported e' he'
  have hRetSrc :
      r.1.1.1.retargetVertex
        (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2) e.source = e'.source := by
    have := congrArg FeynmanEdge.source hRet; simpa using this
  have hRetTgt :
      r.1.1.1.retargetVertex
        (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2) e.target = e'.target := by
    have := congrArg FeynmanEdge.target hRet; simpa using this
  have heGsupp := FeynmanGraph.wellFormed_internal (repG_wellFormed g) heG
  refine ⟨e, heG, hRet, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_endpoint_mem_sourceVertices
      g r δ heGsupp.1 hRetSrc heSupp.1
  · exact forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_endpoint_mem_sourceVertices
      g r δ heGsupp.2 hRetTgt heSupp.2

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.Multiset.exists_le_of_le_map
statement:
private theorem Multiset.exists_le_of_le_map
    {α β : Type*} [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]
    (f : α → β) (t : Multiset β) :
    ∀ s : Multiset α, t ≤ s.map f →
      ∃ u : Multiset α, u ≤ s ∧ u.map f = t
proof:
:= by
  induction t using Multiset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
    intro s _
    exact ⟨0, Multiset.zero_le _, by simp⟩
  | cons b t' ih =>
    intro s h
    have hb : b ∈ s.map f :=
      Multiset.mem_of_le h (Multiset.mem_cons_self b t')
    rcases Multiset.mem_map.mp hb with ⟨a, ha, hfa⟩
    have h_map_erase : (s.erase a).map f = (s.map f).erase b := by
      have := Multiset.map_erase_of_mem f s ha
      rw [hfa] at this; exact this
    have ht' : t' ≤ (s.erase a).map f := by
      rw [Multiset.le_iff_count]
      intro x
      rw [h_map_erase]
      have h1 : Multiset.count x (b ::ₘ t') ≤ Multiset.count x (s.map f) :=
        Multiset.count_le_of_le x h
      rw [Multiset.count_cons] at h1
      by_cases hxb : x = b
      · subst hxb
        rw [Multiset.count_erase_self]
        simp at h1
        omega
      · rw [Multiset.count_erase_of_ne hxb]
        simp [hxb] at h1
        exact h1
    rcases ih (s.erase a) ht' with ⟨u', hu'le, hu'map⟩
    refine ⟨a ::ₘ u', ?_, ?_⟩
    · calc a ::ₘ u'
          ≤ a ::ₘ (s.erase a) := Multiset.cons_le_cons a hu'le
        _ = s := Multiset.cons_erase ha
    · rw [Multiset.map_cons, hu'map, hfa]

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverExactInternalEdges_exists
statement:
private theorem forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverExactInternalEdges_exists
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    (g : HopfGen)
    (r : {r : forestQuotientForestSigma g //
      r ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaIndex g})
    (δ : FeynmanSubgraph (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g r.1.1)) :
    ∃ E : Multiset FeynmanEdge,
      E ≤ r.1.1.1.complementEdges ∧
      E ≤ (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.internalEdges ∧
      E.map
        (r.1.1.1.retargetEdge
          (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
            (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2)) =
        δ.internalEdges ∧
      ∀ e ∈ E,
        e.source ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceVertices g r δ ∧
        e.target ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceVertices g r δ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hδLe : δ.internalEdges ≤
      (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g r.1.1).internalEdges :=
    δ.internalEdges_le
  have hActualEq :
      (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g r.1.1).internalEdges =
        r.1.1.1.complementEdges.map
          (r.1.1.1.retargetEdge
            (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
              (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2)) := by
    unfold forestOuterActualQuotientGraph
    rw [FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestContractGraphWithStars_eq,
      AdmissibleSubgraph.contractWithStars_internalEdges]
  rw [hActualEq] at hδLe
  rcases Multiset.exists_le_of_le_map _ _ _ hδLe with ⟨E, hELe, hEmap⟩
  have hCompLe :
      r.1.1.1.complementEdges ≤ (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.internalEdges := by
    unfold AdmissibleSubgraph.complementEdges
    exact Multiset.sub_le_self _ _
  have hEGLe : E ≤ (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.internalEdges := hELe.trans hCompLe
  refine ⟨E, hELe, hEGLe, hEmap, ?_⟩
  intro e he
  have hfe :
      r.1.1.1.retargetEdge
        (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2) e ∈ δ.internalEdges := by
    rw [← hEmap]
    exact Multiset.mem_map_of_mem _ he

  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · exact forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_endpoint_mem_sourceVertices
      g r δ heGsupp.1 rfl hfeSupp.1
  · exact forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_endpoint_mem_sourceVertices
      g r δ heGsupp.2 rfl hfeSupp.2

private theorem forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverExactExternalLegs_exists
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    (g : HopfGen)
    (r : {r : forestQuotientForestSigma g //
      r ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaIndex g})
    (δ : FeynmanSubgraph (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g r.1.1)) :
    ∃ L : Multiset ExternalLeg,
      L ≤ (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.externalLegs ∧
      L.map
        (r.1.1.1.retargetExternalLeg
          (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
            (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2)) =
        δ.externalLegs ∧
      ∀ ℓ ∈ L,
        ℓ.attachedTo ∈
          forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceVertices g r δ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hδLe : δ.externalLegs ≤
      (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g r.1.1).externalLegs :=
    δ.externalLegs_le
  have hActualEq :
      (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g r.1.1).externalLegs =
        (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.externalLegs.map
          (r.1.1.1.retargetExternalLeg
            (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
              (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2)) := by
    unfold forestOuterActualQuotientGraph
    rw [FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestContractGraphWithStars_eq,
      AdmissibleSubgraph.contractWithStars_externalLegs]
  rw [hActualEq] at hδLe
  rcases Multiset.exists_le_of_le_map _ _ _ hδLe with ⟨L, hLLe, hLmap⟩
  refine ⟨L, hLLe, hLmap, ?_⟩
  intro ℓ hℓ
  have hfℓ :
      r.1.1.1.retargetExternalLeg
        (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2) ℓ ∈ δ.externalLegs := by
    rw [← hLmap]
    exact Multiset.mem_map_of_mem _ hℓ
  have hfℓSupp := δ.legs_supported _ hfℓ
  have hℓG : ℓ ∈ (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.externalLegs :=
    Multiset.mem_of_le hLLe hℓ
  have hℓGsupp := FeynmanGraph.wellFormed_external (repG_wellFormed g) hℓG
  exact forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_endpoint_mem_sourceVertices
    g r δ hℓGsupp rfl hfℓSupp

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverExactInternalEdges_not_mem_nonPromotedInternalEdges
statement:
private theorem forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverExactInternalEdges_not_mem_nonPromotedInternalEdges
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    (g : HopfGen)
    (r : {r : forestQuotientForestSigma g //
      r ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaIndex g})
    (δ : FeynmanSubgraph (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g r.1.1))
    {e : FeynmanEdge}
    (heE : e ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverExactInternalEdges g r δ) :
    e ∉ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverNonPromotedInternalEdges g r δ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro heNP
  unfold forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverNonPromotedInternalEdges at heNP
  rcases Multiset.mem_sum.mp heNP with ⟨η, hηNon, heη⟩
  rw [forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_mem_nonPromotedComponents_iff]
    at hηNon
  obtain ⟨hηA, hStarNotIn⟩ := hηNon
  have hSupp : e.source ∈ η.vertices ∧ e.target ∈ η.vertices :=
    η.edges_supported e heη
  have hDisj : r.1.1.1.IsPairwiseDisjoint :=
    (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs_isPairwiseDisjoint
      r.1.1.2
  have hRet :
      r.1.1.1.retargetVertex
        (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2) e.source =
      FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
        (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2 η :=
    AdmissibleSubgraph.retargetVertex_of_mem_component hDisj _ hηA hSupp.1
  have hMap :=
    forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverExactInternalEdges_map g r δ
  have hfe :
      r.1.1.1.retargetEdge
        (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2) e ∈ δ.internalEdges := by
    rw [← hMap]
    exact Multiset.mem_map_of_mem _ heE
  have hSrcInδ :
      (r.1.1.1.retargetEdge
        (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2) e).source ∈ δ.vertices :=
    (δ.edges_supported _ hfe).1
  rw [AdmissibleSubgraph.retargetEdge_source, hRet] at hSrcInδ
  exact hStarNotIn hSrcInδ

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_promoted_union_nonPromotedComponents
statement:
private theorem forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_promoted_union_nonPromotedComponents
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    (g : HopfGen)
    (r : {r : forestQuotientForestSigma g //
      r ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaIndex g})

    forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverPromotedComponents g r δ ∪
      forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverNonPromotedComponents g r δ =
      r.1.1.1.elements
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext η
  constructor
  · intro h
    rcases Finset.mem_union.mp h with hP | hNP
    · exact (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_mem_promotedComponents_iff
        g r δ).mp hP |>.1
    · exact (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_mem_nonPromotedComponents_iff
        g r δ).mp hNP |>.1
  · intro hη
    by_cases hStar :
        FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2 η ∈ δ.vertices
    · exact Finset.mem_union_left _
        ((forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_mem_promotedComponents_iff
          g r δ).mpr ⟨hη, hStar⟩)
    · exact Finset.mem_union_right _
        ((forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_mem_nonPromotedComponents_iff
          g r δ).mpr ⟨hη, hStar⟩)

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_promoted_disjoint_nonPromotedComponents

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_elements_eq_promoted_union_nonPromoted

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_internalEdges_eq_promoted_add_nonPromoted
statement:
private theorem forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_internalEdges_eq_promoted_add_nonPromoted
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    (g : HopfGen)
    (r : {r : forestQuotientForestSigma g //

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.Multiset.sub_eq_self_of_disjoint
statement:
private theorem Multiset.sub_eq_self_of_disjoint
    {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] {s t : Multiset α}
    (h : Disjoint s t) :
    s - t = s
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  by_cases hx : x ∈ s
  · have hxt : x ∉ t := (Multiset.disjoint_left.mp h) hx
    have ht0 : Multiset.count x t = 0 := Multiset.count_eq_zero_of_notMem hxt
    rw [Multiset.count_sub, ht0, Nat.sub_zero]
  · have hs0 : Multiset.count x s = 0 := Multiset.count_eq_zero_of_notMem hx
    rw [Multiset.count_sub, hs0, Nat.zero_sub]

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceVertices_image_retarget_subset
statement:
private theorem forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceVertices_image_retarget_subset
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    (g : HopfGen)
    (r : {r : forestQuotientForestSigma g //
      r ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaIndex g})
    (δ : FeynmanSubgraph (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g r.1.1)) :
    (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceVertices g r δ).image
      (r.1.1.1.retargetVertex
        (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2)) ⊆
      δ.vertices
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro v hv
  rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hv with ⟨x, hxSrc, rfl⟩
  unfold forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceVertices at hxSrc
  rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hxSrc with hLeft | hRight
  · 
    rcases Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hLeft with ⟨hxδ, hxNotStar⟩
    have hxQ : x ∈ (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g r.1.1).vertices :=
      δ.vertices_subset hxδ
    unfold forestOuterActualQuotientGraph at hxQ
    simp only [FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestContractGraphWithStars_eq,
      AdmissibleSubgraph.contractWithStars_vertices] at hxQ
    rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hxQ with hRest | hStar
    · have hxNotA : x ∉ r.1.1.1.vertices :=
        (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hRest).2
      rw [AdmissibleSubgraph.retargetVertex_of_not_mem r.1.1.1 _ hxNotA]
      exact hxδ
    · exact absurd hStar hxNotStar
  · 
    rcases Finset.mem_biUnion.mp hRight with ⟨η, hηA, hxBranch⟩
    by_cases hStarη :
        FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2 η ∈ δ.vertices
    · simp only [hStarη, if_true] at hxBranch
      have hDisj : r.1.1.1.IsPairwiseDisjoint :=
        (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs_isPairwiseDisjoint
          r.1.1.2
      rw [AdmissibleSubgraph.retargetVertex_of_mem_component hDisj _ hηA hxBranch]
      exact hStarη
    · simp only [hStarη, if_false] at hxBranch
      exact (Finset.notMem_empty x hxBranch).elim

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_starVertex_mem_image_retarget
statement:
private theorem forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_starVertex_mem_image_retarget
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    (g : HopfGen)
    (r : {r : forestQuotientForestSigma g //
      r ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaIndex g})
    (δ : FeynmanSubgraph (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g r.1.1))
    {η : FeynmanSubgraph (repG g).toFeynmanGraph}
    (hηA : η ∈ r.1.1.1.elements)
    (hStar :
      FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
        (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2 η ∈ δ.vertices) :
    FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
        (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2 η ∈
      (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceVertices g r δ).image
        (r.1.1.1.retargetVertex
          (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
            (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hCompNE : r.1.1.1.HasNonemptyComponents :=
    (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs_hasNonemptyComponents
      r.1.1.2
  have hηNE : η.IsNonempty := hCompNE η hηA
  rcases Finset.card_pos.mp hηNE with ⟨x, hxη⟩
  have hxSrc :
      x ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceVertices g r δ :=
    forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceVertices_eta_subset
      g r hηA hStar hxη
  have hPair : r.1.1.1.IsPairwiseDisjoint :=
    (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs_isPairwiseDisjoint
      r.1.1.2
  have hRet :
      r.1.1.1.retargetVertex
          (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
            (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2) x =
        FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2 η :=
    AdmissibleSubgraph.retargetVertex_of_mem_component hPair _ hηA hxη
  exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨x, hxSrc, hRet⟩

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceVertices_image_retarget_supset
statement:
private theorem forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceVertices_image_retarget_supset
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    (g : HopfGen)
    (r : {r : forestQuotientForestSigma g //
      r ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaIndex g})
    (δ : FeynmanSubgraph (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g r.1.1)) :
    δ.vertices ⊆

        (r.1.1.1.retargetVertex
          (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
            (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro v hvδ
  have hvQ : v ∈ (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g r.1.1).vertices :=
    δ.vertices_subset hvδ
  unfold forestOuterActualQuotientGraph at hvQ
  simp only [FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestContractGraphWithStars_eq,
    AdmissibleSubgraph.contractWithStars_vertices] at hvQ
  rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hvQ with hOutside | hStar
  · 
    rcases Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hOutside with ⟨_, hvNotA⟩
    have hFresh :
        r.1.1.1.IsFreshStarAssignment
          (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
            (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2) :=
      FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf_isFreshStarAssignment
        (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2
    have hvNotStar :
        v ∉ r.1.1.1.starVertices
          (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
            (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2) :=
      Finset.disjoint_left.mp hFresh.disjoint_sdiff_starVertices hOutside
    have hvSrc :
        v ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceVertices g r δ :=
      forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceVertices_nonstar_mem
        g r hvδ hvNotStar
    have hRet :
        r.1.1.1.retargetVertex
            (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
              (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2) v = v :=
      AdmissibleSubgraph.retargetVertex_of_not_mem r.1.1.1 _ hvNotA
    exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨v, hvSrc, hRet⟩
  · 
    rcases AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_starVertices.mp hStar with ⟨η, hηA, rfl⟩
    exact forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_starVertex_mem_image_retarget
      g r δ hηA hvδ

    (g : HopfGen)

      r ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaIndex g})

      ∀ δ₁ : FeynmanSubgraph (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g r.1.1),
        δ₁ ∈ (forestQuotientForestSigmaActualQuotientSubgraph g r.1).elements →
      ∀ δ₂ : FeynmanSubgraph (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g r.1.1),
        δ₂ ∈ (forestQuotientForestSigmaActualQuotientSubgraph g r.1).elements →
        δ₁ ≠ δ₂ →
          (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus
            g r δ₁).NestedOrDisjoint
            (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus
              g r δ₂))
    {γ₁ γ₂ : FeynmanSubgraph (repG g).toFeynmanGraph}
    (hγ₁ :
      γ₁ ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverLiftedSourceComponents g r)
    (hγ₂ :
      γ₂ ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverLiftedSourceComponents g r)
    (hne : γ₁ ≠ γ₂) :
    γ₁.NestedOrDisjoint γ₂

:= by
  rcases forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverLiftedSourceComponents_mem_exists
    g r hγ₁ with ⟨δ₁, hEq₁⟩
  rcases forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverLiftedSourceComponents_mem_exists
    g r hγ₂ with ⟨δ₂, hEq₂⟩
  subst hEq₁
  subst hEq₂

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceAdmissibleSubgraph_remainder_elements
statement:
private theorem forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceAdmissibleSubgraph_remainder_elements
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    (g : HopfGen)

      r ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaIndex g})

        δ₁ ∈ (forestQuotientForestSigmaActualQuotientSubgraph g r.1).elements →
      ∀ δ₂ : FeynmanSubgraph (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g r.1.1),
        δ₂ ∈ (forestQuotientForestSigmaActualQuotientSubgraph g r.1).elements →

          (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus
            g r δ₁).NestedOrDisjoint
            (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus
              g r δ₂)) :

        r.1.1.1

          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2)) =
      (forestQuotientForestSigmaActualQuotientSubgraph g r.1).elements

:= by
  classical
  ext γ

  · intro hγ

      g r hγs with ⟨δ, hEq⟩
    subst hEq
    rw [forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus_remainder_eq]
      at hRem
    exact hRem ▸ δ.2
  · intro hγ
    refine Finset.mem_image.mpr
      ⟨forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus g r γ,
        ?_,
        forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus_remainder_eq
          g r γ⟩
    rw [forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceAdmissibleSubgraph_elements]
    unfold forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverLiftedSourceComponents

statement:
private theorem forestQuotientForestSigma_isForestRemnantPattern_source_unique
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    (g : HopfGen)
    (r : {r : forestQuotientForestSigma g //
      r ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaIndex g})

      δ.vertices =
        {FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2 γ₁})
    (hδ₂ :
      δ.vertices =
        {FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2 γ₂}) :
    γ₁ = γ₂
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hStarEq :
      FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2 γ₁ =
        FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2 γ₂ := by
    have hmem :
        FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2 γ₁ ∈ δ.vertices := by
      rw [hδ₁]; exact Finset.mem_singleton.mpr rfl
    rw [hδ₂] at hmem
    exact Finset.mem_singleton.mp hmem
  have hFresh :
      r.1.1.1.IsFreshStarAssignment
        (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2) :=
    FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf_isFreshStarAssignment
      (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2
  exact hFresh.eq_of_star_eq hγ₁ hγ₂ hStarEq

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus_divergent
statement:
private theorem forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus_divergent
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    [IsDivergenceReflectedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    (g : HopfGen)
    (r : {r : forestQuotientForestSigma g //
      r ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaIndex g})
    (δ : FeynmanSubgraph (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g r.1.1))
    (hδ : δ ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverForestComponents g r) :
    (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus g r δ).IsDivergent
proof:
:= by
  have hDisj : r.1.1.1.IsPairwiseDisjoint :=
    (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs_isPairwiseDisjoint
      r.1.1.2
  have hCompNE : r.1.1.1.HasNonemptyComponents :=
    (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs_hasNonemptyComponents
      r.1.1.2
  have hFresh :=
    FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf_isFreshStarAssignment
      (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2
  have hForestDiv : ∀ η ∈ r.1.1.1.elements, η.IsDivergent :=
    fun η hη => r.1.1.1.isDivergent_of_mem hη
  have hδmem :
      δ ∈ (forestQuotientForestSigmaActualQuotientSubgraph g r.1).elements :=
    ((forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverForestComponents_mem g r).mp hδ).1
  have hδDiv : δ.IsDivergent :=
    (forestQuotientForestSigmaActualQuotientSubgraph g r.1).isDivergent_of_mem hδmem
  have hRemDiv :
      (admissibleSubgraphQuotientRemainderSubgraph
        r.1.1.1
        (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2)
        (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus g r δ)).IsDivergent := by
    rw [forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus_remainder_eq g r δ]
    exact hδDiv
  exact admissibleSubgraphQuotientRemainderSubgraph_isDivergent_reflect
    r.1.1.1 hDisj hCompNE hForestDiv
    (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
      (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2)
    hFresh
    (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus g r δ)
    hRemDiv

statement:
private theorem forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverLiftedForestComponents_nestedOrDisjoint_of_source_disjoint
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    (g : HopfGen)
    (r : {r : forestQuotientForestSigma g //
      r ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaIndex g})
    (hForestDisjoint :
      ∀ δ₁ : FeynmanSubgraph (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g r.1.1),
        δ₁ ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverForestComponents g r →
      ∀ δ₂ : FeynmanSubgraph (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g r.1.1),
        δ₂ ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverForestComponents g r →
        δ₁ ≠ δ₂ →
          Disjoint
            (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus
              g r δ₁).vertices
            (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus
              g r δ₂).vertices)
    {γ₁ γ₂ : FeynmanSubgraph (repG g).toFeynmanGraph}
    (hγ₁ :
      γ₁ ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverLiftedForestComponents g r)
    (hγ₂ :
      γ₂ ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverLiftedForestComponents g r)
    (hne : γ₁ ≠ γ₂) :
    γ₁.NestedOrDisjoint γ₂
proof:
:= by
  rcases forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverLiftedForestComponents_mem_exists
    g r hγ₁ with ⟨δ₁, hδ₁, hEq₁⟩
  rcases forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverLiftedForestComponents_mem_exists
    g r hγ₂ with ⟨δ₂, hδ₂, hEq₂⟩
  have hδne : δ₁ ≠ δ₂ := by
    intro hδ
    apply hne
    rw [← hEq₁, ← hEq₂, hδ]
  rw [← hEq₁, ← hEq₂]
  exact Or.inr (hForestDisjoint δ₁ hδ₁ δ₂ hδ₂ hδne)

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverLiftedRightComponents_nestedOrDisjoint

private theorem forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverLiftedRightComponents_nestedOrDisjoint
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    (g : HopfGen)
    (r : {r : forestQuotientForestSigma g //
      r ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaIndex g})
    {γ₁ γ₂ : FeynmanSubgraph (repG g).toFeynmanGraph}
    (hγ₁ :
      γ₁ ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverLiftedRightComponents g r)
    (hγ₂ :
      γ₂ ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverLiftedRightComponents g r)
    (hne : γ₁ ≠ γ₂) :
    γ₁.NestedOrDisjoint γ₂
proof:
:= by
  rcases forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverLiftedRightComponents_mem_exists
    g r hγ₁ with ⟨δ₁, hδ₁Right, _hNoStar₁, hEq₁⟩
  rcases forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverLiftedRightComponents_mem_exists
    g r hγ₂ with ⟨δ₂, hδ₂Right, _hNoStar₂, hEq₂⟩
  have hδ₁D :
      δ₁ ∈ (forestQuotientForestSigmaActualQuotientSubgraph g r.1).elements :=
    ((forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverRightComponents_mem g r).mp hδ₁Right).1
  have hδ₂D :
      δ₂ ∈ (forestQuotientForestSigmaActualQuotientSubgraph g r.1).elements :=
    ((forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverRightComponents_mem g r).mp hδ₂Right).1
  have hδne : δ₁ ≠ δ₂ := by
    intro hδ
    apply hne
    rw [← hEq₁, ← hEq₂]
    subst hδ
    rfl
  have hδNOD : δ₁.NestedOrDisjoint δ₂ :=
    (forestQuotientForestSigmaActualQuotientSubgraph g r.1).forest.nestedOrDisjoint
      hδ₁D hδ₂D hδne
  rw [← hEq₁, ← hEq₂]
  rcases hδNOD with hN | hD
  · refine Or.inl ?_
    rcases hN with hN | hN
    · exact Or.inl ⟨hN.1, hN.2.1, hN.2.2⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨hN.1, hN.2.1, hN.2.2⟩
  · exact Or.inr hD

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentForestChoiceActualRightQuotientSubgraph_eq_of_outer_v3
statement:
private theorem forestComponentForestChoiceActualRightQuotientSubgraph_eq_of_outer_v3
    [IsAmbientInvariantDivergence]
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    (g : HopfGen)
    (r : {r : forestQuotientForestSigma g //
      r ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaIndex g})
    (q : forestComponentChoiceSigma g)
    (hq : q ∈ forestComponentForestChoiceSigmaIndex g)
    (hOuter : forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq = r.1.1)
    (hRight :
      forestComponentChoiceRightSubgraph q.1.1 q.2 =
        forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverRightCandidate_v3 g r) :
    hOuter ▸
      forestComponentForestChoiceActualRightQuotientSubgraphCanonical g q hq
      = forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverRightActualSubgraph g r
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨⟨A, D⟩, hr⟩ := r
  cases hOuter
  apply AdmissibleSubgraph.ext
  apply Forest.ext
  apply Finset.ext
  intro δ
  constructor
  · 
    intro hδLHS
    rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hδLHS with ⟨γ, _, hRetγ⟩
    obtain ⟨γ_val, γ_mem_orig⟩ := γ
    have γ_mem_lifted : γ_val ∈
        forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverLiftedRightComponents
          g ⟨⟨_, D⟩, hr⟩ := by
      rw [← forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverRightCandidate_v3_elements
        g ⟨⟨_, D⟩, hr⟩, ← hRight]
      exact γ_mem_orig
    rcases forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverLiftedRightComponents_mem_exists
      g ⟨⟨_, D⟩, hr⟩ γ_mem_lifted with ⟨δ₀, hδ₀Right, hNoStarδ₀, hLiftEq⟩
    subst hLiftEq
    have hRetEq :=
      forestOuterActualQuotientNoStarComponentLift_retarget_eq
        g (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq) δ₀ hNoStarδ₀
        (forestComponentForestChoiceRightRetarget_edge_le g q hq _ γ_mem_orig)
    have hδEqδ₀ : δ = δ₀ := hRetγ.symm.trans hRetEq
    rw [hδEqδ₀]
    exact hδ₀Right
  · 
    intro hδRHS
    have hδInRC :
        δ ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverRightComponents
          g ⟨⟨_, D⟩, hr⟩ := hδRHS
    have hδRightMem :=
      (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverRightComponents_mem g ⟨⟨_, D⟩, hr⟩).mp hδInRC
    have hNoStarδ := hδRightMem.2
    set lifted := forestOuterActualQuotientNoStarComponentLift g
      (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq) δ hNoStarδ with hLiftedDef
    have hLiftedRight :
        lifted ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverLiftedRightComponents
          g ⟨⟨_, D⟩, hr⟩ := by
      unfold forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverLiftedRightComponents
      exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨⟨δ, hδInRC⟩, Finset.mem_attach _ _, rfl⟩
    have hLiftedInRightSubgraph : lifted ∈
        (forestComponentChoiceRightSubgraph q.1.1 q.2).elements := by
      rw [hRight, forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverRightCandidate_v3_elements]
      exact hLiftedRight
    refine Finset.mem_image.mpr
      ⟨⟨lifted, hLiftedInRightSubgraph⟩, Finset.mem_attach _ _, ?_⟩
    exact forestOuterActualQuotientNoStarComponentLift_retarget_eq
      g (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq) δ hNoStarδ _

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_liftedRight_disjoint_liftedForest_vertices
statement:
private theorem forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_liftedRight_disjoint_liftedForest_vertices
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    (g : HopfGen)
    (r : {r : forestQuotientForestSigma g //
      r ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaIndex g})
    {γR γF : FeynmanSubgraph (repG g).toFeynmanGraph}
    (hR : γR ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverLiftedRightComponents g r)
    (hF : γF ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverLiftedForestComponents g r) :
    Disjoint γR.vertices γF.vertices
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverLiftedRightComponents_mem_exists
    g r hR with ⟨δR, hδRRight, hNoStar, hEqR⟩
  rcases forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverLiftedForestComponents_mem_exists
    g r hF with ⟨δF, hδFForest, hEqF⟩
  rw [← hEqR, ← hEqF]
  rw [forestOuterActualQuotientNoStarComponentLift_vertices,
      forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus_vertices]
  rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
  intro v hvR hvF
  unfold forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceVertices at hvF
  rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hvF with hLeft | hRight
  · 
    rcases Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hLeft with ⟨hvδF, _⟩
    have hδR_D :
        δR ∈ (forestQuotientForestSigmaActualQuotientSubgraph g r.1).elements :=
      ((forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverRightComponents_mem g r).mp hδRRight).1
    have hδF_D :
        δF ∈ (forestQuotientForestSigmaActualQuotientSubgraph g r.1).elements :=
      ((forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverForestComponents_mem g r).mp hδFForest).1
    have hδne : δR ≠ δF := by
      intro hδ
      have hCrossDisj :=
        forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_right_disjoint_forestComponents g r
      rw [Finset.disjoint_left] at hCrossDisj
      exact hCrossDisj hδRRight (hδ ▸ hδFForest)
    have hR2Proper :
        r.1.2 ∈ (forestOuterQuotientGraph g r.1.1
          ).properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs := by
      have hSigma := Finset.mem_sigma.mp r.2
      exact ((mem_forestCoproductProperForestIndex _ _).mp hSigma.2).1
    have hDProper :
        forestQuotientForestSigmaActualQuotientSubgraph g r.1 ∈
          (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g r.1.1
            ).properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs := by
      unfold forestQuotientForestSigmaActualQuotientSubgraph
      exact mapPermAdmissibleSubgraphPreimage_mem_properDisjoint
        (forestOuterActualToRepPerm_spec g r.1.1) hR2Proper
    have hDPairwise :
        (forestQuotientForestSigmaActualQuotientSubgraph
          g r.1).IsPairwiseDisjoint :=
      (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g r.1.1
        ).properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs_isPairwiseDisjoint hDProper
    exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp (hDPairwise hδR_D hδF_D hδne) hvR hvδF
  · 
    rcases Finset.mem_biUnion.mp hRight with ⟨η, hηA, hvIf⟩
    by_cases hStar :
        FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2 η ∈ δF.vertices
    · simp only [hStar, if_true] at hvIf
      have hvA : v ∈ r.1.1.1.vertices :=
        AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_vertices.mpr ⟨η, hηA, hvIf⟩
      have hvNotA :=
        (forestOuterActualQuotient_noStar_vertex_mem_ambient_complement
          g r.1.1 hNoStar hvR).2
      exact hvNotA hvA
    · simp only [hStar, if_false] at hvIf
      exact (Finset.notMem_empty v hvIf).elim
