name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_leftComponents_disjoint_liftedForestComponents_vertices
statement:
private theorem forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_leftComponents_disjoint_liftedForestComponents_vertices
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    (g : HopfGen)
    (r : {r : forestQuotientForestSigma g //
      r ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaIndex g})
    {η γF : FeynmanSubgraph (repG g).toFeynmanGraph}
    (hη : η ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverLeftComponents g r)
    (hγF : γF ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverLiftedForestComponents g r) :
    Disjoint η.vertices γF.vertices
proof:
:= by
  rcases forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverLiftedForestComponents_mem_exists
    g r hγF with ⟨δF, hδF, hEqF⟩
  rcases (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverLeftComponents_mem g r).mp hη
    with ⟨hηA, hηNotAllPromoted⟩
  have hηNotPromotedδF :
      η ∉ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverPromotedComponents g r δF := by
    intro h
    exact hηNotAllPromoted
      ((forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverAllPromotedComponents_mem g r).mpr
        ⟨δF, hδF, h⟩)
  have hStarNotIn :
      FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
        (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2 η ∉ δF.vertices := by
    intro hStar
    exact hηNotPromotedδF
      ((forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_mem_promotedComponents_iff
        g r δF).mpr ⟨hηA, hStar⟩)
  rw [← hEqF, forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus_vertices]
  exact forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceVertices_disjoint_nonPromoted_vertices
    g r hηA hStarNotIn

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_left_disjoint_liftedRight_vertices
statement:
private theorem forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_left_disjoint_liftedRight_vertices
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    (g : HopfGen)
    (r : {r : forestQuotientForestSigma g //
      r ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaIndex g})
    {η γR : FeynmanSubgraph (repG g).toFeynmanGraph}
    (hη : η ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverLeftComponents g r)
    (hR : γR ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverLiftedRightComponents g r) :
    Disjoint η.vertices γR.vertices
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hηA :=
    ((forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverLeftComponents_mem g r).mp hη).1
  rcases forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverLiftedRightComponents_mem_exists
    g r hR with ⟨δR, _hδR, hNoStar, hEq⟩
  rw [← hEq, forestOuterActualQuotientNoStarComponentLift_vertices,
    Finset.disjoint_left]
  intro v hvη hvδ
  have hvNotStar :
      v ∉ r.1.1.1.starVertices
        (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2) :=
    fun hvStar => (Finset.disjoint_left.mp hNoStar hvδ) hvStar
  have hvNotA :=
    forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceVertices_nonstar_mem_not_mem_outer
      g r hvδ hvNotStar
  exact hvNotA (AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_vertices.mpr ⟨η, hηA, hvη⟩)

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.supportReachable_mono_of_internalEdges_le
statement:
private theorem supportReachable_mono_of_internalEdges_le
    {H G : FeynmanGraph} (hle : H.internalEdges ≤ G.internalEdges)
    {u v : VertexId} (h : H.SupportReachable u v) :
    G.SupportReachable u v
proof:
:= by
  refine SimpleGraph.Reachable.mono ?_ h
  intro a b hab
  obtain ⟨hne, e, heH, hend⟩ := hab
  exact ⟨hne, e, Multiset.mem_of_le hle heH, hend⟩

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus_promotedComponent_reachable
statement:
private theorem forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus_promotedComponent_reachable
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    (g : HopfGen)
    (r : {r : forestQuotientForestSigma g //
      r ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaIndex g})
    (δ : FeynmanSubgraph (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g r.1.1))
    {η : FeynmanSubgraph (repG g).toFeynmanGraph}
    (hη : η ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverPromotedComponents g r δ)
    {u v : VertexId} (hu : u ∈ η.vertices) (hv : v ∈ η.vertices) :
    (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus g r δ).toFeynmanGraph.SupportReachable
      u v
proof:
:= by
  have hηA : η ∈ r.1.1.1.elements :=
    ((forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_mem_promotedComponents_iff g r δ).mp hη).1
  have hηconn : η.toFeynmanGraph.IsSupportConnected :=
    (r.1.1.1.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem hηA).1
  have hreach : η.toFeynmanGraph.SupportReachable u v := hηconn hu hv
  have hle :
      η.internalEdges ≤
        (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus g r δ).internalEdges := by
    rw [forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus_internalEdges]
    refine le_trans
      (Finset.single_le_sum (fun i _ => Multiset.zero_le _) hη)
      (Multiset.le_add_left _ _)
  exact supportReachable_mono_of_internalEdges_le hle hreach

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceVertices_retarget_classify
statement:
private theorem forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceVertices_retarget_classify
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    (g : HopfGen)
    (r : {r : forestQuotientForestSigma g //
      r ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaIndex g})
    (δ : FeynmanSubgraph (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g r.1.1))
    {z : VertexId}
    (hz : z ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceVertices g r δ) :
    (r.1.1.1.retargetVertex
        (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2) z = z) ∨
      (∃ η ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverPromotedComponents g r δ,
        z ∈ η.vertices ∧
          r.1.1.1.retargetVertex
            (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
              (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2) z =
            FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
              (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2 η)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hApd : r.1.1.1.IsPairwiseDisjoint :=
    (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs_isPairwiseDisjoint
      r.1.1.2
  unfold forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceVertices at hz
  rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hz with hns | hpr
  · rcases Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hns with ⟨hzδ, hzns⟩
    exact Or.inl (AdmissibleSubgraph.retargetVertex_of_not_mem _ _
      (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceVertices_nonstar_mem_not_mem_outer
        g r hzδ hzns))
  · rcases Finset.mem_biUnion.mp hpr with ⟨η, hηA, hzB⟩
    by_cases hs :
      FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
        (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2 η ∈ δ.vertices
    · simp only [hs, if_true] at hzB
      exact Or.inr ⟨η,
        (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_mem_promotedComponents_iff g r δ).mpr
          ⟨hηA, hs⟩,
        hzB,
        AdmissibleSubgraph.retargetVertex_of_mem_component hApd _ hηA hzB⟩
    · simp only [hs, if_false] at hzB
      exact (Finset.notMem_empty z hzB).elim

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus_sameRetarget_reachable
statement:
private theorem forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus_sameRetarget_reachable
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    (g : HopfGen)
    (r : {r : forestQuotientForestSigma g //
      r ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaIndex g})
    (δ : FeynmanSubgraph (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g r.1.1))
    {x y : VertexId}
    (hx : x ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceVertices g r δ)
    (hy : y ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceVertices g r δ)
    (hret :
      r.1.1.1.retargetVertex
          (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
            (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2) x =
        r.1.1.1.retargetVertex
          (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
            (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2) y) :
    (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus g r δ).toFeynmanGraph.SupportReachable
      x y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hFresh : r.1.1.1.IsFreshStarAssignment
      (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
        (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2) :=
    FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf_isFreshStarAssignment
      (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2
  rcases forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceVertices_retarget_classify g r δ hx with
    hx0 | ⟨ηx, hηx, hxηx, hxret⟩
  · rcases forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceVertices_retarget_classify g r δ hy with
      hy0 | ⟨ηy, hηy, hyηy, hyret⟩
    · rw [show x = y from hx0.symm.trans (hret.trans hy0)]
      exact FeynmanGraph.SupportReachable.refl _ _
    · exfalso
      have hηyA : ηy ∈ r.1.1.1.elements :=
        ((forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_mem_promotedComponents_iff g r δ).mp hηy).1
      have hxstar : x = FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2 ηy := hx0.symm.trans (hret.trans hyret)
      exact hFresh.fresh hηyA
        (hxstar ▸ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceVertices_subset_ambient g r δ hx)
  · rcases forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceVertices_retarget_classify g r δ hy with
      hy0 | ⟨ηy, hηy, hyηy, hyret⟩
    · exfalso
      have hηxA : ηx ∈ r.1.1.1.elements :=
        ((forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_mem_promotedComponents_iff g r δ).mp hηx).1
      have hystar : y = FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2 ηx :=
        hy0.symm.trans (hret.symm.trans hxret)
      exact hFresh.fresh hηxA
        (hystar ▸ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceVertices_subset_ambient g r δ hy)
    · have hηxA : ηx ∈ r.1.1.1.elements :=
        ((forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_mem_promotedComponents_iff g r δ).mp hηx).1
      have hηyA : ηy ∈ r.1.1.1.elements :=
        ((forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_mem_promotedComponents_iff g r δ).mp hηy).1
      have hstar :
          FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
              (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2 ηx =
            FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
              (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2 ηy :=
        hxret.symm.trans (hret.trans hyret)
      have hηeq : ηx = ηy := hFresh.eq_of_star_eq hηxA hηyA hstar
      subst hηeq
      exact forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus_promotedComponent_reachable
        g r δ hηx hxηx hyηy

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus_edgeStep
statement:
private theorem forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus_edgeStep
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    (g : HopfGen)
    (r : {r : forestQuotientForestSigma g //
      r ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaIndex g})
    (δ : FeynmanSubgraph (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g r.1.1))
    {c b : VertexId}
    (hadj : δ.toFeynmanGraph.SupportAdj c b)
    {wc : VertexId}
    (hwc : wc ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceVertices g r δ)
    (hwcc :
      r.1.1.1.retargetVertex
        (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2) wc = c) :
    ∃ wb, wb ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceVertices g r δ ∧
      r.1.1.1.retargetVertex
        (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2) wb = b ∧
      (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus g r δ).toFeynmanGraph.SupportReachable
        wc wb
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨hcb, eδ, heδ, hend⟩ := hadj
  have heδ' : eδ ∈
      (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverExactInternalEdges g r δ).map
        (r.1.1.1.retargetEdge
          (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
            (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2)) := by
    rw [forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverExactInternalEdges_map]; exact heδ
  obtain ⟨eE, heE, hmap⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp heδ'
  obtain ⟨hsE, htE⟩ :=
    forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverExactInternalEdges_endpoints g r δ heE
  have hrs :
      r.1.1.1.retargetVertex
        (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2) eE.source = eδ.source := by
    rw [← hmap]; rfl
  have hrt :
      r.1.1.1.retargetVertex
        (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2) eE.target = eδ.target := by
    rw [← hmap]; rfl
  have heEPlus : eE ∈
      (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus g r δ).internalEdges := by
    rw [forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus_internalEdges]
    exact Multiset.mem_add.mpr (Or.inl heE)
  have plusAdj : eE.source ≠ eE.target →
      (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus g r δ).toFeynmanGraph.SupportReachable
        eE.source eE.target :=
    fun hne => SimpleGraph.Adj.reachable
      (show (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus g r δ).toFeynmanGraph.SupportAdj
          eE.source eE.target from ⟨hne, eE, heEPlus, Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩)
  rcases hend with ⟨hsc, htb⟩ | ⟨hsb, htc⟩
  · have hsEc :
        r.1.1.1.retargetVertex
          (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
            (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2) eE.source = c := hrs.trans hsc
    have htEb :
        r.1.1.1.retargetVertex
          (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
            (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2) eE.target = b := hrt.trans htb
    have hne : eE.source ≠ eE.target := fun h =>
      hcb (hsEc.symm.trans ((congrArg _ h).trans htEb))
    exact ⟨eE.target, htE, htEb,
      (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus_sameRetarget_reachable
        g r δ hwc hsE (hwcc.trans hsEc.symm)).trans (plusAdj hne)⟩
  · have hsEb :
        r.1.1.1.retargetVertex
          (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
            (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2) eE.source = b := hrs.trans hsb
    have htEc :
        r.1.1.1.retargetVertex
          (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
            (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2) eE.target = c := hrt.trans htc
    have hne : eE.source ≠ eE.target := fun h =>
      hcb (htEc.symm.trans ((congrArg _ h.symm).trans hsEb))
    exact ⟨eE.source, hsE, hsEb,
      (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus_sameRetarget_reachable
        g r δ hwc htE (hwcc.trans htEc.symm)).trans (plusAdj hne).symm⟩

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus_reachable_lift
statement:
private theorem forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus_reachable_lift
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    (g : HopfGen)
    (r : {r : forestQuotientForestSigma g //
      r ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaIndex g})
    (δ : FeynmanSubgraph (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g r.1.1))
    {a b u : VertexId}
    (hu : u ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceVertices g r δ)
    (hua :
      r.1.1.1.retargetVertex
        (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2) u = a)
    (hab : δ.toFeynmanGraph.SupportReachable a b) :
    ∃ w, w ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceVertices g r δ ∧
      r.1.1.1.retargetVertex
        (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2) w = b ∧

statement:
private theorem forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus_sameRetarget_reachable_in
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    (g : HopfGen)
    (r : {r : forestQuotientForestSigma g //
      r ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaIndex g})
    (δ : FeynmanSubgraph (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g r.1.1))
    {K : FeynmanGraph}
    (hKle : forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverPromotedInternalEdges g r δ ≤ K.internalEdges)
    {x y : VertexId}
    (hx : x ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceVertices g r δ)
    (hy : y ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceVertices g r δ)
    (hret :
      r.1.1.1.retargetVertex
          (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
            (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2) x =
        r.1.1.1.retargetVertex
          (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
            (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2) y) :
    K.SupportReachable x y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hFresh : r.1.1.1.IsFreshStarAssignment
      (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
        (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2) :=
    FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf_isFreshStarAssignment
      (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2
  rcases forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceVertices_retarget_classify g r δ hx with
    hx0 | ⟨ηx, hηx, hxηx, hxret⟩
  · rcases forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceVertices_retarget_classify g r δ hy with
      hy0 | ⟨ηy, hηy, hyηy, hyret⟩
    · rw [show x = y from hx0.symm.trans (hret.trans hy0)]
      exact FeynmanGraph.SupportReachable.refl _ _
    · exfalso
      have hηyA : ηy ∈ r.1.1.1.elements :=
        ((forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_mem_promotedComponents_iff g r δ).mp hηy).1
      have hxstar : x = FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2 ηy := hx0.symm.trans (hret.trans hyret)
      exact hFresh.fresh hηyA
        (hxstar ▸ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceVertices_subset_ambient g r δ hx)
  · rcases forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceVertices_retarget_classify g r δ hy with
      hy0 | ⟨ηy, hηy, hyηy, hyret⟩
    · exfalso
      have hηxA : ηx ∈ r.1.1.1.elements :=
        ((forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_mem_promotedComponents_iff g r δ).mp hηx).1
      have hystar : y = FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2 ηx :=
        hy0.symm.trans (hret.symm.trans hxret)
      exact hFresh.fresh hηxA
        (hystar ▸ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceVertices_subset_ambient g r δ hy)
    · have hηxA : ηx ∈ r.1.1.1.elements :=
        ((forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_mem_promotedComponents_iff g r δ).mp hηx).1
      have hηyA : ηy ∈ r.1.1.1.elements :=
        ((forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_mem_promotedComponents_iff g r δ).mp hηy).1
      have hstar :
          FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
              (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2 ηx =
            FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
              (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2 ηy :=
        hxret.symm.trans (hret.trans hyret)
      have hηeq : ηx = ηy := hFresh.eq_of_star_eq hηxA hηyA hstar
      subst hηeq
      exact forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus_promotedComponent_reachable_in
        g r δ hηx hKle hxηx hyηy

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus_edgeStep_erase_exact
statement:
private theorem forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus_edgeStep_erase_exact
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    (g : HopfGen)
    (r : {r : forestQuotientForestSigma g //
      r ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaIndex g})
    (δ : FeynmanSubgraph (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g r.1.1))
    {e : FeynmanEdge}
    (he : e ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverExactInternalEdges g r δ)
    {c b : VertexId}
    (hadj :
      (δ.toFeynmanGraph.eraseInternalEdge
        (r.1.1.1.retargetEdge
          (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
            (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2) e)).SupportAdj c b)
    {wc : VertexId}
    (hwc : wc ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceVertices g r δ)
    (hwcc :
      r.1.1.1.retargetVertex
        (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2) wc = c) :
    ∃ wb, wb ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceVertices g r δ ∧
      r.1.1.1.retargetVertex
        (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2) wb = b ∧
      ((forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus g r δ).toFeynmanGraph.eraseInternalEdge
        e).SupportReachable wc wb
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨hcb, eδ, heδ, hend⟩ := hadj
  rw [FeynmanGraph.eraseInternalEdge_internalEdges] at heδ
  
  have heδ' : eδ ∈
      ((forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverExactInternalEdges g r δ).erase e).map
        (r.1.1.1.retargetEdge
          (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
            (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2)) := by
    rw [Multiset.map_erase_of_mem _ _ he,
        forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverExactInternalEdges_map]
    exact heδ
  obtain ⟨eE, heEerase, hmap⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp heδ'
  have heE : eE ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverExactInternalEdges g r δ :=
    Multiset.mem_of_mem_erase heEerase
  obtain ⟨hsE, htE⟩ :=
    forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverExactInternalEdges_endpoints g r δ heE
  have hrs :
      r.1.1.1.retargetVertex
        (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2) eE.source = eδ.source := by
    rw [← hmap]; rfl
  have hrt :
      r.1.1.1.retargetVertex
        (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2) eE.target = eδ.target := by
    rw [← hmap]; rfl
  
  have heraseEq :
      (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus g r δ).internalEdges.erase e =
        (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverExactInternalEdges g r δ).erase e +
          forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverPromotedInternalEdges g r δ := by
    rw [forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus_internalEdges]
    exact Multiset.erase_add_left_pos _ he
  have hKle :
      forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverPromotedInternalEdges g r δ ≤
        ((forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus g r δ).toFeynmanGraph.eraseInternalEdge
          e).internalEdges := by
    rw [FeynmanGraph.eraseInternalEdge_internalEdges]
    show forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverPromotedInternalEdges g r δ ≤
      (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus g r δ).internalEdges.erase e
    rw [heraseEq]
    exact Multiset.le_add_left _ _
  have heEPlus : eE ∈
      ((forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus g r δ).toFeynmanGraph.eraseInternalEdge
        e).internalEdges := by
    rw [FeynmanGraph.eraseInternalEdge_internalEdges]
    show eE ∈
      (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus g r δ).internalEdges.erase e
    rw [heraseEq]
    exact Multiset.mem_add.mpr (Or.inl heEerase)
  have plusAdj : eE.source ≠ eE.target →
      ((forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus g r δ).toFeynmanGraph.eraseInternalEdge
        e).SupportReachable eE.source eE.target :=
    fun hne => SimpleGraph.Adj.reachable
      (show ((forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus g r δ).toFeynmanGraph.eraseInternalEdge
          e).SupportAdj eE.source eE.target from ⟨hne, eE, heEPlus, Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩)
  rcases hend with ⟨hsc, htb⟩ | ⟨hsb, htc⟩
  · have hsEc :
        r.1.1.1.retargetVertex
          (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
            (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2) eE.source = c := hrs.trans hsc
    have htEb :
        r.1.1.1.retargetVertex
          (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
            (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2) eE.target = b := hrt.trans htb
    have hne : eE.source ≠ eE.target := fun h =>
      hcb (hsEc.symm.trans ((congrArg _ h).trans htEb))
    exact ⟨eE.target, htE, htEb,
      (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus_sameRetarget_reachable_in
        g r δ hKle hwc hsE (hwcc.trans hsEc.symm)).trans (plusAdj hne)⟩
  · have hsEb :
        r.1.1.1.retargetVertex
          (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
            (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2) eE.source = b := hrs.trans hsb
    have htEc :
        r.1.1.1.retargetVertex
          (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
            (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2) eE.target = c := hrt.trans htc
    have hne : eE.source ≠ eE.target := fun h =>
      hcb (htEc.symm.trans ((congrArg _ h.symm).trans hsEb))
    exact ⟨eE.source, hsE, hsEb,
      (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus_sameRetarget_reachable_in
        g r δ hKle hwc htE (hwcc.trans htEc.symm)).trans (plusAdj hne).symm⟩

        (r.1.1.1.retargetEdge

            (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2)) := by
    rw [forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverExactInternalEdges_map]; exact heδ
  obtain ⟨eE, heE, hmap⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp heδ'
  obtain ⟨hsE, htE⟩ :=
    forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverExactInternalEdges_endpoints g r δ heE
  have hrs :
      r.1.1.1.retargetVertex
        (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2) eE.source = eδ.source := by
    rw [← hmap]; rfl
  have hrt :
      r.1.1.1.retargetVertex
        (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2) eE.target = eδ.target := by
    rw [← hmap]; rfl
  have heEK : eE ∈ K.internalEdges := Multiset.mem_of_le hExLe heE
  have plusAdj : eE.source ≠ eE.target → K.SupportReachable eE.source eE.target :=
    fun hne => SimpleGraph.Adj.reachable
      (show K.SupportAdj eE.source eE.target from ⟨hne, eE, heEK, Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩)
  rcases hend with ⟨hsc, htb⟩ | ⟨hsb, htc⟩
  · have hsEc :
        r.1.1.1.retargetVertex
          (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
            (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2) eE.source = c := hrs.trans hsc
    have htEb :
        r.1.1.1.retargetVertex
          (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
            (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2) eE.target = b := hrt.trans htb
    have hne : eE.source ≠ eE.target := fun h =>
      hcb (hsEc.symm.trans ((congrArg _ h).trans htEb))
    exact ⟨eE.target, htE, htEb,
      (hglue hwc hsE (hwcc.trans hsEc.symm)).trans (plusAdj hne)⟩
  · have hsEb :
        r.1.1.1.retargetVertex
          (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
            (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2) eE.source = b := hrs.trans hsb
    have htEc :
        r.1.1.1.retargetVertex
          (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
            (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2) eE.target = c := hrt.trans htc
    have hne : eE.source ≠ eE.target := fun h =>
      hcb (htEc.symm.trans ((congrArg _ h.symm).trans hsEb))
    exact ⟨eE.source, hsE, hsEb,
      (hglue hwc htE (hwcc.trans htEc.symm)).trans (plusAdj hne).symm⟩

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus_reachable_lift_in
statement:
private theorem forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus_reachable_lift_in
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    (g : HopfGen)
    (r : {r : forestQuotientForestSigma g //
      r ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaIndex g})
    (δ : FeynmanSubgraph (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g r.1.1))
    {K : FeynmanGraph}
    (hExLe : forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverExactInternalEdges g r δ ≤ K.internalEdges)
    (hglue : ∀ {x y : VertexId},
      x ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceVertices g r δ →
      y ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceVertices g r δ →
      r.1.1.1.retargetVertex
          (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
            (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2) x =
        r.1.1.1.retargetVertex
          (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
            (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2) y →
      K.SupportReachable x y)
    {a b u : VertexId}
    (hu : u ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceVertices g r δ)
    (hua :
      r.1.1.1.retargetVertex
        (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2) u = a)
    (hab : δ.toFeynmanGraph.SupportReachable a b) :
    ∃ w, w ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceVertices g r δ ∧
      r.1.1.1.retargetVertex
        (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2) w = b ∧
      K.SupportReachable u w
proof:
:= by
  have hrtg : Relation.ReflTransGen δ.toFeynmanGraph.SupportAdj a b :=
    (SimpleGraph.reachable_iff_reflTransGen _ _).1 hab
  clear hab
  induction hrtg with
  | refl => exact ⟨u, hu, hua, FeynmanGraph.SupportReachable.refl _ _⟩
  | tail _hac hcb IH =>
      obtain ⟨wc, hwc, hwcc, hreach⟩ := IH
      obtain ⟨wb, hwb, hwbb, hstepR⟩ :=
        forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus_edgeStep_in
          g r δ hExLe hglue hcb hwc hwcc
      exact ⟨wb, hwb, hwbb, hreach.trans hstepR⟩

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus_sameRetarget_reachable_erase_promoted
statement:
private theorem forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus_sameRetarget_reachable_erase_promoted
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    (g : HopfGen)
    (r : {r : forestQuotientForestSigma g //
      r ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaIndex g})
    (δ : FeynmanSubgraph (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g r.1.1))
    {e : FeynmanEdge}
    (he : e ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverPromotedInternalEdges g r δ)
    {x y : VertexId}
    (hx : x ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceVertices g r δ)
    (hy : y ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceVertices g r δ)
    (hret :
      r.1.1.1.retargetVertex
          (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
            (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2) x =
        r.1.1.1.retargetVertex
          (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
            (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2) y) :
    ((forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus g r δ).toFeynmanGraph.eraseInternalEdge
      e).SupportReachable x y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hFresh : r.1.1.1.IsFreshStarAssignment
      (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
        (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2) :=
    FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf_isFreshStarAssignment
      (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2
  have hsplit :
      (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus g r δ).internalEdges.erase e =
        forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverExactInternalEdges g r δ +
          (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverPromotedInternalEdges g r δ).erase e := by
    rw [forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus_internalEdges]
    exact Multiset.erase_add_right_pos _ he
  rcases forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceVertices_retarget_classify g r δ hx with
    hx0 | ⟨ηx, hηx, hxηx, hxret⟩
  · rcases forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceVertices_retarget_classify g r δ hy with
      hy0 | ⟨ηy, hηy, hyηy, hyret⟩
    · rw [show x = y from hx0.symm.trans (hret.trans hy0)]
      exact FeynmanGraph.SupportReachable.refl _ _
    · exfalso
      have hηyA : ηy ∈ r.1.1.1.elements :=
        ((forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_mem_promotedComponents_iff g r δ).mp hηy).1
      have hxstar : x = FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2 ηy := hx0.symm.trans (hret.trans hyret)
      exact hFresh.fresh hηyA
        (hxstar ▸ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceVertices_subset_ambient g r δ hx)
  · rcases forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceVertices_retarget_classify g r δ hy with
      hy0 | ⟨ηy, hηy, hyηy, hyret⟩
    · exfalso
      have hηxA : ηx ∈ r.1.1.1.elements :=
        ((forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_mem_promotedComponents_iff g r δ).mp hηx).1
      have hystar : y = FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2 ηx :=
        hy0.symm.trans (hret.symm.trans hxret)
      exact hFresh.fresh hηxA
        (hystar ▸ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceVertices_subset_ambient g r δ hy)
    · have hηxA : ηx ∈ r.1.1.1.elements :=
        ((forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_mem_promotedComponents_iff g r δ).mp hηx).1
      have hηyA : ηy ∈ r.1.1.1.elements :=
        ((forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_mem_promotedComponents_iff g r δ).mp hηy).1
      have hstar :
          FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
              (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2 ηx =
            FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
              (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2 ηy :=
        hxret.symm.trans (hret.trans hyret)
      have hηeq : ηx = ηy := hFresh.eq_of_star_eq hηxA hηyA hstar
      subst hηeq
      have hηx1PI : ηx.toFeynmanGraph.IsOnePI :=
        (r.1.1.1.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem hηxA).isOnePI
      by_cases hee : e ∈ ηx.internalEdges
      · have hηxErase : (ηx.toFeynmanGraph.eraseInternalEdge e).IsSupportConnected := by
          by_contra hnot
          exact hηx1PI.no_bridge e hee ⟨hee, hnot⟩
        have hreach : (ηx.toFeynmanGraph.eraseInternalEdge e).SupportReachable x y :=
          hηxErase hxηx hyηy
        have hle :
            (ηx.toFeynmanGraph.eraseInternalEdge e).internalEdges ≤
              ((forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus g r δ).toFeynmanGraph.eraseInternalEdge
                e).internalEdges := by
          rw [FeynmanGraph.eraseInternalEdge_internalEdges,
              FeynmanGraph.eraseInternalEdge_internalEdges]
          show ηx.internalEdges.erase e ≤
            (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus g r δ).internalEdges.erase e
          rw [hsplit]
          refine le_trans (Multiset.erase_le_erase e ?_) (Multiset.le_add_left _ _)
          exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun i _ => Multiset.zero_le _) hηx
        exact supportReachable_mono_of_internalEdges_le hle hreach
      · have hreach : ηx.toFeynmanGraph.SupportReachable x y :=
          (r.1.1.1.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem hηxA).1 hxηx hyηy
        have hle :
            ηx.internalEdges ≤
              ((forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus g r δ).toFeynmanGraph.eraseInternalEdge
                e).internalEdges := by
          rw [FeynmanGraph.eraseInternalEdge_internalEdges]
          show ηx.internalEdges ≤
            (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus g r δ).internalEdges.erase e
          rw [hsplit]
          refine le_trans ?_ (Multiset.le_add_left _ _)
          rw [Multiset.le_iff_count]
          intro a
          by_cases ha : a = e
          · subst ha
            rw [Multiset.count_erase_self, Multiset.count_eq_zero.mpr hee]
            exact Nat.zero_le _
          · rw [Multiset.count_erase_of_ne ha]
            exact Multiset.le_iff_count.mp
              (Finset.single_le_sum (fun i _ => Multiset.zero_le _) hηx) a
        exact supportReachable_mono_of_internalEdges_le hle hreach

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus_erase_promoted_isSupportConnected
statement:
private theorem forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus_erase_promoted_isSupportConnected
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    (g : HopfGen)
    (r : {r : forestQuotientForestSigma g //
      r ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaIndex g})
    (δ : FeynmanSubgraph (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g r.1.1))
    (hδ : δ ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverForestComponents g r)
    {e : FeynmanEdge}
    (he : e ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverPromotedInternalEdges g r δ) :
    ((forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus g r δ).toFeynmanGraph.eraseInternalEdge
      e).IsSupportConnected
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hδconn : δ.toFeynmanGraph.IsSupportConnected :=
    ((forestQuotientForestSigmaActualQuotientSubgraph g r.1).isConnectedDivergent_of_mem
      ((forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverForestComponents_mem g r).mp hδ).1).1
  have hrem :=
    forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus_remainder_eq g r δ
  have hsplit :
      (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus g r δ).internalEdges.erase e =
        forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverExactInternalEdges g r δ +
          (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverPromotedInternalEdges g r δ).erase e := by
    rw [forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus_internalEdges]
    exact Multiset.erase_add_right_pos _ he
  have hExLe :
      forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverExactInternalEdges g r δ ≤
        ((forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus g r δ).toFeynmanGraph.eraseInternalEdge
          e).internalEdges := by
    rw [FeynmanGraph.eraseInternalEdge_internalEdges]
    show forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverExactInternalEdges g r δ ≤
      (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus g r δ).internalEdges.erase e
    rw [hsplit]
    exact Multiset.le_add_right _ _
  intro u v hu hv
  rw [FeynmanGraph.eraseInternalEdge_vertices] at hu hv
  have hu' : u ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceVertices g r δ := hu
  have hv' : v ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceVertices g r δ := hv
  have hretu :
      r.1.1.1.retargetVertex
        (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2) u ∈ δ.vertices := by
    rw [← hrem, admissibleSubgraphQuotientRemainderSubgraph_vertices]
    exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨u, hu', rfl⟩
  have hretv :
      r.1.1.1.retargetVertex
        (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2) v ∈ δ.vertices := by
    rw [← hrem, admissibleSubgraphQuotientRemainderSubgraph_vertices]
    exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨v, hv', rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hwv, huw⟩ :=
    forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus_reachable_lift_in
      g r δ hExLe
      (fun hxa hya hra =>
        forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus_sameRetarget_reachable_erase_promoted
          g r δ he hxa hya hra)
      hu' rfl (hδconn hretu hretv)
  exact huw.trans
    (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus_sameRetarget_reachable_erase_promoted
      g r δ he hw hv' hwv)

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus_disjoint
statement:
private theorem forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus_disjoint
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    (g : HopfGen)
    (r : {r : forestQuotientForestSigma g //
      r ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaIndex g})
    {δ₁ δ₂ : FeynmanSubgraph (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g r.1.1)}
    (hδ₁ : δ₁ ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverForestComponents g r)
    (hδ₂ : δ₂ ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverForestComponents g r)
    (hne : δ₁ ≠ δ₂) :
    Disjoint
      (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus g r δ₁).vertices
      (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus g r δ₂).vertices
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hApd : r.1.1.1.IsPairwiseDisjoint :=
    (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs_isPairwiseDisjoint
      r.1.1.2
  have hδdisj : Disjoint δ₁.vertices δ₂.vertices :=
    ((forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g r.1.1).properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs_isPairwiseDisjoint
      (forestQuotientForestSigmaActualQuotientSubgraph_mem_properDisjoint g r))
      ((forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverForestComponents_mem g r).mp hδ₁).1
      ((forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverForestComponents_mem g r).mp hδ₂).1
      hne
  show Disjoint
    (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceVertices g r δ₁)
    (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceVertices g r δ₂)
  rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
  intro v hv₁ hv₂
  unfold forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceVertices at hv₁ hv₂
  rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hv₁ with h1ns | h1pr
  · rcases Finset.mem_sdiff.mp h1ns with ⟨hv1δ, hv1ns⟩
    have hvNotA : v ∉ r.1.1.1.vertices :=
      forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceVertices_nonstar_mem_not_mem_outer
        g r hv1δ hv1ns
    rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hv₂ with h2ns | h2pr
    · exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp hδdisj hv1δ (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp h2ns).1
    · rcases Finset.mem_biUnion.mp h2pr with ⟨η₂, hη₂A, hvB⟩
      by_cases hs₂ :
        FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2 η₂ ∈ δ₂.vertices
      · simp only [hs₂, if_true] at hvB
        exact hvNotA (AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_vertices.mpr ⟨η₂, hη₂A, hvB⟩)
      · simp only [hs₂, if_false] at hvB
        exact (Finset.notMem_empty v hvB).elim
  · rcases Finset.mem_biUnion.mp h1pr with ⟨η₁, hη₁A, hvB1⟩
    by_cases hs₁ :
      FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
        (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2 η₁ ∈ δ₁.vertices
    · simp only [hs₁, if_true] at hvB1
      rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hv₂ with h2ns | h2pr
      · rcases Finset.mem_sdiff.mp h2ns with ⟨hv2δ, hv2ns⟩
        have hvNotA : v ∉ r.1.1.1.vertices :=
          forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceVertices_nonstar_mem_not_mem_outer
            g r hv2δ hv2ns
        exact hvNotA (AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_vertices.mpr ⟨η₁, hη₁A, hvB1⟩)
      · rcases Finset.mem_biUnion.mp h2pr with ⟨η₂, hη₂A, hvB2⟩
        by_cases hs₂ :
          FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
            (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2 η₂ ∈ δ₂.vertices
        · simp only [hs₂, if_true] at hvB2
          by_cases hηe : η₁ = η₂
          · subst hηe
            exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp hδdisj hs₁ hs₂
          · exact (Finset.disjoint_left.mp (hApd hη₁A hη₂A hηe) hvB1) hvB2
        · simp only [hs₂, if_false] at hvB2
          exact (Finset.notMem_empty v hvB2).elim
    · simp only [hs₁, if_false] at hvB1
      exact (Finset.notMem_empty v hvB1).elim

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceElements_v3_cd
statement:
private theorem forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceElements_v3_cd
    [IsAmbientInvariantDivergence]
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    (g : HopfGen)
    (r : {r : forestQuotientForestSigma g //
      r ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaIndex g})
    (hForestCD :
      ∀ δ : FeynmanSubgraph (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g r.1.1),

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_exactInternalEdges_card_eq_actual
statement:
private theorem forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_exactInternalEdges_card_eq_actual
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]

  unfold forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverLiftedRightInternalEdges

    AdmissibleSubgraph.internalEdges
  rw [show (forestQuotientForestSigmaActualQuotientSubgraph g r.1).elements =
        forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverRightComponents g r ∪
          forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverForestComponents g r from
      (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_right_union_forestComponents g r).symm,
      Finset.sum_union
        (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_right_disjoint_forestComponents g r),
      Multiset.card_add]
  
  
  congr 1
  
  
  rw [show ((forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverForestComponents g r).sum
        (fun δ => forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverExactInternalEdges g r δ)).card =
      (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverForestComponents g r).sum
        (fun δ => (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverExactInternalEdges g r δ).card)
      from by
    induction (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverForestComponents g r) using
      Finset.induction_on with
    | empty => simp
    | insert _ _ hni ih => simp [Finset.sum_insert hni, Multiset.card_add, ih]]
  rw [show ((forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverForestComponents g r).sum
        (fun δ : FeynmanSubgraph (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g r.1.1) =>
          δ.internalEdges)).card =
      (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverForestComponents g r).sum
        (fun δ : FeynmanSubgraph (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g r.1.1) =>
          δ.internalEdges.card)

      Finset.induction_on with
    | empty => simp
    | insert _ _ hni ih => simp [Finset.sum_insert hni, Multiset.card_add, ih]]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro δ _
  have hMap := forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverExactInternalEdges_map g r δ

:= by
  classical

  rw [forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_mem_promotedComponents_iff] at hη₁ hη₂

  have hδ₁D :=

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverLiftedForestPromotedInternalEdges_card_le_outer
statement:
private theorem forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverLiftedForestPromotedInternalEdges_card_le_outer
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    (g : HopfGen)
    (r : {r : forestQuotientForestSigma g //
      r ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaIndex g}) :
    ((forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverForestComponents g r).sum
        (fun δ => forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverPromotedInternalEdges
          g r δ)).card ≤
      r.1.1.1.internalEdges.card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  have hBiUnEq :
      (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverForestComponents g r).sum
          (fun δ => forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverPromotedInternalEdges
            g r δ) =
        ((forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverForestComponents g r).biUnion
          (fun δ => forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverPromotedComponents g r δ)).sum
          (fun η => η.internalEdges) := by
    unfold forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverPromotedInternalEdges
    rw [Finset.sum_biUnion]
    intro δ₁ hδ₁ δ₂ hδ₂ hne
    exact forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverPromotedComponents_disjoint_of_ne
      g r hδ₁ hδ₂ hne
  rw [hBiUnEq]
  
  have hSub :
      (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverForestComponents g r).biUnion
          (fun δ => forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverPromotedComponents g r δ) ⊆
        r.1.1.1.elements := by
    intro η hη
    rcases Finset.mem_biUnion.mp hη with ⟨δ, _, hηδ⟩
    exact
      ((forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_mem_promotedComponents_iff
          g r δ).mp hηδ).1
  
  have hSumLe :
      ((forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverForestComponents g r).biUnion
          (fun δ => forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverPromotedComponents g r δ)).sum
          (fun η => η.internalEdges) ≤
        r.1.1.1.elements.sum (fun η => η.internalEdges) :=
    Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset hSub
  
  exact Multiset.card_le_card hSumLe

        g r hForestCD hForestDisjoint).elements.sum

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestQuotientForestSigmaActualQuotient_internalEdges_card_lt_outerComplement
statement:
private theorem forestQuotientForestSigmaActualQuotient_internalEdges_card_lt_outerComplement
    [IsAmbientInvariantDivergence]
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    (g : HopfGen)
    (r : {r : forestQuotientForestSigma g //
      r ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaIndex g}) :
    (forestQuotientForestSigmaActualQuotientSubgraph g r.1).internalEdges.card <
      r.1.1.1.complementEdges.card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hr2pos : 0 < r.1.2.complementEdges.card := by
    have h := (Finset.mem_sigma.mp r.2).2
    unfold forestCoproductProperForestIndex at h
    exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp h).2
  have hr2PD : r.1.2 ∈
      (forestOuterQuotientGraph g r.1.1).properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs := by
    have h := (Finset.mem_sigma.mp r.2).2
    unfold forestCoproductProperForestIndex at h
    exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp h).1
  have hr2IPD :=
    (forestOuterQuotientGraph g r.1.1).properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs_isPairwiseDisjoint
      hr2PD
  have hr2Iₗₑ := admissibleSubgraph_internalEdges_le_of_pairwise r.1.2 hr2IPD
  have hr2ComplCardEq : r.1.2.complementEdges.card =
      (forestOuterQuotientGraph g r.1.1).internalEdges.card -
        r.1.2.internalEdges.card := by
    show ((forestOuterQuotientGraph g r.1.1).internalEdges - r.1.2.internalEdges).card = _
    exact Multiset.card_sub hr2Iₗₑ
  have hQuotCard : (forestOuterQuotientGraph g r.1.1).internalEdges.card =
      (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g r.1.1).internalEdges.card := by
    rw [forestOuterActualToRepPerm_spec g r.1.1]
    show ((forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g r.1.1).mapPerm _).internalEdges.card = _
    rw [FeynmanGraph.mapPerm_internalEdges, Multiset.card_map]
  have hActGraphCard : (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g r.1.1).internalEdges.card =
      r.1.1.1.complementEdges.card := by
    unfold forestOuterActualQuotientGraph
    rw [FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestContractGraphWithStars_eq,
        AdmissibleSubgraph.contractWithStars_internalEdges, Multiset.card_map]
  have hActICard :
      (forestQuotientForestSigmaActualQuotientSubgraph g r.1).internalEdges.card =
        r.1.2.internalEdges.card := by
    unfold forestQuotientForestSigmaActualQuotientSubgraph
    have hMap := mapPermAdmissibleSubgraphPreimage_internalEdges_map
      (forestOuterActualToRepPerm_spec g r.1.1) r.1.2
    have hc := congrArg Multiset.card hMap
    rw [Multiset.card_map] at hc
    exact hc
  rw [hr2ComplCardEq, hQuotCard, hActGraphCard] at hr2pos
  rw [hActICard]
  omega

private theorem forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceAdmissibleSubgraph_v3_complementEdges_card_pos
    [IsAmbientInvariantDivergence]
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    (g : HopfGen)
    (r : {r : forestQuotientForestSigma g //
      r ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaIndex g})
    (hForestCD :
      ∀ δ : FeynmanSubgraph (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g r.1.1),
        δ ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverForestComponents g r →
          (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus
            g r δ).IsConnectedDivergent)
    (hForestDisjoint :
      ∀ δ₁ : FeynmanSubgraph (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g r.1.1),
        δ₁ ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverForestComponents g r →
      ∀ δ₂ : FeynmanSubgraph (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g r.1.1),
        δ₂ ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverForestComponents g r →
        δ₁ ≠ δ₂ →
          Disjoint
            (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus
              g r δ₁).vertices
            (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus
              g r δ₂).vertices) :
    0 < (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceAdmissibleSubgraph_v3
        g r hForestCD hForestDisjoint).complementEdges.card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hI_sum :=
    forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceAdmissibleSubgraph_v3_internalEdges_card_eq_outer_add_actual
      g r hForestCD hForestDisjoint
  have hD_lt :=
    forestQuotientForestSigmaActualQuotient_internalEdges_card_lt_outerComplement g r
  have hAfinalLeG : r.1.1.1.internalEdges ≤
      (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.internalEdges :=
    admissibleSubgraph_internalEdges_le_of_pairwise r.1.1.1
      ((repG g).toFeynmanGraph.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs_isPairwiseDisjoint
        r.1.1.2)
  have hAfinalComplCard : r.1.1.1.complementEdges.card =
      (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.internalEdges.card - r.1.1.1.internalEdges.card := by
    show ((repG g).toFeynmanGraph.internalEdges - r.1.1.1.internalEdges).card = _
    exact Multiset.card_sub hAfinalLeG
  have hAv3LeG :
      (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceAdmissibleSubgraph_v3
          g r hForestCD hForestDisjoint).internalEdges ≤
        (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.internalEdges :=
    admissibleSubgraph_internalEdges_le_of_pairwise _
      (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceAdmissibleSubgraph_v3_isPairwiseDisjoint
        g r hForestCD hForestDisjoint)
  have hAv3ComplCard :
      (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceAdmissibleSubgraph_v3
        g r hForestCD hForestDisjoint).complementEdges.card =
      (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.internalEdges.card -
        (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceAdmissibleSubgraph_v3
          g r hForestCD hForestDisjoint).internalEdges.card := by
    show ((repG g).toFeynmanGraph.internalEdges - _).card = _
    exact Multiset.card_sub hAv3LeG
  have hAfinalCardLeG : r.1.1.1.internalEdges.card ≤
      (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.internalEdges.card :=
    Multiset.card_le_card hAfinalLeG
  rw [hAfinalComplCard] at hD_lt
  rw [hAv3ComplCard, hI_sum]
  omega

  have hαI : α₂.internalEdges = α₁.internalEdges :=

      congrArg FeynmanGraph.internalEdges hα

    show β₂.toFeynmanGraph.externalLegs = β₁.toFeynmanGraph.externalLegs from
      congrArg FeynmanGraph.externalLegs hβ

        g r hForestCD hγ η₂ hη₂)

:= by

  · subst hEq
    exact Or.inl (Or.inl (FeynmanSubgraph.le_refl' _))
  · have hη₁A : η₁ ∈ r.1.1.1.elements :=

    have hη₂A : η₂ ∈ r.1.1.1.elements :=

            (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.mapPerm π) η₁).NestedOrDisjoint
          (mapPermSubgraph (rfl : (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.mapPerm π =
            (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.mapPerm π) η₂) :=
      mapPermSubgraph_nestedOrDisjoint _ hηNOD

    have hBToFG₂ := forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_BElementMap_toFeynmanGraph_eq
      g r hForestCD hγ η₂ hη₂

        (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.mapPerm π) η₁).toFeynmanGraph =
        η₁.toFeynmanGraph.mapPerm π :=
      mapPermSubgraph_toFeynmanGraph _ η₁
    have hLiftToFG₂ : (mapPermSubgraph (rfl : (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.mapPerm π =
        (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.mapPerm π) η₂).toFeynmanGraph =
        η₂.toFeynmanGraph.mapPerm π :=

    exact feynmanSubgraph_nestedOrDisjoint_of_toFeynmanGraph_eq

    (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs_isPairwiseDisjoint
      r.1.1.2 hη₁A hη₂A hη_ne
  set π := feynmanSubgraphToHopfGenRepPerm γ
    (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverLiftedForestComponents_cd_of_source_cd
      g r hForestCD hγ) with hπdef
  have hLift :
      (mapPermSubgraph (rfl : (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.mapPerm π =
          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.mapPerm π) η₁).Disjoint
        (mapPermSubgraph (rfl : (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.mapPerm π =
          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.mapPerm π) η₂) :=
    mapPermSubgraph_disjoint _ hηDisj
  have hBToFG₁ := forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_BElementMap_toFeynmanGraph_eq
    g r hForestCD hγ η₁ hη₁
  have hBToFG₂ := forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_BElementMap_toFeynmanGraph_eq
    g r hForestCD hγ η₂ hη₂
  have hLiftToFG₁ : (mapPermSubgraph (rfl : (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.mapPerm π =
      (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.mapPerm π) η₁).toFeynmanGraph =

      (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.mapPerm π) η₂).toFeynmanGraph =

    mapPermSubgraph_toFeynmanGraph _ η₂
  exact feynmanSubgraph_disjoint_of_toFeynmanGraph_eq
    (hBToFG₁.trans hLiftToFG₁.symm)
    (hBToFG₂.trans hLiftToFG₂.symm)
    hLift

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_BCandidate_hasNonemptyComponents
statement:

    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    [ForestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverPromotedExternalLegsLiftableModel]
    [ForestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverBElementMapAdmissibleModel]
    (g : HopfGen)
    (r : {r : forestQuotientForestSigma g //
      r ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaIndex g})
    (hForestCD :
      ∀ δ : FeynmanSubgraph (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g r.1.1),
        δ ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverForestComponents g r →
          (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus
            g r δ).IsConnectedDivergent)
    {γ : FeynmanSubgraph (repG g).toFeynmanGraph}
    (hγ : γ ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverLiftedForestComponents g r) :
    (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_BCandidate
      g r hForestCD hγ).HasNonemptyComponents
proof:
:= by
  intro ζ hζ
  rw [show (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_BCandidate
        g r hForestCD hγ).elements =
        (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverPromotedComponents g r
          (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_liftedForestSource g r hγ)).attach.image
        (fun η => forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_BElementMap
          g r hForestCD hγ η.1 η.2) from rfl] at hζ
  rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hζ with ⟨⟨η, hη⟩, _, rfl⟩
  have hηA : η ∈ r.1.1.1.elements :=
    ((forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_mem_promotedComponents_iff
      g r _).mp hη).1
  have hηNE : η.IsNonempty :=
    (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs_hasNonemptyComponents
      r.1.1.2 η hηA
  set π := feynmanSubgraphToHopfGenRepPerm γ
    (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverLiftedForestComponents_cd_of_source_cd
      g r hForestCD hγ) with hπdef
  have hLift : (mapPermSubgraph (rfl : (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.mapPerm π =
      (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.mapPerm π) η).IsNonempty :=
    mapPermSubgraph_isNonempty _ hηNE
  have hBToFG := forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_BElementMap_toFeynmanGraph_eq
    g r hForestCD hγ η hη
  have hLiftToFG : (mapPermSubgraph (rfl : (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.mapPerm π =
      (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.mapPerm π) η).toFeynmanGraph =
      η.toFeynmanGraph.mapPerm π :=
    mapPermSubgraph_toFeynmanGraph _ η
  exact feynmanSubgraph_isNonempty_of_toFeynmanGraph_eq
    (hBToFG.trans hLiftToFG.symm) hLift

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_BCandidate_hasPositiveInternalEdgesComponents
statement:
private theorem forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_BCandidate_hasPositiveInternalEdgesComponents
    [IsAmbientInvariantDivergence]
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    [ForestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverPromotedExternalLegsLiftableModel]
    [ForestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverBElementMapAdmissibleModel]
    (g : HopfGen)
    (r : {r : forestQuotientForestSigma g //
      r ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaIndex g})
    (hForestCD :
      ∀ δ : FeynmanSubgraph (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g r.1.1),
        δ ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverForestComponents g r →
          (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus
            g r δ).IsConnectedDivergent)
    {γ : FeynmanSubgraph (repG g).toFeynmanGraph}
    (hγ : γ ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverLiftedForestComponents g r) :
    (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_BCandidate
      g r hForestCD hγ).HasPositiveInternalEdgesComponents
proof:
:= by
  intro ζ hζ
  rw [show (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_BCandidate
        g r hForestCD hγ).elements =
        (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverPromotedComponents g r
          (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_liftedForestSource g r hγ)).attach.image
        (fun η => forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_BElementMap
          g r hForestCD hγ η.1 η.2) from rfl] at hζ
  rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hζ with ⟨⟨η, hη⟩, _, rfl⟩
  have hηA : η ∈ r.1.1.1.elements :=
    ((forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_mem_promotedComponents_iff
      g r _).mp hη).1
  have hηEdges : 0 < η.internalEdges.card :=
    (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs_hasPositiveInternalEdgesComponents
      r.1.1.2 η hηA
  set π := feynmanSubgraphToHopfGenRepPerm γ
    (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverLiftedForestComponents_cd_of_source_cd
      g r hForestCD hγ) with hπdef
  have hBToFG := forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_BElementMap_toFeynmanGraph_eq
    g r hForestCD hγ η hη
  have hCardEq : (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_BElementMap
      g r hForestCD hγ η hη).internalEdges.card =
      (η.toFeynmanGraph.mapPerm π).internalEdges.card := by
    exact congrArg (·.card) (congrArg FeynmanGraph.internalEdges hBToFG)
  rw [hCardEq]
  show 0 < (η.toFeynmanGraph.mapPerm π).internalEdges.card
  simpa using hηEdges

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_BCandidate_isNonempty
statement:
private theorem forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_BCandidate_isNonempty
    [IsAmbientInvariantDivergence]
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    [ForestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverPromotedExternalLegsLiftableModel]
    [ForestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverBElementMapAdmissibleModel]
    (g : HopfGen)
    (r : {r : forestQuotientForestSigma g //
      r ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaIndex g})
    (hForestCD :
      ∀ δ : FeynmanSubgraph (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g r.1.1),
        δ ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverForestComponents g r →
          (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus
            g r δ).IsConnectedDivergent)
    {γ : FeynmanSubgraph (repG g).toFeynmanGraph}
    (hγ : γ ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverLiftedForestComponents g r) :
    (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_BCandidate
      g r hForestCD hγ).IsNonempty
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set δ := forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_liftedForestSource g r hγ with hδdef
  have hδForest : δ ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverForestComponents g r :=
    forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_liftedForestSource_mem g r hγ
  have hNotDisj : ¬ Disjoint δ.vertices
      (r.1.1.1.starVertices
        (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2)) :=
    ((forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverForestComponents_mem
      g r).mp hδForest).2
  rcases Finset.not_disjoint_iff.mp hNotDisj with ⟨v, hvδ, hvStar⟩
  rw [AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_starVertices] at hvStar
  rcases hvStar with ⟨η, hηA, hStarEq⟩
  have hη : η ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverPromotedComponents g r δ := by
    rw [forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_mem_promotedComponents_iff]
    refine ⟨hηA, ?_⟩
    rw [hStarEq]
    exact hvδ
  show (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_BCandidate
      g r hForestCD hγ).elements.Nonempty
  rw [forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_BCandidate_elements]
  exact ⟨_, Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨⟨η, hη⟩, Finset.mem_attach _ _, rfl⟩⟩

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_BCandidate_internalEdges_card_pos
statement:
private theorem forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_BCandidate_internalEdges_card_pos
    [IsAmbientInvariantDivergence]
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    [ForestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverPromotedExternalLegsLiftableModel]
    [ForestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverBElementMapAdmissibleModel]
    (g : HopfGen)
    (r : {r : forestQuotientForestSigma g //
      r ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaIndex g})
    (hForestCD :
      ∀ δ : FeynmanSubgraph (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g r.1.1),
        δ ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverForestComponents g r →
          (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus
            g r δ).IsConnectedDivergent)
    {γ : FeynmanSubgraph (repG g).toFeynmanGraph}
    (hγ : γ ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverLiftedForestComponents g r) :
    0 < (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_BCandidate
      g r hForestCD hγ).internalEdges.card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨ζ, hζ⟩ :=
    forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_BCandidate_isNonempty
      g r hForestCD hγ
  have hζEdges : 0 < ζ.internalEdges.card :=
    forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_BCandidate_hasPositiveInternalEdgesComponents
      g r hForestCD hγ ζ hζ
  have hLe : ζ.internalEdges ≤
      (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_BCandidate g r hForestCD hγ).internalEdges := by
    show ζ.internalEdges ≤
      ∑ γ' ∈ (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_BCandidate
        g r hForestCD hγ).elements, γ'.internalEdges
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun γ' => γ'.internalEdges)
      (fun _ _ => Multiset.zero_le _) hζ
  exact lt_of_lt_of_le hζEdges (Multiset.card_le_card hLe)

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.feynmanGraph_mapPerm_injective
statement:
private theorem feynmanGraph_mapPerm_injective
    {G₁ G₂ : FeynmanGraph} {π : Equiv.Perm VertexId}
    (h : G₁.mapPerm π = G₂.mapPerm π) :
    G₁ = G₂
proof:
:= by
  have hInv : (G₁.mapPerm π).mapPerm π⁻¹ = (G₂.mapPerm π).mapPerm π⁻¹ :=
    congrArg (fun G => G.mapPerm π⁻¹) h
  rw [← FeynmanGraph.mapPerm_mul, ← FeynmanGraph.mapPerm_mul,
      inv_mul_cancel, FeynmanGraph.mapPerm_one,
      FeynmanGraph.mapPerm_one] at hInv
  exact hInv

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_BElementMap_injective
statement:
private theorem forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_BElementMap_injective
    [IsAmbientInvariantDivergence]
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    [ForestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverPromotedExternalLegsLiftableModel]
    (g : HopfGen)
    (r : {r : forestQuotientForestSigma g //
      r ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaIndex g})
    (hForestCD :
      ∀ δ : FeynmanSubgraph (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g r.1.1),
        δ ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverForestComponents g r →
          (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus
            g r δ).IsConnectedDivergent)
    {γ : FeynmanSubgraph (repG g).toFeynmanGraph}
    (hγ : γ ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverLiftedForestComponents g r)
    {η₁ η₂ : FeynmanSubgraph (repG g).toFeynmanGraph}
    (hη₁ : η₁ ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverPromotedComponents g r
      (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_liftedForestSource g r hγ))
    (hη₂ : η₂ ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverPromotedComponents g r
      (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_liftedForestSource g r hγ))
    (h : forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_BElementMap
        g r hForestCD hγ η₁ hη₁ =
      forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_BElementMap
        g r hForestCD hγ η₂ hη₂) :
    η₁ = η₂
proof:
:= by
  have hToFG : η₁.toFeynmanGraph = η₂.toFeynmanGraph := by
    have h1 := congrArg FeynmanSubgraph.toFeynmanGraph h
    rw [forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_BElementMap_toFeynmanGraph_eq,
        forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_BElementMap_toFeynmanGraph_eq] at h1
    exact feynmanGraph_mapPerm_injective h1
  apply FeynmanSubgraph.ext_iff.mpr
  exact ⟨congrArg FeynmanGraph.vertices hToFG,
    congrArg FeynmanGraph.internalEdges hToFG,
    congrArg FeynmanGraph.externalLegs hToFG⟩

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_BCandidate_internalEdges_card_eq
statement:
private theorem forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_BCandidate_internalEdges_card_eq
    [IsAmbientInvariantDivergence]
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    [ForestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverPromotedExternalLegsLiftableModel]
    [ForestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverBElementMapAdmissibleModel]
    (g : HopfGen)
    (r : {r : forestQuotientForestSigma g //
      r ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaIndex g})
    (hForestCD :
      ∀ δ : FeynmanSubgraph (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g r.1.1),
        δ ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverForestComponents g r →
          (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus
            g r δ).IsConnectedDivergent)
    {γ : FeynmanSubgraph (repG g).toFeynmanGraph}
    (hγ : γ ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverLiftedForestComponents g r) :
    (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_BCandidate
        g r hForestCD hγ).internalEdges.card =
      (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverPromotedInternalEdges g r
        (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_liftedForestSource g r hγ)).card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set δ := forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_liftedForestSource g r hγ
  show (∑ ζ ∈ (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_BCandidate
      g r hForestCD hγ).elements, ζ.internalEdges).card = _
  rw [show ∀ (s : Finset (FeynmanSubgraph _)),
        (∑ ζ ∈ s, ζ.internalEdges).card = ∑ ζ ∈ s, ζ.internalEdges.card from by
      intro s
      induction s using Finset.induction_on with
      | empty => simp
      | insert _ _ hni ih => simp [Finset.sum_insert hni, Multiset.card_add, ih]]
  rw [forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_BCandidate_elements]
  rw [Finset.sum_image (fun a _ b _ hEq =>
    Subtype.ext (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_BElementMap_injective
      g r hForestCD hγ a.2 b.2 hEq))]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl
    (fun a _ => show (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_BElementMap
        g r hForestCD hγ a.1 a.2).internalEdges.card = a.1.internalEdges.card by
      have h := forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_BElementMap_toFeynmanGraph_eq
        g r hForestCD hγ a.1 a.2
      have hIE : (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_BElementMap
            g r hForestCD hγ a.1 a.2).internalEdges =
          a.1.internalEdges.map (FeynmanEdge.map
            (feynmanSubgraphToHopfGenRepPerm γ
              (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverLiftedForestComponents_cd_of_source_cd
                g r hForestCD hγ))) :=
        congrArg FeynmanGraph.internalEdges h
      rw [hIE, Multiset.card_map])]
  rw [Finset.sum_attach
    (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverPromotedComponents g r δ)
    (fun η => η.internalEdges.card)]
  unfold forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverPromotedInternalEdges
  induction (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverPromotedComponents g r δ) using
    Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | insert _ _ hni ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_insert hni, Finset.sum_insert hni, Multiset.card_add, ih]

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_liftedForestSource_internalEdges_card_pos
statement:
private theorem forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_liftedForestSource_internalEdges_card_pos
    [IsAmbientInvariantDivergence]
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    [ForestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverPromotedExternalLegsLiftableModel]
    (g : HopfGen)
    (r : {r : forestQuotientForestSigma g //
      r ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaIndex g})
    {γ : FeynmanSubgraph (repG g).toFeynmanGraph}
    (hγ : γ ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverLiftedForestComponents g r) :
    0 < (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_liftedForestSource g r hγ).internalEdges.card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hδForest := forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_liftedForestSource_mem g r hγ
  have hδAct : forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_liftedForestSource g r hγ ∈
      (forestQuotientForestSigmaActualQuotientSubgraph g r.1).elements :=
    ((forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverForestComponents_mem
      g r).mp hδForest).1
  unfold forestQuotientForestSigmaActualQuotientSubgraph at hδAct
  unfold mapPermAdmissibleSubgraphPreimage at hδAct
  rw [mapPermAdmissibleSubgraph_elements] at hδAct
  rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hδAct with ⟨η', hη', hEq⟩
  
  have hr2 : r.1.2 ∈
      forestCoproductProperForestIndex (forestOuterQuotientHopfGen g r.1.1) := by
    have hMem := r.2
    unfold forestQuotientForestSigmaIndex at hMem
    exact (Finset.mem_sigma.mp hMem).2
  have hr2Proper : r.1.2 ∈
      (repG (forestOuterQuotientHopfGen g r.1.1)).toFeynmanGraph.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs :=
    ((mem_forestCoproductProperForestIndex _ _).mp hr2).1
  have hη'pos : 0 < η'.internalEdges.card :=
    (repG (forestOuterQuotientHopfGen g r.1.1)).toFeynmanGraph.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs_hasPositiveInternalEdgesComponents
      hr2Proper η' hη'
  rw [← hEq, mapPermSubgraph_internalEdges_card]
  exact hη'pos

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_BCandidate_complementEdges_card_pos
statement:
private theorem forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_BCandidate_complementEdges_card_pos
    [IsAmbientInvariantDivergence]
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    [ForestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverPromotedExternalLegsLiftableModel]
    [ForestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverBElementMapAdmissibleModel]
    (g : HopfGen)
    (r : {r : forestQuotientForestSigma g //
      r ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaIndex g})
    (hForestCD :
      ∀ δ : FeynmanSubgraph (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g r.1.1),
        δ ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverForestComponents g r →
          (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus
            g r δ).IsConnectedDivergent)
    {γ : FeynmanSubgraph (repG g).toFeynmanGraph}
    (hγ : γ ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverLiftedForestComponents g r) :
    0 < (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_BCandidate
      g r hForestCD hγ).complementEdges.card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set δ := forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_liftedForestSource g r hγ with hδdef
  set π := feynmanSubgraphToHopfGenRepPerm γ
    (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverLiftedForestComponents_cd_of_source_cd
      g r hForestCD hγ) with hπdef
  
  have hAmbientCard :
      (repG (γ.toHopfGen
        (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverLiftedForestComponents_cd_of_source_cd
          g r hForestCD hγ))).toFeynmanGraph.internalEdges.card =
      γ.toFeynmanGraph.internalEdges.card := by
    rw [feynmanSubgraphToHopfGenRepPerm_spec γ
      (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverLiftedForestComponents_cd_of_source_cd
        g r hForestCD hγ)]
    show (γ.toFeynmanGraph.mapPerm π).internalEdges.card = _
    rw [FeynmanGraph.mapPerm_internalEdges, Multiset.card_map]
  
  have hPlusEq :
      forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus g r δ = γ :=
    forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_liftedForestSource_plus_eq g r hγ
  have hγCardAdd : γ.toFeynmanGraph.internalEdges.card =
      (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverExactInternalEdges g r δ).card +
      (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverPromotedInternalEdges g r δ).card := by
    rw [show γ.toFeynmanGraph.internalEdges =
      forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverExactInternalEdges g r δ +
      forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverPromotedInternalEdges g r δ from by
      rw [← hPlusEq]; rfl]
    exact Multiset.card_add _ _
  
  have hLe : (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_BCandidate
        g r hForestCD hγ).internalEdges ≤
      (repG (γ.toHopfGen
        (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverLiftedForestComponents_cd_of_source_cd
          g r hForestCD hγ))).toFeynmanGraph.internalEdges :=
    admissibleSubgraph_internalEdges_le_of_pairwise _
      (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_BCandidate_isPairwiseDisjoint
        g r hForestCD hγ)
  
  have hCompCard : (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_BCandidate
        g r hForestCD hγ).complementEdges.card =
      (repG (γ.toHopfGen
        (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverLiftedForestComponents_cd_of_source_cd
          g r hForestCD hγ))).toFeynmanGraph.internalEdges.card -
      (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCover_BCandidate
        g r hForestCD hγ).internalEdges.card := by
    show ((repG _).toFeynmanGraph.internalEdges - _).card = _

        forestComponentChoiceIsForest q.1.1 q.2 γ ↔
          γ ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverLiftedForestComponents g r) :

      forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverForestComponents g r
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨⟨A, D⟩, hr⟩ := r
  cases hOuter
  apply Finset.ext
  intro δ
  constructor
  · 
    intro hδ
    rcases forestComponentForestChoiceRemnantComponents_mem_exists g q hq hδ
      with ⟨γ, B, hChoice, hδEq⟩
    have hIsForest : forestComponentChoiceIsForest q.1.1 q.2 γ.1 :=
      forestComponentChoiceIsForest_of_eq γ.2 hChoice
    have hγLF :
        γ.1 ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverLiftedForestComponents
          g ⟨⟨_, D⟩, hr⟩ :=
      (hForestSet γ.1).mp hIsForest
    rcases forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverLiftedForestComponents_mem_exists
      g ⟨⟨_, D⟩, hr⟩ hγLF with ⟨δ', hδ', hPlusEq⟩
    rw [hδEq, ← hPlusEq]
    exact (forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus_remainder_eq
      g ⟨⟨_, D⟩, hr⟩ δ').symm ▸ hδ'
  · 
    intro hδ
    set γ := forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus
      g ⟨⟨_, D⟩, hr⟩ δ with hγDef
    have hγLF :
        γ ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverLiftedForestComponents
          g ⟨⟨_, D⟩, hr⟩ := by
      unfold forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverLiftedForestComponents
      exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨⟨δ, hδ⟩, Finset.mem_attach _ _, rfl⟩
    have hIsForest := (hForestSet γ).mpr hγLF
    rcases forestComponentChoiceIsForest_exists hIsForest with ⟨hγMem, B, hChoice⟩
    have hRemEq :
        admissibleSubgraphQuotientRemainderSubgraph
          (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1
          (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
            (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
            (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1
            (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).2)
          γ = δ := by
      rw [hγDef]
      exact forestQuotientForestSigmaForestCoverSourceSubgraphExactPlus_remainder_eq
        g ⟨⟨_, D⟩, hr⟩ δ
    rw [← hRemEq]
    exact forestComponentForestChoiceRemnantComponents_mem_of_forest g q hq
      ⟨γ, hγMem⟩ hChoice

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.admissibleSubgraphRetargetSubgraph_inj_on_elements
statement:
private theorem admissibleSubgraphRetargetSubgraph_inj_on_elements
    {G : FeynmanGraph}
    {A : AdmissibleSubgraph G}
    (hA : A ∈ G.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs)
    {γ₁ γ₂ : FeynmanSubgraph G}
    (hγ₁ : γ₁ ∈ A.elements)
    (hγ₂ : γ₂ ∈ A.elements)
    (hEdges₁ : γ₁.internalEdges ≤ A.complementEdges)
    (hEdges₂ : γ₂.internalEdges ≤ A.complementEdges)
    (hRetarget :
      admissibleSubgraphRetargetSubgraph A
        (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf G A hA) γ₁ hEdges₁ =
      admissibleSubgraphRetargetSubgraph A
        (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf G A hA) γ₂ hEdges₂) :
    γ₁ = γ₂
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hDisj : A.IsPairwiseDisjoint :=
    G.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs_isPairwiseDisjoint hA
  have hNE : A.HasNonemptyComponents :=
    G.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs_hasNonemptyComponents hA
  set starOf := FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf G A hA with hstarOfDef
  have hVerts : γ₁.vertices.image (A.retargetVertex starOf) =
      γ₂.vertices.image (A.retargetVertex starOf) := by
    have := congrArg FeynmanSubgraph.vertices hRetarget
    simpa using this
  
  have hγ₁card : 0 < γ₁.vertices.card := by
    have hne := hNE γ₁ hγ₁
    unfold FeynmanSubgraph.IsNonempty FeynmanSubgraph.vertexCount at hne
    exact hne
  obtain ⟨v₁, hv₁⟩ := Finset.card_pos.mp hγ₁card
  
  have hRetV₁ : A.retargetVertex starOf v₁ = starOf γ₁ :=
    AdmissibleSubgraph.retargetVertex_of_mem_component hDisj starOf hγ₁ hv₁
  
  have hStarMem : starOf γ₁ ∈ γ₂.vertices.image (A.retargetVertex starOf) := by
    rw [← hVerts, ← hRetV₁]
    exact Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hv₁
  
  obtain ⟨v₂, hv₂, hRetV₂⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hStarMem
  
  have hRetV₂' : A.retargetVertex starOf v₂ = starOf γ₂ :=
    AdmissibleSubgraph.retargetVertex_of_mem_component hDisj starOf hγ₂ hv₂
  
  have hStarEq : starOf γ₁ = starOf γ₂ := hRetV₂.symm.trans hRetV₂'
  exact admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf_injOn_elements A hA hγ₁ hγ₂ hStarEq

statement:
private theorem admissibleSubgraphRetargetSubgraph_inj_of_not_mem

    (A : AdmissibleSubgraph G) (starOf : FeynmanSubgraph G → VertexId)
    {γ₁ γ₂ : FeynmanSubgraph G}
    (hE₁ : γ₁.internalEdges ≤ A.complementEdges)
    (hE₂ : γ₂.internalEdges ≤ A.complementEdges)
    (hV₁ : ∀ v ∈ γ₁.vertices, v ∉ A.vertices)
    (hV₂ : ∀ v ∈ γ₂.vertices, v ∉ A.vertices)
    (h : admissibleSubgraphRetargetSubgraph A starOf γ₁ hE₁ =
      admissibleSubgraphRetargetSubgraph A starOf γ₂ hE₂) :

proof:
:= by
  have h1 : γ₁.toFeynmanGraph = γ₂.toFeynmanGraph := by
    have hc := congrArg FeynmanSubgraph.toFeynmanGraph h
    rwa [admissibleSubgraphRetargetSubgraph_toFeynmanGraph_eq_of_not_mem A starOf γ₁ hE₁ hV₁,
      admissibleSubgraphRetargetSubgraph_toFeynmanGraph_eq_of_not_mem A starOf γ₂ hE₂ hV₂] at hc
  exact FeynmanSubgraph.ext_iff.mpr
