     congrArg FeynmanGraph.internalEdges h1,
     congrArg FeynmanGraph.externalLegs h1⟩

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestOuterActualRetargetOfCert_elements_eq_of_eqRec
statement:
private theorem forestOuterActualRetargetOfCert_elements_eq_of_eqRec
    [IsAmbientInvariantDivergence]
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    (g : HopfGen) {A₁ A₂ : forestOuterProperIndex g} (hA : A₁ = A₂)
    {S₁ S₂ : AdmissibleSubgraph (repG g).toFeynmanGraph}
    (C₁ : forestOuterActualRetargetCertificate g A₁ S₁)
    (C₂ : forestOuterActualRetargetCertificate g A₂ S₂)
    (hV₁ : ∀ γ ∈ S₁.elements, ∀ v ∈ γ.vertices, v ∉ A₁.1.vertices)
    (hV₂ : ∀ γ ∈ S₂.elements, ∀ v ∈ γ.vertices, v ∉ A₂.1.vertices)
    (h : hA ▸ forestOuterActualRetargetAdmissibleSubgraphOfCert g A₁ S₁ C₁ =
      forestOuterActualRetargetAdmissibleSubgraphOfCert g A₂ S₂ C₂) :
    S₁.elements = S₂.elements
proof:
:= by
  cases hA
  change forestOuterActualRetargetAdmissibleSubgraphOfCert g A₁ S₁ C₁ =
    forestOuterActualRetargetAdmissibleSubgraphOfCert g A₁ S₂ C₂ at h
  
  have he :
      S₁.elements.attach.image (fun γ =>
        admissibleSubgraphRetargetSubgraph A₁.1
          (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
            (repG g).toFeynmanGraph A₁.1 A₁.2) γ.1 (C₁.edge_le γ.1 γ.2)) =
      S₂.elements.attach.image (fun γ =>
        admissibleSubgraphRetargetSubgraph A₁.1
          (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
            (repG g).toFeynmanGraph A₁.1 A₁.2) γ.1 (C₂.edge_le γ.1 γ.2)) :=
    congrArg AdmissibleSubgraph.elements h
  apply Finset.ext
  intro x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hxim :
        admissibleSubgraphRetargetSubgraph A₁.1
          (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
            (repG g).toFeynmanGraph A₁.1 A₁.2) x (C₁.edge_le x hx) ∈
        S₁.elements.attach.image (fun γ =>
          admissibleSubgraphRetargetSubgraph A₁.1
            (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
              (repG g).toFeynmanGraph A₁.1 A₁.2) γ.1 (C₁.edge_le γ.1 γ.2)) :=
      Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, Finset.mem_attach _ _, rfl⟩
    rw [he] at hxim
    obtain ⟨⟨y, hy⟩, _, hxy⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hxim
    have hyx : y = x :=
      admissibleSubgraphRetargetSubgraph_inj_of_not_mem A₁.1 _
        (C₂.edge_le y hy) (C₁.edge_le x hx) (hV₂ y hy) (hV₁ x hx) hxy
    rwa [hyx] at hy
  · intro hx
    have hxim :
        admissibleSubgraphRetargetSubgraph A₁.1
          (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
            (repG g).toFeynmanGraph A₁.1 A₁.2) x (C₂.edge_le x hx) ∈
        S₂.elements.attach.image (fun γ =>
          admissibleSubgraphRetargetSubgraph A₁.1
            (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
              (repG g).toFeynmanGraph A₁.1 A₁.2) γ.1 (C₂.edge_le γ.1 γ.2)) :=
      Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, Finset.mem_attach _ _, rfl⟩
    rw [← he] at hxim
    obtain ⟨⟨y, hy⟩, _, hxy⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hxim
    have hyx : y = x :=
      admissibleSubgraphRetargetSubgraph_inj_of_not_mem A₁.1 _
        (C₁.edge_le y hy) (C₂.edge_le x hx) (hV₁ y hy) (hV₂ x hx) hxy
    rwa [hyx] at hy

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentMixedBoundary_left_union_right_elements_recovery
statement:
private theorem forestComponentMixedBoundary_left_union_right_elements_recovery
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    {g : HopfGen}
    (q : forestComponentChoiceSigma g)
    (hq : q ∈ forestComponentMixedBoundaryChoiceSigmaIndex g) :
    (forestComponentChoiceLeftSubgraph q.1.1 q.2).elements ∪
        (forestComponentChoiceRightSubgraph q.1.1 q.2).elements =
      q.1.1.elements
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hp : q.2 ∈ forestComponentMixedBoundaryChoiceCoreIndex q.1.1 :=
    (Finset.mem_sigma.mp hq).2
  have hNoForest : ¬ forestComponentChoiceHasForest q.1.1 q.2 := by
    unfold forestComponentMixedBoundaryChoiceCoreIndex at hp
    exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).2
  ext γ
  constructor
  · intro hγ
    rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hγ with hγL | hγR
    · exact forestComponentChoiceLeftSubgraph_elements_subset q.1.1 q.2 hγL
    · exact forestComponentChoiceRightSubgraph_elements_subset q.1.1 q.2 hγR
  · intro hγA
    rcases forestCoproductChoice_eq_left_or_right_or_forest
        (γ.toHopfGen (q.1.1.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem hγA))
        (q.2 ⟨γ, hγA⟩ (Finset.mem_attach q.1.1.elements ⟨γ, hγA⟩)) with
      hLeft | hRightOrForest
    · apply Finset.mem_union_left
      rw [forestComponentChoiceLeftSubgraph_elements]
      exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hγA, by
        unfold forestComponentChoiceIsLeft
        rw [dif_pos hγA]; exact hLeft⟩
    · rcases hRightOrForest with hRight | hForest
      · apply Finset.mem_union_right
        rw [forestComponentChoiceRightSubgraph_elements]
        exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hγA, by
          unfold forestComponentChoiceIsRight
          rw [dif_pos hγA]; exact hRight⟩
      · rcases hForest with ⟨B, hB⟩
        exact False.elim (hNoForest ⟨⟨γ, hγA⟩, B, hB⟩)

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentMixedBoundaryToQuotientForestSigma_q1_recovery
statement:
private theorem forestComponentMixedBoundaryToQuotientForestSigma_q1_recovery
    [IsAmbientInvariantDivergence]
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    {g : HopfGen}
    {q₁ q₂ : forestComponentChoiceSigma g}
    (hq₁ : q₁ ∈ forestComponentMixedBoundaryChoiceSigmaIndex g)

      forestComponentMixedBoundaryToQuotientForestSigma g q₂ hq₂) :
    q₁.1 = q₂.1
proof:
:= by
  
  have hLeft := forestComponentMixedBoundaryToQuotientForestSigma_leftSubgraph_eq_of_eq
    hq₁ hq₂ hEq
  
  have hPD₁ : q₁.1.1.IsPairwiseDisjoint :=
    (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs_isPairwiseDisjoint q₁.1.2
  have hPD₂ : q₂.1.1.IsPairwiseDisjoint :=
    (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs_isPairwiseDisjoint q₂.1.2
  
  have hRight :
      (forestComponentChoiceRightSubgraph q₁.1.1 q₁.2).elements =
      (forestComponentChoiceRightSubgraph q₂.1.1 q₂.2).elements :=
    forestOuterActualRetargetOfCert_elements_eq_of_eqRec g (congrArg Sigma.fst hEq)
      (forestComponentMixedBoundaryRightRetargetCertificateCanonical g q₁ hq₁)
      (forestComponentMixedBoundaryRightRetargetCertificateCanonical g q₂ hq₂)
      (fun γ hγ v hv =>
        forestComponentChoiceRight_vertices_not_mem_leftSubgraph q₁.1.1 q₁.2 hPD₁ hγ hv)
      (fun γ hγ v hv =>
        forestComponentChoiceRight_vertices_not_mem_leftSubgraph q₂.1.1 q₂.2 hPD₂ hγ hv)
      (forestOuterActualToRep_eqRec_inj g (congrArg Sigma.fst hEq)
        (forestComponentMixedBoundaryToQuotientForestSigma_repRight_eqRec_of_eq hq₁ hq₂ hEq))
  
  apply forestOuterProperIndex_eq_of_elements_eq
  rw [← forestComponentMixedBoundary_left_union_right_elements_recovery q₁ hq₁,
      ← forestComponentMixedBoundary_left_union_right_elements_recovery q₂ hq₂,
      hRight]
  rw [show (forestComponentChoiceLeftSubgraph q₁.1.1 q₁.2).elements =
        (forestComponentChoiceLeftSubgraph q₂.1.1 q₂.2).elements from
      congrArg AdmissibleSubgraph.elements hLeft]

  have hA₂ : q₂.1.1.IsPairwiseDisjoint :=

      q₂.1.2
  have hpCore₁ : q₁.2 ∈ forestComponentCoreChoiceIndex q₁.1.1 :=
    (mem_forestComponentForestChoiceCoreIndex_core_hasForest
      (Finset.mem_sigma.mp hq₁).2).1
  have hpCore₂ : q₂.2 ∈ forestComponentCoreChoiceIndex q₂.1.1 :=
    (mem_forestComponentForestChoiceCoreIndex_core_hasForest
      (Finset.mem_sigma.mp hq₂).2).1
  have hNE₁ : q₁.1.1.HasNonemptyComponents :=
    (((repG g).toFeynmanGraph.mem_properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs _).mp
      q₁.1.2).2.1
  have hNE₂ : q₂.1.1.HasNonemptyComponents :=
    (((repG g).toFeynmanGraph.mem_properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs _).mp
      q₂.1.2).2.1
  have hCO₁ :
      (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterSubgraph q₁.1.1 q₁.2 hA₁).HasNonemptyComponents :=
    forestComponentForestChoiceOuterSubgraph_hasNonemptyComponents hpCore₁ q₁.1.2 hA₁

  rcases q₂ with ⟨A₂, p₂⟩

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentChoiceSigmaTerm_eq_quotientForestSigmaTerm_of_factorization
statement:

    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract] (g : HopfGen)
    (q : forestComponentChoiceSigma g)

    (B : AdmissibleSubgraph (forestOuterQuotientGraph g A))

    (hProduct :
      forestComponentChoiceProductTerm q.1.1 q.2 =
        A.1.toHopfH ⊗ₜ[ℚ] B.toHopfH)
    (hRight :
      forestRightHopfH g q.1.1 q.1.2 =
        forestRightHopfH (forestOuterQuotientHopfGen g A) B hB) :

      forestQuotientForestSigmaTerm g ⟨A, B⟩
proof:
:= by

  rw [FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestStrictSummandWithCanonicalStars_of_mem
    (forestOuterQuotientGraph g A)
    (forestCanonicalHCD (forestOuterQuotientHopfGen g A))
    B hB]
  unfold forestRightHopfH
  exact Algebra.TensorProduct.assoc_tmul (R := ℚ) (S := ℚ) (T := ℚ)
    (A := HopfH) (C := HopfH) (D := HopfH) _ _ _

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentMixedBoundaryToQuotientForestSigma_mem
statement:
private theorem forestComponentMixedBoundaryToQuotientForestSigma_mem
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract] (g : HopfGen)
    (q : forestComponentChoiceSigma g)
    (hq : q ∈ forestComponentMixedBoundaryChoiceSigmaIndex g) :
    forestComponentMixedBoundaryToQuotientForestSigma g q hq ∈
      forestQuotientForestSigmaIndex g
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold forestQuotientForestSigmaIndex
  apply Finset.mem_sigma.mpr
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · apply Finset.mem_filter.mpr
    refine ⟨Finset.mem_attach _ _, ?_⟩
    have hAcomp : 0 < q.1.1.complementEdges.card :=
      (Finset.mem_filter.mp (Finset.mem_sigma.mp hq).1).2
    have hDisj :
        q.1.1.IsPairwiseDisjoint :=
      (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
        |>.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs_isPairwiseDisjoint
          q.1.2
    have hLeftLe :
        (forestComponentChoiceLeftSubgraph q.1.1 q.2).internalEdges ≤
          q.1.1.internalEdges := by
      refine admissibleSubgraph_internalEdges_le_of_components_le
        (forestComponentChoiceLeftSubgraph q.1.1 q.2)
        (forestComponentChoiceLeftSubgraph_isPairwiseDisjoint q.1.1 q.2 hDisj)
        ?_
      intro δ hδ
      exact feynmanSubgraph_internalEdges_le_admissible_internalEdges_of_mem
        q.1.1 hDisj
        (forestComponentChoiceLeftSubgraph_elements_subset q.1.1 q.2 hδ)
    exact admissibleSubgraph_complementEdges_card_pos_of_internalEdges_le
      hLeftLe hAcomp
  · change forestComponentMixedBoundaryRepRightQuotientSubgraphCanonical
        g q hq ∈
        ((forestOuterQuotientGraph g
          (forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex g q hq)
        ).properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs).filter
          (fun A => 0 < A.complementEdges.card)
    exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨
      forestComponentMixedBoundaryRepRightQuotientSubgraphCanonical_mem_properDisjoint
        g q hq,
      forestComponentMixedBoundaryRepRightQuotientSubgraphCanonical_complementEdges_card_pos
        g q hq⟩

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentSplitPhi_inj_on_of_split
statement:
private theorem forestComponentSplitPhi_inj_on_of_split
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract] (g : HopfGen)
    (hForest :
      ∀ q₁, ∀ hq₁ : q₁ ∈ forestComponentForestChoiceSigmaIndex g,
        ∀ q₂, ∀ hq₂ : q₂ ∈ forestComponentForestChoiceSigmaIndex g,
          forestComponentForestChoiceToQuotientForestSigma g q₁ hq₁ =
            forestComponentForestChoiceToQuotientForestSigma g q₂ hq₂ →
            q₁ = q₂)
    (hMixed :
      ∀ q₁, ∀ hq₁ : q₁ ∈ forestComponentMixedBoundaryChoiceSigmaIndex g,
        ∀ q₂, ∀ hq₂ : q₂ ∈ forestComponentMixedBoundaryChoiceSigmaIndex g,
          forestComponentMixedBoundaryToQuotientForestSigma g q₁ hq₁ =
            forestComponentMixedBoundaryToQuotientForestSigma g q₂ hq₂ →
            q₁ = q₂)
    (hCross :
      ∀ qF, ∀ hF : qF ∈ forestComponentForestChoiceSigmaIndex g,
        ∀ qM, ∀ hM : qM ∈ forestComponentMixedBoundaryChoiceSigmaIndex g,
          forestComponentForestChoiceToQuotientForestSigma g qF hF ≠
            forestComponentMixedBoundaryToQuotientForestSigma g qM hM) :
    ∀ q₁, q₁ ∈ forestComponentSplitChoiceSigmaIndex g →
      ∀ q₂, q₂ ∈ forestComponentSplitChoiceSigmaIndex g →
        forestComponentSplitPhi g q₁ = forestComponentSplitPhi g q₂ →
          q₁ = q₂
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro q₁ hq₁ q₂ hq₂ hφ
  cases q₁ with
  | inl q₁ =>
      have hq₁Forest : q₁ ∈ forestComponentForestChoiceSigmaIndex g := by
        simpa [forestComponentSplitChoiceSigmaIndex] using hq₁
      rw [forestComponentSplitPhi_inl_of_mem g q₁ hq₁Forest] at hφ
      cases q₂ with
      | inl q₂ =>
          have hq₂Forest : q₂ ∈ forestComponentForestChoiceSigmaIndex g := by
            simpa [forestComponentSplitChoiceSigmaIndex] using hq₂
          rw [forestComponentSplitPhi_inl_of_mem g q₂ hq₂Forest] at hφ
          exact congrArg Sum.inl
            (hForest q₁ hq₁Forest q₂ hq₂Forest hφ)
      | inr q₂ =>
          have hq₂Mixed :
              q₂ ∈ forestComponentMixedBoundaryChoiceSigmaIndex g := by
            simpa [forestComponentSplitChoiceSigmaIndex] using hq₂
          rw [forestComponentSplitPhi_inr_of_mem g q₂ hq₂Mixed] at hφ
          exact False.elim
            ((hCross q₁ hq₁Forest q₂ hq₂Mixed) hφ)
  | inr q₁ =>
      have hq₁Mixed :
          q₁ ∈ forestComponentMixedBoundaryChoiceSigmaIndex g := by
        simpa [forestComponentSplitChoiceSigmaIndex] using hq₁
      rw [forestComponentSplitPhi_inr_of_mem g q₁ hq₁Mixed] at hφ
      cases q₂ with
      | inl q₂ =>
          have hq₂Forest : q₂ ∈ forestComponentForestChoiceSigmaIndex g := by
            simpa [forestComponentSplitChoiceSigmaIndex] using hq₂
          rw [forestComponentSplitPhi_inl_of_mem g q₂ hq₂Forest] at hφ
          exact False.elim
            ((hCross q₂ hq₂Forest q₁ hq₁Mixed) hφ.symm)
      | inr q₂ =>
          have hq₂Mixed :
              q₂ ∈ forestComponentMixedBoundaryChoiceSigmaIndex g := by
            simpa [forestComponentSplitChoiceSigmaIndex] using hq₂
          rw [forestComponentSplitPhi_inr_of_mem g q₂ hq₂Mixed] at hφ
          exact congrArg Sum.inr
            (hMixed q₁ hq₁Mixed q₂ hq₂Mixed hφ)

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentSplitPhi_surj_on_of_split
statement:
private theorem forestComponentSplitPhi_surj_on_of_split
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract] (g : HopfGen)
    (hCover :
      ∀ r, r ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaIndex g →
        (∃ q, ∃ hq : q ∈ forestComponentForestChoiceSigmaIndex g,
          forestComponentForestChoiceToQuotientForestSigma g q hq = r) ∨
        (∃ q, ∃ hq : q ∈ forestComponentMixedBoundaryChoiceSigmaIndex g,
          forestComponentMixedBoundaryToQuotientForestSigma g q hq = r)) :
    ∀ r, r ∈ forestQuotientForestSigmaIndex g →
      ∃ q, ∃ hq : q ∈ forestComponentSplitChoiceSigmaIndex g,
        forestComponentSplitPhi g q = r
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro r hr
  rcases hCover r hr with hForest | hMixed
  · rcases hForest with ⟨q, hq, hφ⟩
    refine ⟨Sum.inl q, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa [forestComponentSplitChoiceSigmaIndex] using hq
    · rw [forestComponentSplitPhi_inl_of_mem g q hq]
      exact hφ
  · rcases hMixed with ⟨q, hq, hφ⟩
    refine ⟨Sum.inr q, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa [forestComponentSplitChoiceSigmaIndex] using hq
    · rw [forestComponentSplitPhi_inr_of_mem g q hq]
      exact hφ

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentSplitPhi_term_eq_of_split
statement:
private theorem forestComponentSplitPhi_term_eq_of_split

    (hForestTerm :
      ∀ q, ∀ hq : q ∈ forestComponentForestChoiceSigmaIndex g,
        forestComponentChoiceSigmaTerm g q =
          forestQuotientForestSigmaTerm g
            (forestComponentForestChoiceToQuotientForestSigma g q hq))

        forestComponentChoiceSigmaTerm g q =
          forestQuotientForestSigmaTerm g
            (forestComponentMixedBoundaryToQuotientForestSigma g q hq)) :

        forestQuotientForestSigmaTerm g (forestComponentSplitPhi g q)

  cases q with

      rw [forestComponentSplitChoiceSigmaTerm,
        forestComponentSplitPhi_inl_of_mem g q hqForest]
      exact hForestTerm q hqForest
  | inr q =>
      have hqMixed : q ∈ forestComponentMixedBoundaryChoiceSigmaIndex g := by

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentForestChoiceRemnantComponentsForChoice_pairwiseDisjoint
statement:
private theorem forestComponentForestChoiceRemnantComponentsForChoice_pairwiseDisjoint
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract] (g : HopfGen)
    (q : forestComponentChoiceSigma g)
    (hq : q ∈ forestComponentForestChoiceSigmaIndex g) :
    Set.PairwiseDisjoint (↑q.1.1.elements.attach)
      (fun γ =>
        forestComponentForestChoiceRemnantComponentsForChoice g q hq γ
          (Finset.mem_attach q.1.1.elements γ))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro γ _hγ η _hη hγη
  change Disjoint
    (forestComponentForestChoiceRemnantComponentsForChoice g q hq γ
      (Finset.mem_attach q.1.1.elements γ))
    (forestComponentForestChoiceRemnantComponentsForChoice g q hq η
      (Finset.mem_attach q.1.1.elements η))
  rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
  intro δ hδγ hδη
  cases hγChoice : q.2 γ (Finset.mem_attach q.1.1.elements γ) with
  | left =>
      simp [forestComponentForestChoiceRemnantComponentsForChoice, hγChoice] at hδγ
  | right =>
      simp [forestComponentForestChoiceRemnantComponentsForChoice, hγChoice] at hδγ
  | forest Bγ =>
      cases hηChoice : q.2 η (Finset.mem_attach q.1.1.elements η) with
      | left =>
          simp [forestComponentForestChoiceRemnantComponentsForChoice, hηChoice] at hδη
      | right =>
          simp [forestComponentForestChoiceRemnantComponentsForChoice, hηChoice] at hδη
      | forest Bη =>
          let remγ :
              FeynmanSubgraph
                (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g
                  (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq)) :=
            admissibleSubgraphQuotientRemainderSubgraph
              (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1
              (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
                (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
                (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1
                (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).2)
              γ.1
          let remη :
              FeynmanSubgraph
                (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g
                  (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq)) :=
            admissibleSubgraphQuotientRemainderSubgraph
              (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1
              (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
                (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
                (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1
                (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).2)
              η.1
          have hδγeq : δ = remγ := by
            have hCarrier :
                forestComponentForestChoiceRemnantComponentsForChoice
                  g q hq γ (Finset.mem_attach q.1.1.elements γ) =
                ({remγ} :
                  Finset (FeynmanSubgraph
                    (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g
                      (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq)))) := by
              simp [forestComponentForestChoiceRemnantComponentsForChoice,
                hγChoice, remγ]
              rfl
            have hmem :
                δ ∈ ({remγ} :
                  Finset (FeynmanSubgraph
                    (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g
                      (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq)))) := by
              rw [← hCarrier]
              exact hδγ
            exact Finset.mem_singleton.mp hmem
          have hδηeq : δ = remη := by
            have hCarrier :
                forestComponentForestChoiceRemnantComponentsForChoice
                  g q hq η (Finset.mem_attach q.1.1.elements η) =
                ({remη} :
                  Finset (FeynmanSubgraph
                    (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g
                      (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq)))) := by
              simp [forestComponentForestChoiceRemnantComponentsForChoice,
                hηChoice, remη]
              rfl
            have hmem :
                δ ∈ ({remη} :
                  Finset (FeynmanSubgraph
                    (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g
                      (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq)))) := by
              rw [← hCarrier]
              exact hδη
            exact Finset.mem_singleton.mp hmem
          have hγVal : γ.1 ≠ η.1 := by
            intro h
            exact hγη (Subtype.ext h)
          have hRemDisj : remγ.Disjoint remη := by
            simpa [remγ, remη] using
              forestComponentForestChoiceRemnantComponents_disjoint_of_source_ne
                g q hq γ η hγChoice hηChoice hγVal
          have hδSelf : δ.Disjoint δ := by
            simpa [← hδγeq, ← hδηeq] using hRemDisj
          have hδGlobal :
              δ ∈ forestComponentForestChoiceRemnantComponents g q hq := by
            rw [forestComponentForestChoiceRemnantComponents_eq_biUnion_forChoice]
            exact Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr
              ⟨γ, Finset.mem_attach q.1.1.elements γ, hδγ⟩
          have hδQ :
              δ ∈ forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientComponents g q hq := by
            unfold forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientComponents
            exact Finset.mem_union_right _ hδGlobal
          have hδNonempty :
              δ.IsNonempty :=
            forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientSubgraphCanonical_hasNonemptyComponents
              g q hq δ hδQ
          unfold FeynmanSubgraph.IsNonempty FeynmanSubgraph.vertexCount at hδNonempty
          rcases Finset.card_pos.mp hδNonempty with ⟨v, hv⟩
          exact (Finset.disjoint_left.mp hδSelf hv) hv

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentForestChoiceRemnant_factor_product_eq_of_componentClass
statement:
private theorem
    forestComponentForestChoiceRemnant_factor_product_eq_of_componentClass
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract] (g : HopfGen)
    (q : forestComponentChoiceSigma g)
    (hq : q ∈ forestComponentForestChoiceSigmaIndex g)
    (γ : {γ : FeynmanSubgraph (repG g).toFeynmanGraph // γ ∈ q.1.1.elements})
    (hClass :
      ∀ B : AdmissibleSubgraph
        (repG (γ.1.toHopfGen
          (q.1.1.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem γ.2))).toFeynmanGraph,
        (hB : q.2 γ (Finset.mem_attach q.1.1.elements γ) =
            forestCoproductChoice.forest B) →
        (admissibleSubgraphQuotientRemainderSubgraph
          (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1
          (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
            (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
            (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1
            (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).2)
          γ.1).toFeynmanGraph.toClass =
        (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestContractGraphWithStars
          (repG (γ.1.toHopfGen
            (q.1.1.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem γ.2))).toFeynmanGraph
          B
          (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
            (repG (γ.1.toHopfGen
              (q.1.1.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem γ.2))).toFeynmanGraph
            B
            (forestComponentChoice_forest_mem_properDisjoint_of_core_mem
              (mem_forestComponentForestChoiceCoreIndex_core_hasForest
                ((Finset.mem_sigma.mp hq).2)).1
              γ hB))).toClass) :
    (∏ δ ∈ forestComponentForestChoiceRemnantComponentsForChoice
        g q hq γ (Finset.mem_attach q.1.1.elements γ),
      (forestComponentForestChoiceActualRemnantQuotientSubgraphCanonical
        g q hq).componentToHopfH δ) =
    forestComponentChoiceRemnantInnerTensorFactor q.1.1 q.2
      (mem_forestComponentForestChoiceCoreIndex_core_hasForest
        ((Finset.mem_sigma.mp hq).2)).1
      γ
      (Finset.mem_attach q.1.1.elements γ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let hpCore :
      q.2 ∈ forestComponentCoreChoiceIndex q.1.1 :=
    (mem_forestComponentForestChoiceCoreIndex_core_hasForest
      ((Finset.mem_sigma.mp hq).2)).1
  cases hChoice : q.2 γ (Finset.mem_attach q.1.1.elements γ) with
  | left =>
      simp [forestComponentForestChoiceRemnantComponentsForChoice,
        forestComponentChoiceRemnantInnerTensorFactor, hChoice]
  | right =>
      simp [forestComponentForestChoiceRemnantComponentsForChoice,
        forestComponentChoiceRemnantInnerTensorFactor, hChoice]
  | forest B =>
      let rem :
          FeynmanSubgraph
            (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g
              (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq)) :=
        admissibleSubgraphQuotientRemainderSubgraph
          (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1
          (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
            (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
            (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1
            (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).2)
          γ.1
      have hBmem :
          B ∈ ((repG (γ.1.toHopfGen
            (q.1.1.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem γ.2))).toFeynmanGraph
          ).properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs :=
        forestComponentChoice_forest_mem_properDisjoint_of_core_mem
          hpCore γ hChoice
      have hremMem :
          rem ∈ (forestComponentForestChoiceActualRemnantQuotientSubgraphCanonical
            g q hq).elements := by
        rw [forestComponentForestChoiceActualRemnantQuotientSubgraphCanonical_elements]
        simpa [rem] using
          forestComponentForestChoiceRemnantComponents_mem_of_forest
            g q hq γ hChoice
      have hComponent :
          (forestComponentForestChoiceActualRemnantQuotientSubgraphCanonical
            g q hq).componentToHopfH rem =
          forestRightHopfH
            (γ.1.toHopfGen (q.1.1.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem γ.2))
            B hBmem := by
        unfold AdmissibleSubgraph.componentToHopfH forestRightHopfH gen
        rw [dif_pos hremMem]
        apply congrArg MvPolynomial.X
        apply Subtype.ext
        simpa [rem, FeynmanSubgraph.toHopfGen_val,
          FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestRightWithCanonicalStars_val] using
          hClass B hChoice
      have hRemnant :
          forestComponentChoiceRemnantInnerTensorFactor q.1.1 q.2 hpCore γ
              (Finset.mem_attach q.1.1.elements γ) =
          forestRightHopfH
            (γ.1.toHopfGen (q.1.1.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem γ.2))
            B hBmem := by
        simp [forestComponentChoiceRemnantInnerTensorFactor, hChoice, hBmem,
          hpCore]
      rw [hRemnant]
      have hCarrier :
          forestComponentForestChoiceRemnantComponentsForChoice
            g q hq γ (Finset.mem_attach q.1.1.elements γ) =
          ({rem} :
            Finset (FeynmanSubgraph
              (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g
                (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq)))) := by
        simp [forestComponentForestChoiceRemnantComponentsForChoice,
          hChoice, rem]
        rfl
      rw [hCarrier]
      rw [Finset.prod_singleton]
      exact hComponent

          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph q.1.1
          (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
            (repG g).toFeynmanGraph q.1.1 q.1.2)).toClass =
        (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestContractGraphWithStars
          (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g
            (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq))
          (forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientSubgraphCanonical g q hq)
          (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
            (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g
              (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq))
            (forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientSubgraphCanonical g q hq)
            (forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientSubgraphCanonical_mem_properDisjoint
              g q hq
              (forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientProperCertificateOfRemnantPositive
                g q hq (C g q hq))))).toClass)
    (hMixedActualRightClass :
      ∀ g q, ∀ hq : q ∈ forestComponentMixedBoundaryChoiceSigmaIndex g,
        (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestContractGraphWithStars
          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph q.1.1
          (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
            (repG g).toFeynmanGraph q.1.1 q.1.2)).toClass =
        (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestContractGraphWithStars
          (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g
            (forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex g q hq))
          (forestComponentMixedBoundaryActualRightQuotientSubgraphCanonical
            g q hq)
          (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
            (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g
              (forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex g q hq))
            (forestComponentMixedBoundaryActualRightQuotientSubgraphCanonical
              g q hq)
            (forestComponentMixedBoundaryActualRightQuotientSubgraphCanonical_mem_properDisjoint
              g q hq))).toClass) :
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.assoc ℚ ℚ ℚ HopfH HopfH HopfH).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
        coproduct_strict_forest.toLinearMap.rTensor HopfH ∘ₗ
        coproduct_strict_forest.toLinearMap
      =
    coproduct_strict_forest.toLinearMap.lTensor HopfH ∘ₗ
      coproduct_strict_forest.toLinearMap
proof:
:=
  coassoc_strict_forest_linear_of_split_phi_canonical_remnant_transport C I
    (fun g q hq =>
      forestRightHopfH_eq_of_contract_toClass_eq
        (forestComponentForestChoice_rightContractClass_of_actual
          g q hq (C g q hq) (hForestActualRightClass g q hq)))
    (fun g q hq =>
      forestRightHopfH_eq_of_contract_toClass_eq
        (forestComponentMixedBoundary_rightContractClass_of_actual
          g q hq (hMixedActualRightClass g q hq)))

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentMixedBoundary_choice_left_or_right
statement:
private theorem forestComponentMixedBoundary_choice_left_or_right
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract] (g : HopfGen)
    (q : forestComponentChoiceSigma g)
    (hq : q ∈ forestComponentMixedBoundaryChoiceSigmaIndex g)
    (γ : FeynmanSubgraph (repG g).toFeynmanGraph)
    (hγ : γ ∈ q.1.1.elements) :
    γ ∈ (forestComponentChoiceLeftSubgraph q.1.1 q.2).elements ∨
      γ ∈ (forestComponentChoiceRightSubgraph q.1.1 q.2).elements
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let γs : {γ : FeynmanSubgraph (repG g).toFeynmanGraph //
      γ ∈ q.1.1.elements} := ⟨γ, hγ⟩
  have hp :
      q.2 ∈ forestComponentMixedBoundaryChoiceCoreIndex q.1.1 :=
    (Finset.mem_sigma.mp hq).2
  have hNoForest : ¬ forestComponentChoiceHasForest q.1.1 q.2 := by
    unfold forestComponentMixedBoundaryChoiceCoreIndex at hp
    exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).2
  rcases forestCoproductChoice_eq_left_or_right_or_forest
      (γ.toHopfGen (q.1.1.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem hγ))
      (q.2 γs (Finset.mem_attach q.1.1.elements γs)) with
    hLeft | hRightOrForest
  · left
    rw [forestComponentChoiceLeftSubgraph_elements]
    refine Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hγ, ?_⟩
    unfold forestComponentChoiceIsLeft
    rw [dif_pos hγ]
    simpa [γs] using hLeft
  · rcases hRightOrForest with hRight | hForest
    · right
      rw [forestComponentChoiceRightSubgraph_elements]
      refine Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hγ, ?_⟩
      unfold forestComponentChoiceIsRight
      rw [dif_pos hγ]
      simpa [γs] using hRight
    · rcases hForest with ⟨B, hB⟩
      exact False.elim (hNoForest ⟨γs, B, by simpa [γs] using hB⟩)

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentMixedBoundary_left_union_right_elements
statement:
private theorem forestComponentMixedBoundary_left_union_right_elements
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract] (g : HopfGen)
    (q : forestComponentChoiceSigma g)
    (hq : q ∈ forestComponentMixedBoundaryChoiceSigmaIndex g) :
    (forestComponentChoiceLeftSubgraph q.1.1 q.2).elements ∪
        (forestComponentChoiceRightSubgraph q.1.1 q.2).elements =
      q.1.1.elements
proof:
:= by
  ext γ
  constructor
  · intro hγ
    rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hγ with hγL | hγR
    · exact forestComponentChoiceLeftSubgraph_elements_subset q.1.1 q.2 hγL
    · exact forestComponentChoiceRightSubgraph_elements_subset q.1.1 q.2 hγR
  · intro hγ
    rcases forestComponentMixedBoundary_choice_left_or_right g q hq γ hγ with
      hγL | hγR
    · exact Finset.mem_union_left _ hγL
    · exact Finset.mem_union_right _ hγR

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentMixedBoundary_left_union_right_vertices
statement:
private theorem forestComponentMixedBoundary_left_union_right_vertices
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract] (g : HopfGen)
    (q : forestComponentChoiceSigma g)
    (hq : q ∈ forestComponentMixedBoundaryChoiceSigmaIndex g) :
    (forestComponentChoiceLeftSubgraph q.1.1 q.2).vertices ∪
        (forestComponentChoiceRightSubgraph q.1.1 q.2).vertices =
      q.1.1.vertices
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  constructor
  · intro hv
    rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hv with hvL | hvR
    · rcases AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_vertices.mp hvL with ⟨γ, hγ, hvγ⟩
      exact AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_vertices.mpr
        ⟨γ, forestComponentChoiceLeftSubgraph_elements_subset q.1.1 q.2 hγ,
          hvγ⟩
    · rcases AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_vertices.mp hvR with ⟨γ, hγ, hvγ⟩
      exact AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_vertices.mpr
        ⟨γ, forestComponentChoiceRightSubgraph_elements_subset q.1.1 q.2 hγ,
          hvγ⟩
  · intro hv
    rcases AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_vertices.mp hv with ⟨γ, hγ, hvγ⟩
    rcases forestComponentMixedBoundary_choice_left_or_right g q hq γ hγ with
      hγL | hγR
    · exact Finset.mem_union_left _
        (AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_vertices.mpr ⟨γ, hγL, hvγ⟩)
    · exact Finset.mem_union_right _
        (AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_vertices.mpr ⟨γ, hγR, hvγ⟩)

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentMixedBoundary_left_union_right_internalEdges
statement:
private theorem forestComponentMixedBoundary_left_union_right_internalEdges
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract] (g : HopfGen)
    (q : forestComponentChoiceSigma g)
    (hq : q ∈ forestComponentMixedBoundaryChoiceSigmaIndex g) :
    q.1.1.internalEdges =
      (forestComponentChoiceLeftSubgraph q.1.1 q.2).internalEdges +
        (forestComponentChoiceRightSubgraph q.1.1 q.2).internalEdges
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let L := forestComponentChoiceLeftSubgraph q.1.1 q.2
  let R := forestComponentChoiceRightSubgraph q.1.1 q.2
  have hUnion : L.elements ∪ R.elements = q.1.1.elements := by
    simpa [L, R] using
      forestComponentMixedBoundary_left_union_right_elements g q hq
  have hDisj : Disjoint L.elements R.elements := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
    intro γ hγL hγR
    exact forestComponentChoiceRightSubgraph_not_mem_left q.1.1 q.2 hγR hγL
  unfold AdmissibleSubgraph.internalEdges
  rw [← hUnion]
  rw [Finset.sum_union hDisj]

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentMixedBoundary_right_internalEdges_le_left_complement
statement:
private theorem forestComponentMixedBoundary_right_internalEdges_le_left_complement
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract] (g : HopfGen)
    (q : forestComponentChoiceSigma g)
    (hq : q ∈ forestComponentMixedBoundaryChoiceSigmaIndex g) :
    (forestComponentChoiceRightSubgraph q.1.1 q.2).internalEdges ≤
      (forestComponentChoiceLeftSubgraph q.1.1 q.2).complementEdges
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let L := forestComponentChoiceLeftSubgraph q.1.1 q.2
  let R := forestComponentChoiceRightSubgraph q.1.1 q.2
  have hDisj : q.1.1.IsPairwiseDisjoint :=
    (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
      |>.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs_isPairwiseDisjoint
        q.1.2
  have hA_le : q.1.1.internalEdges ≤ (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.internalEdges :=
    admissibleSubgraph_internalEdges_le_of_pairwise q.1.1 hDisj
  have hSplit :
      q.1.1.internalEdges = L.internalEdges + R.internalEdges := by
    simpa [L, R] using
      forestComponentMixedBoundary_left_union_right_internalEdges g q hq
  change R.internalEdges ≤ L.complementEdges
  rw [Multiset.le_iff_count]
  intro e
  unfold AdmissibleSubgraph.complementEdges
  rw [Multiset.count_sub]
  have hCountA : q.1.1.internalEdges.count e ≤
      (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.internalEdges.count e :=
    Multiset.count_le_of_le e hA_le
  have hCountSplit :
      q.1.1.internalEdges.count e =
        L.internalEdges.count e + R.internalEdges.count e := by
    simpa [Multiset.count_add] using congrArg (Multiset.count e) hSplit
  omega

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentMixedBoundarySplitStarOf_right
statement:
@[simp] private theorem forestComponentMixedBoundarySplitStarOf_right
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract] (g : HopfGen)
    (q : forestComponentChoiceSigma g)

    {γ : FeynmanSubgraph (repG g).toFeynmanGraph}
    (hγR : γ ∈ (forestComponentChoiceRightSubgraph q.1.1 q.2).elements) :
    forestComponentMixedBoundarySplitStarOf g q hq γ =
      FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
        (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g
          (forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex g q hq))
        (forestComponentMixedBoundaryActualRightQuotientSubgraphCanonical
          g q hq)
        (forestComponentMixedBoundaryActualRightQuotientSubgraphCanonical_mem_properDisjoint
          g q hq)
        (admissibleSubgraphRetargetSubgraph
          (forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex g q hq).1

    forestComponentChoiceRightSubgraph_not_mem_left q.1.1 q.2 hγR

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentMixedBoundary_left_star_mem_outer_quotient_vertices

    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract] (g : HopfGen)

        (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf

statement:
private theorem
    forestComponentMixedBoundaryActualRightQuotientSubgraphCanonical_mem_of_right
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract] (g : HopfGen)
    (q : forestComponentChoiceSigma g)
    (hq : q ∈ forestComponentMixedBoundaryChoiceSigmaIndex g)
    {γ : FeynmanSubgraph (repG g).toFeynmanGraph}
    (hγR : γ ∈ (forestComponentChoiceRightSubgraph q.1.1 q.2).elements) :
    admissibleSubgraphRetargetSubgraph
        (forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex g q hq).1
        (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
          (forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex g q hq).1
          (forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex g q hq).2)
        γ
        (forestComponentMixedBoundaryRightRetarget_edge_le g q hq γ hγR) ∈
      (forestComponentMixedBoundaryActualRightQuotientSubgraphCanonical
        g q hq).elements
proof:
:= by
  change
    admissibleSubgraphRetargetSubgraph
        (forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex g q hq).1
        (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
          (forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex g q hq).1
          (forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex g q hq).2)
        γ
        ((forestComponentMixedBoundaryRightRetargetCertificateCanonical
          g q hq).edge_le γ hγR) ∈
      ((forestComponentChoiceRightSubgraph q.1.1 q.2).elements.attach.image
        fun γ =>
          admissibleSubgraphRetargetSubgraph
            (forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex g q hq).1
            (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
              (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
              (forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex g q hq).1
              (forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex g q hq).2)

            ((forestComponentMixedBoundaryRightRetargetCertificateCanonical

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentMixedBoundaryActualRightQuotientSubgraphCanonical_mem_exists
statement:
private theorem
    forestComponentMixedBoundaryActualRightQuotientSubgraphCanonical_mem_exists
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract] (g : HopfGen)
    (q : forestComponentChoiceSigma g)
    (hq : q ∈ forestComponentMixedBoundaryChoiceSigmaIndex g)
    {δ : FeynmanSubgraph
      (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g
        (forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex g q hq))}
    (hδ :
      δ ∈
        (forestComponentMixedBoundaryActualRightQuotientSubgraphCanonical
          g q hq).elements) :
    ∃ γ : {γ : FeynmanSubgraph (repG g).toFeynmanGraph //
        γ ∈ (forestComponentChoiceRightSubgraph q.1.1 q.2).elements},
      δ =
        admissibleSubgraphRetargetSubgraph
          (forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex g q hq).1
          (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
            (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
            (forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex g q hq).1
            (forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex g q hq).2)
          γ.1
          (forestComponentMixedBoundaryRightRetarget_edge_le g q hq γ.1 γ.2)
proof:
:= by
  change δ ∈
    ((forestComponentChoiceRightSubgraph q.1.1 q.2).elements.attach.image
      fun γ =>
        admissibleSubgraphRetargetSubgraph
          (forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex g q hq).1
          (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
            (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
            (forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex g q hq).1
            (forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex g q hq).2)
          γ.1
          ((forestComponentMixedBoundaryRightRetargetCertificateCanonical
            g q hq).edge_le γ.1 γ.2)) at hδ
  rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hδ with ⟨γ, _hγ, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨γ, rfl⟩

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentMixedBoundarySplitStarOf_right_fresh
statement:
private theorem forestComponentMixedBoundarySplitStarOf_right_fresh
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract] (g : HopfGen)
    (q : forestComponentChoiceSigma g)
    (hq : q ∈ forestComponentMixedBoundaryChoiceSigmaIndex g)
    {γ : FeynmanSubgraph (repG g).toFeynmanGraph}
    (hγR : γ ∈ (forestComponentChoiceRightSubgraph q.1.1 q.2).elements) :
    forestComponentMixedBoundarySplitStarOf g q hq γ ∉
      (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.vertices
proof:
:= by
  let Q :=
    forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g
      (forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex g q hq)
  let δ :=
    admissibleSubgraphRetargetSubgraph
      (forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex g q hq).1
      (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
        (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
        (forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex g q hq).1
        (forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex g q hq).2)
      γ
      (forestComponentMixedBoundaryRightRetarget_edge_le g q hq γ hγR)
  have hp :
      q.2 ∈ forestComponentMixedBoundaryChoiceCoreIndex q.1.1 :=
    (Finset.mem_sigma.mp hq).2
  rcases (mem_forestComponentMixedBoundaryChoiceCoreIndex_hasLeft_right hp).1 with
    ⟨γL, hγLChoice⟩
  have hγL :
      γL.1 ∈ (forestComponentChoiceLeftSubgraph q.1.1 q.2).elements := by
    rw [forestComponentChoiceLeftSubgraph_elements]
    refine Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨γL.2, ?_⟩
    unfold forestComponentChoiceIsLeft
    rw [dif_pos γL.2]
    exact hγLChoice
  have hLeftMem :
      FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
          (forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex g q hq).1
          (forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex g q hq).2 γL.1 ∈
        Q.vertices := by
    simpa [Q] using
      forestComponentMixedBoundary_left_star_mem_outer_quotient_vertices
        g q hq hγL
  have hLeftGe :
      FeynmanGraph.freshVertex (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.vertices ≤
        FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
          (forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex g q hq).1
          (forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex g q hq).2 γL.1 :=
    forestComponentMixedBoundary_left_star_ge_original_freshVertex
      g q hq γL.1
  have hLeftLtQ :
      FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
          (forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex g q hq).1
          (forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex g q hq).2 γL.1 <
        FeynmanGraph.freshVertex Q.vertices :=
    lt_freshVertex_of_mem hLeftMem
  have hQle :
      FeynmanGraph.freshVertex Q.vertices ≤
        (forestComponentMixedBoundaryActualRightQuotientSubgraphCanonical
          g q hq).componentFreshStar δ := by
    simpa [Q, δ] using
      freshVertex_le_componentFreshStar
        (forestComponentMixedBoundaryActualRightQuotientSubgraphCanonical
          g q hq)
        δ
  have hOrigLe :
      FeynmanGraph.freshVertex (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.vertices ≤
        forestComponentMixedBoundarySplitStarOf g q hq γ := by
    rw [forestComponentMixedBoundarySplitStarOf_right g q hq hγR]
    change

    · exact Finset.mem_union_right _
        (AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_starVertices.mpr ⟨γ, hγR, rfl⟩)

        Aout starOf γ.1

      γ ∉ (forestComponentChoiceLeftSubgraph q.1.1 q.2).elements :=
    forestComponentChoiceRightSubgraph_not_mem_left q.1.1 q.2 hγR
  unfold forestComponentForestChoiceSplitStarOf
  rw [dif_neg hnotL, dif_pos hγR]

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentForestChoiceSplitStarOf_forest
statement:
@[simp] private theorem forestComponentForestChoiceSplitStarOf_forest
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract] (g : HopfGen)
    (q : forestComponentChoiceSigma g)
    (hq : q ∈ forestComponentForestChoiceSigmaIndex g)
    (C : forestComponentForestChoiceRemnantPositiveComponentsCertificate
      g q hq)
    (γ : {γ : FeynmanSubgraph (repG g).toFeynmanGraph // γ ∈ q.1.1.elements})
    {B : AdmissibleSubgraph
      (repG (γ.1.toHopfGen (q.1.1.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem γ.2))).toFeynmanGraph}
    (hB :
      q.2 γ (Finset.mem_attach q.1.1.elements γ) =
        forestCoproductChoice.forest B) :
    forestComponentForestChoiceSplitStarOf g q hq C γ.1 =
      FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
        (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g
          (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq))
        (forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientSubgraphCanonical
          g q hq)
        (forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientSubgraphCanonical_mem_properDisjoint
          g q hq
          (forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientProperCertificateOfRemnantPositive
            g q hq C))
        (admissibleSubgraphQuotientRemainderSubgraph
          (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1
          (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
            (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
            (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1
            (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).2)
          γ.1)
proof:
:= by
  have hnotL :
      γ.1 ∉ (forestComponentChoiceLeftSubgraph q.1.1 q.2).elements := by
    intro hγL
    rw [forestComponentChoiceLeftSubgraph_elements] at hγL
    rcases Finset.mem_filter.mp hγL with ⟨_hγA, hLeft⟩
    unfold forestComponentChoiceIsLeft at hLeft
    rw [dif_pos γ.2] at hLeft
    rw [hB] at hLeft
    cases hLeft
  have hnotR :
      γ.1 ∉ (forestComponentChoiceRightSubgraph q.1.1 q.2).elements := by
    intro hγR
    rw [forestComponentChoiceRightSubgraph_elements] at hγR
    rcases Finset.mem_filter.mp hγR with ⟨_hγA, hRight⟩
    unfold forestComponentChoiceIsRight at hRight
    rw [dif_pos γ.2] at hRight
    rw [hB] at hRight
    cases hRight
  unfold forestComponentForestChoiceSplitStarOf
  rw [dif_neg hnotL, dif_neg hnotR, dif_pos γ.2]
  cases hChoice :
      q.2 γ (Finset.mem_attach q.1.1.elements γ) with
  | left =>
      rw [hChoice] at hB
      cases hB
  | right =>
      rw [hChoice] at hB
      cases hB
  | forest B' =>
      rfl

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentForestChoice_outer_star_mem_outer_quotient_vertices
statement:
private theorem forestComponentForestChoice_outer_star_mem_outer_quotient_vertices
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract] (g : HopfGen)
    (q : forestComponentChoiceSigma g)

        (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq)).vertices
proof:
:= by
  change
    (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1.componentFreshStar δ ∈

        (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
          (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1
          (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).2)).vertices

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentForestChoice_actualRightStar_ge_original_freshVertex
statement:
private theorem forestComponentForestChoice_actualRightStar_ge_original_freshVertex
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract] (g : HopfGen)
    (q : forestComponentChoiceSigma g)
    (hq : q ∈ forestComponentForestChoiceSigmaIndex g)
    (C : forestComponentForestChoiceRemnantPositiveComponentsCertificate
      g q hq)
    (δ : FeynmanSubgraph
      (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g
        (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq))) :
    FeynmanGraph.freshVertex (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.vertices ≤
      FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
        (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g
          (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq))
        (forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientSubgraphCanonical
          g q hq)
        (forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientSubgraphCanonical_mem_properDisjoint
          g q hq
          (forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientProperCertificateOfRemnantPositive
            g q hq C))
        δ
proof:
:= by
  let Q := forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g
    (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq)
  let Aout := (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1
  let outerStar :=
    FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
      (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
      (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1
      (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).2
  let Aact := forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientSubgraphCanonical
    g q hq
  have hAoutNonempty : Aout.IsNonempty := by
    simpa [Aout] using
      properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs_isNonempty
        (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).2
  rcases hAoutNonempty with ⟨δ₀, hδ₀⟩
  have hOuterMem :
      outerStar δ₀ ∈ Q.vertices := by
    simpa [Q, outerStar, Aout] using
      forestComponentForestChoice_outer_star_mem_outer_quotient_vertices
        g q hq hδ₀
  have hOuterGe :
      FeynmanGraph.freshVertex (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.vertices ≤
        outerStar δ₀ := by
    simpa [outerStar] using
      forestComponentForestChoice_outer_star_ge_original_freshVertex
        g q hq δ₀
  have hOuterLtQ :
      outerStar δ₀ < FeynmanGraph.freshVertex Q.vertices :=
    lt_freshVertex_of_mem hOuterMem
  have hQle :
      FeynmanGraph.freshVertex Q.vertices ≤ Aact.componentFreshStar δ := by
    simpa [Q, Aact] using freshVertex_le_componentFreshStar Aact δ
  change
    FeynmanGraph.freshVertex (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.vertices ≤
      Aact.componentFreshStar δ
  exact Nat.le_trans hOuterGe
    (Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_of_lt hOuterLtQ) hQle)

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentForestChoiceSplitStarOf_left_fresh

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentForestChoice_choice_left_or_right_or_forest
statement:
private theorem forestComponentForestChoice_choice_left_or_right_or_forest
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract] (g : HopfGen)
    (q : forestComponentChoiceSigma g)
    (_hq : q ∈ forestComponentForestChoiceSigmaIndex g)
    {γ : FeynmanSubgraph (repG g).toFeynmanGraph}
    (hγ : γ ∈ q.1.1.elements) :
    γ ∈ (forestComponentChoiceLeftSubgraph q.1.1 q.2).elements ∨
      γ ∈ (forestComponentChoiceRightSubgraph q.1.1 q.2).elements ∨
      ∃ B : AdmissibleSubgraph
        (repG (γ.toHopfGen (q.1.1.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem hγ))).toFeynmanGraph,
        q.2 ⟨γ, hγ⟩ (Finset.mem_attach q.1.1.elements ⟨γ, hγ⟩) =
          forestCoproductChoice.forest B
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases forestCoproductChoice_eq_left_or_right_or_forest
      (γ.toHopfGen (q.1.1.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem hγ))
      (q.2 ⟨γ, hγ⟩ (Finset.mem_attach q.1.1.elements ⟨γ, hγ⟩)) with
    hLeft | hRightOrForest
  · exact Or.inl (by
      rw [forestComponentChoiceLeftSubgraph_elements]
      refine Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hγ, ?_⟩
      unfold forestComponentChoiceIsLeft
      rw [dif_pos hγ]
      exact hLeft)
  · rcases hRightOrForest with hRight | hForest
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl (by
        rw [forestComponentChoiceRightSubgraph_elements]
        refine Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hγ, ?_⟩
        unfold forestComponentChoiceIsRight
        rw [dif_pos hγ]
        exact hRight))
    · rcases hForest with ⟨B, hB⟩
      exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨B, hB⟩)

  · exact forestComponentForestChoiceSplitStarOf_right_fresh g q hq C hγR

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentForestChoiceSplitStarOf_isFresh_of_injective
statement:
private theorem forestComponentForestChoiceSplitStarOf_isFresh_of_injective
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    (T : forestComponentForestChoiceSplitStarInjectivityPayload) :
    ∀ g q, ∀ hq : q ∈ forestComponentForestChoiceSigmaIndex g,
      ∀ C : forestComponentForestChoiceRemnantPositiveComponentsCertificate
        g q hq,
        q.1.1.IsFreshStarAssignment
          (forestComponentForestChoiceSplitStarOf g q hq C)
proof:
:= by
  intro g q hq C
  constructor
  · intro γ hγ
    exact forestComponentForestChoiceSplitStarOf_point_fresh g q hq C hγ
  · intro γ₁ hγ₁ γ₂ hγ₂ hstar

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentForestChoiceSplitStarInjectivityOfBranches
statement:
private theorem forestComponentForestChoiceSplitStarInjectivityOfBranches
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    (T : forestComponentForestChoiceSplitStarBranchInjectivityPayload) :
    forestComponentForestChoiceSplitStarInjectivityPayload where
  inj
proof:
:= by
    intro g q hq C γ₁ hγ₁ γ₂ hγ₂ hstar
    rcases forestComponentForestChoice_choice_left_or_right_or_forest
        g q hq hγ₁ with hγ₁L | hγ₁R | hγ₁F
    · rcases forestComponentForestChoice_choice_left_or_right_or_forest
        g q hq hγ₂ with hγ₂L | hγ₂R | hγ₂F
      · exact T.left_left g q hq C γ₁ hγ₁L γ₂ hγ₂L hstar
      · exact False.elim ((T.left_right g q hq C γ₁ hγ₁L γ₂ hγ₂R) hstar)
      · rcases hγ₂F with ⟨B₂, hB₂⟩
        exact False.elim
          ((T.left_forest g q hq C γ₁ hγ₁L ⟨γ₂, hγ₂⟩ B₂ hB₂) hstar)
    · rcases forestComponentForestChoice_choice_left_or_right_or_forest
        g q hq hγ₂ with hγ₂L | hγ₂R | hγ₂F
      · exact False.elim ((T.left_right g q hq C γ₂ hγ₂L γ₁ hγ₁R) hstar.symm)
      · exact T.right_right g q hq C γ₁ hγ₁R γ₂ hγ₂R hstar
      · rcases hγ₂F with ⟨B₂, hB₂⟩
        exact False.elim
          ((T.right_forest g q hq C γ₁ hγ₁R ⟨γ₂, hγ₂⟩ B₂ hB₂) hstar)
    · rcases hγ₁F with ⟨B₁, hB₁⟩
      rcases forestComponentForestChoice_choice_left_or_right_or_forest
        g q hq hγ₂ with hγ₂L | hγ₂R | hγ₂F
      · exact False.elim
          ((T.left_forest g q hq C γ₂ hγ₂L ⟨γ₁, hγ₁⟩ B₁ hB₁) hstar.symm)
      · exact False.elim
          ((T.right_forest g q hq C γ₂ hγ₂R ⟨γ₁, hγ₁⟩ B₁ hB₁) hstar.symm)
      · rcases hγ₂F with ⟨B₂, hB₂⟩
        exact T.forest_forest g q hq C ⟨γ₁, hγ₁⟩ B₁ hB₁
          ⟨γ₂, hγ₂⟩ B₂ hB₂ hstar

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentForestChoiceSplitStarBranch_left_left
statement:
private theorem forestComponentForestChoiceSplitStarBranch_left_left
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract] (g : HopfGen)
    (q : forestComponentChoiceSigma g)
    (hq : q ∈ forestComponentForestChoiceSigmaIndex g)
    (C : forestComponentForestChoiceRemnantPositiveComponentsCertificate

    (hγ₂L : γ₂ ∈ (forestComponentChoiceLeftSubgraph q.1.1 q.2).elements)
    (hstar :
      forestComponentForestChoiceSplitStarOf g q hq C γ₁ =
        forestComponentForestChoiceSplitStarOf g q hq C γ₂) :
    γ₁ = γ₂
proof:
:= by
  have hFreshOuter :
      (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1.IsFreshStarAssignment
        (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
          (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1

    FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf_isFreshStarAssignment
      (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
      (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1
      (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).2
  apply hFreshOuter.eq_of_star_eq
  · exact forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex_mem_of_left g q hq hγ₁L
  · exact forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex_mem_of_left g q hq hγ₂L
  · simpa [forestComponentForestChoiceSplitStarOf_left g q hq C hγ₁L,
      forestComponentForestChoiceSplitStarOf_left g q hq C hγ₂L] using hstar

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentForestChoiceSplitStarBranch_left_right
statement:

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentForestChoiceSplitStarBranch_right_right
statement:
private theorem forestComponentForestChoiceSplitStarBranch_right_right
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract] (g : HopfGen)
    (q : forestComponentChoiceSigma g)
    (hq : q ∈ forestComponentForestChoiceSigmaIndex g)
    (C : forestComponentForestChoiceRemnantPositiveComponentsCertificate
      g q hq)
    {γ₁ γ₂ : FeynmanSubgraph (repG g).toFeynmanGraph}
    (hγ₁R : γ₁ ∈ (forestComponentChoiceRightSubgraph q.1.1 q.2).elements)
    (hγ₂R : γ₂ ∈ (forestComponentChoiceRightSubgraph q.1.1 q.2).elements)
    (hstar :
      forestComponentForestChoiceSplitStarOf g q hq C γ₁ =
        forestComponentForestChoiceSplitStarOf g q hq C γ₂) :
    γ₁ = γ₂
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let Aout := (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1
  let outerStar :=
    FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
      (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
      (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1
      (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).2
  let Q := forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g
    (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq)
  let Aact := forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientSubgraphCanonical g q hq
  let rightStar :=
    FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf Q Aact
      (by
        simpa [Q, Aact] using
          forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientSubgraphCanonical_mem_properDisjoint
            g q hq
            (forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientProperCertificateOfRemnantPositive
              g q hq C))
  let δ₁ :=
    admissibleSubgraphRetargetSubgraph Aout outerStar γ₁
      (forestComponentForestChoiceRightRetarget_edge_le g q hq γ₁ hγ₁R)
  let δ₂ :=
    admissibleSubgraphRetargetSubgraph Aout outerStar γ₂
      (forestComponentForestChoiceRightRetarget_edge_le g q hq γ₂ hγ₂R)
  have hFreshQ : Aact.IsFreshStarAssignment rightStar :=
    FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf_isFreshStarAssignment
      Q Aact
      (by
        simpa [Q, Aact] using
          forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientSubgraphCanonical_mem_properDisjoint
            g q hq
            (forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientProperCertificateOfRemnantPositive
              g q hq C))
  have hδeq : δ₁ = δ₂ := by
    apply hFreshQ.eq_of_star_eq
    · simpa [Q, Aact, δ₁] using
        forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientSubgraphCanonical_mem_of_right
          g q hq hγ₁R
    · simpa [Q, Aact, δ₂] using
        forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientSubgraphCanonical_mem_of_right
          g q hq hγ₂R
    · simpa [Q, Aact, rightStar, Aout, outerStar, δ₁, δ₂,
        forestComponentForestChoiceSplitStarOf_right g q hq C hγ₁R,
        forestComponentForestChoiceSplitStarOf_right g q hq C hγ₂R] using hstar
  have hDisjA : q.1.1.IsPairwiseDisjoint :=
    (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
      |>.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs_isPairwiseDisjoint q.1.2
  have hV :
      ∀ η ∈ (forestComponentChoiceRightSubgraph q.1.1 q.2).elements,
        ∀ v ∈ η.vertices, v ∉ Aout.vertices := by
    intro η hη v hv
    simpa [Aout, forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex_val] using
      forestComponentChoiceRight_vertices_not_mem_forestOuterSubgraph
        q.1.1 q.2 hDisjA hη hv
  have hinj :=
    admissibleSubgraphRetarget_injective_of_not_mem
      Aout outerStar (forestComponentChoiceRightSubgraph q.1.1 q.2)
      (fun η hη =>
        forestComponentForestChoiceRightRetarget_edge_le g q hq η hη)
      hV
  have hSubtype :
      (⟨γ₁, hγ₁R⟩ :
        {γ : FeynmanSubgraph (repG g).toFeynmanGraph //
          γ ∈ (forestComponentChoiceRightSubgraph q.1.1 q.2).elements}) =
      ⟨γ₂, hγ₂R⟩ := by
    apply hinj
    simpa [Aout, outerStar, δ₁, δ₂] using hδeq
  exact congrArg Subtype.val hSubtype

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentForestChoiceSplitStarBranch_right_forest
statement:
private theorem forestComponentForestChoiceSplitStarBranch_right_forest
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract] (g : HopfGen)
    (q : forestComponentChoiceSigma g)
    (hq : q ∈ forestComponentForestChoiceSigmaIndex g)
    (C : forestComponentForestChoiceRemnantPositiveComponentsCertificate
      g q hq)
    {γR : FeynmanSubgraph (repG g).toFeynmanGraph}
    (hγR : γR ∈ (forestComponentChoiceRightSubgraph q.1.1 q.2).elements)
    (γF : {γ : FeynmanSubgraph (repG g).toFeynmanGraph //
      γ ∈ q.1.1.elements})
    {B : AdmissibleSubgraph
      (repG (γF.1.toHopfGen
        (q.1.1.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem γF.2))).toFeynmanGraph}
    (hB : q.2 γF (Finset.mem_attach q.1.1.elements γF) =
      forestCoproductChoice.forest B) :
    forestComponentForestChoiceSplitStarOf g q hq C γR ≠
      forestComponentForestChoiceSplitStarOf g q hq C γF.1
proof:
:= by
  intro hstar
  let Aout := (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1
  let outerStar :=
    FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
      (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
      (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1
      (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).2
  let Q := forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g
    (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq)
  let Aact := forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientSubgraphCanonical g q hq
  let rightStar :=
    FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf Q Aact
      (by
        simpa [Q, Aact] using
          forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientSubgraphCanonical_mem_properDisjoint
            g q hq
            (forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientProperCertificateOfRemnantPositive
              g q hq C))
  let δR :=
    admissibleSubgraphRetargetSubgraph Aout outerStar γR
      (forestComponentForestChoiceRightRetarget_edge_le g q hq γR hγR)
  let δF :=
    admissibleSubgraphQuotientRemainderSubgraph Aout outerStar γF.1
  have hFreshQ : Aact.IsFreshStarAssignment rightStar :=
    FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf_isFreshStarAssignment
      Q Aact
      (by
        simpa [Q, Aact] using
          forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientSubgraphCanonical_mem_properDisjoint
            g q hq
            (forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientProperCertificateOfRemnantPositive
              g q hq C))
  have hδeq : δR = δF := by
    apply hFreshQ.eq_of_star_eq
    · simpa [Q, Aact, δR] using
        forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientSubgraphCanonical_mem_of_right
          g q hq hγR
    · simpa [Q, Aact, δF] using
        forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientSubgraphCanonical_mem_of_forest
          g q hq γF hB
    · simpa [Q, Aact, rightStar, Aout, outerStar, δR, δF,
        forestComponentForestChoiceSplitStarOf_right g q hq C hγR,
        forestComponentForestChoiceSplitStarOf_forest g q hq C γF hB] using hstar
  have hδRmem :
      δR ∈ (forestComponentForestChoiceActualRightQuotientSubgraphCanonical
        g q hq).elements := by
    simpa [δR, Aout, outerStar] using
      forestComponentForestChoiceActualRightQuotientSubgraphCanonical_mem_of_right
        g q hq hγR
  have hδFmem :
      δF ∈ forestComponentForestChoiceRemnantComponents g q hq := by
    simpa [δF, Aout, outerStar] using
      forestComponentForestChoiceRemnantComponents_mem_of_forest
        g q hq γF hB
  have hSelfDisj : δR.Disjoint δR := by
    simpa [hδeq] using
      forestComponentForestChoiceRightRemnant_disjoint g q hq
        δR hδRmem δF hδFmem
  have hPos :
      0 < δR.internalEdges.card :=
    forestComponentForestChoiceActualRightQuotientSubgraphCanonical_hasPositiveInternalEdgesComponents
      g q hq δR hδRmem
  rcases Multiset.exists_mem_of_ne_zero (Multiset.card_pos.mp hPos) with
    ⟨e, he⟩
  have hsupp := δR.edges_supported e he
  simp [FeynmanEdge.SupportedOn] at hsupp
  exact (Finset.disjoint_left.mp hSelfDisj hsupp.1) hsupp.1

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentForestChoiceSplitStarBranch_forest_forest
statement:

      g q hq)

      γ ∈ q.1.1.elements})
    {B₁ : AdmissibleSubgraph
      (repG (γ₁.1.toHopfGen
        (q.1.1.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem γ₁.2))).toFeynmanGraph}
    (hB₁ : q.2 γ₁ (Finset.mem_attach q.1.1.elements γ₁) =
      forestCoproductChoice.forest B₁)
    (γ₂ : {γ : FeynmanSubgraph (repG g).toFeynmanGraph //
      γ ∈ q.1.1.elements})
    {B₂ : AdmissibleSubgraph
      (repG (γ₂.1.toHopfGen
        (q.1.1.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem γ₂.2))).toFeynmanGraph}
    (hB₂ : q.2 γ₂ (Finset.mem_attach q.1.1.elements γ₂) =
      forestCoproductChoice.forest B₂)
    (hstar :
      forestComponentForestChoiceSplitStarOf g q hq C γ₁.1 =
        forestComponentForestChoiceSplitStarOf g q hq C γ₂.1) :
    γ₁.1 = γ₂.1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_contra hne
  let Aout := (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1
  let outerStar :=
    FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
      (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
      (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1

    (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq)

    FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf Q Aact
      (by
        simpa [Q, Aact] using
          forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientSubgraphCanonical_mem_properDisjoint
            g q hq
            (forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientProperCertificateOfRemnantPositive
              g q hq C))
  let δ₁ := admissibleSubgraphQuotientRemainderSubgraph Aout outerStar γ₁.1
  let δ₂ := admissibleSubgraphQuotientRemainderSubgraph Aout outerStar γ₂.1

      Q Aact
      (by
        simpa [Q, Aact] using
          forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientSubgraphCanonical_mem_properDisjoint
            g q hq
            (forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientProperCertificateOfRemnantPositive
              g q hq C))
  have hδeq : δ₁ = δ₂ := by
    apply hFreshQ.eq_of_star_eq
    · simpa [Q, Aact, δ₁] using
        forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientSubgraphCanonical_mem_of_forest
          g q hq γ₁ hB₁
    · simpa [Q, Aact, δ₂] using
        forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientSubgraphCanonical_mem_of_forest
          g q hq γ₂ hB₂
    · simpa [Q, Aact, rightStar, Aout, outerStar, δ₁, δ₂,
        forestComponentForestChoiceSplitStarOf_forest g q hq C γ₁ hB₁,
        forestComponentForestChoiceSplitStarOf_forest g q hq C γ₂ hB₂] using hstar
  have hδ₁mem : δ₁ ∈ forestComponentForestChoiceRemnantComponents g q hq := by
    simpa [δ₁, Aout, outerStar] using

        g q hq γ₁ hB₁
  have hδ₂mem : δ₂ ∈ forestComponentForestChoiceRemnantComponents g q hq := by
    simpa [δ₂, Aout, outerStar] using
      forestComponentForestChoiceRemnantComponents_mem_of_forest
        g q hq γ₂ hB₂
  have hSelfDisj : δ₁.Disjoint δ₁ := by

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentForestChoiceForestSplitStarVertices_mem_of_forest
statement:
private theorem

    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract] (g : HopfGen)

      g q hq)

:= by

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentForestChoiceForestSplitStarVertices_mem_exists
statement:
private theorem
    forestComponentForestChoiceForestSplitStarVertices_mem_exists
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract] (g : HopfGen)
    (q : forestComponentChoiceSigma g)
    (hq : q ∈ forestComponentForestChoiceSigmaIndex g)
    (C : forestComponentForestChoiceRemnantPositiveComponentsCertificate
      g q hq)
    {v : VertexId}
    (hv :
      v ∈ forestComponentForestChoiceForestSplitStarVertices g q hq C) :
    ∃ γ : {γ : FeynmanSubgraph (repG g).toFeynmanGraph //
        γ ∈ q.1.1.elements},
      ∃ B : AdmissibleSubgraph
        (repG (γ.1.toHopfGen
          (q.1.1.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem γ.2))).toFeynmanGraph,
        q.2 γ (Finset.mem_attach q.1.1.elements γ) =
          forestCoproductChoice.forest B ∧
        forestComponentForestChoiceSplitStarOf g q hq C γ.1 = v
proof:
:= by
  unfold forestComponentForestChoiceForestSplitStarVertices at hv
  replace hv := Finset.mem_biUnion.mp hv
  rcases hv with ⟨γ, _hγ, hvγ⟩
  cases hChoice : q.2 γ (Finset.mem_attach q.1.1.elements γ) with
  | left =>
      simp [hChoice] at hvγ
  | right =>
      simp [hChoice] at hvγ
  | forest B =>
      have hvγ' :
          v ∈
            ({forestComponentForestChoiceSplitStarOf g q hq C γ.1} :
              Finset VertexId) := by
        simpa [hChoice] using hvγ
      exact ⟨γ, B, hChoice, (Finset.mem_singleton.mp hvγ').symm⟩

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentForestChoice_splitStar_starVertices_eq_union
statement:
private theorem
    forestComponentForestChoice_splitStar_starVertices_eq_union
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract] (g : HopfGen)
    (q : forestComponentChoiceSigma g)
    (hq : q ∈ forestComponentForestChoiceSigmaIndex g)
    (C : forestComponentForestChoiceRemnantPositiveComponentsCertificate
      g q hq) :
    q.1.1.starVertices (forestComponentForestChoiceSplitStarOf g q hq C) =
      (forestComponentChoiceLeftSubgraph q.1.1 q.2).starVertices
          (forestComponentForestChoiceSplitStarOf g q hq C) ∪
        ((forestComponentChoiceRightSubgraph q.1.1 q.2).starVertices
            (forestComponentForestChoiceSplitStarOf g q hq C) ∪
          forestComponentForestChoiceForestSplitStarVertices g q hq C)
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  constructor
  · intro hv
    rw [AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_starVertices] at hv
    rcases hv with ⟨γ, hγ, rfl⟩
    rcases forestComponentForestChoice_choice_left_or_right_or_forest
        g q hq hγ with hγL | hγR | hγF
    · exact Finset.mem_union_left _
        (AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_starVertices.mpr ⟨γ, hγL, rfl⟩)
    · exact Finset.mem_union_right _

    · rw [AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_starVertices] at hvL

        q.1.1 q.2 hγL, rfl⟩
    · rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hvRest with hvR | hvF

        rcases hvR with ⟨γ, hγR, rfl⟩

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentForestChoiceActualRightQuotientSubgraphCanonical_vertices_eq_right
statement:
private theorem
    forestComponentForestChoiceActualRightQuotientSubgraphCanonical_vertices_eq_right
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract] (g : HopfGen)
    (q : forestComponentChoiceSigma g)
    (hq : q ∈ forestComponentForestChoiceSigmaIndex g) :
    (forestComponentForestChoiceActualRightQuotientSubgraphCanonical
      g q hq).vertices =
      (forestComponentChoiceRightSubgraph q.1.1 q.2).vertices
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hDisj : q.1.1.IsPairwiseDisjoint :=
    (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
      |>.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs_isPairwiseDisjoint q.1.2
  let Aout := (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1
  let starOf :=
    FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
      (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
      (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1
      (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).2
  have hV :
      ∀ η ∈ (forestComponentChoiceRightSubgraph q.1.1 q.2).elements,
        ∀ v ∈ η.vertices, v ∉ Aout.vertices := by
    intro η hη v hv
    simpa [Aout, forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex_val] using
      forestComponentChoiceRight_vertices_not_mem_forestOuterSubgraph
        q.1.1 q.2 hDisj hη hv
  ext v
  constructor
  · intro hv
    rcases AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_vertices.mp hv with ⟨δ, hδ, hvδ⟩
    rcases
        forestComponentForestChoiceActualRightQuotientSubgraphCanonical_mem_exists
          g q hq hδ with
      ⟨γ, rfl⟩
    have hVeq :=
      admissibleSubgraphRetargetSubgraph_vertices_eq_of_not_mem
        Aout starOf γ.1
        (forestComponentForestChoiceRightRetarget_edge_le g q hq γ.1 γ.2)
        (hV γ.1 γ.2)
    exact AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_vertices.mpr ⟨γ.1, γ.2, by
      exact hVeq ▸ hvδ⟩
  · intro hv
    rcases AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_vertices.mp hv with ⟨γ, hγ, hvγ⟩
    let δ :=
      admissibleSubgraphRetargetSubgraph
        Aout starOf γ
        (forestComponentForestChoiceRightRetarget_edge_le g q hq γ hγ)
    have hVeq :
        δ.vertices = γ.vertices := by
      simpa [δ] using
        admissibleSubgraphRetargetSubgraph_vertices_eq_of_not_mem
          Aout starOf γ
          (forestComponentForestChoiceRightRetarget_edge_le g q hq γ hγ)
          (hV γ hγ)
    exact AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_vertices.mpr ⟨δ, by
      simpa [δ] using
        forestComponentForestChoiceActualRightQuotientSubgraphCanonical_mem_of_right
          g q hq hγ, by
      simpa [hVeq] using hvγ⟩

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentForestChoice_actualRemnant_vertices_mem_of_forest_vertex

    (γ : {γ : FeynmanSubgraph (repG g).toFeynmanGraph //
      γ ∈ q.1.1.elements})
    {B : AdmissibleSubgraph
      (repG (γ.1.toHopfGen
        (q.1.1.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem γ.2))).toFeynmanGraph}
    (hB : q.2 γ (Finset.mem_attach q.1.1.elements γ) =
      forestCoproductChoice.forest B)
    {u : VertexId} (hu : u ∈ γ.1.vertices) :
    (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1.retargetVertex
        (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
          (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1
          (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).2)

      (forestComponentForestChoiceActualRemnantQuotientSubgraphCanonical
        g q hq).vertices
proof:
:= by

  let outerStar :=
    FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
      (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
      (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentForestChoice_promoted_outer_star_mem_actual_remnant_vertices
statement:
private theorem
    forestComponentForestChoice_promoted_outer_star_mem_actual_remnant_vertices
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract] (g : HopfGen)
    (q : forestComponentChoiceSigma g)
    (hq : q ∈ forestComponentForestChoiceSigmaIndex g)
    {δ : FeynmanSubgraph (repG g).toFeynmanGraph}
    (hδ :
      δ ∈ forestComponentChoicePromotedForestComponents q.1.1 q.2) :
    FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
        (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
        (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1
        (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).2 δ ∈
      (forestComponentForestChoiceActualRemnantQuotientSubgraphCanonical
        g q hq).vertices
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases forestComponentChoicePromotedForestComponents_mem_exists
      q.1.1 q.2 hδ with
    ⟨γ, B, hB, hδB⟩
  let Aout := (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1
  let outerStar :=
    FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
      (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
      (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1
      (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).2
  have hpCore : q.2 ∈ forestComponentCoreChoiceIndex q.1.1 :=
    (mem_forestComponentForestChoiceCoreIndex_core_hasForest
      (Finset.mem_sigma.mp hq).2).1
  have hPromotedProper :
      feynmanSubgraphRepForestPromoteAdmissibleSubgraph γ.1
        (q.1.1.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem γ.2) B ∈
        (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs :=
    forestComponentChoice_promotedForest_mem_properDisjoint_of_core_mem
      hpCore γ hB
  have hδNonempty : δ.IsNonempty :=
    (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
      |>.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs_hasNonemptyComponents
        hPromotedProper δ hδB
  unfold FeynmanSubgraph.IsNonempty FeynmanSubgraph.vertexCount at hδNonempty
  rcases Finset.card_pos.mp hδNonempty with ⟨u, huδ⟩
  have huγ : u ∈ γ.1.vertices :=
    feynmanSubgraphRepForestPromoteAdmissibleSubgraph_vertices_subset_outer
      γ.1 (q.1.1.isConnectedDivergent_of_mem γ.2) B hδB huδ
  have hδAout : δ ∈ Aout.elements := by
    dsimp [Aout]
    change δ ∈
      (forestComponentChoiceLeftSubgraph q.1.1 q.2).elements ∪
        forestComponentChoicePromotedForestComponents q.1.1 q.2
    exact Finset.mem_union_right
      (forestComponentChoiceLeftSubgraph q.1.1 q.2).elements hδ
  have hAoutDisj : Aout.IsPairwiseDisjoint := by
    dsimp [Aout]
    exact (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
      |>.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs_isPairwiseDisjoint
        (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).2
  have hRet :
      Aout.retargetVertex outerStar u = outerStar δ := by
    exact AdmissibleSubgraph.retargetVertex_of_mem_component
      hAoutDisj outerStar hδAout huδ
  change outerStar δ ∈
    (forestComponentForestChoiceActualRemnantQuotientSubgraphCanonical
      g q hq).vertices
  rw [← hRet]
  exact forestComponentForestChoice_actualRemnant_vertices_mem_of_forest_vertex
    g q hq γ hB huγ

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentForestChoice_actualRemnant_vertex_mem_original_of_mem_graph
statement:
private theorem
    forestComponentForestChoice_actualRemnant_vertex_mem_original_of_mem_graph
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract] (g : HopfGen)
    (q : forestComponentChoiceSigma g)
    (hq : q ∈ forestComponentForestChoiceSigmaIndex g)
    {v : VertexId}
    (hvM :
      v ∈ (forestComponentForestChoiceActualRemnantQuotientSubgraphCanonical
        g q hq).vertices)
    (hvG : v ∈ (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.vertices) :
    v ∈ q.1.1.vertices
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_vertices.mp hvM with ⟨δ, hδ, hvδ⟩
  have hδ' : δ ∈ forestComponentForestChoiceRemnantComponents g q hq := by
    simpa [forestComponentForestChoiceActualRemnantQuotientSubgraphCanonical]
      using hδ
  rcases forestComponentForestChoiceRemnantComponents_mem_exists
      g q hq hδ' with
    ⟨γ, B, hB, rfl⟩
  let Aout := (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1
  let outerStar :=
    FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
      (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
      (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1
      (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).2
  rw [admissibleSubgraphQuotientRemainderSubgraph_vertices] at hvδ
  rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hvδ with ⟨u, huγ, huv⟩
  by_cases huOut : u ∈ Aout.vertices
  · have hAoutDisj : Aout.IsPairwiseDisjoint := by
      dsimp [Aout]
      exact (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
        |>.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs_isPairwiseDisjoint
          (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).2
    have hRet :
        Aout.retargetVertex outerStar u =
          outerStar (Aout.componentAt huOut) :=
      AdmissibleSubgraph.retargetVertex_of_mem_component
        hAoutDisj outerStar (Aout.componentAt_mem huOut)
        (Aout.componentAt_vertex_mem huOut)
    have hFresh :
        Aout.IsFreshStarAssignment outerStar := by
      dsimp [Aout, outerStar]
      exact FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf_isFreshStarAssignment
        (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
        (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1
        (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).2
    have hStarEq : outerStar (Aout.componentAt huOut) = v :=
      hRet.symm.trans huv
    exact False.elim
      (hFresh.fresh (Aout.componentAt_mem huOut)
        (by simpa [hStarEq] using hvG))
  · have hRet : Aout.retargetVertex outerStar u = u :=
      AdmissibleSubgraph.retargetVertex_of_not_mem Aout outerStar huOut
    have huv' : u = v := hRet.symm.trans huv
    exact AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_vertices.mpr
      ⟨γ.1, γ.2, by simpa [huv'] using huγ⟩

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentForestChoice_left_outer_star_not_actual_quotient_vertices
statement:
private theorem
    forestComponentForestChoice_left_outer_star_not_actual_quotient_vertices
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract] (g : HopfGen)
    (q : forestComponentChoiceSigma g)
    (hq : q ∈ forestComponentForestChoiceSigmaIndex g)
