      g q hq)
    {γL : FeynmanSubgraph (repG g).toFeynmanGraph}
    (hγL :
      γL ∈ (forestComponentChoiceLeftSubgraph q.1.1 q.2).elements) :
    FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
        (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
        (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1
        (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).2 γL ∉
      (forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientSubgraphCanonical
        g q hq).vertices
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let G₀ := (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
  let Aout := (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1
  let outerStar :=
    FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
      (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
      (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1
      (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).2
  intro hv
  have hFreshOuter : Aout.IsFreshStarAssignment outerStar := by
    dsimp [Aout, outerStar]
    exact FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf_isFreshStarAssignment
      (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
      (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1
      (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).2
  have hγLout : γL ∈ Aout.elements := by
    simpa [Aout] using
      forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex_mem_of_left g q hq hγL
  have hStarNotG : outerStar γL ∉ G₀.vertices := by
    simpa [G₀, Aout, outerStar] using hFreshOuter.fresh hγLout
  have hActSplit :=
    forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientSubgraphCanonical_vertices_eq_right_union_remnant
      g q hq
  rw [hActSplit] at hv
  rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hv with hvR | hvM
  · have hvR' :
        outerStar γL ∈
          (forestComponentChoiceRightSubgraph q.1.1 q.2).vertices := by
      exact forestComponentForestChoiceActualRightQuotientSubgraphCanonical_vertices_eq_right
        g q hq ▸ hvR
    exact hStarNotG ((forestComponentChoiceRightSubgraph q.1.1 q.2).vertices_subset hvR')
  · rcases AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_vertices.mp hvM with ⟨δ, hδ, hvδ⟩
    have hδ' : δ ∈ forestComponentForestChoiceRemnantComponents g q hq := by
      simpa [forestComponentForestChoiceActualRemnantQuotientSubgraphCanonical]
        using hδ
    rcases forestComponentForestChoiceRemnantComponents_mem_exists
        g q hq hδ' with
      ⟨γF, B, hB, rfl⟩
    rw [admissibleSubgraphQuotientRemainderSubgraph_vertices] at hvδ
    rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hvδ with ⟨u, huγF, huv⟩
    by_cases huOut : u ∈ Aout.vertices
    · have hAoutDisj : Aout.IsPairwiseDisjoint := by
        dsimp [Aout]
        exact (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
          |>.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs_isPairwiseDisjoint
            (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).2
      have hRet :
          Aout.retargetVertex outerStar u =
            outerStar (Aout.componentAt huOut) :=
        AdmissibleSubgraph.retargetVertex_of_mem_component
          hAoutDisj outerStar (Aout.componentAt_mem huOut)
          (Aout.componentAt_vertex_mem huOut)
      have hStarEq :
          outerStar (Aout.componentAt huOut) = outerStar γL :=
        hRet.symm.trans huv
      have hCompEq : Aout.componentAt huOut = γL :=
        hFreshOuter.eq_of_star_eq (Aout.componentAt_mem huOut) hγLout hStarEq
      have hDisjA : q.1.1.IsPairwiseDisjoint :=
        (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
          |>.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs_isPairwiseDisjoint q.1.2
      have hSubset :
          (Aout.componentAt huOut).vertices ⊆ γF.1.vertices := by
        simpa [Aout] using
          forestComponentForestChoiceOuterSubgraph_componentAt_vertices_subset_source
            q.1.1 q.2 hDisjA γF hB huγF (by
              simpa [Aout] using huOut)
      have huL : u ∈ γL.vertices := by
        simpa [hCompEq] using Aout.componentAt_vertex_mem huOut
      have hγLA : γL ∈ q.1.1.elements :=
        forestComponentChoiceLeftSubgraph_elements_subset q.1.1 q.2 hγL
      have hne : γL ≠ γF.1 := by
        intro hEq
        have hγFLeft :
            γF.1 ∈ (forestComponentChoiceLeftSubgraph q.1.1 q.2).elements := by
          simpa [hEq] using hγL
        rw [forestComponentChoiceLeftSubgraph_elements] at hγFLeft
        rcases Finset.mem_filter.mp hγFLeft with ⟨_hγA, hLeft⟩
        unfold forestComponentChoiceIsLeft at hLeft
        have hLeftChoice :
            q.2 γF (Finset.mem_attach q.1.1.elements γF) =
              forestCoproductChoice.left := by
          simpa [dif_pos γF.2] using hLeft
        rw [hB] at hLeftChoice
        cases hLeftChoice
      have hDisj : γL.Disjoint γF.1 := hDisjA hγLA γF.2 hne
      exact (Finset.disjoint_left.mp hDisj huL) huγF
    · have hRet : Aout.retargetVertex outerStar u = u :=
        AdmissibleSubgraph.retargetVertex_of_not_mem Aout outerStar huOut
      have huEq : u = outerStar γL := hRet.symm.trans huv
      exact hStarNotG (by simpa [huEq] using γF.1.vertices_subset huγF)

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentForestChoice_splitStar_vertices_eq
statement:
private theorem forestComponentForestChoice_splitStar_vertices_eq
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract] (g : HopfGen)
    (q : forestComponentChoiceSigma g)
    (hq : q ∈ forestComponentForestChoiceSigmaIndex g)
    (C : forestComponentForestChoiceRemnantPositiveComponentsCertificate
      g q hq) :
    (forestComponentForestChoiceActualRightContractGraph g q hq C).vertices =
      (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestContractGraphWithStars
        (repG g).toFeynmanGraph q.1.1
        (forestComponentForestChoiceSplitStarOf g q hq C)).vertices
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let G₀ := (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
  let A := q.1.1
  let L := forestComponentChoiceLeftSubgraph q.1.1 q.2
  let R := forestComponentChoiceRightSubgraph q.1.1 q.2
  let Aout := (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1
  let Q := forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g
    (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq)
  let Aact := forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientSubgraphCanonical
    g q hq
  let Ract := forestComponentForestChoiceActualRightQuotientSubgraphCanonical
    g q hq
  let Mact := forestComponentForestChoiceActualRemnantQuotientSubgraphCanonical
    g q hq
  let outerStar :=
    FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
      G₀ Aout (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).2
  let rightStar :=
    FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf Q Aact
      (by
        simpa [Q, Aact] using
          forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientSubgraphCanonical_mem_properDisjoint
            g q hq
            (forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientProperCertificateOfRemnantPositive
              g q hq C))
  let splitStar := forestComponentForestChoiceSplitStarOf g q hq C
  have hQvertices :
      Q.vertices = (G₀.vertices \ Aout.vertices) ∪
        Aout.starVertices outerStar := by
    simp [Q, G₀, Aout, outerStar, forestOuterActualQuotientGraph,
      FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestContractGraphWithStars_eq,
      AdmissibleSubgraph.contractWithStars_vertices]
  have hAactVertices :
      Aact.vertices = Ract.vertices ∪ Mact.vertices := by
    simpa [Aact, Ract, Mact] using
      forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientSubgraphCanonical_vertices_eq_right_union_remnant
        g q hq
  have hRactVertices : Ract.vertices = R.vertices := by
    simpa [Ract, R] using
      forestComponentForestChoiceActualRightQuotientSubgraphCanonical_vertices_eq_right
        g q hq
  have hSplitStars :
      A.starVertices splitStar =
        L.starVertices splitStar ∪
          (R.starVertices splitStar ∪
            forestComponentForestChoiceForestSplitStarVertices g q hq C) := by
    simpa [A, L, R, splitStar] using
      forestComponentForestChoice_splitStar_starVertices_eq_union g q hq C
  have hLeftStars :
      L.starVertices splitStar = L.starVertices outerStar := by
    simpa [L, Aout, outerStar, splitStar] using
      forestComponentForestChoice_left_splitStar_starVertices_eq_outer
        g q hq C
  have hRightStars :
      R.starVertices splitStar = Ract.starVertices rightStar := by
    simpa [R, Ract, Q, Aact, rightStar, splitStar] using
      forestComponentForestChoice_right_splitStar_starVertices_eq_actual
        g q hq C
  have hForestStars :
      forestComponentForestChoiceForestSplitStarVertices g q hq C =
        Mact.starVertices rightStar := by
    simpa [Mact, Q, Aact, rightStar] using
      forestComponentForestChoice_forest_splitStar_starVertices_eq_remnant
        g q hq C
  have hAoutSubsetA : Aout.vertices ⊆ A.vertices := by
    intro v hv
    rcases AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_vertices.mp hv with ⟨δ, hδ, hvδ⟩
    rcases
        forestComponentForestChoiceOuterSubgraph_mem_source
          q.1.1 q.2
          ((repG g).toFeynmanGraph
            |>.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs_isPairwiseDisjoint
              q.1.2)
          (by simpa [Aout, forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex_val] using hδ) with
      ⟨γ, hγA, hδγ⟩
    exact AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_vertices.mpr ⟨γ, hγA, hδγ hvδ⟩
  have hRsubsetG : R.vertices ⊆ G₀.vertices := by
    intro v hv
    simpa [G₀, R] using R.vertices_subset hv
  have hLeftStarNotAct :
      ∀ {v}, v ∈ L.starVertices outerStar → v ∉ Aact.vertices := by
    intro v hv
    rw [AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_starVertices] at hv
    rcases hv with ⟨γ, hγL, rfl⟩
    simpa [Aact, outerStar] using
      forestComponentForestChoice_left_outer_star_not_actual_quotient_vertices
        g q hq C hγL
  simp only [forestComponentForestChoiceActualRightContractGraph,
    FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestContractGraphWithStars_eq,
    AdmissibleSubgraph.contractWithStars_vertices]
  ext v
  constructor
  · intro hv
    rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hv with hvDiff | hvStarAct
    · rcases Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hvDiff with ⟨hvQ, hvNotAct⟩
      rw [hQvertices] at hvQ
      rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hvQ with hvGnotOut | hvOuterStar
      · rcases Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hvGnotOut with ⟨hvG, hvNotOut⟩
        by_cases hvA : v ∈ A.vertices
        · rcases AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_vertices.mp hvA with ⟨γ, hγA, hvγ⟩
          rcases forestComponentForestChoice_choice_left_or_right_or_forest
              g q hq hγA with hγL | hγR | hγF
          · have hvOut : v ∈ Aout.vertices := by
              exact AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_vertices.mpr
                ⟨γ, by
                  simpa [Aout] using
                    forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex_mem_of_left
                      g q hq hγL, hvγ⟩
            exact False.elim (hvNotOut hvOut)
          · have hvAct : v ∈ Aact.vertices := by
              rw [hAactVertices]
              exact Finset.mem_union_left _
                (by
                  rw [hRactVertices]
                  exact AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_vertices.mpr ⟨γ, hγR, hvγ⟩)
            exact False.elim (hvNotAct hvAct)
          · rcases hγF with ⟨B, hB⟩
            have hRet :
                Aout.retargetVertex outerStar v = v :=
              AdmissibleSubgraph.retargetVertex_of_not_mem Aout outerStar hvNotOut
            have hvM : v ∈ Mact.vertices := by
              have hvMret :
                  Aout.retargetVertex outerStar v ∈ Mact.vertices := by
                simpa [Mact, Aout, outerStar] using
                  forestComponentForestChoice_actualRemnant_vertices_mem_of_forest_vertex
                    g q hq ⟨γ, hγA⟩ hB hvγ
              exact hRet ▸ hvMret
            have hvAct : v ∈ Aact.vertices := by
              rw [hAactVertices]
              exact Finset.mem_union_right _ hvM
            exact False.elim (hvNotAct hvAct)
        · refine Finset.mem_union_left _ ?_
          exact Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨hvG, hvA⟩
      · rw [AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_starVertices] at hvOuterStar
        rcases hvOuterStar with ⟨δ, hδOut, rfl⟩
        dsimp [Aout] at hδOut
        change δ ∈
          (forestComponentChoiceLeftSubgraph q.1.1 q.2).elements ∪
            forestComponentChoicePromotedForestComponents q.1.1 q.2 at hδOut
        rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hδOut with hδL | hδP
        · refine Finset.mem_union_right _ ?_
          rw [hSplitStars, hLeftStars]
          exact Finset.mem_union_left _
            (AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_starVertices.mpr ⟨δ, hδL, rfl⟩)
        · have hvM : outerStar δ ∈ Mact.vertices := by
            simpa [Mact, outerStar] using
              forestComponentForestChoice_promoted_outer_star_mem_actual_remnant_vertices
                g q hq hδP
          have hvAct : outerStar δ ∈ Aact.vertices := by
            rw [hAactVertices]
            exact Finset.mem_union_right _ hvM
          exact False.elim (hvNotAct hvAct)
    · rw [AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_starVertices] at hvStarAct
      rcases hvStarAct with ⟨δ, hδAct, rfl⟩
      rw [forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientSubgraphCanonical_elements] at hδAct
      unfold forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientComponents at hδAct
      rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hδAct with hδR | hδM
      · refine Finset.mem_union_right _ ?_
        rw [hSplitStars, hRightStars]
        exact Finset.mem_union_right _
          (Finset.mem_union_left _
            (AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_starVertices.mpr ⟨δ, hδR, rfl⟩))
      · refine Finset.mem_union_right _ ?_
        rw [hSplitStars, hForestStars]
        exact Finset.mem_union_right _
          (Finset.mem_union_right _
            (AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_starVertices.mpr ⟨δ, by
              simpa [Mact] using hδM, rfl⟩))
  · intro hv
    rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hv with hvDiff | hvStar
    · rcases Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hvDiff with ⟨hvG, hvNotA⟩
      refine Finset.mem_union_left _ ?_
      refine Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hQvertices]
        refine Finset.mem_union_left _ ?_
        refine Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨hvG, ?_⟩
        intro hvOut
        exact hvNotA (hAoutSubsetA hvOut)
      · intro hvAct
        rw [hAactVertices] at hvAct
        rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hvAct with hvR | hvM
        · exact hvNotA (by
            have hvRorig : v ∈ R.vertices := hRactVertices ▸ hvR
            rcases AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_vertices.mp hvRorig with
              ⟨δ, hδ, hvδ⟩
            exact AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_vertices.mpr
              ⟨δ,
                forestComponentChoiceRightSubgraph_elements_subset
                  q.1.1 q.2 hδ, hvδ⟩)
        · exact hvNotA
            (forestComponentForestChoice_actualRemnant_vertex_mem_original_of_mem_graph
              g q hq (by simpa [Mact] using hvM) hvG)
    · rw [hSplitStars, hLeftStars, hRightStars, hForestStars] at hvStar
      rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hvStar with hvLStar | hvRest
      · refine Finset.mem_union_left _ ?_
        refine Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [hQvertices]
          have hvAoutStar : v ∈ Aout.starVertices outerStar := by
            rw [AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_starVertices] at hvLStar ⊢
            rcases hvLStar with ⟨γ, hγL, rfl⟩
            exact ⟨γ, by
              simpa [Aout] using
                forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex_mem_of_left
                  g q hq hγL, rfl⟩
          exact Finset.mem_union_right _ hvAoutStar
        · exact hLeftStarNotAct hvLStar
      · rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hvRest with hvRStar | hvMStar
        · refine Finset.mem_union_right _ ?_
          rw [AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_starVertices] at hvRStar
          rcases hvRStar with ⟨δ, hδR, rfl⟩
          exact AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_starVertices.mpr ⟨δ, by
            rw [forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientSubgraphCanonical_elements]
            unfold forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientComponents
            exact Finset.mem_union_left _ hδR, rfl⟩
        · refine Finset.mem_union_right _ ?_
          rw [AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_starVertices] at hvMStar
          rcases hvMStar with ⟨δ, hδM, rfl⟩
          exact AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_starVertices.mpr ⟨δ, by
            rw [forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientSubgraphCanonical_elements]
            unfold forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientComponents
            exact Finset.mem_union_right _ (by
              simpa [Mact] using hδM), rfl⟩

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentForestChoice_twoStep_retargetVertex_eq_splitStar_of_mem
statement:
private theorem
    forestComponentForestChoice_twoStep_retargetVertex_eq_splitStar_of_mem
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract] (g : HopfGen)
    (q : forestComponentChoiceSigma g)
    (hq : q ∈ forestComponentForestChoiceSigmaIndex g)
    (C : forestComponentForestChoiceRemnantPositiveComponentsCertificate
      g q hq)
    {v : VertexId} (hvG : v ∈ (repG g).toFeynmanGraph.vertices) :
    (forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientSubgraphCanonical
      g q hq).retargetVertex
        (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
          (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g
            (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq))
          (forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientSubgraphCanonical
            g q hq)
          (forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientSubgraphCanonical_mem_properDisjoint
            g q hq
            (forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientProperCertificateOfRemnantPositive
              g q hq C)))
        ((forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1.retargetVertex
          (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
            (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
            (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1
            (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).2)
          v) =
      q.1.1.retargetVertex
        (forestComponentForestChoiceSplitStarOf g q hq C) v
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let G₀ := (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
  let A := q.1.1
  let Aout := (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1
  let Q := forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g
    (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq)
  let Aact := forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientSubgraphCanonical
    g q hq
  let Ract := forestComponentForestChoiceActualRightQuotientSubgraphCanonical
    g q hq
  let Mact := forestComponentForestChoiceActualRemnantQuotientSubgraphCanonical
    g q hq
  let outerStar :=
    FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
      G₀ Aout (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).2
  let rightStar :=
    FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf Q Aact
      (by
        simpa [Q, Aact] using
          forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientSubgraphCanonical_mem_properDisjoint
            g q hq
            (forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientProperCertificateOfRemnantPositive
              g q hq C))
  let splitStar := forestComponentForestChoiceSplitStarOf g q hq C
  have hADisj : A.IsPairwiseDisjoint :=
    G₀.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs_isPairwiseDisjoint
      (by simpa [G₀, A] using q.1.2)
  have hAoutDisj : Aout.IsPairwiseDisjoint := by
    simpa [Aout] using
      G₀.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs_isPairwiseDisjoint
        (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).2
  have hAactDisj : Aact.IsPairwiseDisjoint :=
    Q.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs_isPairwiseDisjoint
      (by
        simpa [Q, Aact] using
          forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientSubgraphCanonical_mem_properDisjoint
            g q hq
            (forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientProperCertificateOfRemnantPositive
              g q hq C))
  have hAactVertices :
      Aact.vertices = Ract.vertices ∪ Mact.vertices := by
    simpa [Aact, Ract, Mact] using
      forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientSubgraphCanonical_vertices_eq_right_union_remnant
        g q hq
  have hRactVertices :
      Ract.vertices =
        (forestComponentChoiceRightSubgraph q.1.1 q.2).vertices := by
    simpa [Ract] using
      forestComponentForestChoiceActualRightQuotientSubgraphCanonical_vertices_eq_right
        g q hq
  have hAoutSubsetA : Aout.vertices ⊆ A.vertices := by
    intro u hu
    rcases AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_vertices.mp hu with ⟨δ, hδ, huδ⟩
    rcases
        forestComponentForestChoiceOuterSubgraph_mem_source
          q.1.1 q.2 hADisj
          (by simpa [Aout, forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex_val] using hδ) with
      ⟨γ, hγA, hδγ⟩
    exact AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_vertices.mpr ⟨γ, hγA, hδγ huδ⟩
  by_cases hvA : v ∈ A.vertices
  · let γ := A.componentAt hvA
    have hγA : γ ∈ A.elements := A.componentAt_mem hvA
    have hvγ : v ∈ γ.vertices := A.componentAt_vertex_mem hvA
    rcases forestComponentForestChoice_choice_left_or_right_or_forest
        g q hq hγA with hγL | hγR | hγF
    · have hγAout : γ ∈ Aout.elements := by
        simpa [Aout] using
          forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex_mem_of_left g q hq hγL
      have hOuter :
          Aout.retargetVertex outerStar v = outerStar γ := by
        exact AdmissibleSubgraph.retargetVertex_of_mem_component
          hAoutDisj outerStar hγAout hvγ
      have hOuterNotAct : outerStar γ ∉ Aact.vertices := by
        simpa [Aact, outerStar] using
          forestComponentForestChoice_left_outer_star_not_actual_quotient_vertices
            g q hq C hγL
      calc
        Aact.retargetVertex rightStar (Aout.retargetVertex outerStar v)
            = Aact.retargetVertex rightStar (outerStar γ) := by rw [hOuter]
        _ = outerStar γ := by
          exact AdmissibleSubgraph.retargetVertex_of_not_mem
            Aact rightStar hOuterNotAct
        _ = splitStar γ := by
          simpa [outerStar, splitStar] using
            (forestComponentForestChoiceSplitStarOf_left
              g q hq C hγL).symm
        _ = A.retargetVertex splitStar v := by
          rw [AdmissibleSubgraph.retargetVertex_of_mem_component
            hADisj splitStar hγA hvγ]
    · have hNotAout : v ∉ Aout.vertices := by
        simpa [Aout, forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex_val] using
          forestComponentChoiceRight_vertices_not_mem_forestOuterSubgraph
            q.1.1 q.2 hADisj hγR hvγ
      have hOuter : Aout.retargetVertex outerStar v = v :=
        AdmissibleSubgraph.retargetVertex_of_not_mem Aout outerStar hNotAout
      let δ :=
        admissibleSubgraphRetargetSubgraph Aout outerStar γ
          (forestComponentForestChoiceRightRetarget_edge_le g q hq γ hγR)
      have hδ : δ ∈ Aact.elements := by
        simpa [Aact, δ, Aout, outerStar] using
          forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientSubgraphCanonical_mem_of_right
            g q hq hγR
      have hvδ : v ∈ δ.vertices := by
        change v ∈ γ.vertices.image (Aout.retargetVertex outerStar)
        exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨v, hvγ, hOuter⟩
      calc
        Aact.retargetVertex rightStar (Aout.retargetVertex outerStar v)
            = Aact.retargetVertex rightStar v := by rw [hOuter]
        _ = rightStar δ := by
          exact AdmissibleSubgraph.retargetVertex_of_mem_component
            hAactDisj rightStar hδ hvδ
        _ = splitStar γ := by
          simpa [Aout, outerStar, Q, Aact, rightStar, splitStar, δ] using
            (forestComponentForestChoiceSplitStarOf_right
              g q hq C hγR).symm
        _ = A.retargetVertex splitStar v := by
          rw [AdmissibleSubgraph.retargetVertex_of_mem_component
            hADisj splitStar hγA hvγ]
    · rcases hγF with ⟨B, hB⟩
      let δ :=
        admissibleSubgraphQuotientRemainderSubgraph Aout outerStar γ
      have hδ : δ ∈ Aact.elements := by
        simpa [Aact, δ, Aout, outerStar] using
          forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientSubgraphCanonical_mem_of_forest
            g q hq ⟨γ, hγA⟩ hB
      have hvδ :
          Aout.retargetVertex outerStar v ∈ δ.vertices := by
        change Aout.retargetVertex outerStar v ∈
          γ.vertices.image (Aout.retargetVertex outerStar)
        exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨v, hvγ, rfl⟩
      calc
        Aact.retargetVertex rightStar (Aout.retargetVertex outerStar v)
            = rightStar δ := by
          exact AdmissibleSubgraph.retargetVertex_of_mem_component
            hAactDisj rightStar hδ hvδ
        _ = splitStar γ := by
          simpa [Aout, outerStar, Q, Aact, rightStar, splitStar, δ] using
            (forestComponentForestChoiceSplitStarOf_forest
              g q hq C ⟨γ, hγA⟩ hB).symm
        _ = A.retargetVertex splitStar v := by
          rw [AdmissibleSubgraph.retargetVertex_of_mem_component
            hADisj splitStar hγA hvγ]
  · have hNotAout : v ∉ Aout.vertices := fun hvOut =>
      hvA (hAoutSubsetA hvOut)
    have hNotAct : v ∉ Aact.vertices := by
      intro hvAct
      rw [hAactVertices] at hvAct
      rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hvAct with hvR | hvM
      · have hvRorig :
            v ∈ (forestComponentChoiceRightSubgraph q.1.1 q.2).vertices :=
          hRactVertices ▸ hvR
        exact hvA (by
          rcases AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_vertices.mp hvRorig with
            ⟨δ, hδ, hvδ⟩
          exact AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_vertices.mpr
            ⟨δ,
              forestComponentChoiceRightSubgraph_elements_subset
                q.1.1 q.2 hδ, hvδ⟩)
      · exact hvA
          (forestComponentForestChoice_actualRemnant_vertex_mem_original_of_mem_graph
            g q hq (by simpa [Mact] using hvM) (by simpa [G₀] using hvG))
    have hOuter : Aout.retargetVertex outerStar v = v :=
      AdmissibleSubgraph.retargetVertex_of_not_mem Aout outerStar hNotAout
    calc
      Aact.retargetVertex rightStar (Aout.retargetVertex outerStar v)
          = Aact.retargetVertex rightStar v := by rw [hOuter]
      _ = v := by
        exact AdmissibleSubgraph.retargetVertex_of_not_mem
          Aact rightStar hNotAct
      _ = A.retargetVertex splitStar v := by
        rw [AdmissibleSubgraph.retargetVertex_of_not_mem A splitStar hvA]

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentForestChoice_twoStep_retargetExternalLeg_eq_splitStar
statement:
private theorem
    forestComponentForestChoice_twoStep_retargetExternalLeg_eq_splitStar
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract] (g : HopfGen)
    (q : forestComponentChoiceSigma g)

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientSubgraphCanonical_internalEdges_eq_right_add_remnant
statement:
private theorem
    forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientSubgraphCanonical_internalEdges_eq_right_add_remnant
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract] (g : HopfGen)
    (q : forestComponentChoiceSigma g)
    (hq : q ∈ forestComponentForestChoiceSigmaIndex g) :
    (forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientSubgraphCanonical
      g q hq).internalEdges =
      (forestComponentForestChoiceActualRightQuotientSubgraphCanonical
        g q hq).internalEdges +
        (forestComponentForestChoiceActualRemnantQuotientSubgraphCanonical
          g q hq).internalEdges
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let R := forestComponentForestChoiceActualRightQuotientSubgraphCanonical g q hq
  let M := forestComponentForestChoiceActualRemnantQuotientSubgraphCanonical g q hq
  have hDisj : Disjoint R.elements M.elements := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
    intro δ hδR hδM
    have hδM' : δ ∈ forestComponentForestChoiceRemnantComponents g q hq := by
      simpa [M] using hδM
    have hSelfDisj : δ.Disjoint δ :=
      forestComponentForestChoiceRightRemnant_disjoint g q hq
        δ (by simpa [R] using hδR) δ hδM'
    have hPos :
        0 < δ.internalEdges.card :=
      forestComponentForestChoiceActualRightQuotientSubgraphCanonical_hasPositiveInternalEdgesComponents
        g q hq δ (by simpa [R] using hδR)
    rcases Multiset.exists_mem_of_ne_zero (Multiset.card_pos.mp hPos) with
      ⟨e, he⟩
    have hsupp := δ.edges_supported e he
    simp [FeynmanEdge.SupportedOn] at hsupp
    exact (Finset.disjoint_left.mp hSelfDisj hsupp.1) hsupp.1
  unfold AdmissibleSubgraph.internalEdges
  rw [forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientSubgraphCanonical_elements]
  unfold forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientComponents
  rw [Finset.sum_union (by simpa [R, M] using hDisj)]
  rw [forestComponentForestChoiceActualRemnantQuotientSubgraphCanonical_elements]

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentForestChoiceActualRightQuotientSubgraphCanonical_internalEdges_eq_right
statement:
private theorem
    forestComponentForestChoiceActualRightQuotientSubgraphCanonical_internalEdges_eq_right
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract] (g : HopfGen)
    (q : forestComponentChoiceSigma g)
    (hq : q ∈ forestComponentForestChoiceSigmaIndex g) :
    (forestComponentForestChoiceActualRightQuotientSubgraphCanonical
      g q hq).internalEdges =
      (forestComponentChoiceRightSubgraph q.1.1 q.2).internalEdges
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hDisj : q.1.1.IsPairwiseDisjoint :=
    (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
      |>.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs_isPairwiseDisjoint q.1.2
  let Aout := (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1
  let starOf :=
    FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
      (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
      (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1
      (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).2
  let R := forestComponentChoiceRightSubgraph q.1.1 q.2
  have hV :
      ∀ η ∈ R.elements, ∀ v ∈ η.vertices, v ∉ Aout.vertices := by
    intro η hη v hv
    simpa [Aout, R, forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex_val] using
      forestComponentChoiceRight_vertices_not_mem_forestOuterSubgraph
        q.1.1 q.2 hDisj hη hv
  have hinj :=
    admissibleSubgraphRetarget_injective_of_not_mem
      Aout starOf R
      (fun η hη =>
        (forestComponentForestChoiceRightRetargetCertificateCanonical
          g q hq).edge_le η hη)
      hV
  unfold AdmissibleSubgraph.internalEdges
  change
    (∑ δ ∈
        (R.elements.attach.image fun γ =>
          admissibleSubgraphRetargetSubgraph
            Aout starOf γ.1
            ((forestComponentForestChoiceRightRetargetCertificateCanonical
              g q hq).edge_le γ.1 γ.2)),
        δ.internalEdges) =
      ∑ γ ∈ R.elements, γ.internalEdges
  rw [Finset.sum_image]
  · trans ∑ γ ∈ R.elements.attach, γ.1.internalEdges
    · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro γ _hγ
      exact admissibleSubgraphRetargetSubgraph_internalEdges_eq_of_not_mem
        Aout starOf γ.1
        ((forestComponentForestChoiceRightRetargetCertificateCanonical
          g q hq).edge_le γ.1 γ.2)
        (hV γ.1 γ.2)
    · rw [Finset.sum_attach]
  · intro γ₁ _ γ₂ _ hEq
    exact hinj hEq

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentForestChoice_right_internalEdges_outerRetarget_eq
statement:

        ((forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1.retargetEdge
          (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
            (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
            (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1
            (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).2)) =
      (forestComponentChoiceRightSubgraph q.1.1 q.2).internalEdges
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hDisj : q.1.1.IsPairwiseDisjoint :=
    (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
      |>.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs_isPairwiseDisjoint q.1.2
  let Aout := (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1
  let starOf :=
    FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf

  let R := forestComponentChoiceRightSubgraph q.1.1 q.2
  have hV :
      ∀ η ∈ R.elements, ∀ v ∈ η.vertices, v ∉ Aout.vertices := by

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentForestChoice_right_internalEdges_le_outer_complement
statement:
private theorem forestComponentForestChoice_right_internalEdges_le_outer_complement
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract] (g : HopfGen)
    (q : forestComponentChoiceSigma g)
    (hq : q ∈ forestComponentForestChoiceSigmaIndex g) :
    (forestComponentChoiceRightSubgraph q.1.1 q.2).internalEdges ≤
      (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1.complementEdges
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let R := forestComponentChoiceRightSubgraph q.1.1 q.2
  have hDisj : q.1.1.IsPairwiseDisjoint :=
    (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
      |>.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs_isPairwiseDisjoint q.1.2
  have hRDisj : R.IsPairwiseDisjoint := by
    simpa [R] using
      forestComponentChoiceRightSubgraph_isPairwiseDisjoint q.1.1 q.2 hDisj
  rw [Multiset.le_iff_count]
  intro e
  by_cases heR : e ∈ R.internalEdges
  · rcases AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_internalEdges.mp heR with ⟨γ, hγ, heγ⟩
    have hzero :
        ∀ δ ∈ R.elements, δ ≠ γ → δ.internalEdges.count e = 0 := by
      intro δ hδ hne
      by_cases heδ : e ∈ δ.internalEdges
      · have hdisj := hRDisj hδ hγ hne
        have hsuppδ := δ.edges_supported e heδ
        have hsuppγ := γ.edges_supported e heγ
        simp [FeynmanEdge.SupportedOn] at hsuppδ hsuppγ
        exact False.elim ((Finset.disjoint_left.mp hdisj hsuppδ.1) hsuppγ.1)
      · exact Multiset.count_eq_zero.mpr heδ
    unfold AdmissibleSubgraph.internalEdges
    rw [multiset_count_finset_sum]
    calc
      (∑ x ∈ R.elements, Multiset.count e x.internalEdges)
          = γ.internalEdges.count e := by
            rw [Finset.sum_eq_single γ]
            · intro δ hδ hne
              exact hzero δ hδ hne
            · intro hγnot
              exact False.elim (hγnot hγ)
      _ ≤ ((forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1.complementEdges).count e :=
          Multiset.count_le_of_le e
            (forestComponentChoiceRight_internalEdges_le_forestOuter_complement
              q.1.1 q.2 hDisj hγ)
  · rw [Multiset.count_eq_zero.mpr heR]
    exact Nat.zero_le _

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentForestChoice_splitStar_internalEdges_eq_of_complement
statement:
private theorem forestComponentForestChoice_splitStar_internalEdges_eq_of_complement
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract] (g : HopfGen)
    (q : forestComponentChoiceSigma g)
    (hq : q ∈ forestComponentForestChoiceSigmaIndex g)
    (C : forestComponentForestChoiceRemnantPositiveComponentsCertificate
      g q hq)
    (hComplement :
      (forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientSubgraphCanonical
        g q hq).complementEdges =
        q.1.1.complementEdges.map
          ((forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1.retargetEdge
            (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
              (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
              (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1
              (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).2))) :
    (forestComponentForestChoiceActualRightContractGraph g q hq C).internalEdges =
      (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestContractGraphWithStars
        (repG g).toFeynmanGraph q.1.1
        (forestComponentForestChoiceSplitStarOf g q hq C)).internalEdges
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let G₀ := (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
  let A := q.1.1
  let Aout := (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1
  let Q := forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g
    (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq)
  let Aact := forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientSubgraphCanonical g q hq
  let outerStar :=
    FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
      G₀ Aout (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).2
  let rightStar :=
    FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf Q Aact
      (by
        simpa [Q, Aact] using
          forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientSubgraphCanonical_mem_properDisjoint
            g q hq
            (forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientProperCertificateOfRemnantPositive
              g q hq C))
  let splitStar := forestComponentForestChoiceSplitStarOf g q hq C
  simp only [forestComponentForestChoiceActualRightContractGraph,
    FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestContractGraphWithStars_eq,
    AdmissibleSubgraph.contractWithStars_internalEdges]
  calc
    Aact.complementEdges.map (Aact.retargetEdge rightStar)
        = (A.complementEdges.map (Aout.retargetEdge outerStar)).map
            (Aact.retargetEdge rightStar) := by
          rw [hComplement]
    _ = A.complementEdges.map
          ((Aact.retargetEdge rightStar) ∘ (Aout.retargetEdge outerStar)) := by
          rw [Multiset.map_map]
    _ = A.complementEdges.map (A.retargetEdge splitStar) := by
          refine Multiset.map_congr rfl ?_
          intro e he
          have heG : e ∈ G₀.internalEdges := by
            simpa [G₀, A] using A.mem_ambientInternalEdges_of_mem_complementEdges he
          exact forestComponentForestChoice_twoStep_retargetEdge_eq_splitStar_of_mem
            g q hq C heG

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentForestChoice_actualQuotient_complementEdges_eq_original_complement_map_of_internalEdges
statement:
private theorem
    forestComponentForestChoice_actualQuotient_complementEdges_eq_original_complement_map_of_internalEdges
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract] (g : HopfGen)
    (q : forestComponentChoiceSigma g)
    (hq : q ∈ forestComponentForestChoiceSigmaIndex g)
    (hInternal :
      (forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientSubgraphCanonical
        g q hq).internalEdges =
        (q.1.1.internalEdges -
          (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1.internalEdges).map
          ((forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1.retargetEdge
            (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
              (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
              (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1
              (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).2))) :
    (forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientSubgraphCanonical
      g q hq).complementEdges =
      q.1.1.complementEdges.map
        ((forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1.retargetEdge
          (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
            (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
            (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1
            (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).2))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let G₀ := (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
  let A := q.1.1
  let Aout := (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).1
  let Q := forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g
    (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq)
  let Aact := forestComponentForestChoiceActualQuotientSubgraphCanonical g q hq
  let outerStar :=
    FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
      G₀ Aout (forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex g q hq).2
  have hADisj : A.IsPairwiseDisjoint :=
    G₀.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs_isPairwiseDisjoint
      (by simpa [G₀, A] using q.1.2)
  have hpCore : q.2 ∈ forestComponentCoreChoiceIndex A := by
    exact (mem_forestComponentForestChoiceCoreIndex_core_hasForest
      ((Finset.mem_sigma.mp hq).2)).1
  have hA_le_G : A.internalEdges ≤ G₀.internalEdges :=
    admissibleSubgraph_internalEdges_le_of_pairwise A hADisj
  have hAout_le_A : Aout.internalEdges ≤ A.internalEdges := by
    simpa [Aout, A, forestComponentForestChoiceOuterIndex_val] using
      forestComponentForestChoiceOuterSubgraph_internalEdges_le_original
        q.1.1 q.2 hpCore hADisj
  have hDiff_le :
      A.internalEdges - Aout.internalEdges ≤
        G₀.internalEdges - Aout.internalEdges := by
    rw [Multiset.le_iff_count]
    intro e
    rw [Multiset.count_sub, Multiset.count_sub]
    have hcount := Multiset.count_le_of_le e hA_le_G
    omega
  have hSubSub :
      (G₀.internalEdges - Aout.internalEdges) -
          (A.internalEdges - Aout.internalEdges) =
        G₀.internalEdges - A.internalEdges := by
    refine Multiset.ext.mpr ?_
    intro e
    simp only [Multiset.count_sub]
    have hAoutA := Multiset.count_le_of_le e hAout_le_A
    have hAG := Multiset.count_le_of_le e hA_le_G
    omega
  have hQinternal :
      Q.internalEdges =
        (G₀.internalEdges - Aout.internalEdges).map
          (Aout.retargetEdge outerStar) := by
    simp [Q, G₀, Aout, outerStar, forestOuterActualQuotientGraph,
      FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestContractGraphWithStars_eq,
      AdmissibleSubgraph.contractWithStars_internalEdges,
      AdmissibleSubgraph.complementEdges]
  unfold AdmissibleSubgraph.complementEdges
  calc
    Q.internalEdges - Aact.internalEdges =
        (G₀.internalEdges - Aout.internalEdges).map
          (Aout.retargetEdge outerStar) -
          (A.internalEdges - Aout.internalEdges).map
            (Aout.retargetEdge outerStar) := by
          rw [hQinternal]
          rw [hInternal]
    _ = ((G₀.internalEdges - Aout.internalEdges) -
            (A.internalEdges - Aout.internalEdges)).map
          (Aout.retargetEdge outerStar) := by
          exact (multiset_map_sub_of_le (Aout.retargetEdge outerStar)
            hDiff_le).symm
    _ = (G₀.internalEdges - A.internalEdges).map
          (Aout.retargetEdge outerStar) := by
          rw [hSubSub]

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentMixedBoundary_splitStar_vertices_eq
statement:

proof:

  classical

  let L := forestComponentChoiceLeftSubgraph q.1.1 q.2
  let R := forestComponentChoiceRightSubgraph q.1.1 q.2
  let A := q.1.1

  let outerStar :=
    FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
      G₀ Aout (forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex g q hq).2
  let rightStar :=
    FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
      Q Aact
      (by
        simpa [Q, Aact] using
          forestComponentMixedBoundaryActualRightQuotientSubgraphCanonical_mem_properDisjoint
            g q hq)
  let splitStar := forestComponentMixedBoundarySplitStarOf g q hq
  have hQvertices :
      Q.vertices = (G₀.vertices \ L.vertices) ∪ L.starVertices outerStar := by
    simp [Q, G₀, forestOuterActualQuotientGraph, L, Aout, outerStar,
      forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex_val,
      FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestContractGraphWithStars_eq,
      AdmissibleSubgraph.contractWithStars_vertices]
  have hAactVertices : Aact.vertices = R.vertices := by
    simpa [Aact, R] using
      forestComponentMixedBoundaryActualRightQuotientSubgraphCanonical_vertices_eq_right
        g q hq
  have hAvertices : A.vertices = L.vertices ∪ R.vertices := by
    simpa [A, L, R] using
      (forestComponentMixedBoundary_left_union_right_vertices g q hq).symm
  have hSplitStars :
      A.starVertices splitStar =
        L.starVertices splitStar ∪ R.starVertices splitStar := by
    simpa [A, L, R, splitStar] using
      forestComponentMixedBoundary_splitStar_starVertices_eq_union g q hq
  have hLeftStars :
      L.starVertices splitStar = L.starVertices outerStar := by
    simpa [L, Aout, outerStar, splitStar] using
      forestComponentMixedBoundary_left_splitStar_starVertices_eq_outer g q hq
  have hRightStars :
      R.starVertices splitStar = Aact.starVertices rightStar := by
    simpa [R, Aact, Q, rightStar, splitStar] using
      forestComponentMixedBoundary_right_splitStar_starVertices_eq_actualRight
        g q hq
  have hLStarFresh :
      ∀ {v}, v ∈ L.starVertices outerStar → v ∉ G₀.vertices := by
    intro v hv
    rw [AdmissibleSubgraph.mem_starVertices] at hv
    rcases hv with ⟨γ, hγL, rfl⟩
    have hFresh :
        Aout.IsFreshStarAssignment outerStar := by
      simpa [G₀, Aout, outerStar] using
        FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf_isFreshStarAssignment
          (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
          (forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex g q hq).1
          (forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex g q hq).2
    exact hFresh.fresh (by
      simpa [Aout, L, forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex_val] using hγL)
  have hRsubsetG : R.vertices ⊆ G₀.vertices := by
    intro v hv
    simpa [G₀, R] using R.vertices_subset hv
  simp only [forestComponentMixedBoundaryActualRightContractGraph,
    FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestContractGraphWithStars_eq,
    AdmissibleSubgraph.contractWithStars_vertices]
  ext v
  constructor
  · intro hv
    rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hv with hvDiff | hvStarR
    · rcases Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hvDiff with ⟨hvQ, hvNotAct⟩
      rw [hQvertices] at hvQ
      rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hvQ with hvGnotL | hvLStar
      · rcases Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hvGnotL with ⟨hvG, hvNotL⟩
        refine Finset.mem_union_left _ ?_
        refine Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨hvG, ?_⟩
        rw [hAvertices, Finset.mem_union]
        exact fun hLR => hLR.elim hvNotL (fun hvR =>
          hvNotAct (by exact hAactVertices.symm ▸ hvR))
      · refine Finset.mem_union_right _ ?_
        rw [hSplitStars, hLeftStars]
        exact Finset.mem_union_left _ hvLStar
    · refine Finset.mem_union_right _ ?_
      rw [hSplitStars, hRightStars]
      exact Finset.mem_union_right _ hvStarR
  · intro hv
    rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hv with hvDiff | hvStar
    · rcases Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hvDiff with ⟨hvG, hvNotA⟩
      refine Finset.mem_union_left _ ?_
      refine Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hQvertices]
        refine Finset.mem_union_left _ ?_
        refine Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨hvG, ?_⟩
        intro hvL
        exact hvNotA (by
          rw [hAvertices, Finset.mem_union]
          exact Or.inl hvL)
      · intro hvAct
        exact hvNotA (by
          rw [hAvertices, Finset.mem_union]
          exact Or.inr (by exact hAactVertices ▸ hvAct))
    · rw [hSplitStars, hLeftStars, hRightStars] at hvStar
      rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hvStar with hvLStar | hvRStar
      · refine Finset.mem_union_left _ ?_
        refine Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [hQvertices]
          exact Finset.mem_union_right _ hvLStar
        · intro hvAct
          exact hLStarFresh hvLStar (hRsubsetG (by
            exact hAactVertices ▸ hvAct))
      · exact Finset.mem_union_right _ hvRStar

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentMixedBoundary_twoStep_retargetVertex_eq_splitStar
statement:
private theorem forestComponentMixedBoundary_twoStep_retargetVertex_eq_splitStar
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract] (g : HopfGen)
    (q : forestComponentChoiceSigma g)
    (hq : q ∈ forestComponentMixedBoundaryChoiceSigmaIndex g)
    (v : VertexId) :
    (forestComponentMixedBoundaryActualRightQuotientSubgraphCanonical
      g q hq).retargetVertex
        (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
          (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g
            (forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex g q hq))
          (forestComponentMixedBoundaryActualRightQuotientSubgraphCanonical
            g q hq)
          (forestComponentMixedBoundaryActualRightQuotientSubgraphCanonical_mem_properDisjoint
            g q hq))
        ((forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex g q hq).1.retargetVertex
          (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
            (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
            (forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex g q hq).1
            (forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex g q hq).2)
          v) =
      q.1.1.retargetVertex
        (forestComponentMixedBoundarySplitStarOf g q hq) v
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let G₀ := (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
  let A := q.1.1
  let L := forestComponentChoiceLeftSubgraph q.1.1 q.2
  let R := forestComponentChoiceRightSubgraph q.1.1 q.2
  let Aout := (forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex g q hq).1
  let Q := forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g
    (forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex g q hq)
  let Aact := forestComponentMixedBoundaryActualRightQuotientSubgraphCanonical
    g q hq
  let outerStar :=
    FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
      G₀ Aout (forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex g q hq).2
  let rightStar :=
    FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf Q Aact
      (by
        simpa [Q, Aact] using
          forestComponentMixedBoundaryActualRightQuotientSubgraphCanonical_mem_properDisjoint
            g q hq)
  let splitStar := forestComponentMixedBoundarySplitStarOf g q hq
  have hADisj : A.IsPairwiseDisjoint :=
    G₀.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs_isPairwiseDisjoint
      (by simpa [G₀, A] using q.1.2)
  have hAoutDisj : Aout.IsPairwiseDisjoint := by
    simpa [Aout, L, forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex_val] using
      forestComponentChoiceLeftSubgraph_isPairwiseDisjoint q.1.1 q.2 hADisj
  have hAactDisj : Aact.IsPairwiseDisjoint :=
    Q.properDisjointAdmissibleDivergentSubgraphs_isPairwiseDisjoint
      (by
        simpa [Q, Aact] using
          forestComponentMixedBoundaryActualRightQuotientSubgraphCanonical_mem_properDisjoint
            g q hq)
  have hAoutVertices : Aout.vertices = L.vertices := by
    simpa [Aout, L, forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex_val]
  have hAactVertices : Aact.vertices = R.vertices := by
    simpa [Aact, R] using
      forestComponentMixedBoundaryActualRightQuotientSubgraphCanonical_vertices_eq_right
        g q hq
  have hAvertices : A.vertices = L.vertices ∪ R.vertices := by
    simpa [A, L, R] using
      (forestComponentMixedBoundary_left_union_right_vertices g q hq).symm
  by_cases hvA : v ∈ A.vertices
  · let γ := A.componentAt hvA
    have hγA : γ ∈ A.elements := A.componentAt_mem hvA
    have hvγ : v ∈ γ.vertices := A.componentAt_vertex_mem hvA
    rcases forestComponentMixedBoundary_choice_left_or_right g q hq γ hγA with
      hγL | hγR
    · have hγAout : γ ∈ Aout.elements := by
        simpa [Aout, L, forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex_val] using hγL
      have hOuter :
          Aout.retargetVertex outerStar v = outerStar γ := by
        exact AdmissibleSubgraph.retargetVertex_of_mem_component
          hAoutDisj outerStar hγAout hvγ
      have hFreshOuter :
          Aout.IsFreshStarAssignment outerStar := by
        simpa [G₀, Aout, outerStar] using
          FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf_isFreshStarAssignment
            (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
            (forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex g q hq).1
            (forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex g q hq).2
      have hOuterNotAct : outerStar γ ∉ Aact.vertices := by
        intro hvAct
        have hvR : outerStar γ ∈ R.vertices := by
          exact hAactVertices ▸ hvAct
        exact hFreshOuter.fresh hγAout (R.vertices_subset hvR)
      calc
        Aact.retargetVertex rightStar (Aout.retargetVertex outerStar v)
            = Aact.retargetVertex rightStar (outerStar γ) := by rw [hOuter]
        _ = outerStar γ := by
          exact AdmissibleSubgraph.retargetVertex_of_not_mem
            Aact rightStar hOuterNotAct
        _ = splitStar γ := by
          simpa [outerStar, splitStar] using
            (forestComponentMixedBoundarySplitStarOf_left
              g q hq hγL).symm
        _ = A.retargetVertex splitStar v := by
          rw [AdmissibleSubgraph.retargetVertex_of_mem_component
            hADisj splitStar hγA hvγ]
    · have hNotAout : v ∉ Aout.vertices := by
        intro hvOut
        have hvL : v ∈ L.vertices := by
          exact hAoutVertices ▸ hvOut
        exact forestComponentChoiceRight_vertices_not_mem_leftSubgraph
          q.1.1 q.2 hADisj hγR hvγ hvL
      have hOuter : Aout.retargetVertex outerStar v = v :=
        AdmissibleSubgraph.retargetVertex_of_not_mem Aout outerStar hNotAout
      let δ :=
        admissibleSubgraphRetargetSubgraph
          Aout outerStar γ
          (forestComponentMixedBoundaryRightRetarget_edge_le g q hq γ hγR)
      have hδ : δ ∈ Aact.elements := by
        simpa [Aout, outerStar, Aact, δ] using
          forestComponentMixedBoundaryActualRightQuotientSubgraphCanonical_mem_of_right
            g q hq hγR
      have hvδ : v ∈ δ.vertices := by
        change v ∈ γ.vertices.image (Aout.retargetVertex outerStar)
        exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨v, hvγ, hOuter⟩
      calc
        Aact.retargetVertex rightStar (Aout.retargetVertex outerStar v)
            = Aact.retargetVertex rightStar v := by rw [hOuter]
        _ = rightStar δ := by
          exact AdmissibleSubgraph.retargetVertex_of_mem_component
            hAactDisj rightStar hδ hvδ
        _ = splitStar γ := by
          simpa [Aout, outerStar, Q, Aact, rightStar, splitStar, δ] using
            (forestComponentMixedBoundarySplitStarOf_right
              g q hq hγR).symm
        _ = A.retargetVertex splitStar v := by
          rw [AdmissibleSubgraph.retargetVertex_of_mem_component
            hADisj splitStar hγA hvγ]
  · have hNotAout : v ∉ Aout.vertices := by
      intro hvOut
      apply hvA
      rw [hAvertices]
      exact Finset.mem_union_left _ (by exact hAoutVertices ▸ hvOut)
    have hNotAct : v ∉ Aact.vertices := by
      intro hvAct
      apply hvA
      rw [hAvertices]
      exact Finset.mem_union_right _ (by exact hAactVertices ▸ hvAct)
    have hOuter : Aout.retargetVertex outerStar v = v :=
      AdmissibleSubgraph.retargetVertex_of_not_mem Aout outerStar hNotAout
    calc
      Aact.retargetVertex rightStar (Aout.retargetVertex outerStar v)
          = Aact.retargetVertex rightStar v := by rw [hOuter]
      _ = v := by
        exact AdmissibleSubgraph.retargetVertex_of_not_mem
          Aact rightStar hNotAct
      _ = A.retargetVertex splitStar v := by
        rw [AdmissibleSubgraph.retargetVertex_of_not_mem A splitStar hvA]

statement:

        (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf

            (forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex g q hq))
          (forestComponentMixedBoundaryActualRightQuotientSubgraphCanonical
            g q hq)
          (forestComponentMixedBoundaryActualRightQuotientSubgraphCanonical_mem_properDisjoint

          (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf

proof:

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentMixedBoundary_twoStep_retargetEdge_eq_splitStar
statement:
private theorem forestComponentMixedBoundary_twoStep_retargetEdge_eq_splitStar
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract] (g : HopfGen)
    (q : forestComponentChoiceSigma g)
    (hq : q ∈ forestComponentMixedBoundaryChoiceSigmaIndex g)

      g q hq).retargetEdge
        (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
          (forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g
            (forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex g q hq))
          (forestComponentMixedBoundaryActualRightQuotientSubgraphCanonical
            g q hq)

          (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
            (repG g).toFeynmanGraph

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentMixedBoundary_splitStar_externalLegs_eq
statement:
private theorem forestComponentMixedBoundary_splitStar_externalLegs_eq
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract] (g : HopfGen)

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentMixedBoundary_splitStar_internalEdges_eq
statement:
private theorem forestComponentMixedBoundary_splitStar_internalEdges_eq
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract] (g : HopfGen)
    (q : forestComponentChoiceSigma g)
    (hq : q ∈ forestComponentMixedBoundaryChoiceSigmaIndex g) :
    (forestComponentMixedBoundaryActualRightContractGraph g q hq).internalEdges =
      (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestContractGraphWithStars
        (repG g).toFeynmanGraph q.1.1
        (forestComponentMixedBoundarySplitStarOf g q hq)).internalEdges
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let G₀ := (repG g).toFeynmanGraph
  let A := q.1.1
  let L := forestComponentChoiceLeftSubgraph q.1.1 q.2
  let R := forestComponentChoiceRightSubgraph q.1.1 q.2
  let Aout := (forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex g q hq).1
  let Q := forestOuterActualQuotientGraph g
    (forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex g q hq)
  let Aact := forestComponentMixedBoundaryActualRightQuotientSubgraphCanonical
    g q hq
  let outerStar :=
    FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf
      G₀ Aout (forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex g q hq).2
  let rightStar :=
    FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestCanonicalStarOf Q Aact
      (by
        simpa [Q, Aact] using
          forestComponentMixedBoundaryActualRightQuotientSubgraphCanonical_mem_properDisjoint
            g q hq)
  let splitStar := forestComponentMixedBoundarySplitStarOf g q hq
  have hRle : R.internalEdges ≤ L.complementEdges := by
    simpa [L, R] using
      forestComponentMixedBoundary_right_internalEdges_le_left_complement
        g q hq
  have hRmap :
      R.internalEdges.map (Aout.retargetEdge outerStar) =
        R.internalEdges := by
    simpa [Aout, outerStar, R] using
      forestComponentMixedBoundary_right_internalEdges_outerRetarget_eq
        g q hq
  have hAactI : Aact.internalEdges = R.internalEdges := by
    simpa [Aact, R] using
      forestComponentMixedBoundaryActualRightQuotientSubgraphCanonical_internalEdges_eq_right
        g q hq
  have hSplit :
      A.internalEdges = L.internalEdges + R.internalEdges := by
    simpa [A, L, R] using
      forestComponentMixedBoundary_left_union_right_internalEdges g q hq
  have hQinternal :
      Q.internalEdges =
        (G₀.internalEdges - L.internalEdges).map (Aout.retargetEdge outerStar) := by
    simp [Q, G₀, L, Aout, outerStar, forestOuterActualQuotientGraph,
      forestComponentMixedBoundaryOuterIndex_val,
      FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestContractGraphWithStars_eq,
      AdmissibleSubgraph.contractWithStars_internalEdges,
      AdmissibleSubgraph.complementEdges]
  have hAactComplement :
      Aact.complementEdges =
        ((G₀.internalEdges - L.internalEdges) - R.internalEdges).map
          (Aout.retargetEdge outerStar) := by
    unfold AdmissibleSubgraph.complementEdges
    calc
      Q.internalEdges - Aact.internalEdges
          = (G₀.internalEdges - L.internalEdges).map
              (Aout.retargetEdge outerStar) - R.internalEdges := by
            rw [hQinternal, hAactI]
      _ = (G₀.internalEdges - L.internalEdges).map
              (Aout.retargetEdge outerStar) -
            R.internalEdges.map (Aout.retargetEdge outerStar) := by
            rw [hRmap]
      _ = ((G₀.internalEdges - L.internalEdges) - R.internalEdges).map
              (Aout.retargetEdge outerStar) := by
            exact (multiset_map_sub_of_le (Aout.retargetEdge outerStar)
              (by simpa [L] using hRle)).symm
  have hComplementSource :
      (G₀.internalEdges - L.internalEdges) - R.internalEdges =
        G₀.internalEdges - A.internalEdges := by
    rw [hSplit, Multiset.sub_add_eq_sub_sub]
  simp only [forestComponentMixedBoundaryActualRightContractGraph,
    FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestContractGraphWithStars_eq,
    AdmissibleSubgraph.contractWithStars_internalEdges]
  calc
    Aact.complementEdges.map (Aact.retargetEdge rightStar)
        =
      (((G₀.internalEdges - L.internalEdges) - R.internalEdges).map
          (Aout.retargetEdge outerStar)).map (Aact.retargetEdge rightStar) := by
        rw [hAactComplement]
    _ =
      ((G₀.internalEdges - L.internalEdges) - R.internalEdges).map
        ((Aact.retargetEdge rightStar) ∘ (Aout.retargetEdge outerStar)) := by
        rw [Multiset.map_map]
    _ =
      ((G₀.internalEdges - L.internalEdges) - R.internalEdges).map
        (A.retargetEdge splitStar) := by
        refine Multiset.map_congr rfl ?_
        intro e _he
        exact forestComponentMixedBoundary_twoStep_retargetEdge_eq_splitStar
          g q hq e
    _ = (G₀.internalEdges - A.internalEdges).map (A.retargetEdge splitStar) := by
        rw [hComplementSource]
    _ = A.complementEdges.map (A.retargetEdge splitStar) := by
        unfold AdmissibleSubgraph.complementEdges
        simp [G₀]

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentForestChoiceSplitStarReducedFieldModelOfBranches
statement:

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.graph_eq_mapPerm_inv_of_eq_mapPerm
statement:
private theorem graph_eq_mapPerm_inv_of_eq_mapPerm
    (G₀ G₁ : FeynmanGraph) (τ : Equiv.Perm VertexId)
    (h : G₀ = G₁.mapPerm τ) :
    G₁ = G₀.mapPerm τ⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  calc
    G₁ = G₁.mapPerm (1 : Equiv.Perm VertexId) := (FeynmanGraph.mapPerm_one G₁).symm
    _ = G₁.mapPerm (τ⁻¹ * τ) := by simp
    _ = (G₁.mapPerm τ).mapPerm τ⁻¹ := by
      rw [← FeynmanGraph.mapPerm_mul]
    _ = G₀.mapPerm τ⁻¹ := by
      rw [← h]

name: GaugeGeometry.QFT.Combinatorial.forestComponentActualRightContractionFieldRelabelingOfSplitStarModel
statement:
private theorem forestComponentActualRightContractionFieldRelabelingOfSplitStarModel
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    (T : forestComponentActualRightContractionSplitStarModel) :
    forestComponentActualRightContractionFieldRelabeling where
  forest_field_relabel
proof:
:= by
    intro g q hq C
    rcases T.forest_model g q hq C with ⟨starOf, hFresh, hActual⟩
    rcases admissibleForestContractFreshStarFieldRelabeling_of_wellFormed
        (repG_wellFormed g) q.1.1 q.1.2 starOf hFresh with
      ⟨τ, hV, hI, hE⟩
    have hOrig :
        forestComponentChoiceOriginalRightContractGraph g q =
          (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestContractGraphWithStars
            (repG g).toFeynmanGraph q.1.1 starOf).mapPerm τ := by
      apply FeynmanGraph.mk.injEq _ _ _ _ _ _ |>.mpr
      exact ⟨hV, hI, hE⟩
    have hOrigActual :
        forestComponentChoiceOriginalRightContractGraph g q =
          (forestComponentForestChoiceActualRightContractGraph g q hq C
            ).mapPerm τ := by
      rw [hOrig, hActual]
    have hActualGraph :
        forestComponentForestChoiceActualRightContractGraph g q hq C =
          (forestComponentChoiceOriginalRightContractGraph g q).mapPerm τ⁻¹ :=
      graph_eq_mapPerm_inv_of_eq_mapPerm
        (forestComponentChoiceOriginalRightContractGraph g q)
        (forestComponentForestChoiceActualRightContractGraph g q hq C)
        τ hOrigActual
    refine ⟨τ⁻¹, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact congrArg FeynmanGraph.vertices hActualGraph
    · exact congrArg FeynmanGraph.internalEdges hActualGraph
    · exact congrArg FeynmanGraph.externalLegs hActualGraph
  mixed_field_relabel := by
    intro g q hq
    rcases T.mixed_model g q hq with ⟨starOf, hFresh, hActual⟩
    rcases admissibleForestContractFreshStarFieldRelabeling_of_wellFormed
        (repG_wellFormed g) q.1.1 q.1.2 starOf hFresh with
      ⟨τ, hV, hI, hE⟩
    have hOrig :
        forestComponentChoiceOriginalRightContractGraph g q =
          (FeynmanGraph.admissibleForestContractGraphWithStars
            (repG g).toFeynmanGraph q.1.1 starOf).mapPerm τ := by
      apply FeynmanGraph.mk.injEq _ _ _ _ _ _ |>.mpr
      exact ⟨hV, hI, hE⟩
    have hOrigActual :
        forestComponentChoiceOriginalRightContractGraph g q =
          (forestComponentMixedBoundaryActualRightContractGraph g q hq
            ).mapPerm τ := by
      rw [hOrig, hActual]
    have hActualGraph :
        forestComponentMixedBoundaryActualRightContractGraph g q hq =
          (forestComponentChoiceOriginalRightContractGraph g q).mapPerm τ⁻¹ :=
      graph_eq_mapPerm_inv_of_eq_mapPerm
        (forestComponentChoiceOriginalRightContractGraph g q)
        (forestComponentMixedBoundaryActualRightContractGraph g q hq)
        τ hOrigActual
    refine ⟨τ⁻¹, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact congrArg FeynmanGraph.vertices hActualGraph
    · exact congrArg FeynmanGraph.internalEdges hActualGraph
    · exact congrArg FeynmanGraph.externalLegs hActualGraph

statement:
private theorem coassoc_strict_forest_linear_of_split_phi_actual_right_relabeling
    [IsDivergencePreservedByAdmissibleForestContract]
    (C : ∀ g q, ∀ hq : q ∈ forestComponentForestChoiceSigmaIndex g,
      forestComponentForestChoiceRemnantPositiveComponentsCertificate g q hq)
    (I : ∀ g : HopfGen, forestComponentSplitPhiBranchInverseCover g)
    (T : forestComponentActualRightContractionRelabeling) :
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.assoc ℚ ℚ ℚ HopfH HopfH HopfH).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
        coproduct_strict_forest.toLinearMap.rTensor HopfH ∘ₗ
        coproduct_strict_forest.toLinearMap
      =
    coproduct_strict_forest.toLinearMap.lTensor HopfH ∘ₗ
      coproduct_strict_forest.toLinearMap
proof:
:=
  coassoc_strict_forest_linear_of_split_phi_actual_right_payloads C I
    (fun g q hq => by
      change
        (forestComponentChoiceOriginalRightContractGraph g q).toClass =
          (forestComponentForestChoiceActualRightContractGraph
            g q hq (C g q hq)).toClass
      rcases T.forest_relabel g q hq (C g q hq) with ⟨τ, hτ⟩
      exact (FeynmanGraph.toClass_eq_iff _ _).mpr ⟨τ, hτ⟩)
    (fun g q hq => by
      change
        (forestComponentChoiceOriginalRightContractGraph g q).toClass =
          (forestComponentMixedBoundaryActualRightContractGraph g q hq).toClass
      rcases T.mixed_relabel g q hq with ⟨τ, hτ⟩
      exact (FeynmanGraph.toClass_eq_iff _ _).mpr ⟨τ, hτ⟩)
